Semantic-ID methods rely on quantization, mutable identifier vocabularies, and token-to-item grounding; embedding-based pipelines train the item encoder separately from the query generator, which limits user-item alignment. We propose EGR, an Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval framework for recommendation and advertising. EGR uses a single shared LLM to learn item representations from item metadata and user representations from interaction histories in one embedding space. Items are indexed directly as dense vectors, and user histories are encoded as dense retrieval queries. Joint contrastive training groups related items and aligns queries with their target items. We evaluate EGR on public benchmarks, industrial data, and live deployment. EGR outperforms published baselines on Amazon Reviews; on Snap DPA, it scales with data, handles cold-start items, and benefits from multimodal input. In production, EGR delivers a +2.91% conversion-rate lift, simplifying system design while improving retrieval quality and ad performance.

AI.tldr: EGR是一个嵌入原生生成式检索框架，使用单个共享LLM统一学习项目和用户表示，通过联合对比训练对齐查询与目标项目，在公开基准、工业数据和实际部署中均表现优异，实现+2.91%的转化率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式检索方法存在语义ID依赖离散量化、变标识符词汇表及token到项目映射等复杂性；基于嵌入的流水线将项目编码器与查询生成器分离训练，限制了用户-项目对齐效果。
AI.method: 提出EGR框架，使用单一共享LLM在同一嵌入空间中学习项目表示（来自项目元数据）和用户表示（来自交互历史）。项目直接以稠密向量索引，用户历史编码为稠密检索查询，通过联合对比训练将相关项目聚类并对齐查询与目标项目。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews上超越现有基准；在Snap DPA上具备数据规模扩展性、冷启动处理能力和多模态输入优势；生产部署中带来+2.91%的转化率提升。
AI.conclusion: EGR在简化系统设计的同时提升了检索质量和广告性能，验证了嵌入原生生成式检索在大规模推荐和广告系统中的有效性。

title: AssumptionMiner: Extracting, Tracing, and Revising Implicit Assumptions in LLM Code Generation
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21535058
summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate code from natural-language prompts, yet real-world prompts rarely provide complete specifications. When prompts leave input formats, error handling, or design decisions unspecified, LLMs fill these gaps with implicit assumptions that shape the generated code's behavior and correctness. Because these assumptions remain hidden, generated code may satisfy tests while violating developer intent. We present AssumptionMiner, a framework that makes implicit assumptions a first-class artifact of LLM-based code generation. In addition to code, AssumptionMiner produces an explicit assumption layer, a structured representation of inferred constraints and design decisions that developers can inspect, confirm, or revise. An AST-based dependency graph enables targeted regeneration of only the code affected by a revised assumption. We also introduce a benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with 676 annotated assumptions, including a human-verified subset for evaluating code localization. We evaluate assumption extraction, code localization, and assumption-guided regeneration. Across open-source LLMs, a confidence-weighted ensemble achieves an F1 score of 0.816 for assumption extraction, improving on the strongest offline baseline by 3.6x. On the human-verified localization benchmark, AST-guided localization identifies more precise code regions than keyword-based and whole-file baselines. During assumption revision, targeted regeneration modifies less code than non-targeted alternatives while exposing challenges in handling cascading edits. These results demonstrate that making assumptions explicit improves the transparency and controllability of LLM-based code generation.

AI.tldr: 提出AssumptionMiner框架，将LLM代码生成中的隐含假设显式化，通过假设提取、代码定位和定向重生成，提升代码生成的透明度和可控性。
AI.motivation: LLM从模糊的自然语言提示生成代码时会隐含假设，这些假设不可见且可能导致代码满足测试但违反开发者意图，因此需要将这些假设显式化。
AI.method: 提出AssumptionMiner框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 显式假设层（结构化表示约束和设计决策）；2) 基于AST的依赖图（支持定向重生成）；3) 置信度加权集成方法（用于假设提取）。同时构建了180个模糊编程任务的基准数据集。
AI.result: 置信度加权集成在假设提取F1分数达0.816，比最强离线基线提升3.6倍；AST引导的代码定位比关键词和全文件基线更精确；定向重生成修改代码量少于非定向方法。
AI.conclusion: 将隐含假设显式化能有效提升LLM代码生成的可控性和透明性，为开发者提供可检查、确认和修正的假设层。

title: Between Suppression and Collapse: Evaluating Narrative Unlearning with LENS
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce disinformation-aligned narrative frames as plausible explanations, raising the question of whether existing machine-unlearning algorithms can suppress this behavior. We introduce Level-based Evaluation of Narrative Suppression (LENS), a contextualization based evaluation protocol for testing target narrative reproduction across direct, attributed, contrastive, and abstract resistance levels. We evaluate two source-grounded narratives: one framing Russia's war against Ukraine as forced by NATO expansion, and one framing the United States as exploiting or abandoning Taiwan. The experiments cover four near-12B multilingual instruction models: Lapa LLM, Gemma-12B, Qwen-14B, and TAIDE-Gemma.
  We introduce the Suppression-Collapse Efficiency (SCE) score as a checkpoint selection summary that rewards target-narrative suppression while penalizing degraded outputs. Our results shows that selected checkpoints can reduce narrative reproduction and suppression may transfer beyond direct forget prompts. We also report entity recovery as a separate side effect: abstract A/B/C prompts can cause models to recover the real-world actors associated with the target frame after unlearning. These findings demonstrate that LENS is a successful diagnostic protocol for both reporting and guiding the further study of the deeper structure of narrative unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LENS评估协议，用于测试大模型在机器遗忘后是否仍会复述特定叙事框架（如俄乌战争叙事、美国涉台叙事）。实验覆盖4个12B参数多语言模型，引入SCE分数衡量抑制效果，发现遗忘可能跨提示类型迁移，但也存在实体恢复副作用。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可能复述与虚假信息一致的叙事框架，现有机器遗忘算法能否抑制这种行为尚不明确，因此需要系统化的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出LENS评估协议，涵盖直接、归因、对比和抽象四种抵抗层级；引入SCE分数作为检查点选择指标；在4个12B多语言模型上测试两个源叙事（北约东扩-俄乌战争叙事、美国利用/抛弃台湾叙事）。
AI.result: 选定的检查点可减少叙事复述，抑制效果可迁移至直接遗忘提示之外；但存在实体恢复副作用——抽象A/B/C提示可能导致模型在遗忘后恢复目标框架中的真实行为者。
AI.conclusion: LENS是一个成功的诊断协议，可用于报告和指导叙事遗忘深层结构的进一步研究。

title: Histopathological Spectrum-Guided Prostate Stratification via Segmentation-Assisted Diagnostic Transformer
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, and 4 tables. Code will be made publicly available in a future revision
summary: Prostate cancer diagnosis with multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) is commonly based on PI-RADS assessment or binary classification, which suffer from subjectivity and fail to capture clinically relevant pathological heterogeneity. To address this limitation, we construct a Prostate Cancer Histopathology Spectrum Dataset (PCa-HSD) and formulate a clinically meaningful four-class classification task, addressing the underrepresentation of benign lesions that are easily confounded with prostate cancer in existing datasets. We propose Language-guided Segmentation-assisted Diagnostic Transformer model (LSDT), which leverages zero-shot segmentation to provide anatomical priors and performs effective multi-modal slice fusion for classification. Our proposed method consistently improves accuracy across backbones, achieving the best average accuracy of 0.633 and JointRecall of 0.768 in five-fold cross-validation on a cohort of 344 patients. These results demonstrate that integrating pathology supervision and anatomical priors significantly enhances fine-grained prostate MRI classification and provides a more clinically relevant paradigm for risk stratification. Code will be made publicly available in a future revision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了前列腺癌组织病理学谱数据集（PCa-HSD）和语言引导分割辅助诊断Transformer模型（LSDT），通过四分类任务和零样本分割技术，在344名患者队列中实现了平均准确率0.633和联合召回率0.768，有效提升了MRI细粒度分类的临床实用性。
AI.motivation: 当前基于PI-RADS或二分类的前列腺癌mpMRI诊断存在主观性强、无法捕捉病理异质性的问题，且现有数据集缺乏易与癌症混淆的良性病变样本，限制了临床风险分层能力。
AI.method: 构建PCa-HSD四类分类数据集；提出LSDT模型，利用零样本分割提供解剖先验，并结合多模态切片融合进行细粒度分类。
AI.result: 在344名患者五折交叉验证中，最佳平均准确率0.633，JointRecall达0.768，各骨干网络下均有稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 整合病理监督和解剖先验能有效增强MRI细粒度分类，为临床风险分层提供了更具临床相关性的范式。

title: QFedPolyp: A Communication- and Inference-Efficient Federated Learning Framework for Polyp Segmentation
summary:
Background and Objective: Automatic polyp segmentation supports computer-aided diagnosis and early colorectal cancer detec- tion. Centralized deep learning requires hospitals to share sensitive medical data, while federated learning preserves privacy but introduces high communication costs through repeated transmission of full-precision model parameters. We propose QFedPolyp, a communication- and inference-efficient federated learning framework for collaborative polyp segmentation.
  Methods: QFedPolyp combines quantization-aware training with low-precision model communication. Each hospital locally trains a lightweight U-Net on private data while simulating quantization during training. Clients transmit quantized model parameters to a central server, where they are reconstructed and aggregated using Federated Averaging. Evaluation is performed on Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicVideoDB, PolypGen, and BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp.
  Results: Full-precision federated training achieves Dice scores of 0.910 on Kvasir-SEG and 0.930 on CVC-ClinicVideoDB. Uni- form 8-bit communication reduces transmission cost by approximately 4 times while preserving competitive segmentation accuracy. Quantized models also achieve up to 1.5 times faster inference than full-precision models.
  Conclusions: QFedPolyp enables privacy-preserving collaborative polyp segmentation with reduced communication overhead and faster inference. The resulting lightweight models are suitable for real-time clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出QFedPolyp框架，通过量化感知训练实现隐私保护的协作式息肉分割，在保持分割精度的同时将通信成本降低约4倍，推理速度提升1.5倍。
AI.motivation: 集中式深度学习需要共享敏感医疗数据存在隐私风险，而联邦学习虽保护隐私但全精度模型参数的反复传输带来高昂通信成本。
AI.method: 将量化感知训练与低精度模型通信结合：各医院本地训练轻量U-Net并模拟量化过程，客户端传输量化后参数至中央服务器，使用联邦平均算法进行聚合重建。
AI.result: 全精度联邦训练在Kvasir-SEG和CVC-ClinicVideoDB上Dice分别达0.910和0.930；8位均匀量化通信成本降低约4倍，分割精度几乎无损；量化模型推理速度提升最高1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: QFedPolyp在保护隐私前提下实现协作息肉分割，显著降低通信开销并提升推理效率，轻量模型适合临床实时部署。

title: DeepLens Diagnosis Agent: Agentic Workflow Design Lets a Small Reasoning Model Compete with Frontier LLMs
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Technical report, John Snow Labs
summary:
Medical diagnosis is a multi-stage process: extract facts, consult knowledge, generate a differential analysis, and select the best diagnosis with explanations. Frontier LLMs are strong generalists, but single-shot prompting often yields brittle diagnostic reasoning. We present the DeepLens Diagnosis Agent, a five-stage harnessing pipeline (combining model capabilities with disciplined process constraints) centered on a small medical reasoning model (JSL Medical Small 7B v2) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The pipeline enforces structured clinical extraction, disciplined retrieval, constrained candidate generation, explicit evidence triangulation, and an auditable final decision. On the 915-case DiagnosisArena benchmark, the agent achieved 60.14% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, the highest among small and medium-sized models. The same model without the agent workflow achieved 23.99%, a +36-point gain from workflow design alone, despite 88.2% on standard medical benchmarks, showing that diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty requires more than knowledge recall. The agent costs USD 0.0072 per case (24K tokens on A100) with 24-second latency, 35-45% cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 (USD 0.0110) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (USD 0.0128) while outperforming them by +9.70pp and +9.17pp. Harnessing can also correct frontier model failures; workflow constraints can outweigh parameter count or API cost.
  Beyond aggregate accuracy, the pipeline produces structured intermediate artifacts that make each stage inspectable and support error localization. These properties support high-stakes settings where traceability, reproducibility, and auditable evidence matter alongside benchmark performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepLenz诊断智能体，通过五阶段流水线（结构化临床提取、约束检索、候选生成、证据三角验证、可审计决策）结合小型医学推理模型和RAG，在DiagnosisArena基准上达到60.14%的Top-1诊断准确率，比无流水线时提升36个百分点，成本仅$0.0072/例，优于Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在医学诊断中单次提示推理脆弱，缺乏结构化流程约束，难以应对不确定性下的诊断推理。
AI.method: 五阶段流水线：1)结构化临床信息提取；2)基于RAG的约束检索；3)约束候选生成；4)显式证据三角验证；5)可审计最终决策。核心模型为小规模医学推理模型JSL Medical Small 7B v2。
AI.result: 在915例DiagnosisArena上Top-1准确率60.14%，无流水线仅23.99%（+36pp）；成本$0.0072/例，延迟24秒；比Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro准确率高9.70pp和9.17pp，成本低35-45%。
AI.conclusion: 流水线约束比模型参数量或API成本更重要；结构化中间产物支持可追溯、可复现、可审计的高风险诊断场景。

title: Fair Division with Strictly Increasing Valuations: A Tight Threshold for Two-Agent EF1 and PO
summary: We study whether strictly positive marginal values restore the compatibility of envy-freeness up to one good (EF1) and Pareto optimality (PO) for indivisible goods. For two agents, we identify the exact threshold in the number of goods. Every instance with at most seven goods and strictly increasing valuations admits an allocation that is both EF1 and PO, without any submodularity assumption. In contrast, we construct an eight-good instance with normalized, integer-valued, strictly increasing, submodular valuations in which every EF1 allocation is strictly Pareto dominated. Thus, eight goods are necessary and sufficient for a two-agent counterexample. Finally, we strengthen the three-agent NP-hardness result of Chandramouleeswaran and Nimbhorkar (2026): deciding whether an EF1 and PO allocation exists remains NP-hard for normalized, integer-valued, monotone submodular valuations even when zero marginals are confined to eight fixed agent-good pairs, all involving a single agent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究严格正边际价值能否恢复不可分物品的EF1与PO的兼容性。对于两个智能体，确定了精确的商品数量阈值：最多7个商品时总是存在EF1+PO分配；但8个商品时存在反例。对于三个智能体，加强了NP-hard结果。
AI.motivation: 探索严格正边际价值是否能使EF1和PO兼容，并确定两个智能体情况下兼容性的精确阈值。
AI.method: 通过理论推导和构造反例，分析不同商品数量下EF1和PO分配的存在性，并加强NP-hard性结果。
AI.result: 两个智能体时，7个商品以内总是存在EF1+PO分配；8个商品时存在反例。三个智能体时，即使将零边际价值限制在8个固定智能体-商品对上，NP-hard性依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 严格正边际价值在一定条件下能恢复EF1与PO的兼容性，但存在精确的阈值；且该问题在更严格的条件下仍然是NP-hard的。

title: Limbomorphs
comment: 3 pages, 3 figures. Extended abstract accepted as a Late Breaking Abstract at the Artificial Life Conference (ALIFE 2026)
summary: Artificial life systems are typically defined by a set of dynamical rules over an environment, an agent, or both, from which lifelike patterns may emerge. Gifbreeder is an animated version of the interactive evolutionary computation (IEC) platform Picbreeder, and was initially created to generate visual art. Instead of encoding the agent or the environment, Gifbreeder genomes encode a spatiotemporal field and evolve through the user's aesthetic selection. The evolved expressions can sometimes resemble motile lifelike creatures that we term Limbomorphs, given that they exist in a deterministic three-second looping "limbo". We assess their behavior via input-space perturbations and find species-specific reactions to different kinds of perturbations. We discuss whether these reactions may reflect goal-directed behavior like navigation, or merely the appearance of it, and more broadly how agent-like dynamics may emerge in a system with no explicitly defined agent, environment, or interaction rules.

AI.tldr: Gifbreeder通过进化时空场而非传统智能体/环境规则，生成了类似生命体的动图（Limbomorphs），并在扰动测试中表现出物种特异性反应，探讨了无明确智能体定义下涌现类智能行为的可能性。
AI.motivation: 探索在没有明确定义智能体、环境或交互规则的人工生命系统中，类生命模式（尤其是类智能体行为）能否自发涌现。
AI.method: 基于Picbreeder的交互式进化计算（IEC）平台Gifbreeder，基因组编码时空场而非智能体或环境，通过用户审美选择进行进化，并对进化结果进行输入空间扰动测试。
AI.result: 进化出的Limbomorphs在扰动下表现出物种特异性反应，暗示类智能体行为的存在。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了这些反应是否反映了真正的目标导向行为（如导航），或仅仅是对此类行为的模仿；更广泛地探讨了在无显式定义智能体、环境和交互规则的系统中，类智能体动力学如何涌现。

title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
comment: To be published in the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (recsys'26), September 27 - October 2, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA
summary: Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) require retrieving relevant items from multi-million product catalogs, balancing two competing objectives: retargeting (re-surfacing known interests) and prospecting (discovering new categories). While Large Language Models (LLMs) capture semantic intent better than traditional embedding models, deploying them at scale introduces prohibitive inference costs and lexical mismatch issues. Through controlled experiments on millions of users, we demonstrate a critical retrieval decomposition: rule-generated queries excel at retargeting on a lexical BM25 index, while LLM-generated queries excel at prospecting on a dense ANN index. Building on this, we propose SMART (SeMantic-aware Adaptive ReTrieval). To manage costs, a lightweight quality gate identifies coverage gaps in initial keyword results, adaptively routing only the ~10% of users who benefit from semantic prospecting to the LLM path. Offline evaluation demonstrates that this gated approach captures the bulk of semantic prospecting gains in Relevance Score while maintaining competitive re-targeting performance at a 90% reduction in LLM costs. Finally, in a 2-week online A/B test at Snap, SMART improved the ad conversion rate by +27.6% over a strong embedding-based baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SMART方法，通过轻量级门控机制在BM25索引上用规则查询进行重定向、在ANN索引上用LLM查询进行探索，仅路由约10%用户至LLM路径，实现广告转化率提升27.6%且降低90%LLM成本。
AI.motivation: DPA需要从百万级商品目录中检索相关物品，面临重定向（重新挖掘已知兴趣）和探索（发现新类别）两大目标的权衡。传统嵌入模型语义理解不足，而LLM虽能捕捉语义意图，但大规模部署存在高昂推理成本和词汇不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出SMART框架：1）通过对照实验发现规则查询在BM25索引上擅长重定向，LLM查询在ANN索引上擅长探索；2）设计轻量级质量门控，识别初始关键词结果的覆盖缺口，仅将约10%能从语义探索中受益的用户路由至LLM路径。
AI.result: 离线评估：在Relevance Score上捕获了大部分语义探索增益，同时保持竞争性重定向性能，LLM成本降低90%。在线A/B测试：广告转化率相比强嵌入基线提升27.6%。
AI.conclusion: SMART通过检索分解与自适应路由，以极小成本实现语义探索与高效重定向的平衡，证明了门控机制在实际广告系统中的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Metamorphic Testing for Clinical ML Models: A Framework Proposal and Pilot Study
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at the AIware 2026 arXiv Track
summary:
Machine learning models for clinical prediction tasks, such as in-hospital mortality and sepsis onset, routinely achieve high AUROC scores. However, AUROC measures ranking performance rather than clinical sensibility. A model may rank patients correctly overall while predicting a lower mortality risk when a patient's SOFA score worsens, contradicting established medical knowledge.
  This paper proposes applying metamorphic testing (MT) to clinical machine learning models to evaluate behavioral correctness without requiring ground-truth labels for individual predictions. We design a catalog of 12 candidate metamorphic relations (MRs) for three ICU prediction tasks using the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets, with each MR grounded in an authoritative clinical guideline. We further propose a five-layer validation strategy to ensure that MRs are clinically sound before deployment.
  As a feasibility study, we evaluate the approach on the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Although the three clinical models achieve strong predictive performance (AUROC = 0.849-0.900), they exhibit MT violation rates ranging from 27% to 87% across five pilot MRs. An injected-fault experiment further shows that a sign-negation error in a blood pressure feature remains undetected by AUROC but increases the MT violation rate by 31-67 percentage points. These findings suggest that metamorphic testing provides a valuable complement to conventional performance metrics for assessing the behavioral correctness of clinical prediction models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将蜕变测试（MT）应用于临床机器学习模型，通过12条基于临床指南的蜕变关系（MRs）评估模型行为正确性。实验表明，尽管模型AUROC高达0.849-0.900，但MT违反率高达27%-87%，且AUROC无法检测到特征符号错误，而MT能有效发现。
AI.motivation: 传统AUROC指标仅衡量排序性能而非临床合理性，例如模型可能在SOFA评分恶化时反而预测更低死亡风险，违背医学常识。因此需要一种不依赖真实标签就能评估模型行为正确性的方法。
AI.method: 1) 设计12条基于临床指南的蜕变关系（MRs），涵盖三个ICU预测任务（MIMIC-III/IV）；2) 提出五层验证策略确保MRs临床合理性；3) 在UCI心脏病数据集上进行可行性研究，评估5条试点MRs；4) 开展注入故障实验（血压特征符号反转）。
AI.result: 三种临床模型AUROC达0.849-0.900，但MT违反率在27%-87%之间。注入符号反转错误后AUROC无变化，但MT违反率提升了31-67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 蜕变测试可作为传统性能指标的有力补充，更有效地检测临床预测模型的行为异常，尤其在AUROC无法捕捉的语义错误方面表现突出。

title: PatiGonit22K: A Comprehensive Dataset for Solving Complex Bengali MWPs
summary: Mathematical Word Problems (MWPs) are an important benchmark for evaluating natural language understanding and quantitative reasoning. Despite recent progress in high resource languages, Bengali remains underexplored due to the limited availability of large scale annotated datasets. In this work, we introduce PatiGonit22K, an expanded Bengali MWP dataset containing 22,441 problems, developed by extending the original PatiGonit dataset with a substantially larger collection of complex mathematical problems. The dataset includes both simple and multi operation equations, providing a balanced benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning across different difficulty levels. Each problem is carefully translated, annotated, culturally adapted, and verified to ensure linguistic consistency and mathematical correctness. By increasing both the scale and complexity of Bengali MWPs, PatiGonit22K provides a more comprehensive resource for future research on mathematical reasoning and educational NLP applications in low resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了 PatiGonit22K，一个包含 22,441 道题目的孟加拉语数学应用题数据集，旨在解决低资源语言数学推理研究数据匮乏的问题。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语等低资源语言缺乏大规模、高质量的数学应用题标注数据集，限制了相关 NLP 模型的研究发展。
AI.method: 在原有 PatiGonit 数据集基础上进行扩展，新增大量复杂数学问题，确保文化适配、翻译准确和数学正确性，最终形成包含简单和多步运算的 22,441 道题目。
AI.result: 成功构建了 PatiGonit22K 数据集，包含 22,441 道题目，涵盖简单和多步运算，为难度的平衡评估提供了基准。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为低资源语言（特别是孟加拉语）的数学推理和 NLP 教育应用提供了更全面、更具挑战性的资源，有助于推动该领域未来研究。

title: Visible-Light Imaging Diagnosis of Neutral Particle Emission Tomography in the Tokamak Divertor: An Efficient Transformer-based Surrogate Model
summary: Nuclear fusion has made significant progress in recent years and is expected to become one of the most important pathways to addressing global energy challenges. This paper focuses on observing plasma using visible-light cameras, analyzing its spatio-temporal motion cues, and predicting the two-dimensional spatial distribution of light intensity, aiming to provide a foundational basis for future scientific experiments using deep neural networks. Specifically, we propose Delta-InvFormer, a novel backbone network centered on a differential Transformer. The key insight is that by taking consecutive video frames as input, we can better capture the dynamics of the plasma. Moreover, spatial and temporal differential self-attention effectively mitigates interference from noisy signals, ensuring high-quality feature extraction. These features are then fused into a compact and informative representation, which is fed into a decoder network to predict the distribution. Based on real experimental data collected from the Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) large-scale scientific facility, our results demonstrate that the proposed model not only significantly accelerates traditional methods for distribution prediction but also achieves competitive reconstruction accuracy. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion

AI.tldr: 本文提出Delta-InvFormer，一种基于差分Transformer的骨干网络，通过可见光相机观测等离子体视频帧，预测其二维光强分布，在EAST托卡马克数据上实现了快速且准确的分布预测。
AI.motivation: 利用可见光相机观测等离子体，通过分析其时空运动线索预测光强二维空间分布，为未来基于深度神经网络的科学实验提供基础依据。
AI.method: 提出Delta-InvFormer骨干网络，核心是差分Transformer：以连续视频帧为输入，利用空间和时序差分自注意力机制有效抑制噪声信号，提取高质量特征，融合为紧凑表示后送入解码器进行分布预测。
AI.result: 基于EAST真实实验数据，Delta-InvFormer相比传统方法显著加速了分布预测，同时达到了有竞争力的重建精度。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在速度与精度之间取得了良好平衡，为核聚变等离子体观测提供了高效的深度学习方法，代码已开源。

title: Learning to Access Computation: Accessibility Plasticity as a Principle of Adaptive Intelligence
summary: Modern neural networks primarily adapt through parameter modification within predefined computational structures. While recent methods introduce modularity, conditional computation, and parameter-efficient adaptation, they generally do not distinguish computational capability from computational accessibility as separate adaptive variables. This work introduces Accessibility Plasticity, a principle of adaptive computation in which systems adapt not only by changing what computation exists, but also by reorganizing which existing computations can interact and participate. We formalize Accessibility Plasticity through a relationship-based operational realization and establish a reuse-first hierarchy of adaptation, where accessibility modification precedes more costly capability and structural changes. A proof-of-concept evaluation on sequential learning tasks shows that accessibility adaptation can reduce capability modification while maintaining comparable task performance. These results suggest accessibility as a distinct adaptive dimension and provide a foundation for future dynamic neural systems whose computational relationships evolve with changing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可及性可塑性"（Accessibility Plasticity）作为神经网络的新的自适应维度，通过修改计算组件之间的连接关系而非直接修改计算能力本身来实现适应，并在序列学习任务中证明其能减少能力修改同时保持性能。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络主要依赖修改参数（能力）来适应，缺乏区分"计算能力"和"计算可及性"作为独立自适应变量的视角。作者希望建立一种新的自适应原则，让系统通过重组现有计算组件的交互关系来适应。
AI.method: 形式化定义"可及性可塑性"为基于关系的操作实现；建立"重用优先"（reuse-first）的适应层次结构，其中可及性修改优先于更昂贵的能力修改和结构修改；在序列学习任务上进行概念验证评估。
AI.result: 可及性适应能够在减少能力修改的同时，保持与直接修改能力相当的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 可及性是一个独立的自适应维度，为未来计算关系随环境演化的动态神经系统的研究奠定了基础。

title: MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, we propose MIITA, a Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation framework for supervised CL under constrained storage. MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors, and retrieves them at inference time using semantic and uncertainty-based cues. The retrieved directions are applied through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation, enabling non-destructive reuse of past supervision without backbone updates, prompt extensions, or test-time backpropagation. A local theoretical analysis links this design to first-order loss reduction, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and directional coverage for retaining old-stage knowledge. Extensive experiments across diverse supervised CL settings show that MIITA consistently improves final performance and mitigates forgetting under fixed memory budgets.

AI.tldr: MIITA提出了一种针对资源受限小语言模型的持续学习框架，通过存储压缩的校正方向原型并在推理时进行门控隐藏状态适配，在不更新主干网络的情况下实现知识保留。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型参数空间有限，直接更新会导致灾难性遗忘。现有基于记忆的方法为大语言模型设计，依赖大存储空间和强上下文推理能力，不适用于资源受限的小语言模型部署场景。
AI.method: 将监督经验存储为带语义锚点的压缩校正方向原型，推理时基于语义和不确定性线索检索，通过门控临时隐藏状态适配实现非破坏性知识重用，无需骨干更新、提示扩展或测试时反向传播。
AI.result: 多种持续学习实验表明，在固定记忆预算下，MIITA持续提升最终性能并有效缓解遗忘问题。
AI.conclusion: MIITA为资源受限场景下的小语言模型持续学习提供了一种有效的记忆驱动推理时适配方案，理论分析表明该方法与一阶损失降低、不确定性引导检索和方向覆盖相关联。

title: The Tiered Clinching Auction with Applications to Carbon Offset Markets
summary: Voluntary carbon offsetting is a strategy which has been pursued globally by corporations to reduce their effective carbon emissions. Carbon offset markets currently suffer from low liquidity: offsets are highly heterogeneous, the landscape of accreditation is fragmented, and the market lacks a centralized trading infrastructure which would provide clear demand and price signaling to producers and buyers of offsets. In this paper, we propose an ascending auction mechanism which can be applied to the sale of carbon offsets. It generalizes Ausubel's clinching auction to a setting with items of tiered quality. The central idea behind the clinching mechanism is that bidders are allocated items when their opponents' demand drops below the supply. This is generalized to multiple nested submarkets where clinching can occur in the tiered case. Assuming that bidders have a minimum quality level that they will accept but are indifferent to quality beyond that, along with having decreasing marginal utility, we obtain that the auction generates the efficient outcome and charges VCG prices. As a result, sincere bidding is a weakly dominant strategy given private values. Moreover, the auction can be implemented in polynomial time. Beyond offset markets, this auction can be applied to any market where items can be ordered on a scale and bidders have a cutoff point for desiring items on the scale, such as hotel room bookings, concert ticketing and sponsored search auctions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对碳抵消市场流动性低的问题，提出了一种适用于分级质量物品的上升式拍卖机制，该机制推广了Ausubel的紧缩拍卖，在投标人具有最低质量接受阈值和递减边际效用假设下，实现了有效配置和VCG定价，且投标人的诚实报价是弱占优策略。
AI.motivation: 碳抵消市场存在严重低流动性问题：抵消产品高度异质、认证体系碎片化、缺乏集中交易基础设施，导致供需双方缺乏清晰的价格信号。现有市场机制无法有效解决这些问题，因此需要设计一种新的拍卖机制来提升市场效率。
AI.method: 提出一种上升式紧缩拍卖机制，将Ausubel的紧缩拍卖推广到分级质量物品场景。核心思想是当投标人的对手需求低于供给时，该投标人获得物品。该方法被推广到多个嵌套子市场，允许在分级情况下发生紧缩。算法可在多项式时间内实现。
AI.result: 在投标人具有最低可接受质量水平（高于该水平对质量无差异）和递减边际效用的假设下，该拍卖产生有效配置，收取VCG价格；诚实报价是弱占优策略；算法可在多项式时间内运行。
AI.conclusion: 该拍卖机制不仅适用于碳抵消市场，还可推广至任何物品可按等级排序且投标人具有截止点的市场，如酒店预订、演唱会票务和赞助搜索拍卖等场景。

title: Statistically Supported LLM Ingredient and Recipe Data Collection in Computational Nutrition
summary: Computational nutrition needs precise ingredient data, but current databases are incomplete, inconsistent, and built for human reference rather than automated reasoning. LLMs could help fill these gaps, but single-pass outputs are unreliable and can introduce silent errors into downstream computation. We present a quality-controlled LLM pipeline for ingredient data acquisition that combines robust statistical estimation, domain-specific invariant checks, and a web-fetch fallback. An illustrative Heap's Law fit to 233 recipes suggests that unique-ingredient growth is sub-linear and front-loaded: the projected ratio of unique ingredients to recipes falls from 1.74 at 100 recipes to 0.19 at 5,000. For each ingredient attribute, repeated LLM queries are treated as samples from a model-induced answer distribution, and we apply robust point estimators and normalised confidence scores across numerical, Boolean, multiple-choice, open categorical, and optional integer types. An invariant guard layer enforces nutritional and logical self-consistency within each ingredient record. Minor numeric inconsistencies are reconciled via a linear program that minimises worst-case percentage deviation while preserving semantic zeros, and major violations are escalated to web-evidence-grounded repair, then human review only if that fails. On a curated 30-ingredient reference set, the pipeline achieves 98.4% exact match on nutrient flags and cuts median absolute percentage error on nutrient ratios from 31.9% for the median-aggregated baseline to 10.1%, a reduction of 21.8 percentage points, at an API cost of about $1 per ingredient. This frames LLM-assisted database construction as a controlled data-engineering workflow that makes uncertainty operational rather than discarding it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个质量控制LLM管线，用于从食谱中提取食材营养数据。该管线结合统计估计、领域不变性检查和网络回退机制，通过重复查询、鲁棒估计和不变性检查层处理LLM输出的不确定性。在30个食材的参考集上，营养标志精确匹配率达98.4%，营养比率中位绝对百分比误差从31.9%降至10.1%，API成本约每食材1美元。
AI.motivation: 当前营养数据库不完整、不一致，且是为人工参考而非自动推理设计。LLM虽可填补数据空白，但单次输出不可靠，会向下游计算引入静默错误，因此需要一个可控、可量化不确定性的数据获取流程。
AI.method: 构建质量控制LLM管线：(1) 对每个食材属性进行重复LLM查询，将多次回答视为模型诱导的答案分布；(2) 针对数值、布尔、多选、开放分类和可选整数类型，应用鲁棒点估计和归一化置信度评分；(3) 不变性检查层强制营养与逻辑自洽性，微小数值不一致通过线性规划（最小化最差百分比偏差）调和，重大违规则先通过网络证据修复，失败后再人工审核。此外还拟合Heap定律分析唯一食材增长模式。
AI.result: 在30个食材参考集上，营养标志精确匹配率达98.4%；营养比率中位绝对百分比误差从基线（中位聚合）的31.9%降至10.1%，降低21.8个百分点；API成本约每食材1美元。Heap定律拟合显示，唯一食材与食谱比例从100个食谱时的1.74降至5000个时的0.19。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将LLM辅助数据库构建重构为受控的数据工程工作流，使不确定性变得可操作而非被丢弃，为在计算营养学中安全使用LLM提供了可行框架。

title: Adversarial Test-Hardening for AI-Written Code: An Instrument Autopsy and a Pre-Registered Causal Estimate of the Critic Loop
comment: 26 pages. Two pre-registered experiments; protocols, all run receipts, and analysis code at https://github.com/Jott2121/crucible
summary: Large language models increasingly write both code and the tests meant to check it; coverage records what ran, not what was verified. We study an adversarial test-hardening loop under a mechanical oracle: a Tester model writes tests, mutation testing names surviving injected defects, and a Critic model writes tests to kill exactly those, with every verdict decided mechanically, so no model judges another's output. In Experiment 1, on five Python subjects (one same-lineage-loop cell could not be scored), the loop killed 105 mutants that one-shot generation missed and lost none, and the cross-lineage-Critic question returned a pre-declared null. The central finding was an autopsy: an earlier analysis reported a cross-lineage effect at p = 9.5e-66 that was an instrument artifact, an output cap silently truncating the verbose model, caught only by adversarial review of the completed analysis. Review then found a further confound, each arm resampling its own initial suite; Experiment 2 removes it. Under a pre-registered frozen-shared-round-0 design (five replicates on each of four subjects, seeds committed in advance), same-lineage Critic rounds killed 78% of the survivors the frozen initial suite left standing (mean incremental kill rate 0.783, 95% cluster-bootstrap interval [0.592, 0.935]), a within-replicate causal estimate; the cross-provider configuration showed a positive pilot difference (rate gap 0.178, 95% interval [0.039, 0.347]; magnitude dominated by a single replicate) at 5.5x lower arm cost. This compares two named model-provider-harness configurations, not an isolated lineage effect: part of the gap is one configuration's receipted operational failures, including truncation recurrences, now detected and scored rather than laundered. Cross-model comparisons can inherit the asymmetries of the harness that runs them. We release both protocols, all receipts, and the analysis code.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种对抗性测试强化循环，在机械裁决下通过Tester和Critic模型协作生成测试用例，利用变异测试杀死残留缺陷。实验发现，先前报道的跨谱系效应是仪器伪影（输出截断）所致，并通过预注册实验验证了同谱系Critic轮次可杀死78%的残留变异体，而跨提供商配置显示出正差异但部分由单一重复主导。结论：跨模型比较会继承运行框架的不对称性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型同时编写代码和测试，但覆盖率只记录执行了什么，未验证实际验证了什么。现有测试生成方法可能遗漏缺陷，需要更有效的测试强化机制。
AI.method: 提出对抗性测试强化循环：Tester模型生成测试，变异测试识别存活的注入缺陷，Critic模型针对这些缺陷编写测试。所有判定由机械裁决完成，无模型互评。实验采用预注册的冻结共享第0轮设计（四主题各五重复，种子预先提交）。
AI.result: 实验1中，循环杀死了一轮生成遗漏的105个变异体且无遗漏。实验2中，同谱系Critic轮次平均增量杀死率0.783（95% CI [0.592, 0.935]），跨提供商配置正差异0.178（95% CI [0.039, 0.347]），但幅度由一个重复主导，且部分差异来自配置的操作故障（包括截断复发）。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性测试强化循环可有效提升测试质量。先前报告的跨谱系效应是输出截断伪影。跨模型比较会继承运行框架的不对称性，需谨慎解释。研究释放了协议、收据和分析代码。

title: CHiPS: Character Histograms and Positional Signals for Lightweight Authorship Attribution in Romanian Texts
summary: We propose CHiPS, a lightweight character-level authorship attribution method for Romanian texts. All reported experiments are closed-set: the true author is one of the candidate authors in the training data. CHiPS studies two complementary fingerprints of writing style: CH-SVM, a character-histogram classifier based on one-character marginal distributions, and FFT12-LR, a positional-signal classifier that represents selected characters and punctuation classes as impulse trains (binary indicator sequences over character positions) and extracts Fourier/Welch spectral descriptors. We also report CHiPS-F, a leakage-safe decision-level fusion variant, and an optional top-5 listwise reranker trained only on out-of-fold predictions. The method requires no tokenization, syntactic analysis, pretrained language model, or transformer fine-tuning, and it avoids character $n$-gram features with $n \geq 2$ in the histogram component. On a locked grouped ROST split comprising 400 files from 392 source-text groups, written by 10 authors, with source-text-level evaluation and grouped five-fold model selection, CHiPS-F reaches 0.9310 accuracy and 0.9341 macro-F1. A matched but unrestricted character 2--5-gram TF--IDF SVM comparator reaches 1.0000 accuracy and macro-F1 on the same held-out groups, so the contribution is not a claim of best possible classification accuracy. Instead, the experiments ask how far restricted, transparent character evidence can go under strict leakage control. On ROSTories-cleaned, a secondary ROST-overlapping corpus comprising 1,248 files from 1,240 source-text groups, written by 19 authors, the same protocol gives 0.8919 accuracy and 0.8708 macro-F1 for CHiPS-R.

AI.tldr: CHiPS是一种轻量级的罗马尼亚语作者归属方法，仅使用字符级特征（直方图+位置信号），无需分词或预训练模型。在ROST数据集上达到0.9310准确率，但作者明确表示其贡献不在于最高准确率，而在于探究受限的纯字符证据在严格泄漏控制下能达到什么程度。
AI.motivation: 探究在严格泄漏控制下，仅使用受限制的、透明的字符级特征（而非n-gram或预训练模型）进行作者归属能达到怎样的效果。
AI.method: 提出CHiPS框架，包含两个互补的字符级特征：1) CH-SVM：基于单字符边际分布（直方图）的SVM分类器；2) FFT12-LR：将字符和标点符号表示为脉冲序列，提取傅里叶/Welch谱特征，用逻辑回归分类。另外还有CHiPS-F（决策级融合）和基于top-5的重排序器。
AI.result: 在ROST（10作者，400文件）上CHiPS-F达到0.9310准确率、0.9341 macro-F1；在ROSTories-cleaned（19作者，1,248文件）上CHiPS-R达到0.8919准确率、0.8708 macro-F1。作为对比，不受限的2-5元字符TF-IDF SVM达到1.0000准确率。
AI.conclusion: CHiPS证明了受限的、可解释的字符级特征在作者归属任务上具有实用价值，其贡献不在于追求最高准确率，而在于提供了一种无需分词、无需预训练模型的轻量级替代方案，同时验证了严格泄漏控制的重要性。

title: EditCLEVR: A Paired-Scene Intervention Benchmark for Compositional Faithfulness of Object-Centric Representations
summary: Object-centric learning aims to represent scenes as objects whose properties can be reused in new combinations. Existing evaluations usually score segmentation, single-image factor prediction, or downstream accuracy, but these tests do not directly ask whether a per-object representation behaves correctly under a controlled semantic edit. We introduce EditCLEVR, a paired-scene intervention benchmark in which each example contains a before/after pair of CLEVR-style renders with the same object indices and scene layout, and either exactly one known attribute change on one known object or a no-edit re-render for drift measurement. The protocol includes probe-free diagnostics for representation-change localization and stability, together with probe-decoded semantic faithfulness metrics that test whether the predicted scene change matches the intended intervention across in-distribution and compositional out-of-distribution (OOD) suites, allowing code-space movement and decoded object-attribute correctness to be evaluated separately. We introduce the semantic metric Scene-Graph Intervention Accuracy (SGIA), which requires the full after-scene prediction to be correct and the only predicted before-to-after semantic change to be the intended object-factor edit. We also establish Delta-SGIA as a companion diagnostic that checks the single-site change pattern without requiring the full after-scene graph to be correct. Baseline evaluations on ground-truth-mask backbones, learned-slot models, SAM 2 + frozen-ViT models, and one mask-feature hybrid indicate that CoGenT-OOD-core degradation can persist under ground-truth instance masks, that mask source accounts for part but not all of native performance, and that locality or stability alone can overstate semantic faithfulness. Code is available at https://github.com/torux-bughunter/EditCLEVR.

AI.tldr: 提出了EditCLEVR基准测试，通过受控场景编辑干预来评估面向对象表示的正确性，并引入SGIA和Delta-SGIA指标，发现现有方法在语义忠实度方面存在不足。
AI.motivation: 现有面向对象学习评估方法（分割、因子预测、下游准确率）无法直接检验对象表示在受控语义编辑下的行为是否正确，缺乏对表示变化定位和语义忠实度的直接诊断。
AI.method: 构建EditCLEVR配对场景干预基准，包含前后对比的CLEVR渲染图（已知单属性改变或无编辑重渲染）。提出无探针的诊断方法用于表示变化定位与稳定性，以及基于探针解码的语义忠实度指标。引入SGIA（场景图干预准确率）要求完整后场景预测正确且语义变化仅限目标编辑，Delta-SGIA检查单点变化模式而不需完整场景图正确。
AI.result: 在GT掩码骨干、学习型槽模型、SAM2+冻结ViT、掩码特征混合模型上的评估表明：CoGenT-OOD退化在GT实例掩码下仍然存在；掩码来源部分解释了原生性能差异；仅靠局部性或稳定性会高估语义忠实度。
AI.conclusion: EditCLEVR能更直接地诊断对象表示的语义正确性，现有方法在OOD组合泛化下的语义忠实度仍有显著差距。

title: Hierarchical Grading in Large Language Models
summary:
We introduce Graded Large Language Models (GLLMs), an algebraic framework that equips the representation space of a transformer with a grading and propagates the induced weighted scalar action through embeddings, self-attention, and the training objective. The construction extends the theory of graded neural networks and graded transformers to autoregressive language models while preserving expressive power, asymptotic computational complexity, and inference cost.
  The governing geometric picture is that of geometric invariant theory. The benefit of a grading is expressed by a Kempf--Ness functional on the grading torus; the grades that improve upon the uniform architecture form an open convex cone whose membership is decided by a Hilbert--Mumford-type criterion pairing a grade direction against two measurable profiles of the target and the data; the optimal grades are the coincidence point of two moment maps, given in closed form; and the ordinary transformer appears as a semistable isotropic point on the boundary of the cone: one member of a larger graded family rather than a distinguished optimum.
  Separately, for level-stratified targets we prove a minimax separation between the graded prior and its absence: over all estimators the risks of the graded and uniform target classes separate throughout an explicit window of sample sizes, by a factor that decays exponentially in the number of levels under geometric stratification. Both profiles are estimable offline, so the optimal grades solve a convex program certified before training begins. Because the grading is absorbed into the learned parameters after training, every GLLM compiles to a standard transformer of identical architecture and inference complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分级大语言模型（GLLM），通过代数框架为Transformer表示空间赋予分级结构，在不增加推理复杂度的情况下提升模型性能，并证明分级先验在分层目标上具有指数级极小化最优分离优势。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer架构缺乏对表示空间的结构化约束，传统均匀架构可能不是最优选择。作者希望引入分级理论来系统地优化表示空间的结构，同时保持模型的计算效率和推理成本不变。
AI.method: 基于分级神经网络和分级Transformer理论，将分级结构扩展到自回归语言模型。利用几何不变理论（Kempf-Ness泛函、Hilbert-Mumford准则、矩映射）刻画最优分级。分级通过凸优化离线求解，训练后编译为普通Transformer。
AI.result: 最优分级构成开凸锥，普通Transformer是边界上的半稳定各向同性点而非最优。对于分层目标，分级先验与均匀先验之间存在极小化最优风险分离，分离因子随层数呈指数衰减。
AI.conclusion: GLLM在不改变架构和推理成本的前提下提升了表达能力，分级可离线求解，训练后无缝编译为标准Transformer，具有实用价值。

title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
summary: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PAJAMA系统，通过程序蒸馏将LLM评判逻辑转化为可编程评判委员会，实现低成本、高透明度的自动化评估，在多个数据集上匹配13B LLM性能，并可作为奖励信号以极低成本超越专有LLM。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge成本高、延迟大、决策不透明，限制了可扩展性和可靠性，需要更高效、透明的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出程序蒸馏（program distillation），将LLM评判逻辑蒸馏为可编程评判委员会，每个程序直接评分；PAJAMA系统聚合多个程序判决，并引入置信度回退机制（低置信度时转LLM处理）。
AI.result: 在5个数据集和4个模型家族上，程序化评判可匹配13B规模LLM评判表现；PAJAMA的路径选择机制提升准确率和吞吐量；在RewardBench上，从程序判决蒸馏的奖励模型以两数量级更低的API成本超越专有LLM标签训练的奖励模型。
AI.conclusion: 程序蒸馏是一种简单高效的LLM评判替代方案，兼具透明性、可编辑性和低成本优势，在评估和奖励建模两个任务上均有出色表现。

title: Algorithms for Equilibria in Concurrent Stopping Games
summary:
Concurrent games are a standard model for multi-agent systems, with Nash equilibrium as their central solution concept. The associated \emph{constrained existence problem}---does a game admit a Nash equilibrium whose expected payoff lies within a prescribed interval for every player?---is undecidable, and remains so even for 10-player \emph{stopping} games, in which a terminal state is reached almost surely under every strategy profile. We give two routes to tractability.
  We first relax exactness and consider the problem of approximate constrained existence problem, parametrised by $\varepsilon$-NE, which decides whether an \(\varepsilon\)-Nash equilibrium with the prescribed payoffs exists. The algorithm runs in exponential time, and only polynomially in the bit-size of \(\varepsilon\). We complement it with a \PSPACE-hardness lower bound that holds already for turn-based games, and for pure equilibria as well.
  We then relax the solution concept, turning to \emph{extreme risk-sensitive equilibria} (XRSE), recently introduced for turn-based stochastic games. Here the players are partitioned into optimists and pessimists, who evaluate a strategy profile by the best, respectively the worst, payoff attainable with positive probability, instead of the expected payoff. We prove that the constrained existence problem for XRSE is \NP-complete on concurrent games, as for turn-based games.

AI.tldr: 本文研究并发博弈中纳什均衡的约束存在性问题的可判定性边界，通过引入ε-近似均衡（指数时间可解，PSPACE-hard下界）和极端风险敏感均衡（NP完全）两条路径实现可处理性。
AI.motivation: 并发博弈中纳什均衡的约束存在性问题是不可判定的，即使对于10人停止博弈也是如此。寻找其可处理的特例或近似版本。
AI.method: 1) 将约束存在性松弛为ε-近似约束存在性问题，设计指数时间算法（在ε的比特大小上呈多项式）。2) 将解概念替换为极端风险敏感均衡（XRSE），将玩家分为乐观者和悲观者，分别以最好/最坏支付评估策略。
AI.result: ε-近似均衡问题：指数时间算法，且对回合制博弈和纯均衡有PSPACE-hard下界；XRSE约束存在性：对并发博弈为NP-complete。
AI.conclusion: 通过放松精确性（ε-近似）或放松解概念（XRSE）可以绕过原始问题的不可判定性，获得可判定的复杂度边界。

title: Stress-Testing EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Decoding: Dataset Identity and Targeted Negative Controls
summary: Pretrained EEG foundation models are increasingly proposed for clinical decoding, but their transfer across populations and robustness to negative controls remain unclear. We benchmark six models (LaBraM, EEGMamba, CBraMod, REVE, BENDR, and BIOT) on five clinical tasks across four datasets using frozen linear probes with leave-one-subject-out, subject-grouped, or explicitly identified recording-level splits. Selected REVE findings are tested against random initialisation, random features, label permutation, scrambled-label fine-tuning, and projection sensitivity. On Korean dementia (CAUEEG, three-way), frozen REVE reaches 0.568 AUROC versus 0.769 for classical features; the ordering persists on a patient-disjoint held-out split (0.565 versus 0.768). Dataset identity is readily decoded from frozen embeddings (AUROC 1.000 at PCA-50; 0.9998 after band restriction and per-epoch z-scoring), whereas the same PCA-50 pipeline decodes Korean diagnosis at 0.528. A randomly initialised encoder also outperforms pretrained REVE on this task (0.659 versus 0.570). On Alzheimer's disease, Gaussian random projection and PCA of the same pretrained embeddings perform similarly, and classical features nominally exceed REVE at the subject level. The clearest controlled positive is cross-subject ictal detection on CHB-MIT (n=23), where REVE achieves 0.793 AUROC, 9.2 percentage points above a randomly initialised encoder. These results show that EEG foundation-model conclusions depend strongly on evaluation unit, dataset shift, comparator strength, and targeted controls.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了六种EEG基础模型在五个临床任务上的迁移能力与鲁棒性，发现模型表现高度依赖评估单元、数据集偏移及对照实验设计，多数场景下经典特征或随机初始化编码器反而表现更优，仅CHB-MIT癫痫检测任务显示明确正向效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管EEG基础模型被广泛提出用于临床解码，但其跨群体迁移能力和对负面控制的鲁棒性尚不清楚，亟需系统性基准测试。
AI.method: 对六种模型（LaBraM、EEGMamba、CBraMod、REVE、BENDR、BIOT）在五个临床任务、四个数据集上进行冻结线性探测评估，采用留一法、分组或显式记录级划分；对REVE进一步测试随机初始化、随机特征、标签置换、 scrambled标签微调及投影敏感性。
AI.result: 1) 在韩国痴呆症数据集上，冻结REVE AUROC为0.568，经典特征达0.769；2) 数据集身份可轻易从冻结嵌入中解码（AUROC 1.000），而诊断解码仅0.528；3) 随机初始化编码器在该任务上优于预训练REVE（0.659 vs 0.570）；4) 阿尔茨海默病任务中，高斯随机投影与PCA表现相似，经典特征略优于REVE；5) 唯一清晰的正向结果为CHB-MIT癫痫检测（REVE AUROC 0.793，比随机初始化高9.2个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: EEG基础模型的结论高度依赖于评估单元、数据集偏移、对比方法强度及针对性控制实验设计，需谨慎解读模型性能。

title: Choosing a Text Embedding Model: A Practical Benchmarking and Decision Framework
summary: Choosing the right text embedding model is one of the most consequential -- and most frequently under-examined -- decisions in building a retrieval or search system, yet the model that tops a leaderboard is rarely the best choice for a given deployment. This report develops a practical, evidence-based framework for embedding model selection, built on a benchmarking study that evaluates T3EM (Text 3 Embedding Model), a commercial API-based embedding model, against a broad set of open-source alternatives on English-language retrieval tasks, and situates these findings within the wider Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) landscape spanning classification, clustering, semantic similarity, reranking, pair classification, bitext mining, and summarization. Beyond raw benchmark scores, the report traces the full path from embedding model to retrieved result -- how embeddings are produced, how they are indexed and searched at scale, and how document chunking strategy shapes retrieval quality -- so that model choice can be reasoned about as one decision within a complete retrieval pipeline rather than in isolation. The result is a consolidated set of practical recommendations for selecting an embedding model according to task, latency, cost, and deployment constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于实证的嵌入模型选择框架，通过对比T3EM（商业API模型）与多种开源模型在检索任务上的表现，并结合MTEB基准测试结果，给出了根据任务、延迟、成本和部署约束选择嵌入模型的实用建议。
AI.motivation: 在选择文本嵌入模型时，排行榜第一的模型往往并非最适合特定部署场景，而这一决策却对检索或搜索系统至关重要，但常被忽视。
AI.method: 通过基准测试对比T3EM与多种开源模型在英语检索任务上的表现，结合MTEB基准（分类、聚类、语义相似度、重排序等），并追踪从嵌入生成到索引、搜索、分块策略的完整检索流程。
AI.result: 提供了根据任务类型、延迟要求、成本预算和部署约束选择嵌入模型的实用建议。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应作为完整检索流程的一部分进行考量，而非孤立决策；商业API模型和开源模型各有适用场景。

title: Bifrost: Empowering Pretrained Language Model with Fallibility Representation for Log-Based Fault Diagnosis
summary: Log-based fault diagnosis is crucial for runtime debugging and maintenance. Existing fault diagnosis methods use language models pre-trained on natural language (PLMs) for log representation. However, system faults are reflected in the multi-level structure of system logs. PLMs pre-trained on natural language struggle to comprehensively capture multi-level fault information, failing to meet the requirements of fault diagnosis. We refer to this information as fallibility representations. To address this problem, we propose a novel log representation learning method, Bifrost. It draws inspiration from the log analysis experience of Site Reliability Engineers and meticulously designs strategies based on self-supervised contrastive learning to learn the fallibility representations of logs. Across three public systems and one industrial ML-as-a-Service system, the log representations produced by Bifrost outperform existing PLMs by average margins of 9.83% in F1 for anomaly detection, 18.28% in HR@k for root cause localization, and 20.88% in Macro-F1 for fault identification.

AI.tldr: 现有基于预训练语言模型的日志故障诊断方法难以捕捉日志的多层结构信息，本文提出Bifrost，一种基于自监督对比学习的日志表示方法，在异常检测、根因定位和故障识别任务上显著优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于自然语言预训练的PLMs难以全面捕捉系统日志中反映故障的多层结构信息，导致故障诊断效果不佳。
AI.method: 借鉴SRE的日志分析经验，基于自监督对比学习设计策略，学习日志的故障表征（fallibility representations）。
AI.result: 在3个公开系统与1个工业ML-as-a-Service系统上，Bifrost在异常检测F1、根因定位HR@k、故障识别Macro-F1上分别平均提升9.83%、18.28%、20.88%。
AI.conclusion: Bifrost通过对比学习有效捕获了日志中的多层故障信息，显著优于现有PLMs方法。

title: Simple Language Normalization Wins: Cross-Lingual Speaker Verification for the TidyVoice 2026 Challenge
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures (submitted to the TidyVoice challenge colocated with Interspeech2026)
summary: Cross-lingual mismatch remains a key source of overall degradation in modern speaker verification. The TidyVoice2026 Challenge targets this setting with text-independent verification, comprising 3,666 training and 808 development speakers in 40 languages and 2,200 evaluation speakers in 38 unseen languages, without language labels at test time. Starting from the official SimAM-ResNet34 baseline pretrained on VoxBlink2 and VoxCeleb2 and fine-tuned on TidyVoice, we revisit Nuisance Attribute Projection (NAP) as a simple language-normalization step in the embedding space. We estimate a compact language subspace from cross-language same-speaker differences and project embeddings onto its orthogonal complement before cosine scoring with Adaptive Symmetric score normalization. This reduces development EER from 2.97\% with cosine and 2.70\% with AS-Norm to 2.18\% and yields a Codabench evaluation score of 8.40, showing that simple back-end language normalization can rival more complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨语言说话人验证中的语言不匹配问题，提出将 nuisance attribute projection (NAP) 作为嵌入空间中的简单语言归一化步骤，通过估计跨语言同说话人差异的紧凑语言子空间，将嵌入投影到其正交补空间，并结合自适应对称分数归一化，在 TidyVoice2026 挑战赛上取得了 8.40 的评估分数，表明简单的后端语言归一化可与更复杂系统媲美。
AI.motivation: 跨语言不匹配是当前说话人验证系统性能下降的主要原因，现有方法复杂度高，需要更简单有效的语言归一化手段。
AI.method: 使用 SimAM-ResNet34 基线模型，在嵌入空间中引入 NAP，从跨语言同说话人差异中估计紧凑语言子空间，将嵌入投影到该子空间的正交补空间，再结合自适应对称分数归一化 (AS-Norm) 进行余弦评分。
AI.result: 开发集 EER 从余弦评分的 2.97% 和 AS-Norm 的 2.70% 降至 2.18%，Codabench 评估分数为 8.40。
AI.conclusion: 简单的后端语言归一化（NAP + AS-Norm）能够有效缓解跨语言说话人验证中的语言不匹配问题，性能可与更复杂系统相竞争。

title: LowAux-RDNet: Low-Pass Residual Supervision with Scene-Balanced Real-World Training for Single-Image Reflection Removal
summary: Single-image reflection removal aims to recover a clean transmission layer from one image captured through glass. We study an explicit decomposition pipeline built on RDNet and introduce LowAux, a training-only low-pass reflection auxiliary objective. The original residual target remains the main reflection supervision, while symmetrically filtered prediction and target provide a stable low-frequency constraint. We further incorporate scene-balanced real pairs from RRW to broaden real-scene coverage and improve cross-dataset generalization. To avoid evaluation discrepancies caused by model-specific resizing, padding, output quantization, and metric code, we build a unified public benchmark over CEILNet, Real20, Postcard, Objects, and Wild. Under the same evaluator, the proposed system obtains a five-dataset macro average of 27.546 dB PSNR, 0.9220 SSIM, 0.9751 NCC, and 0.004760 LMSE, achieving the highest macro-average PSNR, SSIM, and NCC and the lowest LMSE among the compared public checkpoints and internal variants. Per-dataset and qualitative analyses show that the main benefit is a more balanced performance across diverse reflection distributions, while clear semantic reflections in Postcard remain challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LowAux，一种仅用于训练的低通反射辅助目标，结合RDNet分解管道和场景平衡的真实数据对，在统一评估基准上实现了跨五个数据集的最优平均性能（PSNR 27.546 dB，SSIM 0.9220），但对清晰语义反射（如Postcard数据集）仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像反射去除方法在跨数据集泛化能力上存在不足，且由于不同研究使用不同的预处理（resize、padding等）和评估代码，导致结果难以公平比较。
AI.method: 基于RDNet的显式分解管道，引入仅训练阶段使用的低通反射辅助目标（LowAux），通过对称滤波对预测和目标的低频分量进行约束；同时引入RRW的场景平衡真实数据对增强真实场景覆盖。
AI.result: 在统一基准（CEILNet、Real20、Postcard、Objects、Wild）上取得五数据集宏平均PSNR 27.546 dB、SSIM 0.9220、NCC 0.9751、LMSE 0.004760，均优于对比的公开检查点和内部变体。
AI.conclusion: 低通辅助目标有助于在多样反射分布下实现更平衡的性能，但清晰语义反射（如Postcard）仍是开放挑战。

title: An Integrated Deep Learning and Statistical Framework for Whole-Network Gene--Environment Association with Leaf Vascular Architecture
summary: Leaf veins exhibit remarkable diversity in architecture and patterning, yet existing gene--environment association studies have primarily quantified leaf venation using a small collection of low-dimensional summary traits, thereby discarding most of the structural information contained in the original images. We propose an integrated deep learning and statistical framework. The proposed framework achieves four methodological advances. First, it represents the complete leaf vascular architecture as a whole-network image phenotype. Second, it fine-tunes the deep learning-based Edge Detection with Transformers (EDTER) model to accurately extract whole-network leaf vascular architecture from RGB images by jointly learning local and global contextual features. Third, it constructs a new annotated leaf image database by integrating edge maps generated by DiffusionEdge with the Berkeley Segmentation Database (BSDS500). Fourth, it applies Semiparametric Sparse Canonical Correlation Analysis (SSCCA) to perform variable selection and model associations between repeatedly measured high-dimensional Bivariate image responses and high-dimensional predictors while simultaneously accommodating sparse, zero-inflated data represented by edge maps through a truncated latent Gaussian copula model. Two simulation studies demonstrate the performance of the proposed framework under increasing levels of complexity. Application to a real \emph{Populus} dataset identifies three significant gene--geography interactions associated with leaf vascular architecture, providing new biological insights and establishing a broadly applicable methodological framework for high-dimensional complex image phenotypes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成深度学习和统计框架，从RGB图像中完整提取叶脉网络结构，并通过半参数稀疏典型相关分析识别与叶脉架构相关的基因-地理交互作用，在杨树数据中发现了三个显著关联。
AI.motivation: 现有基因-环境关联研究仅用低维概要性状量化叶脉结构，丢弃了大部分图像中的结构信息，无法充分利用完整的叶脉网络架构进行关联分析。
AI.method: 1) 将完整叶脉血管架构表示为全网络图像表型；2) 微调基于Transformer的边缘检测模型(EDTER)提取叶脉网络；3) 构建融合DiffusionEdge边缘图与BSDS500的新标注数据集；4) 采用半参数稀疏典型相关分析(SSCCA)处理高维二值图像响应与高维预测变量的关联，并用截断潜在高斯copula模型处理稀疏零膨胀的边缘图数据。
AI.result: 两个模拟实验验证了框架的有效性。在真实杨树数据集中识别出三个显著的基因-地理交互作用与叶脉架构相关。
AI.conclusion: 提供了新的生物学见解，并建立了一个适用于高维复杂图像表型的通用方法论框架。

title: SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
summary: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure that prioritizes stable entity-consistent information while filtering noise. On top of this, Composite Importance Scoring integrates semantic and entity level signals to improve retrieval robustness. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s show consistent gains over strong state of the art baselines including LightMem MemO and A-Mem. The largest improvement appears in multi-hop reasoning under Qwen2.5-7B where SF-AMS achieves plus 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline followed by temporal reasoning under GPT-4o-mini plus 6.91 F1 and open-domain tasks plus 6.53 F1 demonstrating strong cross backbone generalization. These results show that modeling memory importance as a dynamic utility signal is critical for reliable long-context reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出SF-AMS框架，通过效用驱动的记忆重要性建模替代静态检索和启发式衰减，实现紧凑高效用记忆管理，在长上下文推理任务中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文依赖是LLM智能体的主要瓶颈，冗余和无关信息会损害多步推理能力，现有静态检索和启发式衰减方法无法动态建模记忆的长期重要性。
AI.method: 提出SF-AMS框架：1) 效用驱动的生存机制，基于使用冗余度和时间信号更新记忆重要性；2) 层级记忆结构优先保留稳定实体一致性信息并过滤噪声；3) 复合重要性评分整合语义和实体层信号提升检索鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s上超越LightMem、MemO、A-Mem等SOTA基线。Qwen2.5-7B多跳推理+9.65 F1，GPT-4o-mini时序推理+6.91 F1，开放域+6.53 F1，展示强跨骨干泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆重要性建模为动态效用信号对可靠的长上下文推理至关重要，SF-AMS提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: CAP-DO: Learned Contextual Action Proposals for Certified Double-Oracle Solving Across Related Zero-Sum Games
summary: Many security and inspection-planning problems require solving a sequence of related zero-sum games. Across this sequence, the feasible defender and attacker action spaces re-main fixed, whereas each context induces a different payoff matrix through changes in target values, inspection effective-ness, costs, and interaction effects. Double Oracle (DO) solves large zero-sum games without materializing the full payoff matrix by iteratively expanding a restricted game. However, applying standard DO independently to each new payoff context requires restarting the search from a generic restricted game and requires rediscovering context-relevant actions through full-space best responses. We propose Con-textual Action Proposal Double Oracle (CAP-DO), a learning-augmented framework that warm-starts DO for repeated contextual games. Offline, CAP-DO trains separate defender and attacker rankers once from solved contexts. Online, the fixed rankers propose initial restricted action sets for each new context. Learning therefore determines where certified search starts, while the current game, through full-space best-response checks and a two-sided certificate, still determines whether the output is accepted. Theoretically, CAP-DO pre-serves DO's full-game certification guarantee, so every accepted output meets the prescribed certificate tolerance. Under standard exact-oracle assumptions, CAP-DO also retains finite convergence when expansion is uncapped. Empirically, across three scales of a non-additive contextual inspection-game benchmark, with up to 9,880 actions per player, CAP-DO-balanced achieves higher certification rates and uses few-er full-space best-response calls than cold-start, trace-reuse, and heuristic warm starts under fixed expansion budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出CAP-DO框架，通过学习已解决上下文来热启动双正交算法，在重复零和博弈中减少全空间最优响应调用，同时保持完整博弈的认证保证。
AI.motivation: 序列化零和博弈中，标准Double Oracle算法每次遇到新上下文都需要从通用受限博弈重新开始搜索，导致重复发现上下文相关动作，效率低下。
AI.method: 离线阶段，从已解决的上下文中训练防守方和攻击方的排序器（ranker）；在线阶段，固定排序器为新上下文提议初始受限动作集，再通过全空间最优响应检查与双端认证决定是否接受输出。
AI.result: 在非加性上下文检查博弈基准上（每玩家最多9880个动作），CAP-DO相比冷启动、轨迹复用和启发式热启动，在固定扩展预算下实现更高认证率，并使用更少全空间最优响应调用。
AI.conclusion: CAP-DO保留了DO的完整博弈认证保证，在标准精确预言机假设下仍保持有限收敛性，有效结合了学习的效率与搜索的可靠性。

title: The K-SCAN Clustering Algorithm
summary: In the Big Data era, the scalability of clustering algorithms constitutes a key challenge. Traditional density-based methods (e.g., DBSCAN) offer robustness to noise and the ability to detect non-linear clusters, yet their quadratic time complexity $O(N^2)$ drastically limits their applicability. Conversely, partitional algorithms (e.g., K-Means), with their linear complexity $O(N)$, impose sphericity on the resulting groups and fail in the presence of outliers. This paper presents K-SCAN -- a novel hybrid algorithm that optimizes this trade-off. The method integrates preliminary vector quantization (stochastic Mini-Batch K-Means) to extract a reduced set of weighted micro-clusters, followed by a subsequent density-based structural analysis. Empirical evaluation on datasets of up to $10^6$ samples confirms the linear computational complexity of the proposed solution. K-SCAN achieves more than a 3-fold speed-up over the hierarchical BIRCH algorithm, avoiding the costly management of tree-based structures. The method precisely identifies non-linear manifolds while maintaining structural stability (Adjusted Rand Index > 0.99), even with noise levels reaching 55\% of the data volume. The main limitation of the proposed algorithm, which could not be fully eliminated in the present study, remains its susceptibility to over-smoothing and its difficulty in separating clusters with highly heterogeneous local density. In complex visual spaces, this can lead to the loss of the finest topological details.

AI.tldr: 提出K-SCAN混合聚类算法，先用Mini-Batch K-Means做向量量化提取加权微簇，再用密度聚类分析，实现线性复杂度且在高噪环境下保持高聚类稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统密度聚类（如DBSCAN）复杂度O(N²)难以扩展，而划分聚类（如K-Means）线性但假设簇为球形且对异常值敏感，现有方法无法兼顾可扩展性与非球形聚类能力。
AI.method: 两阶段混合框架：第一阶段用随机Mini-Batch K-Means对原始数据做向量量化，提取一组加权微簇（微簇中心及权重）；第二阶段对这些微簇执行密度分析，识别最终簇结构。
AI.result: 在百万级数据集上确认线性计算复杂度，比BIRCH快3倍以上；在噪声高达55%时ARI>0.99，能准确识别非线性流形。
AI.conclusion: K-SCAN在可扩展性和聚类质量之间取得了良好平衡，但存在过平滑问题，难以分离密度高度异质的簇，可能丢失细微拓扑细节。

title: Towards a Relevance Posterior in Neural Information Access
summary: Modern information retrieval systems typically operationalise relevance as a query-conditional score computed at inference time. This design choice has become dominant such that alternative decompositions of relevance are rarely discussed, despite the long history of document and query priors in probabilistic retrieval and large-scale search. As neural ranking models grow more computationally expensive and retrieval pipelines expand to include multi-stage ranking, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation, this monolithic view of query-time scoring becomes increasingly limiting. We argue that modern information access systems are more naturally understood as performing approximate posterior inference, in which relevance is refined through a staged combination of query-dependent likelihoods and query-independent priors. We extend classical probabilistic retrieval formalisms to contemporary learned systems and show how explicit likelihood-prior decomposition exposes new opportunities to shift computation offline while disentangling document-level and interaction-level beliefs. We present empirical evidence that incorporating query-independent document utility can complement existing rankers and improve effectiveness with minimal query-time computation (solely score fusion). Concretely, a learned prior improves first-stage retrieval through rank fusion (up to 0.046 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2019 and 0.029 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020) and also improves downstream re-ranking, with the largest gains observed for the LLM re-ranker RankZephyr (up to 0.054 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020). Finally, we discuss how this decomposition connects to broader information access and outline research directions for designing retrieval systems that explicitly allocate modelling capacity between offline priors and online interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将现代检索系统中的相关性评分重新理解为近似后验推断，通过显式分解为查询无关的先验（离线计算）和查询相关的似然（在线计算），从而在不增加查询时计算负担的情况下提升检索与重排序效果。
AI.motivation: 现代神经排序模型计算成本日益高昂，多阶段检索流水线（含RAG）中，传统单一的查询时评分方式限制了计算效率与灵活性。作者希望借助概率检索的经典思想，将相关性分解为先验与似然，实现计算的时间转移（offline vs. online）。
AI.method: 将经典概率检索框架扩展到现代学习系统，显式区分查询无关的文档先验（utility）与查询相关的似然；通过分数融合的方式在首阶段检索和下游重排序中引入先验信息，无需额外查询时计算。
AI.result: 在TREC DL-2019和DL-2020上，先验通过秩融合提升首阶段检索（最高+0.046/0.029 nDCG@10）；对LLM重排序器RankZephyr提升最显著（DL-2020上+0.054 nDCG@10）。
AI.conclusion: 相关性分解为离线先验与在线似然是可行且有效的，未来应据此重新设计检索系统，在离线建模能力与在线交互计算之间进行显式分配。

title: Backend-Aware Graph Learning for Denoising Outcome Distributions in Quantum Program Testing
summary: Testing quantum programs on NISQ (Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum) backends is challenging because the noise disturbs outcome distributions and can affect pass/fail decisions. We present Q-BRIDGE, a graph learning-based approach that converts noisy observations into denoised distributions suitable for oracle-based verification. Q-BRIDGE uses a graph transformer architecture to encode a transpiled quantum circuit, capturing the characteristics of its gates and their connectivity; the physical backend information is encoded together with the logical structure of the circuit. An additional conditioning layer, based on FiLM (Feature-Wise Linear Modulation), takes the encoding as input and integrates noisy observations to produce denoised outcomes. We evaluate Q-BRIDGE on 23 IBM noise backends and 6 circuit families representative of practical workloads. In the first setting, we train a separate Q-BRIDGE model for each backend; in the second setting, we train a single general model shared across all backends. Across both settings, Q-BRIDGE outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline in noise mitigation by a large margin. In testing scenarios with noisy executions, Q-BRIDGE achieves 93.97%-94.90% precision and 82.50%-83.51% recall in detecting bug-induced test failures, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline. These results indicate that considering the graph structure of the transpiled circuits and the physical characteristics of specific quantum backends is a practical route to more reliable noise-aware quantum program testing.

AI.tldr: Q-BRIDGE是一种基于图学习的量子程序测试方法，通过图Transformer架构编码量子电路的图结构和物理后端信息，结合FiLM条件层对噪声观测进行去噪，在23个IBM噪声后端上显著优于现有基线，实现93.97%-94.90%的精确率和82.50%-83.51%的召回率。
AI.motivation: NISQ量子后端存在严重噪声干扰，导致量子程序测试中的通过/失败判断不准确，亟需可靠的噪声缓解方法。
AI.method: 采用图Transformer编码编译后的量子电路的图结构（门操作及连接关系）和物理后端信息，通过FiLM（特征级线性调制）条件层整合噪声观测，输出去噪后的分布。
AI.result: 在23个IBM噪声后端和6个电路家族上，Q-BRIDGE在噪声缓解上大幅超越基线；bug检测精确率93.97%-94.90%，召回率82.50%-83.51%。
AI.conclusion: 考虑编译后电路的图结构和量子后端物理特性是实现更可靠噪声感知量子程序测试的有效途径。

title: Not All LLM Reasoning is Visible in the Chain-of-Thought
summary: A key question for AI safety is whether a language model expresses all of its reasoning in its output tokens. We demonstrate a concrete failure mode where frontier models exhibit invisible reasoning by leveraging semantically irrelevant filler tokens to improve performance on synthetic reasoning tasks. We evaluate 13 frontier language models across three tasks and find that many models benefit significantly from filler tokens, with accuracy improvements of up to 13 percentage points. The benefit depends on which tokens are used and differs across models. We further show that filler tokens enable Claude Opus 4.5 to satisfy a hidden modular arithmetic constraint without sacrificing accuracy on its primary task, demonstrating that invisible reasoning can serve objectives entirely invisible to CoT monitoring. Reinforcement learning gives Qwen3-235B strong preferences over filler token content, but neither RL nor supervised fine-tuning produces a filler token benefit that persists at test time. Our results indicate that frontier models already perform consequential computation with no interpretable trace in their output tokens.

AI.tldr: 研究发现前沿语言模型会利用语义无关的填充词（filler tokens）进行“隐形推理”，在不被CoT监控察觉的情况下提升任务表现，准确率提升高达13个百分点，且RL和SFT都无法消除这一行为。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型是否将所有推理过程都体现在输出token中，验证AI安全监控（如CoT监控）是否存在盲区。
AI.method: 在三个合成推理任务上评估13个前沿语言模型，通过引入填充词（filler tokens）观察模型性能变化，并设计隐藏模算术约束任务检测隐形推理。
AI.result: 多个模型从填充词中显著获益（准确率提升最高13个百分点）；Claude Opus 4.5能利用填充词满足隐藏约束；Qwen3-235B通过RL对填充词内容产生强烈偏好，但RL和SFT均无法使填充词收益在测试时持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型已经在输出token中执行了无迹可寻的计算，现有CoT监控手段存在安全盲区。

title: StepX-Edge: An On-Device UI Vision-Language Model via Architecture-Training-Deployment Co-Design
summary: Deploying a vision-language model with full UI understanding on end devices has long been trapped between accuracy and efficiency: on one side is the accuracy bar for OCR, screen understanding, visual question answering, and element grounding; on the other is the strict compute, memory, and power budget of mobile chips. Existing work either trades one for the other, or stops at simulation without real-device validation. We present StepX-Edge, a 0.9B-parameter on-device UI vision-language model that resolves this tension through three-layer co-design of architecture, training, and deployment. Architecturally, UI-aware Layered Visual Encoding (ULVE) and a Progressive Dimensionality Projection (PDP) connector target the extreme aspect ratios and fine-grained perception of screens, while standard full attention throughout ensures native compatibility with mainstream mobile NPU operators. For training, the five-stage StepX-Curriculum framework is designed around our observation of mutual-promotion effects among UI subtasks, so that all four capabilities grow synergistically under a tight parameter budget rather than interfering. For deployment, a module-wise differentiated two-stage PTQ-to-QAT quantization scheme keeps the post-quantization accuracy loss within 1%. StepX-Edge achieves the strongest overall UI understanding among <=1B models, surpassing all 2B-2.3B baselines on ScreenQA (88.76 F1) and Chinese OCRBench v2 (57.25), and matching 1.3B-2.3B general VLMs on RefCOCO (92.0%) and OCRBench v1 (831) with far fewer parameters. After W4A16+KV8 quantization, the model runs stably on Snapdragon 8 Gen5 devices with ~0.84 s TTFT, 98 tok/s decode, and 1.4 GB peak memory. We will open-source the training data, the full training recipe, and the quantization deployment pipeline.

AI.tldr: StepX-Edge是一个0.9B参数的端侧UI视觉语言模型，通过架构、训练和部署的三层协同设计，在超小参数量下实现了全面的UI理解能力（OCR、屏幕理解、VQA、元素定位），并在骁龙8 Gen5上实现了~0.84秒首Token延迟、98 tok/s解码速度。
AI.motivation: 端侧部署具备完整UI理解能力的视觉语言模型一直受困于准确率与效率之间的权衡，现有工作要么牺牲一方换取另一方，要么停留在仿真阶段缺乏真实设备验证。
AI.method: 提出三层协同设计：1）架构层：UI感知的分层视觉编码（ULVE）和渐进式维度投影连接器（PDP），适配屏幕极端长宽比和细粒度感知；2）训练层：五阶段StepX-Curriculum框架，利用UI子任务间的相互促进作用，让四项能力在紧凑参数下协同增长；3）部署层：模块级差异化两阶段PTQ-to-QAT量化方案，将量化后精度损失控制在1%以内。
AI.result: 在<=1B模型中UI理解能力最强，超越所有2B-2.3B基线：ScreenQA 88.76 F1，中文OCRBench v2 57.25，RefCOCO 92.0%，OCRBench v1 831。W4A16+KV8量化后在骁龙8 Gen5上稳定运行：~0.84s TTFT、98 tok/s解码、1.4 GB峰值内存。
AI.conclusion: 证明了通过架构-训练-部署的协同设计，小模型可以在端侧同时实现高水平UI理解和高效部署，并开源训练数据、完整训练配方和量化部署流程。

title: Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
summary: The alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by data quality. As datasets scale, massive preference and instruction-tuning corpora inevitably accumulate hidden structural contradictions, safety risks, and systemic human annotation errors. Standard dataset auditing methods, such as semantic deduplication or LLM-as-a-judge, struggle to capture the actual predictive impact of individual records and often miss deep functional rule clashes. To address this, we introduce a scalable, inference-only data valuation pipeline that approximates the Shapley value without iterative model retraining. By mapping semantic k-NN neighborhoods into a directed graph, our framework evaluates data utility directly through a reference LLM's probability distribution using zero-shot and one-shot conditional log-likelihood shifts. Our pipeline then translates these predictive influence scores into localized advantage metrics to isolate gradient-conflicting records. We demonstrate the pipeline's efficacy in sanitizing two heavily vetted alignment datasets. First, applying our pipeline to the HelpSteer2 dataset reduced the manual audit search space by 99.1%, successfully uncovering falsely-labeled records across diverse failure modes. Second, applying our automated audit strategy to Anthropic's HH-RLHF training and evaluation splits identified thousands of hidden safety and factual preference inversions. Crucially, by extending this audit to the evaluation split, we expose severe vulnerabilities in current benchmark integrity: highly capable models frequently predict the safer or more helpful response, only to be penalized by objectively flawed human ground-truth labels. Overall, our work provides a mathematically grounded, highly efficient diagnostic tool to uncover human label failures, sanitize evaluation benchmarks, and ensure the integrity of LLM alignment data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Shapley值的可扩展数据估值流水线，无需迭代重训即可评估数据质量，成功在HelpSteer2和HH-RLHF数据集中发现大量隐藏的标签错误和安全隐患，并将审计搜索空间缩小了99.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐数据在规模化过程中不可避免地积累结构矛盾、安全风险和人工标注错误，而传统审计方法（如语义去重、LLM-as-a-judge）难以捕捉单个样本的实际预测影响，特别是深层功能规则冲突。
AI.method: 通过将语义k-NN邻域映射为有向图，利用参考LLM的零样本和一样本条件对数似然变化来估计数据效用，并将预测影响分数转化为局部优势指标以隔离梯度冲突样本。
AI.result: 在HelpSteer2数据集上审计搜索空间减少99.1%，成功发现多种失败模式的错误标签；在HH-RLHF数据集中识别出数千个隐藏的安全性和事实性偏好反转问题，并暴露了评估基准中人类标签的严重缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个数学基础扎实、高效的诊断工具，可用于发现人工标签失败、净化评估基准，确保LLM对齐数据的完整性。

title: Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents
summary: Industrial agent benchmarks require realistic evaluation scenarios that integrate telemetry, failure modes, maintenance records, and domain standards. However, existing benchmarks such as AssetOpsBench rely on manually authored scenarios and cover a limited set of asset classes. We extend AssetOpsBench with a Smart Grid Transformer asset class and four IEC-grounded diagnostic tools for health-index prediction, dissolved-gas analysis, winding-temperature assessment, and load-profile assessment. We further introduce ScenarioGeneratorAgent, a pipeline for synthetic industrial-agent scenario generation. The pipeline constructs evidence-grounded asset profiles, allocates coverage-aware scenario budgets across operational domains, and generates candidates through a hybrid validation-and-repair loop that enforces schema validity, tool reachability, physical plausibility, standards alignment, and deduplication. To improve scalability, we apply two-level caching, parallel focus-group generation, thread-pool offloading, batched LLM calls, and early rejection filtering. On Smart Grid Transformer scenario generation, these optimizations reduce end-to-end runtime by $8\times$ for 50 scenarios while preserving quality, achieving a composite quality score of $74.2 \pm 1.9$ compared with $73.8 \pm 3.0$ for the unoptimized baseline. These results show that standards-grounded synthetic scenario generation can efficiently expand industrial-agent benchmarks without sacrificing scenario quality.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了AssetOpsBench基准，新增智能电网变压器资产类别及四种IEC接地诊断工具，并提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent流水线用于合成工业智能体场景生成，通过混合验证-修复循环和多级优化，在50场景下实现8倍加速，质量得分74.2，与基线相当。
AI.motivation: 现有工业智能体基准如AssetOpsBench依赖手工编写场景，覆盖资产类别有限，缺乏可扩展性，亟需能自动生成高质量、符合标准场景的方法。
AI.method: 提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent流水线：构建基于证据的资产档案，分配覆盖感知的场景预算，通过混合验证-修复循环（含模式验证、工具可达性、物理合理性、标准对齐、去重）生成候选场景，并采用两级缓存、并行焦点组生成、线程池卸载、批量LLM调用和早期拒绝过滤以优化性能。
AI.result: 在智能电网变压器场景生成中，优化后端到端运行时间减少8倍（50场景），质量得分74.2±1.9，与未优化基线73.8±3.0相当。
AI.conclusion: 基于标准指导的合成场景生成能够高效扩展工业智能体基准，且不牺牲场景质量。

title: The Degree of Strategy-Proofness for Risk-Averse Committee Selection
summary: The classic notion of strategyproofness implicitly assumes that a manipulating agent either possesses complete knowledge of what all other agents are going to report, or is willing to take the risk and act as if they know these reports. To capture the profound uncertainty of real-world voters, recent work introduced \emph{risk-avoiding truthfulness (RAT)} and the \emph{RAT-degree}, which quantifies the exact number of known reports required for a manipulation to be strictly safe. While the RAT-degree has been analyzed in settings such as single-winner elections, its implications for multi-winner voting remain unexplored. In this paper, we bridge this gap by extending the RAT-degree framework to approval-based committee (ABC) selection, a domain characterized by a fundamental tension between proportional representation and strategic robustness. Focusing on the prominent Proportional Approval Voting (PAV) rule, we investigate its susceptibility to safe subset manipulations. We establish tight bounds on its superset risk-avoiding strategy-proofness under dropping candidates, demonstrating that PAV is vulnerable to safe manipulation when the agent knows the exact ballots of $f = \lceil n/k \rceil$ other voters, but remains completely immune given knowledge of at most $f = \lfloor \frac{n}{k+1} \rfloor - 1$ voters.

AI.tldr: 本文将风险规避真实性（RAT）框架扩展到基于批准的委员会（ABC）选举领域，分析了比例批准投票（PAV）规则在子集操纵下的脆弱性，并给出了其安全操纵所需知情选民数的精确界限。
AI.motivation: 经典策略证明性假设操纵者完全了解其他选民的报告，但现实世界中选民面临深刻的不确定性。近期工作引入RAT概念来捕捉这种不确定性，但此前仅分析了单赢家选举，尚未探索多赢家投票场景。
AI.method: 将RAT-degree框架扩展到基于批准的委员会选举（ABC），聚焦比例批准投票（PAV）规则，分析其在候选人丢弃场景下对安全子集操纵的敏感性，推导出紧界限。
AI.result: PAV在操纵者知道f = ⌈n/k⌉个其他选民的精确选票时易受安全操纵，但当知情选民数不超过f = ⌊n/(k+1)⌋ - 1时完全免疫。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了多赢家投票中比例代表性与策略鲁棒性之间的张力，为PAV规则的策略安全性提供了量化理解。

title: Melo: A Production LLM-Powered Music Recommendation Agent
summary: We describe Melo, an LLM-powered music recommendation agent deployed on NetEase Cloud Music. Melo is structured as a deterministic five-node state graph over heterogeneous tools, with a prompt- and state-machine-driven orchestration policy rather than a fine-tuned controller. At industrial scale, the bottleneck is not how smart the brain is but how the system detects and recovers from the mistakes that brain makes. Two production failure modes drove the design: entity hallucination, where the agent commits to interpretations unsupported by the live catalog or user-behavior index, and long-tail degradation, where over-constrained requests collapse to generic popular fallbacks. We address them with two complementary mechanisms. Inference-time entity grounding repurposes the production search index as a verification primitive that gates entity decisions before they propagate downstream. Reflective retry verbalizes failure reasons from a broken tool chain and feeds them into the next planning step, so the system can relax or revise constraints rather than fall back blindly. A one-month online A/B test across NetEase Cloud Music's playlist surfaces reports an over 2 pp lift in a primary playlist retention metric and a lift of over one minute in a core playlist engagement metric.
