Dynamic Adaptive Scan (DAS), which learns data-dependent reordering before selective scan, has not been applied to medical imaging or extended to 3D volumes. We propose DAMamba-UNet3D, a hybrid encoder-decoder that integrates tri-plane 3D-DAS blocks at encoder stages E2-E4 while retaining convolutions elsewhere (~5.3M parameters). On BraTS 2020 five-fold cross-validation, DAMamba-UNet3D achieves mean Dice 0.815+/-0.013 (full-volume per-case evaluation) at ~13x lower parameter cost than SegMamba (0.824+\-0.014, ~70M). At comparable scale, DAMamba-L (~70M), a wide DAS-native variant with encoder-only DAMamba and a convolutional bottleneck, reaches 0.829+\-0.012, surpassing retrained SegMamba by 0.5pt. Component ablations show that encoder-only DAS placement is critical as bottleneck and decoder SSM blocks lower Dice. Together, the results suggest that learned tri-plane DAS in a hybrid U-Net is competitive with, and under our large-scale design may improve upon, SegMamba's fixed Tri-orientated Mamba (ToM) scanning on BraTS 2020. Code: https://github.com/marafathussain/DAMamba-UNet3D.

AI.tldr: 提出DAMamba-UNet3D，一种将可学习动态自适应扫描（DAS）与混合U-Net架构结合的3D医学图像分割方法，在BraTS 2020上以约5.3M参数达到0.815 Dice，大幅低于SegMamba的70M参数；放大版本DAMamba-L（~70M）达到0.829 Dice，超越SegMamba。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割方法中，卷积U-Net缺乏全局上下文，Transformer计算成本高（O(n²)），而SSM虽具有O(n)全局传播能力，但现有医学SSM分割器依赖固定扫描模式且参数量大。动态自适应扫描（DAS）尚未被应用于医学影像分割或扩展到3D体积。
AI.method: 提出DAMamba-UNet3D混合编码器-解码器架构：在编码器E2-E4阶段集成三平面3D-DAS块（可学习数据依赖的重排序+选择性扫描），其余部分保留卷积；设计两种变体：轻量版（~5.3M参数）和宽版DAMamba-L（~70M参数，编码器全DAS+卷积瓶颈）。
AI.result: BraTS 2020五折交叉验证：DAMamba-UNet3D（~5.3M）平均Dice 0.815±0.013，比SegMamba（~70M，0.824±0.014）参数少约13倍；DAMamba-L（~70M）达到0.829±0.012，超越SegMamba 0.5个百分点。消融实验表明编码器专用DAS放置至关重要，瓶颈和解码器SSM块会降低Dice。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的三平面DAS混合U-Net架构在3D医学图像分割上具有竞争力，参数效率远优于固定扫描模式方法，且放大后性能可超越现有方法。

title: What Softmax Throws Away: Mass-Aware Attention for Evidence Accumulation
summary:
High task performance does not show whether a model retains prediction-relevant structural information in its internal representation. Temporal graph models, for example, can achieve high future-link AUC while basic graph statistics remain difficult to recover from the same representation. We identify one source of this gap in the weighted averaging used by standard attention: when an evidence pattern is repeated, the numerator and denominator grow at the same rate, so inputs with different amounts of accumulated evidence can produce the same aggregate.
  We propose Mass-Aware Attention (MAA), which generalizes standard L1 normalization to an Lp family. Under repetition, MAA makes the numerator and denominator scale at different rates, retaining the effective number of contributing inputs in the representation magnitude. It adds no supervision, parameters, hidden dimensions, or explicit count features, and recovers standard attention at p=1.
  Across four continuous-time dynamic graph models and three datasets, MAA improves future-link AUC in 11 of 12 model-dataset cells. Linear recovery from the same hidden representation increases by 4.49% on average, and preferential-attachment recovery improves in all 12 cells after family-wise correction. We also observe consistent evidence in marked temporal point processes, temporal knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation, and spatio-temporal point processes. Information accessibility and task utility remain distinct: NLL improves in MTPP, ranking is largely preserved in TKG, additional information in RAG does not improve the diagnostic head, and downstream LayerNorm can erase the signal in STPP. These results position MAA as a general normalization principle for improving predictor-facing representation informativeness by controlling repetition invariance in standard attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mass-Aware Attention (MAA)，通过将标准注意力中的L1归一化推广到Lp族，解决了重复模式下的信息丢失问题，在不增加参数和监督的情况下提升表示信息量，在多种时序图模型和任务中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力中的加权平均机制存在重复不变性问题：当证据模式重复出现时，分子分母同比例增长，导致不同累积证据量的输入产生相同的聚合结果。这造成模型虽能保持高任务性能，但难以从表示中恢复预测相关的结构性信息。
AI.method: Mass-Aware Attention (MAA) 将标准L1归一化推广到Lp范数族。在重复模式下，分子和分母以不同速率缩放，从而在表示幅度中保留有效贡献输入的数量信息。MAA无需额外监督、参数、隐藏维度或显式计数特征，当p=1时退化为标准注意力。
AI.result: 在4个连续时间动态图模型和3个数据集上，MAA在11/12个实验单元中提升了未来链接AUC；线性恢复提升4.49%，优先附着恢复在全部12个单元中显著改善。在标记时间点过程、时序知识图谱、检索增强生成和时空点过程中也观察到一致证据。
AI.conclusion: 信息可访问性与任务效用是分离的：MTPP中NLL改善，TKG中排序基本保持，RAG中额外信息未改善诊断头，STPP中下游LayerNorm可能抹除信号。MAA作为改进预测器端表示信息量的通用归一化原则，通过控制标准注意力中的重复不变性来实现。

title: SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) enables natural language interaction with structured enterprise knowledge, yet existing agentic approaches that perform well on public benchmarks often fail to generalize to real-world enterprise Knowledge Graphs (KGs), which are dense, schema-driven, and operationally constrained. To address these limitations, we propose SCAIR (Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning), a training-free framework that integrates structured planning with controlled iterative reasoning by injecting schema-conditioned structural priors and enforcing schema-aware traversal during multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on an enterprise-oriented benchmark constructed from a real-world Configuration Management DataBase (CMDB) demonstrate that SCAIR substantially improves performance over existing KG-RAG methods. Crucially, our study highlights that reliable enterprise graph reasoning cannot rely on generic agentic designs; instead, it must explicitly incorporate the target domain's structural and operational constraints into the reasoning process. We demonstrate that by aligning agent design with business logic, substantial performance gains can be achieved without the need for costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCAIR框架，通过注入模式条件的结构先验和强制模式感知遍历，在不需重新训练模型的情况下，显著提升了知识图谱检索增强生成在真实企业场景（如CMDB）中的多跳推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能体的KG-RAG方法在公开数据集上表现良好，但在真实企业知识图谱（密集、模式驱动、操作受限）上泛化失败，亟需能融入领域结构约束的推理方案。
AI.method: SCAIR（Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning）是一种免训练框架，通过在多跳推理中注入模式条件的结构先验并强制执行模式感知遍历，将结构化规划与受控迭代推理相结合。
AI.result: 在基于真实CMDB构建的企业级基准上，SCAIR显著优于现有KG-RAG方法，证明对齐智能体设计与业务逻辑可在无需昂贵模型重训的情况下带来实质性性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的企业图谱推理不能依赖通用智能体设计，必须显式地将目标领域的结构和操作约束纳入推理过程，将智能体设计与业务逻辑对齐才是关键。

title: SpecFormer: Mitigating Embedding and Attention Collapse via Spectral-Aware Transformer for Recommendation
summary: Transformer architectures have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains; however, directly applying their standard self-attention mechanism to recommendation often yields suboptimal performance, sometimes even trailing behind well-designed simple recommendation models. In this paper, we reveal that this performance bottleneck stems from severe embedding and attention collapse unique to recommendation scenarios. The heterogeneity and long-tail nature of recommendation data lead to a severe spectral collapse dominated by a few principal singular values. We further theoretically demonstrate that this triggers a vicious cycle in recommendation model's forward and backward propagation, which accelerates embedding and attention collapse and limits the model's scaling capability with increased depth. To address these issues, we propose SpecFormer, a novel Spectral-Aware Transformer designed for mitigating embedding and attention collapse in recommendation. Specifically, SpecFormer introduces 1) a Learnable Spectral Softening module to dynamically smooth the singular values distribution of the input token embeddings; 2) a Spectrum-softened Attention mechanism to model feature interaction under a more uniform spectral distribution space; 3) a Spectral Residual Position Encoding via Taylor expansion of singular values, explicitly providing a spectral inductive bias for feature interactions. Extensive experiments on one industrial and two public datasets demonstrate that SpecFormer significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, SpecFormer has been successfully deployed in a real-world commercial recommender system and exhibits exceptional scaling capabilities: stacking SpecFormer layers actively improves the attention effective rank and recommendation performance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示标准Transformer在推荐任务中的性能瓶颈源于嵌入塌陷和注意力塌陷，并提出SpecFormer——通过可学习谱软化、谱软化注意力和谱残差位置编码来解决这些问题，在工业和公开数据集上均取得SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer的自注意力机制在推荐任务中表现不佳，甚至不如简单推荐模型，作者发现根本原因是推荐数据的异质性和长尾分布导致的嵌入与注意力塌陷，限制了模型的深度扩展能力。
AI.method: 提出SpecFormer，包含三个核心模块：1) 可学习谱软化模块，动态平滑输入嵌入的奇异值分布；2) 谱软化注意力机制，在更均匀的谱分布空间下建模特征交互；3) 基于泰勒展开的谱残差位置编码，提供谱归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在1个工业数据集和2个公开数据集上SpecFormer显著优于所有基线模型，且在真实商业推荐系统中成功部署，叠加层数能主动提升注意力有效秩和推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: SpecFormer通过谱感知设计有效缓解了推荐场景下的嵌入和注意力塌陷，实现了更好的深度扩展能力与推荐性能。

title: Semantic-Enhanced Automatic Refinement of Architecture Recovery Results Using LLMs
summary:
Understanding the architecture is crucial for effectively maintaining and managing large software systems. However, discrepancies often exist between the designed and implemented architectures, which can pose significant risks. To identify these discrepancies, architects need to extract the architecture from the system implementation, which is both time-consuming and error-prone. To simplify this procedure, many automatic architecture recovery techniques have been developed. Yet, their accuracy is often limited. Architects must still invest significant effort in refining recovery results to ensure they accurately reflect the implemented architecture.
  To reduce such manual effort, we introduce Semref, a framework that combines LLMs with dependency analysis to automatically refine architectures recovered by existing architecture recovery tools. By leveraging the LLM's semantic understanding capabilities and integrating structural dependencies, Semref enhances both the accuracy and the comprehension of recovered architectures. To evaluate Semref, we tested on 9 projects with published ground-truth architectures and 10 state-of-the-art architecture recovery tools. 5 commonly used metrics are adopted to evaluate the effectiveness of Semref. The results show that Semref improves accuracy across various metrics, with normalized gains ranges from 17.72\% to 43.35\%. Specifically, for MoJoFM and $a2a_{adj}$ metrics, Semref achieves relative improvements of 118.57\% and 100.41\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出Semref框架，结合大语言模型与依赖分析自动优化架构恢复结果，在9个项目上相比10种现有工具提升了17.72%-43.35%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 架构恢复工具准确率有限，人工精炼恢复结果耗时且易出错，亟需自动化方法来减少人工投入。
AI.method: 将LLM的语义理解能力与结构依赖分析相结合，自动精炼现有架构恢复工具的输出结果。
AI.result: 在9个真实架构项目和10种现有工具上测试，准确率提升17.72%-43.35%，MoJoFM和a2a_adj指标相对提升118.57%和100.41%。
AI.conclusion: Semref能有效减少架构恢复后的人工精炼工作量，显著提升恢复架构的准确性和可理解性。

title: Beyond a Global Norm: Personalizing Toxicity Sensitivity in Language Models Without Retraining
summary: Reducing toxicity is often framed as a global alignment problem, yet perceptions of harmful language are subjective and context-dependent. We present the first comparative evaluation of training-free methods for aligning language generation to user-specific toxicity sensitivities across three inference-time intervention stages: pre-decoding (prompt conditioning and rewriting), in-decoding (token, logit, and representation steering), and post-decoding (candidate re-ranking). Evaluated against toxicity sensitivity targets derived from the PRISM dataset, all methods reduce alignment error by 28-47%. However, the results reveal a fundamental trade-off between alignment effectiveness, personalization, and general language quality, showing how toxicity sensitivity alignment is an inherently multi-objective problem.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统比较了三种免训练方法（预解码、解码中、后解码）在根据用户个性化毒性敏感度对齐语言生成上的效果，发现所有方法都能将对齐错误减少28-47%，但存在对齐效果、个性化和语言质量之间的根本性权衡。
AI.motivation: 减少毒性通常被框定为全局对齐问题，但有害语言的感知具有主观性和上下文依赖性，现有方法忽略了用户个性化的毒性敏感度差异。
AI.method: 在三种推理时干预阶段（预解码：提示条件化与重写；解码中：token/logit/表示引导；后解码：候选重排）上，对比评估免训练方法，以PRISM数据集导出的毒性敏感度目标为基准。
AI.result: 所有方法均将对齐误差减少28-47%，但揭示了对齐效果、个性化程度与语言质量之间存在根本性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 毒性敏感度对齐本质上是一个多目标优化问题，无法通过单一方法同时兼顾所有维度。

title: $γ$-Bridge: A Look-Parametric Diffusion Bridge
summary: Multiplicative Gamma noise is a signal-dependent degradation in coherent imaging; synthetic aperture radar (SAR) despeckling is its most prominent real-world instance. Existing diffusion denoisers parameterize their forward process by abstract signal-to-noise schedules rather than by the physical look number $L$, so different deployment scenarios typically require separately trained models, and transfer from synthetic Gamma training to real SAR remains challenging without clean ground truth. We introduce $γ$-Bridge, a look-parametric bridge whose schedule $L(t)$ connects the noisy observation at $L_{obs}$ to the clean limit through exact multiplicative Gamma marginals. Its closed-form Gamma--Lévy reverse posterior admits both stochastic and deterministic processes, while observation conditioning and a two-step consistency loss stabilize multi-step inference in the low-SNR single-look regime. Because bridge time directly represents $L$, one conditioned network can smart-start from any admissible input look and stop at a target look number. These two orthogonal controls enable zero-shot restoration over the full admissible grid after training only at $L_{obs} = 1$ on natural images with synthetic Gamma corruption. Combined with a homogeneous-patch look estimator, $γ$-Bridge processes data from six spaceborne and airborne SAR sensors without sensor-specific fine-tuning, achieving leading results on standard synthetic benchmarks while providing physically interpretable input and output controls absent from prior denoisers. Codes are released \href{https://github.com/Teriri1999/GammaBridge}{here}.

AI.tldr: 提出γ-Bridge，一种基于物理参数(视数L)的扩散桥模型，用于SAR图像去斑。通过Gamma-Lévy逆过程实现从任意输入视数到目标视数的零样本迁移，在6种SAR传感器上无需微调即取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散去噪器依赖抽象信噪比调度而非物理视数L，导致不同场景需单独训练模型，且从合成Gamma噪声迁移到真实SAR图像缺乏无监督适应能力。
AI.method: 设计视数参数化的Gamma桥L(t)，连接观测L_obs到清洁极限；推导闭式Gamma-Lévy反向过程(含随机/确定性两种形式)；提出两步一致性损失稳定低SNR单视推理；仅需在L_obs=1的合成Gamma噪声自然图像上训练，即可零样本恢复全参数空间。
AI.result: 在6种星载/机载SAR传感器数据上无需传感器特定微调，在标准合成基准上达到领先水平，提供物理可解释的输入/输出控制。
AI.conclusion: 首次将扩散模型的噪声调度与物理退化参数显式对齐，实现跨传感器零样本泛化，为SAR去斑提供了物理可解释且无需重训练的统一框架。

title: Optimizing Transformer Neural Network for Real-Time Outlier Detection on FPGAs
summary:
In this work, we explore how the inference time of a Transformer Neural Network can be efficiently optimized with applications to real-time anomaly detection in financial time series. The financial time series are price series such as asset prices. Unfortunately, the data is often with errors or outliers that make the downstream data processing tasks useless, unstable or even harmful. Moreover, the amount of financial time-series data has been significantly increasing. Hence, there is a need for better data-cleaning methods in terms of accuracy and in terms of processing speed.
  Transformers as a neural network architecture have achieved superior performances in many tasks such as Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision. Time series modelling and especially anomaly detection tasks can benefit from the features of transformers architecture in multiple ways, including the capacity to capture long-range dependencies and interactions.
  Increasingly powerful hardware, such as field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), have seen increasing usage in recent years due to their reconfigurability and high performance. They can be efficiently utilized to speed up the computations of the Transformer architecture.
  We explore different Transformer architectures for time series modelling and how they can be efficiently implemented on an FPGA board (PYNQ-Z2). In particular, we examine the application of Transformers to detect anomalies in time series and we show how they can be efficiently implemented on an FPGA board to minimize latency.
  The code is available at https://github.com/thxi/icl_thesis

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何优化Transformer神经网络的推理时间，并将其应用于金融时间序列的实时异常检测。通过在FPGA（PYNQ-Z2）上高效实现不同Transformer架构，显著降低了延迟。
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列数据存在大量错误和异常值，且数据量显著增长，现有数据处理方法在精度和处理速度上均需改进。
AI.method: 探索多种Transformer架构用于时间序列建模，并在PYNQ-Z2 FPGA板上实现高效部署，以优化推理延迟。
AI.result: 在FPGA上成功实现了Transformer的高效部署，有效降低了推理时间，适用于实时异常检测场景。
AI.conclusion: FPGA可显著加速Transformer的推理过程，使其适用于金融时间序列的实时异常检测任务，代码已开源。

title: Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL): Live Schema Grounding and Hallucination Validation for Oracle NL2SQL
summary: Large language models can generate fluent SQL from natural language, but on real enterprise Oracle databases they frequently fail at execution time: columns and aliases are hallucinated and dialect-specific syntax is missed, leading to ORA-00904 invalid-identifier errors. In this setting, failures are primarily due to missing schema grounding: the model cannot know which tables and columns actually exist. This paper introduces Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL), a lightweight middleware layer for Oracle NL2SQL that requires no model retraining. SAL queries Oracle's USER_TAB_COLUMNS catalog to build a live schema map, selects a relevant table subset for each question (falling back to the full schema for multi-table queries), and injects this ground-truth context into the LLM prompt. Generated SQL is then checked by the Hallucination Index (Hidx), which validates every alias.column reference against the live catalog, automatically rewrites predictable prefix errors, and otherwise triggers a structured retry with itemised corrections. We evaluate SAL on 500 TPC-H natural language questions executed against a live Oracle Autonomous Database 23c instance using GPT-4o-mini. Without any schema grounding, execution-grounded truth (EGT; executes and matches the reference result set) is 2.2% (12/500). A hand-written static schema hint brings EGT to 62.0%. SAL, with no manual schema curation, achieves 62.6% EGT (96% simple, 95% medium, 40.7% complex) while reducing execution failures from 97.6% to 2.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL)，一种轻量级中间件，通过实时查询Oracle数据字典注入真实Schema信息，大幅提升NL2SQL在Oracle数据库上的执行成功率（EGT从2.2%提升至62.6%），无需模型重训练。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在自然语言转SQL任务中表现良好，但在真实企业Oracle数据库上频繁失败，主要原因是模型无法获得真实的表名、列名等Schema信息，导致产生幻觉（hallucinated columns/aliases）和方言语法错误（如ORA-00904错误），执行成功率极低（仅2.2%）。
AI.method: SAL方法包含两个核心组件：1) Schema感知本地化（Schema-Aware Localisation）：查询Oracle的USER_TAB_COLUMNS系统目录构建实时Schema映射，为每个问题选取相关子表集（多表查询回退到全Schema），将真实上下文注入LLM提示；2) 幻觉指数（Hallucination Index, Hidx）：验证生成的SQL中每个alias.column引用是否存在于实时目录中，自动重写可预测的前缀错误，否则触发结构化重试并提供逐项修正。
AI.result: 在500个TPC-H自然语言问题、Oracle Autonomous Database 23c实例上，使用GPT-4o-mini评估：无Schema接地时EGT仅2.2%（12/500）；手工静态Schema提示达到62.0%；SAL无需手动Schema整理达到62.6% EGT（简单96%、中等95%、复杂40.7%），执行失败率从97.6%降至2.6%。
AI.conclusion: SAL通过轻量级、无需模型重训练的中间件方法，有效解决了LLM在真实Oracle数据库上因缺乏Schema接地导致的执行失败问题，将执行成功率提升至与手工Schema提示相当甚至略优的水平，为企业级NL2SQL落地提供了实用方案。

title: ConAlign: Conditional Alignment Framework for Balancing Biased and Unbiased Recommendation
summary: Industry recommender systems trained on observational data suffer from various biases that create filter bubbles, causing user interests to collapse into narrow categories and severely degrading long-term engagement. While utilizing unbiased uniform data for debiasing has shown promise, existing methods remain impractical for industrial deployment due to limitations such as neglect of factual (biased) recommendation performance and the substantial computational overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConAlign (Conditional Alignment Framework), a conditional debiasing approach for industrial deployment. The key innovation of ConAlign lies in a discrete gating-based conditional alignment mechanism that selectively transfers knowledge from the biased tower to the unbiased tower. Following a selective intervention paradigm rather than universal correction, it seamlessly balances factual accuracy and unbiased preference estimation while supporting real-time streaming adaptation. To the best of our knowledge, ConAlign is the first streaming debiasing recommendation framework successfully deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system that utilizes a small fraction of unbiased random traffic for debiasing. Extensive offline experiments on three real-world datasets rigorously validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework. Furthermore, large-scale online A/B testing on Kuaishou demonstrates significant improvements in long-term user engagement and interest diversity, with negligible latency overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出ConAlign，一种基于条件对齐的流式去偏推荐框架，通过离散门控机制选择性从有偏塔向无偏塔迁移知识，在保持事实准确性的同时实现无偏偏好估计，已在快手大规模工业系统中部署并验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有工业推荐系统受观测数据偏差影响导致用户兴趣窄化，虽有利用无偏数据进行去偏的方法，但存在忽视有偏推荐性能和计算开销大等问题，难以工业部署。
AI.method: 提出ConAlign条件对齐框架，核心是离散门控条件对齐机制，通过选择性干预范式将有偏塔的知识选择性迁移到无偏塔，而非通用校正，兼顾事实准确性与无偏偏好估计，并支持实时流式适应。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上的离线实验验证了有效性；在快手的大规模在线A/B测试中，显著提升了长期用户参与度和兴趣多样性，且延迟开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: ConAlign是首个成功部署于大规模工业推荐系统的流式去偏推荐框架，能有效利用少量无偏随机流量进行去偏，平衡了有偏推荐性能与无偏估计，具有实际工业价值。

title: The Influence of Fraudulent AI-Generated Responses on Software Engineering Surveys
summary: Background: Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce new concerns regarding fraudulent or AI assisted participation in software engineering surveys. Aims: This study investigates how suspicious or potentially AI assisted responses may affect the validity of software engineering survey findings. Method: We conducted a secondary analysis of four software engineering survey datasets using manual identification of suspicious responses, automated AI generated text detection, descriptive statistical analysis, and thematic analysis. We compared findings obtained from the original and manually cleaned datasets. Results: Quantitative findings generally remained stable after filtering suspicious responses, although some demographic and analytical variables showed moderate variation, affecting the interpretation of specific participant groups and contextual characteristics. In contrast, qualitative findings were more strongly influenced by changes in contextual framing, code prominence, and the nature of the evidence supporting interpretation, shaping how participants' experiences and study contexts were interpreted and characterized. Conclusions: AI assisted participation may influence software engineering survey findings differently depending on the type of analysis being conducted. The findings reinforce the importance of combining multiple validation procedures, particularly in studies relying on open ended responses.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对四个软件工程调查数据集进行二次分析，发现AI辅助参与对定量研究结果影响较小，但对定性研究结果（如语境框架、代码显著性等）影响显著，强调了多验证程序的重要性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的兴起引发了软件工程调查中可能存在欺诈或AI辅助参与的担忧，这可能威胁调查结果的有效性。
AI.method: 对四个软件工程调查数据集进行二次分析，采用人工识别可疑响应、自动化AI生成文本检测、描述性统计分析和主题分析等方法，比较原始数据集与人工清理后的数据集的分析结果。
AI.result: 定量结果在过滤可疑响应后总体保持稳定，但部分人口统计和分析变量出现中等程度变化；定性结果则受到语境框架、代码显著性和证据性质变化的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助参与对软件工程调查发现的影响因分析类型而异，强调了在依赖开放式回答的研究中结合多种验证程序的重要性。

title: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed conversational AI, yet high-quality multilingual code-mixed dialogue resources remain scarce, particularly for Indic languages where speakers naturally alternate between English and their native language in both native-script and Romanized forms. We present IndicTalk, one of the largest multilingual Indic code-mixed conversational corpora, comprising over 13,28,604 event-grounded multi-turn conversations across 18 language varieties covering 9 Indic languages. The corpus is generated through a fully automated pipeline that combines real-world news grounding, persona-conditioned dialogue generation using multilingual LLMs, and automatic quality validation. Extensive linguistic, automatic, and human evaluations demonstrate that IndicTalk produces fluent, coherent, and naturally code-mixed conversations across both script variants. We will release IndicTalk to support the development and evaluation of multilingual conversational AI for underrepresented Indic languages. The dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/IndicTalk .

AI.tldr: IndicTalk 是一个包含超过130万条多轮对话的大规模多语言印地语代码混合语料库，覆盖9种印地语及18种语言变体，通过自动化流水线结合新闻事件、多语言LLM生成和质量验证构建，在流畅性、连贯性和自然代码混合方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 高质量的多语言代码混合对话资源稀缺，尤其是印地语系语言（用户常在英语与本地语言间切换，且涉及本土文字和罗马化两种书写形式），现有资源无法满足这一需求。
AI.method: 采用全自动化流水线：(1) 基于真实新闻事件作为对话背景；(2) 使用多语言LLM进行人物角色条件下的对话生成；(3) 自动质量验证机制。覆盖9种印地语、18种语言变体。
AI.result: 构建了包含1,328,604条多轮对话的语料库，经语言、自动和人工三种评估，证明对话流畅、连贯且代码混合自然，并支持两种书写变体（本土文字和罗马化）。
AI.conclusion: IndicTalk将为低资源印地语系语言的多语言对话AI开发和评估提供重要资源，数据集已在Hugging Face公开发布。

title: An Interactive Vision Language Platform for Cognitive Remediation in Schizophrenia
summary: Cognitive remediation tasks often require patients to perform structured actions involving object manipulation and sequential reasoning. For patients diagnosed with schizophrenia, these tasks are crucial for addressing severe cognitive deficits. However, evaluating the correctness of these physical actions generally relies on manual observation by clinicians, which introduces subjectivity and limits the scalability of therapeutic interventions. In this paper, we propose an automated framework based on Vision-Language Models for action verification in cognitive remediation tasks tailored for schizophrenia rehabilitation. The proposed system relies on a camera-monitored tabletop environment composed of structured miniature scenes including roads, a roundabout, a park, and toy vehicles. Patients receive audio instructions describing goal-oriented spatial actions to perform by manipulating a toy vehicle. These interactive physical activities are specifically designed to stimulate targeted cognitive functions, such as sustained attention, motor coordination, spatial navigation, and cognitive flexibility. To verify the correctness of the performed actions without requiring continuous clinical oversight, the system analyzes the video feed tracking the patient's hand and toy movements. A fine-tuned Vision-Language Model interprets the recorded video sequences and generates semantic descriptions of the observed activities, enabling high-level verification of the executed actions with respect to the initial textual instructions. A dedicated dataset of 4634 tabletop cognitive remediation video scenarios was collected to evaluate the proposed approach. Experimental results demonstrate that our specialized framework effectively bridges low-level physical telemetry with high-level clinical feedback, presenting a scalable and objective solution for advanced cognitive rehabilitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于视觉语言模型的自动化框架，用于精神分裂症患者认知康复任务中的动作验证。系统通过摄像头监控桌面场景，利用微调的VLM分析患者操作玩具车的视频，自动判断动作是否符合指令，有效替代人工观察，在4634个视频场景上验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 精神分裂症患者的认知康复任务通常依赖临床医生手动观察来评估动作正确性，这种方法主观性强且难以规模化推广，亟需自动化的客观评估方案。
AI.method: 构建摄像头监控的桌面微型场景（道路、环岛、公园、玩具车），患者根据音频指令操作玩具车；微调视觉语言模型分析视频中手部与车辆运动轨迹，生成语义描述并与指令进行高级别动作验证。
AI.result: 收集了4634个桌面认知康复视频场景数据集，实验表明该框架能有效将底层物理遥测数据与高层临床反馈对接。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化框架为高级认知康复提供了可扩展、客观的解决方案，实现了无需持续临床监督的动作正确性验证。

title: FMOPF: Latent Flow Matching with Constraint-Aware Interaction Priors for AC Optimal Power Flow
summary: AC optimal power flow determines the minimum-cost generation dispatch under nonlinear power balance constraints and is solved thousands of times daily in electricity market operations. Learning a direct mapping from load conditions to OPF solutions can accelerate this computation, yet with deepening renewable penetration, a single optimal dispatch is no longer sufficient. Operators require a characterization of the distribution of feasible near-optimal solutions for risk quantification, sensitivity analysis, and multi-objective trade-off assessment. Supervised neural networks provide fast point predictions but cannot capture this conditional distribution. Diffusion-based generative models can sample diverse solutions in principle, yet existing methods operating in the raw state space exhibit degraded solution quality and fail to scale beyond medium-sized systems. We identify the root cause as the conflation of two distinct tasks within a single model. Compressing the high-dimensional OPF solution manifold is one task, and learning the conditional mapping from loads to that manifold is another. This paper presents FMOPF, a framework that resolves this conflation by decoupling compression from generation through latent flow matching and by explicitly modeling load-state coupling through a Constraint-Aware Interaction Prior Network. Experiments on four IEEE test systems demonstrate that FMOPF provides the most effective Newton-Raphson warm starts, achieves the lowest tail risk among generative methods, and is the first such method to scale to systems with several hundred buses while preserving full feasibility. Ablation studies confirm that the latent generation pipeline is a necessary condition for physical feasibility and that the interaction prior functions as a late-stage tail-risk controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FMOPF框架，通过解耦压缩与生成（潜在流匹配）和约束感知交互先验网络，实现高维最优潮流可行近优解的条件分布生成，在多个IEEE测试系统上达到最佳热启动、最低尾部风险，并首次扩展到数百节点系统。
AI.motivation: 传统监督神经网络仅能给出点预测，无法刻画可行近优解的分布，而现有扩散生成模型在原始状态空间中质量下降且无法扩展到大系统。根本原因在于将高维解流形压缩与条件映射学习两个任务混淆在单一模型中。
AI.method: 提出FMOPF框架：(1) 通过潜在流匹配将压缩与生成解耦；(2) 设计约束感知交互先验网络显式建模负荷-状态耦合。两步分离策略分别处理流形压缩和条件分布生成。
AI.result: 在四个IEEE测试系统上，FMOPF提供最有效的Newton-Raphson热启动，在生成式方法中尾部风险最低，是首个在数百节点系统上保持完全可行性的生成方法。消融实验证实潜在生成流水线是物理可行性的必要条件，交互先验充当尾部风险控制器。
AI.conclusion: 解耦压缩与生成是解决高维OPF可行解生成的关键，潜在流匹配结合约束感知交互先验网络可有效扩展到大规模电力系统，同时保持解质量和可行性。

title: PhononBench-MP40: a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset for phonon stability
summary: Imaginary phonon modes remain a practical bottleneck in computational materials screening because otherwise plausible structures can be locally dynamically unstable under a chosen workflow. Here we present PhononBench-MP40, a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset of Materials Project-derived crystals for workflow-defined phonon stability. The dataset starts from 47,969 MP40 workflow tasks and provides 46,899 completed records with paired stability labels and local phonopy YAML spectra, including 16,683 Stable records and 30,216 completed-phonon unstable records. A further 1,067 relaxation failures are reported separately rather than merged into the completed phonon denominator. The release centers on the local YAML spectrum: the stability label, the lowest sampled frequency and any threshold-dependent relabeling are derived from that spectrum. The dataset is openly available through Science Data Bank at https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.38735. A companion GitHub repository provides the calculation code and lightweight access utilities. PhononBench-MP40 provides an auditable reference for workflow-defined stability classification, minimum-frequency analysis, threshold studies and failure-aware triage, while keeping the reference workflow, data schema and interpretation boundaries explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了 PhononBench-MP40 基准数据集，包含 46,899 个 Materials Project 衍生晶体的声子稳定性记录（16,683 稳定 + 30,216 不稳定），提供完整的本地声子 YAML 频谱、稳定性标签及最低频率，旨在为计算材料筛选中的虚频问题提供可审计的参考基准。
AI.motivation: 解决计算材料筛选中虚声子模式导致的动态不稳定性瓶颈问题，当前缺乏包含完整频谱信息的大规模、可审计的声子稳定性基准数据集。
AI.method: 从 Materials Project MP40 工作流的 47,969 个任务出发，经 phonopy 计算获得 46,899 条完整记录；每条记录包含本地 YAML 声子频谱文件、稳定性标签、最低采样频率；1,067 个弛豫失败案例单独报告。数据集托管于 Science Data Bank，配套 GitHub 仓库提供代码和访问工具。
AI.result: 构建了 PhononBench-MP40 基准数据集，含 46,899 条记录（16,683 稳定，30,216 不稳定），提供完整 YAML 频谱及阈值可变的稳定性标签重标定能力，并单独报告弛豫失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为工作流定义的声子稳定性分类、最低频率分析、阈值研究和失败感知分类提供了可审计的参考基准，明确了参考工作流、数据模式和解释边界。

title: Strategy-Aware Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for LLM-based Auto-Bidding
summary: Advertising bidding has evolved from manual strategies to auto-bidding systems better adapted for large-scale, dynamic auction environments. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning for auto-bidding, existing methods suffer from shallow trajectory-text interactions and require costly fine-tuning, hindering the efficient use of pretrained knowledge under diverse constraints. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE, a novel Strategy-aware Auto-bidding framework Guided by LLMs for Efficient bidding. SAGE introduces a parameter-efficient multi-modal alignment framework for constrained auto-bidding with LLMs. Specifically, SAGE comprises three key components: (i) the position augmentation module adopts temporal-semantic positional embeddings to effectively capture the intrinsic dynamics and semantic structures; (ii) the text alignment module leverages gated cross-attention to align the embedding spaces of trajectory and text modalities, enabling effective multi-modal fusion while alleviating the computational overhead caused by long trajectories; (iii) the constraint-gated LoRA module employs constraints as routing signals, activating only a small subset of experts to adapt the behavior of a frozen LLM efficiently. Extensive experiments on large-scale auto-bidding benchmark demonstrate that SAGE consistently achieves superior performance while tuning less than 10% of the trainable parameters required by full fine-tuning. Ablation studies further validate the critical contribution of each component to the framework's overall performance.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE框架，通过参数高效的多模态对齐方法，利用大语言模型实现智能出价，仅需微调不到10%的参数即达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动出价方法存在轨迹-文本交互浅层、需要昂贵的全参数微调等问题，无法高效利用预训练知识应对多样化约束。
AI.method: SAGE包含三个模块：(i)位置增强模块：时序-语义位置嵌入；(ii)文本对齐模块：门控交叉注意力融合轨迹与文本模态；(iii)约束门控LoRA模块：以约束为路由信号，仅激活少量专家适配冻结的LLM。
AI.result: 在大规模自动出价基准上，SAGE在微调不到10%可训练参数的情况下，一致取得了优于全参数微调的性能。消融实验验证了各模块的关键贡献。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过参数高效的多模态对齐框架，有效解决了LLM在自动出价中效率与性能的平衡问题，为大规模广告竞价场景提供了高效可行的方案。

title: RESTOR: Automated Test Oracle Generation for RESTful APIs via Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to ISSTA 2026. 22 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables
summary: Modern REST API testing faces a critical challenge in defining reliable test oracles, particularly in agile industrial environments where formal specifications (e.g., OpenAPI) are frequently missing or outdated, and historical execution logs are unavailable for newly deployed endpoints. In this paper, we present Restor (Reinforcement Enhanced Single-Traffic Oracle generator for REST APIs), a framework that generates executable test assertions from a single observed request-response pair in a black-box setting. Unlike existing approaches that rely on rule-based templates or massive training logs, Restor utilizes a novel data augmentation pipeline to fine-tune a lightweight Large Language Model (LLM) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). This training process enables the model to internalize testing "common sense" by optimizing a reward function that jointly encourages: (i) the selection of stable, semantically meaningful fields for validation and the avoidance of dynamic noise (e.g., timestamps or trace IDs); (ii) the generation of robust assertions that withstand logic variations. We evaluate Restor on an industrial dataset comprising over 2,300 API traces across 246 real-world services. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Restor significantly outperforms prompt-engineered baselines and generalist models, achieving a superior $F_1$ score of 85.42% in key field identification and increasing the proportion of semantically accurate assertions. Furthermore, deployment in a production CI/CD workflow at ByteDance confirms its practical value: the system raised the adoption rate of automatically generated test cases from 74.1% to over 96%, substantially reducing manual Quality Assurance (QA) effort while ensuring high execution stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Restor框架，利用强化学习（GRPO）微调轻量级LLM，从单一HTTP请求-响应对生成可执行测试断言，在字节跳动工业数据集上F1达85.42%，并将自动生成测试用例的采用率从74.1%提升至96%以上。
AI.motivation: 现代REST API测试在敏捷工业环境中面临关键挑战：正式规约（如OpenAPI）频繁缺失或过时，且新部署端点缺乏历史执行日志。现有方法依赖规则模板或大量训练日志，难以适应实际工业需求。
AI.method: Restor采用数据增强流水线，通过GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）微调轻量级LLM。奖励函数联合优化：(i)选择稳定、语义有意义的字段进行验证，避免动态噪声；(ii)生成能容忍逻辑变化的稳健断言。
AI.result: 在覆盖246个真实服务的2300+API轨迹上，Restor的关键字段识别F1达85.42%，显著优于基于提示的基线和通用模型。在字节跳动生产CI/CD流程中，测试用例采用率从74.1%提升至96%以上。
AI.conclusion: Restor验证了基于强化学习微调的小模型在单样本API测试断言生成中的有效性，大幅减少人工QA工作量，展示了在工业级持续测试中的实用价值。

title: Co-Evolving Graph and Text Memory for Training-Free Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires coordinating relational and textual evidence across reasoning steps, a combination neither a text corpus nor a knowledge graph can supply alone. Prior work often emphasizes only part of this loop: graph-augmented RAG retrieves from a pre-built or query-updated graph, KGQA systems search within topic-centered subgraphs, and memory-augmented agents maintain evolving memories without continuously reconciling graph memory with textual context. We propose Co-E, a training-free system built around synchronized bidirectional graph-text working memory. A synchronization cycle consolidates textual memory, extracts relational triples into graph memory, and injects graph facts back into the generation context. Because both memories are maintained, they shape subsequent retrieval and generation. Evaluated on six multi-hop QA benchmarks, Co-E improves over comparable training-free open-backbone baselines and is competitive with larger or trained systems.

AI.tldr: Co-E是一种无需训练的多跳问答系统，通过同步双向图-文本工作记忆，在六个基准测试上优于同类方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（图增强RAG、KGQA、记忆增强智能体）都只强调多跳推理循环的部分环节，无法同时协调关系推理和文本证据。需要一种能持续同步图记忆与文本上下文的方法。
AI.method: 提出Co-E系统，核心是同步双向图-文本工作记忆：一个同步周期包含三个步骤——整合文本记忆、提取关系三元组注入图记忆、将图事实注入生成上下文。两种记忆相互影响，共同指导后续检索和生成。
AI.result: 在六个多跳问答基准测试上，Co-E优于同类的无训练开放骨干基线，并与更大规模或经过训练的系统具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的同步双向记忆机制能有效弥合文本和图谱之间的鸿沟，是多跳问答中一个简洁而有效的解决方案。

title: A New Kind of Adversarial Example: Measuring the Human-Model Gap, and Its Relationship to OOD Detection
summary: Almost all adversarial attacks add an imperceptible perturbation to fool a model. We instead study the opposite: a large, clearly visible perturbation that causes the model to keep its original, correct prediction, even though a human would no longer recognize the image. Prior work showed such examples can be generated at scale but left three questions untested: whether humans really perform worse than the model, whether standard out-of-distribution (OOD) detection and calibration tools catch it, and whether existing defenses mitigate it. We answer all three on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet. (i) An independent recognizer proxy drops to ~49% on CIFAR-10 while the model stays at 100% -- a gap a small human pilot (N=5) corroborates directly and that is not explained by signal loss (a matched-magnitude Gaussian control degrades recognizability faster); a CLIP zero-shot proxy confirms the gap at ImageNet scale too. (ii) Confidence- and energy-based OOD detectors and calibration are structurally blind (0% detection, ECE ~= 0), while a feature-space Mahalanobis detector flags 100% -- but is evaded by an adaptive attacker at no cost to success. (iii) No classical defense, including adversarial training (45% robust accuracy), reduces attack success (correlation with large-epsilon_l resistance r ~= 0). A mechanistic analysis further shows the attack destroys low-level texture far faster than edge/shape structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种与常见对抗攻击相反的扰动：大而可见的扰动，使模型保持正确预测而人类无法识别。作者在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet上验证了三个未解问题：人类表现是否真比模型差、标准OOD检测和校准工具能否捕捉、现有防御能否缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击研究关注微小不可见扰动，本文则探索相反的极端情况——大幅可见扰动下模型仍保持正确预测的现象，并填补前人工作遗留的三个关键问题：人类识别能力、现有检测工具有效性、防御方法的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet三个数据集上进行实验，使用独立识别器代理、小规模人类实验（N=5）、CLIP零样本代理进行评估；测试多种OOD检测方法（置信度、能量、马氏距离）和校准工具；评估经典防御方法（包括对抗训练）的效果；进行机制分析研究扰动对图像特征的影响。
AI.result: (i) CIFAR-10上识别器代理降至~49%而模型保持100%，人类实验和CLIP验证了该差距；(ii) 置信度、能量OOD检测器和校准完全失效（0%检测率），但马氏距离检测器可100%检测却被自适应攻击者规避；(iii) 经典防御（包括对抗训练45%鲁棒准确率）无法降低攻击成功率。机制分析表明攻击破坏低层纹理远快于边缘/形状结构。
AI.conclusion: 大幅可见扰动构成的攻击对现有OOD检测和防御方法具有强鲁棒性，揭示了当前模型与人类感知之间的显著差距，以及现有安全机制在面对此类攻击时的结构性盲区。

title: Multimodal Domain Generalization for Depression Detection: An Attention-Based BiLSTM Network with Domain-Adversarial Training
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS)
summary: Automatic depression detection with deep learning has shown promise but often suffers from limited generalization due to domain shift arising from inter-speaker variability. To address this critical issue, we present the first patient-independent multimodal depression detection framework that incorporates domain generalization (DG), jointly leveraging both acoustic and textual modalities. The proposed model integrates bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) with intra- and cross-modal attention mechanisms, accompanied by segment-level fusion for decision-making. Generalization is further enhanced by applying a gradient reversal layer inspired by Domain-Adversarial Training of Neural Networks (DANN), which promotes domain-invariant representations by adversarially limiting the model's ability to identify individual speakers, effectively reducing patient-specific bias. Conducting experiments on the Androids-Corpus dataset with a 5-fold cross-validation (CV) protocol, various pairings of audio and text feature extractors were evaluated over different segment durations, determining MelSpec and ItalianBERT as the optimal baseline at a 30-second segment duration. The addition of DG to this baseline yields a 2.5% increase in accuracy and 3.3% in F1-score, achieving 93.2% accuracy, 93.2% precision, 96.2% recall, and 94.2% F1-score, surpassing all existing benchmarks. Extensive ablation studies assess the impact of multimodal fusion, deep architectural choices, and DG, highlighting their combined contribution to robust and generalizable depression detection.

AI.tldr: 首个结合域泛化的患者独立多模态抑郁检测框架，使用BiLSTM与跨模态注意力机制，通过梯度反转层实现域不变表征，在Androids-Corpus数据集上达到93.2%准确率。
AI.motivation: 自动抑郁检测中深度学习模型常因说话人差异导致的域偏移而泛化能力不足，现有方法缺乏对不同患者的独立性考量。
AI.method: 提出BiLSTM结合帧内与跨模态注意力机制，采用分段级融合决策，并引入DANN风格的梯度反转层进行对抗性训练以消除个体说话人偏见，实现域泛化。
AI.result: 在Androids-Corpus数据集的5折交叉验证中，MelSpec+ItalianBERT在30秒分段下最优；加入域泛化后准确率提升2.5%，F1提升3.3%，达到93.2%准确率、93.2%精确率、96.2%召回率、94.2%F1，超越所有现有基准。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合、深度架构选择与域泛化的组合对鲁棒且可泛化的抑郁检测至关重要，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。

title: Too much evidence, too little time: From text to actionable recommendations through multi-objective evidence reasoning
summary: Evidence-based clinical decision making requires specialists to identify, evaluate and synthesize relevant scientific literature. However, PubMed searches for complex clinical cases often return hundreds of publications that cannot be reviewed manually under time constraints. This study proposes SCEPTER (Single-Case Evidence-driven PubMed-To-rEcommendation Reasoner), a framework for transforming clinical case descriptions into evidence-based recommendations. SCEPTER combines PubMed retrieval, PubMedBERT semantic ranking, large language model (LLM)-based claim extraction, evidence-level weighting, contradiction detection, consensus analysis and multi-objective Pareto claim selection. The framework generates structured evidence syntheses and grounded actionable recommendations. A Paper Q&A module further enables interactive exploration of selected publications. The proposed framework introduces multi-objective reasoning model that integrates literature support, contradiction analysis and interactive literature interrogation into a unified clinical decision-support pipeline. Evaluation on 150 case studies demonstrated that the framework reduced an average search space of 576 papers to 53 retained papers, 7 Pareto-optimal claims and 3 final recommendations, corresponding to an overall compression ratio of 192:1. Despite this reduction, the retained evidence maintained high diversity (entropy=0.901). The ablation study showed that Pareto-based selection increased evidence diversity and recommendation utility compared with conventional ranking approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCEPTER框架，将临床病例描述转化为循证推荐，通过PubMed检索、语义排序、LLM提取声明、证据加权、矛盾检测、共识分析和帕累托多目标选择，将平均576篇论文压缩至53篇保留论文、7个帕累托最优声明和3条最终推荐（压缩比192:1），同时保持高证据多样性（熵=0.901）。
AI.motivation: 临床决策需要快速筛选海量文献，但PubMed搜索常返回数百篇论文，手动审阅在时间压力下不可行。现有方法缺乏将病例描述转化为结构化、可操作推荐的统一框架。
AI.method: SCEPTER框架包含六个核心步骤：PubMed检索获取候选论文、PubMedBERT语义排序、大语言模型提取声明、证据水平加权、矛盾检测与共识分析、多目标帕累托最优声明选择。此外还包含论文问答模块支持交互式探索。
AI.result: 在150个案例研究中，平均搜索空间从576篇论文压缩至53篇保留论文、7个帕累托最优声明和3条最终推荐（压缩比192:1），保留证据多样性高达0.901。消融实验显示帕累托选择比传统排序方法显著提升证据多样性和推荐效用。
AI.conclusion: SCEPTER框架成功将文献支持、矛盾分析和交互式文献探究整合为统一的临床决策支持管线，在实现极高压缩比的同时维持了证据的高多样性和推荐质量。

title: A Model-Driven Pipeline for Data Quality Specification and Operationalization: A No-Code Approach for Domain Experts
summary: High-quality data is essential for reliable analysis, decision-making, and research across domains. This is especially relevant in areas such as cultural heritage, where data is collected and curated manually, making it prone to quality issues like inconsistencies. To improve data quality, the data must be analyzed regularly using systematic quality analyses. Quality analyses validate the conformance of data to domain-specific expectations. These expectations are best understood by domain experts, who can express them using natural language. However, they rarely possess the technical expertise to formalize these expectations into executable quality analyses. Consequently, this process requires domain experts and data engineers, making it time-consuming and technically demanding. The required technical expertise and the resulting dependencies pose a significant challenge. To address this challenge, we present a pipeline for formalizing and operationalizing data quality constraints. We support this pipeline using QPM, a metamodel for defining templates for reusable quality analyses. The web application Constrainify enables tailoring templates to specific conceptual requirements and translating them into executable quality analyses via a tool-chain based on model-driven engineering subpipelines. The result is a set of reusable, repeatable, and domain-specific quality analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一条基于模型驱动工程的流水线（QPM元模型+Constrainify应用），将领域专家用自然语言表达的数据质量期望，自动转化为可执行的、可复用的质量分析工具，解决了跨领域协作中技术门槛高的问题。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产等领域的数据由人工采集整理，容易出现不一致等质量问题。领域专家能用自然语言描述质量期望，但缺乏技术能力将其形式化为可执行的分析，依赖数据工程师导致过程耗时且技术门槛高。
AI.method: 提出QPM元模型用于定义可复用质量分析的模板，并通过Constrainify Web应用将模板定制为具体概念需求，再基于模型驱动的工程子流水线将其转化为可执行的质量分析。
AI.result: 得到一组可复用、可重复、领域特定的质量分析工具。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线有效降低了质量分析形式化的技术门槛，减少了领域专家与数据工程师间的依赖，提升了数据质量分析的效率与可复用性。

title: Industrial Practice of LLM-Based Test Case Carving and Assertion Generation (Experience Paper)
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, Proceedings of the 35th ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis (ISSTA 2026)
summary:
Enterprise regression testing for microservice systems is often constrained by incomplete or outdated documentation. In practice, QA engineers frequently rely on real execution traffic to reconstruct business scenarios; however, turning raw traffic into replayable regression tests with stable validation logic remains labor-intensive and error-prone.
  This paper presents NL2Test, an end-to-end approach and tool that generates executable API regression tests from (i) a natural-language scenario description and (ii) a traffic capture recorded while executing the scenario. NL2Test addresses two coupled tasks: test case carving, which extracts a minimal replayable request sequence and reconstructs data dependencies so that dynamic values are bound from their responses rather than hard-coded; and assertion generation, which produces assertions aligned with business intent while avoiding non-deterministic fields and hallucinated paths. To improve reliability, NL2Test uses LLMs for semantic interpretation and constrained code synthesis, and uses deterministic algorithms for request filtering, dependency confirmation via value consistency, and assertion-path validation.
  We evaluate NL2Test on 51 industrial regression scenarios extracted from a large consumer-facing Internet company. NL2Test achieves an exact-match rate of 82.4% (42/51), and produces a functionally usable draft in 98.0% (50/51) of scenarios when allowing minor post-edits. In a 9-month production deployment starting in March 2025, NL2Test generated 3,196 test cases with an overall code adoption rate of 85.4%. These results indicate that traffic-grounded generation with deterministic guardrails can substantially reduce manual effort while improving regression automation in complex microservice environments.

AI.tldr: NL2Test 是一种端到端方法，通过自然语言场景描述和执行流量捕获，自动生成可执行的 API 回归测试用例。它结合 LLM 和确定性算法解决测试用例提取和断言生成两大任务，在工业环境中实现 82.4% 的精确匹配率和 85.4% 的生产代码采纳率。
AI.motivation: 微服务系统的回归测试常因文档不完整或过时而受限，QA 工程师依赖真实执行流量重建业务场景，但将原始流量转化为可重放的回归测试且具备稳定的验证逻辑，既耗时又易出错。
AI.method: NL2Test 将自然语言场景描述与执行流量捕获结合，完成两个任务：(1) 测试用例提取——提取最小可重放请求序列并重构数据依赖，使动态值从响应中绑定而非硬编码；(2) 断言生成——生成与业务意图对齐的断言，避免非确定性字段和幻觉路径。使用 LLM 进行语义解释和约束代码合成，使用确定性算法进行请求过滤、基于值一致性的依赖确认和断言路径验证。
AI.result: 在 51 个工业回归场景上，NL2Test 的精确匹配率为 82.4%（42/51），允许少量后期编辑时的功能可用率为 98.0%（50/51）。在 2025 年 3 月开始的 9 个月生产部署中，生成了 3,196 个测试用例，代码采纳率达 85.4%。
AI.conclusion: 基于流量生成并辅以确定性护栏的方法，能够显著减少人工工作量，同时提高复杂微服务环境中的回归测试自动化水平。

title: BHARATI: Morphology-Aware Tokenizers for Classical Indian Languages with Subword Fertility Analysis
summary: Standard subword tokenization algorithms such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) and SentencePiece are trained predominantly on modern language corpora and produce inefficient segmentations when applied to classical Indian languages. Sanskrit, Tamil, and other classical Indic languages exhibit agglutinative morphology, productive sandhi (phonological fusion at word boundaries), and domain-specific vocabularies absent from general-purpose training data. This paper presents BHARATI, a set of SentencePiece BPE tokenizers trained on a balanced 781 MB corpus spanning seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam) with native script support for all languages. We describe three successive tokenizer versions: v1 (English and Sanskrit only, with broken byte-fallback for Tamil), v2 (four-language support with byte-level fallback for southern languages), and v3 (full seven-language native subword coverage). Subword fertility analysis demonstrates that v3 averages 2.6 tokens per Indian Knowledge System (IKS) technical term, compared to 5.25 tokens per term with GPT-2's tokenizer and 3.75 tokens with the multilingual SentencePiece baseline, with the largest gains on a set of reserved IKS terms that are represented as single tokens by construction. On a held-out test set of 490 IKS-domain sentences (70 per language across seven languages, released with the measurement script), v3 reduces sequence length by roughly 90% relative to GPT-2 and byte-level encoding (which lack native Indic subwords) and by approximately 25% relative to the mBART-50 multilingual baseline, averaged across the six Indic languages, directly translating to increased effective context length for downstream language models. The tokenizer models (32,000 vocabulary), training scripts, and evaluation benchmarks are released under open licenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BHARATI，一套基于SentencePiece BPE的tokenizer，在七语言（英、印地、梵、泰米爾、泰盧固、卡納達、馬拉雅拉姆）781MB语料上训练。v3版本对印度知识系统（IKS）术语平均仅需2.6个子词，相比GPT-2的5.25和mBART-50基线的3.75有显著提升，序列长度相比GPT-2减少约90%，相比多语言基线减少约25%。
AI.motivation: 现有BPE/SentencePiece tokenizer主要基于现代语言语料训练，对梵语、泰米尔语等古典印度语言处理效率低下，因为这些语言具有黏着形态、复杂的sandhi音变规则以及领域特有词汇。
AI.method: 训练三版tokenizer：v1仅英+梵（泰米尔用字节回退），v2四语言+南印语言字节级回退，v3七语言原生子词覆盖。在781MB平衡语料上训练32K词汇量，并构建490句IKS领域测试集（每语言70句）。
AI.result: v3对IKS术语平均2.6 tokens/词（GPT-2: 5.25，基线: 3.75）；IKS保留术语可完全单token表示；序列长度比GPT-2降低~90%，比mBART-50降低~25%。
AI.conclusion: 针对古典印度语言设计的专用tokenizer能大幅提升子词效率，直接转化为下游模型更长有效上下文长度，所有模型、代码和评测集已开源。

title: Visual Information Extraction from Documents via Classification-Guided Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual information extraction (VIE) from visually rich documents remains challenging due to high layout variability and real-world impairments. Existing methods typically rely on sequential OCR pipelines or end-to-end models requiring extensive labeled data and layout-specific training, limiting their scalability.We propose a classification-guided large vision-language model (LVLM) framework for multi-type VIE that achieves high accuracy with minimal supervision. The approach decouples document-type classification from content extraction and employs in-context learning (ICL)-based dynamic prompt engineering to inject task-specific knowledge, enabling robust zero-shot inference across diverse layouts. From a theoretical perspective, the proposed method can be viewed as a form of conditional computation that reduces task uncertainty and improves information efficiency during prompt-based inference. Evaluated on a real-world bidding dataset with 16 certificate types, our zero-shot method (based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B) outperforms a strong supervised baseline by 18.35 percentage points in F1-score (86.43\% vs. 68.08\%) and 0.23 in normalized edit distance (0.90 vs. 0.67). Optional domain-specific fine-tuning further improves performance to 93.65\% F1 and 0.93 NED, demonstrating superior robustness against seals, watermarks, and low contrast. The framework offers an efficient, scalable solution for complex document understanding in office automation. Code is available at https://github.com/FairmeHIT/Multi-VIE, and fine-tuned models at https://huggingface.co/fairme/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-SFT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于分类引导的大视觉语言模型框架，通过解耦文档类型分类与内容提取，结合动态提示工程，在零样本场景下多类型VIE任务中F1达86.43%，超越强监督基线18个百分点，微调后可进一步提升至93.65%。
AI.motivation: 现有VIE方法依赖顺序OCR管道或端到端模型，需要大量标注数据和特定布局训练，可扩展性差，难以应对真实场景中布局多样性和图像缺陷（如印章、水印、低对比度）的挑战。
AI.method: 提出分类引导的LVLM框架：1）将文档类型分类与内容提取解耦；2）基于上下文学习的动态提示工程注入任务知识；3）从理论上可以看作一种降低任务不确定性的条件计算方式。
AI.result: 在16种证书类型的真实招投标数据集上，零样本方法（Qwen2.5-VL-7B）F1达86.43%，NED为0.90，超越监督基线68.08% F1和0.67 NED；微调后进一步提升至93.65% F1和0.93 NED，对印章、水印等鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种高效、可扩展的复杂文档理解方案，适用于办公自动化场景，且代码与模型已开源。

title: Physically Verifiable Evidence and LLM-Based Reporting for Bearing Fault Diagnosis
summary: Trustworthy deployment of AI-based diagnosis in safety-critical mechanical systems hinges on validation: whether a prediction can be checked against physical reality before it is acted upon. Current intelligent fault diagnosers fail this standard in two ways. Their standard output, a class label with a softmax confidence score, is an internal statistic of the classifier, offering nothing checkable against independent physical knowledge; and the growing use of generative language models in maintenance reporting adds a second risk: hallucinated content entering reports on which decisions rest. Taking bearing fault diagnosis as the testbed, this work addresses both problems from the output side. The proposed Diagnostic Evidence Network (DENet) is an encoder-agnostic multi-task framework extending the output to a structured evidence record: the classification, a predicted characteristic frequency comparable against the theoretical value determined by bearing geometry and shaft speed, and a temporal localization of transient impulses inspectable on the raw waveform. Across four encoders and three public datasets, this evidence incurs no statistically significant accuracy cost, with a frequency error of about 6 Hz on 1,024-point segments where spectral estimation is structurally inapplicable. Centrally, the deviation between predicted and theoretical frequency constitutes a label-free, inference-time validation signal: it detects misclassifications with AUROC values of 0.970 and 0.871, and remains discriminative in the high-confidence regime where confidence-derived detectors are blind. Finally, a QLoRA-adapted language model is constrained to translate, but never generate, diagnostic content, reducing unsupported-claim rates from 10-12% to 2% and eliminating fabricated quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出诊断证据网络（DENet），通过输出结构化证据记录（分类标签、特征频率、瞬态冲击定位）解决AI诊断的可验证性问题，并利用QLoRA约束语言模型减少幻觉，在不牺牲精度的前提下实现了标签无关的推理时验证信号（误检AUROC达0.970）。
AI.motivation: 当前智能故障诊断系统输出仅为类别标签加softmax置信度，无法与独立物理知识对照验证；且生成式语言模型在维护报告中使用时会产生幻觉内容，威胁安全关键系统的可靠部署。
AI.method: 提出DENet：一种编码器无关的多任务框架，扩展输出为结构化证据记录，包含分类结果、可对照轴承几何与转速理论值的预测特征频率、以及可在原始波形上检查的瞬态冲击时域定位；同时用QLoRA适配语言模型，约束其仅能翻译而不能生成诊断内容。
AI.result: 在四种编码器和三个公开数据集上，证据输出无统计显著的精度损失，频率误差约6Hz（1024点片段）。预测频率与理论频率的偏差可作为标签无关的推理时验证信号，误检AUROC达0.970和0.871，在高置信度区间仍具区分性。语言模型未支持主张率从10-12%降至2%，消除虚构数量。
AI.conclusion: DENet有效弥合了AI诊断输出与物理可验证性之间的鸿沟，为安全关键机械系统的可信部署提供了可行方案，同时约束语言模型可显著降低幻觉风险。

title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
summary: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal order memory task. Using a new dataset of human behavior based on memory of a full-length novel, we show that models exhibit the same characteristic distance effect observed in humans on this task. We next apply long-context mechanistic interpretability analyses to uncover how models solve this task, and find that model performance relies on a one-dimensional temporal code that is reinstated during retrieval by a single time-reinstatement attention head. These findings support temporal context reinstatement as an important mechanism for episodic-like temporal-order memory in LLMs, offering new insights into how temporal aspects of long-term episodic memory may be instantiated in both artificial and biological systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过长上下文LLM模拟人类情景记忆中的时间顺序记忆任务，发现模型表现出与人类相同的距离效应，并通过机制可解释性分析揭示了一个一维时间编码机制——由单个“时间重建注意力头”在检索时重建时间上下文，支持时间上下文重建是长时情景记忆的重要计算机制。
AI.motivation: 人类情景记忆能够检索长时间跨度的经历，但其计算机制因长期记忆实验的机制可及性有限而长期存在争议。作者试图利用长上下文LLM作为可解释的模型系统，来揭示驱动这类检索的计算机制。
AI.method: 基于一部全长小说的新人类行为数据集，让LLM执行时间顺序记忆任务；对比人类与模型的行为表现；采用长上下文机制可解释性分析方法，定位并分析模型内部的时间编码机制。
AI.result: 1) LLM表现出与人类相同的特征性距离效应；2) 模型依赖一个一维时间编码来完成该任务；3) 该编码在检索时由一个“时间重建注意力头”（time-reinstatement attention head）实现重建。
AI.conclusion: 时间上下文重建是类情景时间顺序记忆的重要机制，该发现为理解人工和生物系统中长时情景记忆的时间维度如何实现提供了新见解。

title: OxygenREC-v2: Internalizing Discrimination into Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation unifies retrieval and ranking within a single model by autoregressively decoding semantic identifier (SID) sequences. Yet reliably incorporating behavior signals from clicks, cart additions, and orders remains challenging. Existing approaches either jointly optimize generative and discriminative objectives, requiring delicate trade-offs, or use a separate ranker as a post-hoc reinforcement-learning reward, risking out-of-distribution scoring and reward misalignment. We propose OxygenREC-v2, a generative recommender that Internalizes Discrimination into Generative Recommendation (IDGR). Rather than adding a separate discriminative objective, OxygenREC-v2 uses logged behavior to condition generation and supervise training. During pre-training, a behavior instruction conditions generation on the target behavior. During post-training, future interaction behaviors are exploited as privileged knowledge in our entropy-aware trajectory optimization self-distillation framework, enabling reward-model-free policy optimization. Throughout both training stages, OxygenREC-v2 maintains a single unified backbone. We implement OxygenREC-v2 as a 3B-parameter, 1B-activated MoE and deploy it on JD.com's large-scale e-commerce platform. Across multiple online A/B tests, OxygenREC-v2 improves user click-through conversion rate (UCTCVR) by 1.6--4.4% and GMV by 2.8--6.8% over OxygenREC-v1.

AI.tldr: 提出OxygenREC-v2，通过将行为信号内化到生成式推荐中（IDGR），利用行为条件化生成和自蒸馏优化，无需单独判别目标或奖励模型，在京东电商平台上线后显著提升UCTCVR和GMV。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐要么联合优化生成和判别目标导致权衡困难，要么使用独立排序器作为强化学习奖励导致分布外评分和奖励错位问题，亟需一种更统一的方法将行为信号可靠地融入生成式推荐。
AI.method: 预训练阶段使用行为指令条件化生成目标行为；后训练阶段通过熵感知轨迹优化的自蒸馏框架，将未来交互行为作为特权知识指导策略优化，无需奖励模型，全程保持单一统一骨干网络。
AI.result: 在京东电商平台在线A/B测试中，用户点击转化率提升1.6-4.4%，GMV提升2.8-6.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将判别信号内化到生成过程的训练阶段（而非添加额外目标），可以更干净、有效地统一检索与排序，避免传统方法的权衡与错位问题。

title: Four Years of GenAI: How Educators and Industry Adapted Their Assessment Strategies
summary: GenAI's ability to solve a wide range of software engineering tasks is reshaping the software industry, raising the question of what an entry-level software engineer looks like today. In this work, we investigate whether the core skills for entry-level engineers have changed with GenAI and how the assessment of those skills has changed. Through two surveys, we consider both the educational and hiring perspectives, drawing on responses from 56 educators and 24 hiring professionals across diverse geographic regions to identify gaps and misaligned expectations. We find that educators frame their GenAI policies primarily around academic integrity, whereas GenAI use in industry is near-universal, with organizational policy governing how it should be used rather than whether to use it. Policies on GenAI use during interviews are still emerging, and respondents are split on whether they prefer candidates who demonstrate GenAI skills. Both populations are moving toward GenAI-resistant assessments built on observable real-time interactions and higher-order tasks, and both agree on which skills matter most, rating critical evaluation of AI-generated output, responsible and effective use of GenAI tools, and the ability to learn and adapt independently highly. However, they disagree on graduate readiness in these skills: hiring professionals report larger gaps, with the disagreement concentrated on foundational, non-GenAI-specific skills.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过调查56名教育者和24名招聘专业人士，发现教育界和工业界在GenAI使用政策、技能评估和毕业生准备度认知上存在显著差异：教育者侧重学术诚信，而工业界已普遍采用GenAI；双方虽对核心技能（如批判性评估AI输出、负责任使用GenAI工具、独立学习适应能力）达成共识，但对毕业生在这些技能上的准备度看法不一，招聘方认为缺口更大，且分歧集中在非GenAI的基础技能上。
AI.motivation: 探究GenAI时代入门级软件工程师的核心技能是否发生变化，以及这些技能的评估方式如何演变，识别教育界与招聘方之间的认知差距和期望错位。
AI.method: 通过两项调查，分别面向56名教育工作者和24名招聘专业人士，覆盖多个地理区域，从教育和招聘两个视角收集数据并进行对比分析。
AI.result: 教育者将GenAI政策主要围绕学术诚信制定，而工业界已近乎普遍使用GenAI，由组织政策规范使用方式而非是否使用；面试中对GenAI使用的政策仍在形成中，受访者对是否偏好展现GenAI技能的候选人意见不一；双方都倾向于构建抗GenAI的评估方式（基于可观察的实时互动和高阶任务）；双方一致认为批判性评估AI输出、负责任使用GenAI工具、独立学习适应能力最重要，但对毕业生准备度存在分歧，招聘方认为缺口更大，且集中在非GenAI的基础技能上。
AI.conclusion: 教育界和工业界在GenAI时代对入门级软件工程师的技能认知有共识也有分歧，需要弥合双方在基础技能准备度评估上的差距，以适应GenAI重塑的软件行业人才需求。

title: IKS-Instruct: A 24,000-Example Multilingual Dataset for Teaching Language Models Indian Knowledge Systems
summary: Instruction tuning has become the standard method for adapting large language models to follow human intent, yet existing instruction datasets are dominated by English-language general-knowledge tasks and lack coverage of specialized pedagogical domains. This paper presents IKS-Instruct, a dataset of 24,795 instruction-response pairs for teaching language models to deliver educational content grounded in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS). The dataset spans seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam), covers 41 pedagogical techniques from the Vedic oral and mathematical traditions, and is aligned with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) curriculum for classes 6 through 12. The pairs are derived from six source types: classical text corpora (Bhagavad Gita, Thirukkural, Sangam literature, Vedic texts), curriculum-aligned pedagogical templates, Vedic mathematical sutra demonstrations, bilingual instruction pairs, technique-grounded multi-turn dialogues, and cross-tradition comparative analyses. Quality is assessed through a multi-judge evaluation framework in which independent language models score responses on 12 dimensions including technique fidelity, pedagogical quality, factual accuracy, and IKS cultural depth. Under a uniform five-judge external panel (median aggregation over 1,201 stratified items), the strongest IKS-Instruct fine-tune of a compact 7B model reaches a median judge score of 6.39, within 0.15 of a strong general-purpose reference model (Nemotron-Nano at 6.54) at a fraction of its deployment cost, while the base model without IKS fine-tuning scores near zero on the IKS-specific dimensions. Model quality does not increase monotonically with data curation, a result we report together with the corresponding data-quality gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IKS-Instruct数据集，包含24,795条指令-回复对，用于训练语言模型传授基于印度知识体系（IKS）的教育内容。数据集覆盖7种语言、41种教学法，并符合CBSE课程标准。通过多裁判评估框架，微调后的7B模型在12个维度上达到接近强通用模型（Nemotron-Nano）的性能（6.39 vs 6.54），而基础模型在IKS维度上得分近乎为零。
AI.motivation: 现有指令微调数据集主要覆盖英文通用知识任务，缺乏专业教育领域（尤其是印度知识体系）的覆盖，因此需要构建专门面向IKS的教育指令数据集。
AI.method: 构建了24,795条指令-回复对，数据来源包括古典文本语料库（如《薄伽梵歌》《蒂鲁古拉尔》等）、课程对齐教学模板、吠陀数学口诀、双语指令对、多轮对话及跨传统比较分析。采用多裁判评估框架，由5个独立语言模型在12个维度上对回复评分。
AI.result: 微调后的7B模型在统一五裁判外部评估中达到中位数分数6.39，接近参考模型Nemotron-Nano的6.54，部署成本显著更低。基础模型在IKS特定维度上得分近乎为零。模型质量与数据筛选并非单调递增关系。
AI.conclusion: IKS-Instruct数据集能有效提升小模型在教育领域的专业化能力，以较低成本接近通用大模型性能，同时揭示了数据筛选与模型质量之间的非单调关系。

title: Structural Preservation Governs Data Augmentation in Deep Learning-Based Laser Speckle Material Classification
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. This is the author's version of the work that has been Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE 2025 Intelligent Methods, Systems, and Applications (IMSA). Final published version will be available on IEEE Xplore
summary: Data augmentation is routinely used to improve generalization in image classification, but the assumptions underlying standard policies are poorly matched to coherent imaging. Laser speckle patterns are not generic textures; they arise from coherent interference, and their discriminative content is carried by structured stochastic spatial and frequency statistics. This study examines how controlled augmentation perturbations influence speckle-based material classification on the SensiCut dataset. We train ResNet18 and EfficientNet-B0 under a parametric augmentation framework comprising rotation, Gaussian blur, independent Gaussian noise, spatially correlated speckle-aware noise, intensity jitter, and spatial masking, and evaluate test performance using macro F1-score averaged over three random seeds. Separate ordinary least squares models link augmentation parameters to performance for each architecture. Across both models, Gaussian blur exerts a strong negative effect (p < 0.001), indicating that low-pass filtering suppresses high-frequency structure that is informative for material discrimination. Independent pixel-wise noise is likewise harmful (p = 0.003 for EfficientNet-B0 and p = 0.001 for ResNet18), consistent with disruption of local spatial coherence. In contrast, spatially correlated perturbations yield significant positive coefficients (p = 0.004 for EfficientNet-B0 and p = 0.001 for ResNet18), showing that variability can improve robustness when it preserves speckle organization. The fitted models explain a substantial fraction of performance variation (R2 = 0.796 for EfficientNet-B0 and R2 = 0.879 for ResNet18). These results show that, in laser speckle imaging, augmentation effectiveness is determined primarily by structural preservation rather than perturbation magnitude. The findings motivate physics-aware augmentation design for coherent optical sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数据增强对激光散斑图像分类的影响，发现保留散斑结构特性的增强（如空间相关噪声）能提升模型鲁棒性，而破坏结构的增强（如模糊、独立噪声）则有负面影响。这为相干光学传感中的物理感知增强设计提供了依据。
AI.motivation: 标准数据增强方法假设图像是自然纹理，但激光散斑图像具有相干干涉产生的结构化随机统计特性。因此需要专门研究哪些增强扰动能有效提升散斑材料分类性能。
AI.method: 在SensiCut数据集上，对ResNet18和EfficientNet-B0进行参数化增强框架训练（包括旋转、高斯模糊、独立高斯噪声、空间相关散斑感知噪声、强度抖动、空间掩蔽），使用宏F1分数评估，并用普通最小二乘模型建立增强参数与性能的关系。
AI.result: 高斯模糊和独立像素噪声显著负向影响分类性能（p<0.001），而空间相关噪声显著正向提升鲁棒性（p=0.001-0.004）。模型解释力强（R²=0.796-0.879）。
AI.conclusion: 散斑成像中，增强效果取决于结构是否被保留，而非扰动幅度。需要物理感知的增强设计方法。

title: LithoFormer: A Robust Framework for Stratigraphic Inference via Transformers
summary: Accurate geological characterization of subsurface reservoirs from well log data is essential to support projects such as carbon capture and storage (CCS), geothermal development, and extraction of natural resources. Existing automated techniques for geological characterization primarily use sliding-window classification, which limits their ability to understand broader geological contexts, often leading to misaligned formation layers. To overcome these limitations, we introduce LithoFormer, a robust framework for stratigraphic inference using a Seq2Seq transformer model that ingests entire multivariate well logs in a single pass. The framework utilizes a channel-independent PatchTST backbone enhanced with rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) to capture long-range geological dependencies across entire multivariate well logs. A decoupled multi-task head is employed to jointly predict geological zonation and precise boundary probabilities, while a geology-informed loss function enforces physical constraints such as the Law of Superposition. Validated and deployed on three real-world datasets, LithoFormer demonstrates a 90% reduction in median boundary error and eliminates stratigraphic order violations compared to traditional sliding-window baselines. It also achieves a 80% reduction in manual expert labor and eliminates stratigraphic inconsistencies, providing a scalable and reliable solution for large-scale subsurface modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LithoFormer，一个基于Seq2Seq Transformer的框架，通过一次性处理整个多变量测井数据，实现高精度、无地层顺序违规的地质分层推断，相比传统滑动窗口方法，中位边界误差降低90%，并减少80%的人工专家工作量。
AI.motivation: 传统滑动窗口分类方法难以理解更广泛的地质上下文，常导致地层对齐错误，亟需一种能捕捉全局地质依赖关系的自动化方法。
AI.method: 采用通道独立的PatchTST骨干网络，结合旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）捕捉长程依赖；使用解耦的多任务头联合预测地质分区和边界概率；设计地质信息约束的损失函数（如叠加法则）。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上验证，中位边界误差降低90%，消除地层顺序违规，减少80%人工专家工作量。
AI.conclusion: LithoFormer为大规模地下建模提供了可扩展且可靠的解决方案，显著提升了地质表征的精度与效率。

title: cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-LLMs
summary: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size-a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes. We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN. Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel streams but incurs substantial overhead and suffers from homogenized routing and gradient collapse, and AltUp, which uses an auxiliary prediction branch but offers limited adaptivity and slow convergence. We establish that MoE-style mixture layers can be reformulated as variable-kernel dynamic convolutions, where each expert corresponds to a $1{\times}1$ convolutional kernel and routing implements input-conditioned kernel aggregation. Building on this equivalence, we introduce cMoLLM: a convolutionally gated mixture-of-LLMs that routes over end-to-end streams through fully differentiable dynamic convolution. In GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, cMoLLM improves language modeling perplexity and downstream GLUE and SQuAD accuracy under matched compute, with better stream utilization, more stable optimization, and favorable scaling compared to ParaScale- and AltUp-style baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出cMoLLM，将MoE混合机制重新表述为可变核动态卷积，实现在LLM整个流水线（而非仅FFN）上的端到端路由，相比ParaScale和AltUp等方法在困惑度、下游任务准确率和训练稳定性上更优。
AI.motivation: 稠密Transformer中每个参数对所有token激活，导致参数量和计算量线性耦合，在万亿参数规模下训练和推理代价过高。现有流水线级混合方法（如ParaScale、AltUp）存在计算开销大、路由同质化、梯度崩溃、收敛慢等问题。
AI.method: 将MoE混合层重新表述为可变核动态卷积：每个专家对应一个1×1卷积核，路由实现输入条件化的核聚合。基于此等价性，提出cMoLLM，通过全可微的动态卷积对端到端流进行门控路由，实现卷积门控的混合LLM架构。
AI.result: 在GPT-2风格模型上使用FineWeb数据集，cMoLLM在同等算力下提升了语言建模困惑度以及GLUE、SQuAD下游任务准确率，并展现出更好的流利用率、更稳定的优化和更有利的扩展特性。
AI.conclusion: cMoLLM通过动态卷积视角统一了MoE混合机制，在保持计算效率的同时实现更灵活的端到端路由，为大规模LLM的高效扩展提供了新方向。

title: Energy Constrained Hierarchical Underwater Monitoring via Local Multi-Agent RAG
comment: Contains 25 pages, 11 figures. To be submitted to Elsevier Ocean Engineering
summary: Marine life monitoring is limited by strict energy constraints, poor underwater connectivity, and the high cost of transmitting raw multimodal data from remote deployments. This paper proposes a low-consumption underwater monitoring architecture that combines always-on edge sensing with selective high-performance local reasoning. The system follows a hierarchical master--satellite design in which ultra-low-power MAX78000/MAX78002 microcontrollers continuously monitor visual and acoustic signals, while an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX is activated only for scheduled processing, event-driven analysis, or researcher interaction. Once active, the Jetson executes a fully local multimodal pipeline for data ingestion, visual target extraction, embedding-based indexing, species identification, retrieval-augmented reasoning, and automated reporting. BioCLIP/OpenCLIP embeddings are used to organize mission data, marine taxonomic references, scientific documents, and operational metadata in local ChromaDB collections. A dedicated identification layer combines visual similarity search, centroid-based classification, and supervised classifiers to support adaptive species recognition. A LangChain-based multi-agent framework coordinates query routing, structured analysis, energy management, hardware reconfiguration, and report generation. The architecture is evaluated through visual and acoustic monitoring case studies. The proposed system bridges ultra-low-power continuous sensing with local multimodal intelligence, enabling underwater stations to produce structured, researcher-ready knowledge while compressing local data for flexible acoustic, optical, or satellite transmission, minimizing both energy use and communication overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种低功耗水下监测架构，结合始终在线的边缘感知与选择性高性能本地推理，采用主从设计（MAX78000/78002 + Jetson Orin NX），通过多模态管道、BioCLIP/OpenCLIP嵌入、ChromaDB检索、多智能体框架实现本地化物种识别与自动化报告，显著降低能耗与通信开销。
AI.motivation: 水下生命监测面临严格能耗限制、弱连接性以及传输原始多模态数据的高成本问题，现有方案难以兼顾持续感知与智能处理。
AI.method: 采用主从分层架构：超低功耗MAX78000/78002微控制器持续感知视觉与声学信号，NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX仅在计划调度、事件触发或研究者交互时激活，执行本地多模态处理流水线（数据摄取、目标提取、嵌入索引、物种识别、检索增强推理、自动报告）。使用BioCLIP/OpenCLIP嵌入组织数据，ChromaDB本地存储；识别层结合视觉相似性搜索、质心分类与监督分类器；LangChain多智能体框架协调查询路由、能量管理与报告生成。
AI.result: 通过视觉与声学监测案例验证了架构可行性，能够生成结构化的研究者就绪知识，同时压缩本地数据以适应声学、光学或卫星传输。
AI.conclusion: 该架构填补了超低功耗连续感知与本地多模态智能之间的空白，在极小化能耗与通信开销的同时，实现了从原始数据到结构化知识的高效转化，适用于远程水下部署场景。

title: Alternative UX Extensions and Their Trade-offs for Code Completion in Pharo
summary: Complishon is Pharo's context-aware code completion engine, built on AST analysis, lazy candidate generation, and filter-based candidate selection. Its existing design already provides strong semantic completion, but several practical limits remain. Strict prefix matching is sensitive to small typing errors, framework prefixes often force redundant input, large completion menus are difficult to scan, and prefix-only matching does not support common camel-case abbreviations. This paper presents four extensions that address these limits: typo tolerance, implicit prefix expansion, grouped completion entries, and camel-case matching. For each extension, we describe the implementation, discuss alternative designs, and explain the trade-offs involved. The main contribution of the paper is to show that these improvements can be integrated into Complishon while preserving its modular architecture and predictable behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Pharo代码补全引擎Complishon的四个实际限制（拼写错误、冗余前缀、菜单扫描困难、驼峰缩写），提出了四项扩展：拼写容错、隐式前缀扩展、分组补全条目和驼峰匹配，并在保持模块化架构的前提下成功集成。
AI.motivation: 现有Complishon引擎虽提供强大的语义补全，但存在严格前缀匹配对拼写错误敏感、框架前缀导致冗余输入、大型补全菜单难以浏览、不支持驼峰缩写等实际限制。
AI.method: 提出四项扩展：1) 拼写容错容忍输入错误；2) 隐式前缀扩展减少冗余输入；3) 分组补全条目提升菜单可浏览性；4) 驼峰匹配支持缩写补全。对每项扩展描述了实现细节、替代方案及设计权衡。
AI.result: 成功将这些改进集成到Complishon中，同时保持了其模块化架构和可预测行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过四项扩展解决了Complishon的实际限制，验证了改进可在不破坏原有架构的前提下融入现有代码补全系统。

title: BERT-based Models vs. Large Language Models for Low-Resource Named Entity Recognition: A Comparative Study on Marathi
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) for low-resource languages such as Marathi remains a challenging task due to limited annotated resources and linguistic complexity. Although recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, their effectiveness for language-specific NER in low-resource settings remains uncertain. In this study, we fine-tune MahaBERT-v2 on different variants of the MahaNER dataset and systematically compare the performance of these models with an existing MahaNER baseline and prominent general-purpose LLMs, including Gemini, LLaMA-3.3-70B, and Gemma models. All models are evaluated on a Marathi NER test dataset using standard metrics of precision, recall, and F1-score. The experimental results show that the fine-tuned MahaBERT-based models consistently outperform both the baseline and all evaluated LLMs, with the fine-tuned models achieving F1-scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.91, surpassing the existing MahaNER model (0.8843) and significantly exceeding the performance of LLM-based approaches, whose F1-scores range from 0.57 to 0.69. These findings demonstrate that task-specific, language-focused models trained on domain-relevant data remain more effective than general-purpose LLMs for Marathi NER, highlighting the continued importance of specialized architectures for low-resource language processing.

AI.tldr: 针对低资源语言马拉地语的命名实体识别任务，微调MahaBERT-v2模型（F1=0.88-0.91）显著优于通用大语言模型（F1=0.57-0.69）及现有基线模型，表明任务专用模型在低资源NER中仍具关键优势。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如马拉地语）因标注数据稀缺和语言复杂性，NER任务极具挑战。尽管LLMs在众多NLP任务中表现优异，但其在低资源语言特定NER任务上的有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 在MahaNER数据集的不同变体上微调MahaBERT-v2，并与已有MahaNER基线模型及Gemini、LLaMA-3.3-70B、Gemma等通用LLM进行系统比较，使用精确率、召回率和F1分数评估。
AI.result: 微调MahaBERT模型F1分数达0.88-0.91，高于MahaNER基线（0.8843），远超LLM方法（0.57-0.69）。
AI.conclusion: 针对低资源语言NER，基于领域相关数据训练的任务特定模型比通用LLM更有效，凸显了专用架构在低资源语言处理中的持续重要性。

title: PCA: Persistence-Aware Compression and Aggregation for Fast Video Large Language Models
summary: Despite advances in Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) that have displayed promising outcomes in video understanding, the redundancy in the long-duration frames remains a hindrance to efficient reasoning. This paper introduces a training-free $\mathbf{P}$ersistence-Aware $\mathbf{C}$ompression and $\mathbf{A}$ggregation (PCA) method designed to preserve high-fidelity raw visual information before the encoding stage. PCA can be built on arbitrary VLLMs and consists of two modules: 1) A Dynamic Downsampling (DD) module that adaptively removes redundant frames by analyzing frame-wise similarity. 2) A Persistence-Aware Motion Enhancement (PAME) module that enriches each selected keyframe by aggregating the temporal context of its neighbors, ensuring that essential information is preserved even after aggressive frame reduction. Our approach substantially reduces the computation of long-context modeling, while enhancing the performance of the baseline model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PCA consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in both efficiency and accuracy, achieving a speedup of 1.8$\times$ to 2.5$\times$ compared to the baseline VLLM. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/Heisenberg10110/PCA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的PCA方法，通过动态降采样（DD）和持久感知运动增强（PAME）两个模块，在编码前自适应压缩长视频帧冗余，显著提升VLLM的推理效率（1.8-2.5倍加速）并保持甚至提升准确性。
AI.motivation: 长视频中大量冗余帧导致VLLM推理效率低下，现有方法难以在计算效率和信息保真度之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1）动态降采样模块（DD）：基于帧间相似性自适应去除冗余帧；2）持久感知运动增强模块（PAME）：通过聚合邻居帧的时间上下文来增强关键帧，确保信息完整性。整个方法是训练无关的，可即插即用于任意VLLM。
AI.result: 在多个基准上一致优于现有方法，相比基线VLLM实现1.8-2.5倍加速，同时准确性不降反升。
AI.conclusion: 通过编码前的轻量级帧压缩策略，有效解决了长视频理解中的冗余问题，兼顾效率与精度，且具备良好的模型通用性。

title: OrchNAS: Orchestrated Neural Architecture Search Service for Personalised Federated Edge Intelligence
summary: We propose OrchNAS, an energy-aware, personalised, federated edge intelligence framework that leverages a Neural Architecture Search Service to automatically design service-adaptive models for heterogeneous edge environments. The framework orchestrates the architecture search process on a server-side NAS service, enabling edge services to derive personalised architectures under device-level energy, computation, and memory constraints.
