We introduce an energy-aware global architecture search mechanism that learns a compact global representation across heterogeneous services. We develop an energy-efficient architecture selection mechanism that enables each service to derive a personalised subnet that satisfies its resource constraints via a progressive, greedy, energy-aware pruning strategy. We propose an energy-efficient personalised model optimisation scheme that updates service-adaptive parameters while preserving global representations, where a primal-dual optimisation mechanism enforces strict energy budgets during architecture adaptation. Experiments on real-world and benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出了OrchNAS，一个面向异构边缘环境的能源感知、个性化联邦边缘智能框架，通过神经架构搜索服务自动设计适配模型。
AI.motivation: 解决异构边缘环境中设备在能源、计算和内存约束下，缺乏自动化、个性化的模型架构设计方法的问题。
AI.method: 1) 服务器端NAS服务进行全局架构搜索；2) 能源感知的全局架构搜索机制学习跨服务的紧凑全局表示；3) 基于渐进式贪婪剪枝策略的能源高效架构选择机制；4) 结合原始-对偶优化的个性化模型优化方案以强制执行能源预算。
AI.result: 在真实世界和基准数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OrchNAS能在异构边缘环境下自动设计满足设备资源约束的个性化模型，实现能源感知的联邦边缘智能。

title: HeraSys: Collaborative Serving of Multiple LLM Workflows via Fine-Grained End-to-End Optimization
summary: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has shifted serving systems from processing isolated requests to orchestrating high-concurrency, multi-tenant agentic workflows. However, existing solutions typically prioritize intra-workflow optimization, largely neglecting the significant potential for inter-workflow optimization. In this paper, we propose HeraSys, an LLM serving system designed to optimize the end-to-end performance of concurrent workflows. Through fine-grained orchestration, HeraSys eliminates cross-workflow computational redundancy via structural node merging and reuse. Furthermore, HeraSys introduces a load-aware joint scheduling policy that dynamically manages execution order by evaluating both inter- and intra-query priorities. By integrating a resource skewing mechanism with adaptive batching and pipeline decomposition, HeraSys effectively mitigates tail latency while maintaining low average latency, thereby substantially improving system throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HeraSys reduces P99 latency by up to 2.17$\times$ and increases serving throughput by up to 1.85$\times$ under strict latency guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HeraSys，一种面向高并发多租户agentic工作流的LLM服务系统，通过跨工作流节点合并复用、负载感知联合调度及资源倾斜机制，显著降低P99延迟（最高2.17倍）并提升吞吐量（最高1.85倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM服务系统主要优化单工作流内部执行，忽略了跨工作流之间（inter-workflow）的计算冗余和调度优化潜力，导致高并发场景下系统效率低下。
AI.method: 1）结构节点合并与复用，消除跨工作流计算冗余；2）负载感知联合调度策略，综合评估查询间和查询内优先级动态调整执行顺序；3）资源倾斜机制，结合自适应批处理与流水线分解，缓解尾部延迟。
AI.result: 在严格延迟保证下，P99延迟降低最高2.17倍，服务吞吐量提升最高1.85倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度的跨工作流协同优化，HeraSys在高并发多租户场景下显著优于仅优化单工作流的现有方案，验证了inter-workflow优化的巨大潜力。

title: CogRec: Structure-Cognitive Fast-and-Slow Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
summary: Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation represents each item as a hierarchical discrete token sequence and reformulates next-item prediction as constrained sequence generation. Existing methods, however, mainly use Semantic IDs as target sequences to be memorized, leaving the hierarchy, intra-layer relations, and item neighborhoods underused as an explicit reasoning space. Explicit reasoning-enhanced generative methods often produce a natural-language rationale before the item identifier, but this rationale is only weakly coupled with the discrete SID space in which the final prediction is made. We propose CogRec, a structure-cognitive fast-and-slow reasoning framework that grounds intermediate reasoning in the same SID topology used for target generation. CogRec augments the vertical SID hierarchy with intra-layer semantic graphs and item-level neighborhoods, and introduces SID Routing to represent recommendation reasoning through layer-wise Match, LateralJump, and Explore operations. Exact matching implements fast semantic localization, whereas lateral and exploratory operations instantiate slower structural navigation. A supervised multi-stage pipeline aligns the newly introduced SID tokens, establishes direct SID generation, and trains natural-language and SID-routing reasoning branches from a shared checkpoint under the same trie-constrained output space. Experiments on three public sequential-recommendation benchmarks show that SID Routing improves its corresponding direct-generation, indicate that structure-grounded reasoning is most useful when prefix matching is insufficient but learnable SID-space transitions remain available, whereas long or weakly supported routes introduce additional decoding cost and accumulated errors. Code is available at https://github.com/caskcsg/CogRec

AI.tldr: 提出CogRec框架，通过SID路由机制在层次化语义ID空间中进行结构化推理（快：精确匹配；慢：横向/探索操作），提升生成式推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语义ID生成式推荐仅将SID作为待记忆的目标序列，未充分利用SID空间的层次结构、层内关系和物品邻域作为显式推理空间；自然语言推理与SID空间耦合弱。
AI.method: 提出CogRec框架：(1) 用层内语义图和物品邻域增强垂直SID层次；(2) 引入SID路由（Match精确匹配/快、LateralJump横向跳转/慢、Explore探索/慢）实现结构推理；(3) 多阶段监督流水线对齐SID token、训练自然语言+ SID路由两条推理分支。
AI.result: 三个公开序列推荐基准实验表明：SID路由优于直接生成；结构锚定推理在前缀匹配不足但SID空间可学习时最有效；过长或弱支持的路径会增加解码开销和累积误差。
AI.conclusion: 在SID拓扑中显式进行快慢推理可提升生成式推荐效果，但需权衡推理路径长度与准确性。

title: Motivations and Barriers to Communicating Software Engineering Research: Insights from Early Career Researchers
summary: Science communication is increasingly becoming a part of modern research careers, involving researchers to disseminate knowledge, engage broader communities, and increase the societal impact of their work. Despite its growing importance, little is known about how early-career software engineering researchers perceive and navigate science communication in practice. In this paper, we investigate how PhD students in software engineering experience science communication. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 18 doctoral candidates from diverse international backgrounds. Using thematic analysis, we examine three interconnected dimensions: motivations, communication channels, and barriers. Our findings reveal a strong tension between aspiration and practice. Participants were highly motivated to engage in science communication due to opportunities for collaboration, professional recognition, broader impact, and advocacy for themselves and their research. However, translating these motivations into action was frequently constrained by social anxiety, uncertainty regarding appropriate audiences and communication venues, limited feedback mechanisms, insufficient institutional guidance, and challenges associated with navigating an increasingly fragmented communication landscape. Our findings highlight the need for tailored, balanced support systems that empower software engineering PhD students to engage in science communication effectively and confidently across diverse cultural and institutional environments. We outline practical implications that offer initial guidance for addressing these challenges in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对18位软件工程博士生的半结构化访谈，揭示了他们在科学传播中面临的动机与实际行动之间的强烈张力，指出了社交焦虑、受众不确定、反馈匮乏、制度支持不足等障碍，并呼吁提供定制化支持体系。
AI.motivation: 科学传播对研究职业日益重要，但早期职业软件工程研究人员如何理解和实践科学传播尚不明确，缺乏对博士生群体在这方面的系统性认知。
AI.method: 采用半结构化访谈方法，访谈了18位来自不同国际背景的软件工程博士生，并运用主题分析法对数据进行分析。
AI.result: 博士生在科学传播中动机强烈（如合作机会、专业认可、社会影响、自我倡导），但实际执行中受限于社交焦虑、受众与渠道选择不确定、反馈机制缺乏、制度指导不足以及传播环境碎片化。
AI.conclusion: 需要为软件工程博士生提供量身定制的平衡支持体系，帮助他们跨越文化与环境差异，自信有效地参与科学传播，并提出了初步的实践指导建议。

title: Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-match Tokenization
summary: Recent work has shown that subword vocabularies can be trained to optimize compression for a specific inference rule rather than relying on greedy heuristics such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE). We extend this approach to greedy left-to-right longest-match decoding, the fast and widely used inference rule underlying WordPiece. We introduce Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-Match Tokenization (JOLT), which formulates vocabulary learning as an integer program over vocabulary-selection and segmentation-choice variables. Greedy-consistency constraints ensure that each optimized segmentation exactly matches the segmentation produced by longest-match decoding under the selected vocabulary, aligning the training objective with deployment-time tokenization. To scale the optimization, we solve a linear programming relaxation and selectively introduce higher-order segmentations only for unresolved pretokens. The resulting relaxation is nearly integral: rounded solutions fall within 0.008 - 0.176 % of the LP lower bound on the training scope. The bound also shows that BPE is already within 1 - 2 % of the best achievable compression under greedy longest-match decoding, while JOLT closes 89.6 - 99.4 % of the remaining gap. On held-out validation data across four training scopes and vocabulary sizes of 32,000 and 64,000, JOLT produces up to 0.78 % fewer tokens than BPE, with improvements generally increasing as the training scope grows. These results demonstrate that inference-aligned vocabulary optimization can recover most of the limited compression headroom left by BPE while providing a certificate of near-optimality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JOLT方法，通过整数规划联合优化词汇表选择与分词策略，在保证贪婪最长匹配解码一致性的前提下，实现比BPE更优的压缩率，并证明BPE已接近最优，JOLT可进一步缩小剩余差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的子词词汇表训练通常依赖贪婪启发式方法（如BPE），但这些方法并未针对实际部署时使用的推理规则（如贪婪从左到右最长匹配解码，即WordPiece使用的规则）进行优化。本文旨在弥合训练目标与部署时分词方式之间的不一致性，通过联合优化词汇表与分割方案来提升压缩效率。
AI.method: 提出JOLT方法，将词汇表学习建模为整数规划问题，包含词汇表选择变量和分割选择变量，并引入贪婪一致性约束确保优化后的分割与部署时最长匹配解码结果一致。为提升可扩展性，求解线性规划松弛，并对未解析的预词元选择性引入高阶分割。通过舍入解与LP下界的差距评估解的质量。
AI.result: 松弛后的解接近整数解，舍入解与LP下界偏差仅0.008–0.176%。证明BPE已接近最优（差距1–2%），JOLT可缩小89.6–99.4%的剩余差距。在验证集上，JOLT比BPE最多减少0.78%的词元数，且优势随训练范围增大而提升。
AI.conclusion: 与推理对齐的词汇优化能够恢复BPE留下的有限压缩空间的大部分，同时提供接近最优的证书，验证了该方法在理论与实践上的价值。

title: Trustworthy Medical Segmentation: Uncertainty-Aware U-Net Evaluation Under Clinical Image Degradation
summary: Medical image segmentation models often report high benchmark accuracy under ideal imaging conditions, yet their failures under clinical degradation can be quiet: sensor noise, patient motion, low- resolution acquisition, and contrast variability may all alter model behavior without producing an obvious warning. We present a reproducible framework for evaluating uncertainty-aware segmentation under con- trolled clinical degradation. Our experiments use a synthetic multimodal brain tumor MRI cohort generated with a biophysical phantom simulator that follows the BraTS protocol. We train U-Net and Attention U-Net baselines for multi-class tumor sub-region segmentation and augment both models with Monte Carlo dropout to estimate per-voxel uncertainty. Across eight clinically motivated corruption types at five severity levels, we measure segmentation accuracy, calibration, failure detection, and selective prediction coverage. On clean data, Attention U-Net achieves a whole-tumor Dice of 0.990; under severe Gaussian noise, its performance falls to 0.089. Predictive uncertainty rises with degradation and tracks segmentation error (Pearson r = 0.53 under severity-3 Gaussian noise), allowing us to flag failures with an AUROC of 0.843. These results argue for uncertainty-aware inference as a practical safety layer in physician-in-the-loop radiology workflows. We release the code, trained models, and evaluation protocol to support direct reproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在可控临床退化条件下评估不确定性感知分割的框架，证明蒙特卡洛丢弃法能有效检测分割失败，可作为放射学工作流的安全层。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割模型在理想条件下表现优异，但在临床退化（噪声、运动、低分辨率、对比度变化）时可能无声失败，缺乏有效预警机制。
AI.method: 使用生物物理体模模拟器生成遵循BraTS协议的多模态脑肿瘤MRI合成数据；训练U-Net和Attention U-Net基线模型，结合蒙特卡洛丢弃法进行逐体素不确定性估计；在8种临床相关退化类型、5个严重级别上评测分割精度、校准、失败检测和选择性预测覆盖率。
AI.result: Attention U-Net在干净数据上全肿瘤Dice为0.990，严重高斯噪声下降至0.089；预测不确定性与分割误差相关（r=0.53），失败检测AUROC达0.843。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知推理可作为医师参与放射学工作流中实用的安全层，代码和模型已开源以支持复现。

title: SLA-Constrained Carbon-Aware Routing in Geo-Distributed Serverless Clouds
summary: Modern cloud deployments distribute applications across multiple geographic regions, yet standard routing mechanisms prioritize latency while ignoring the fluctuating carbon intensity of local power grids. Latency-driven routing incurs avoidable carbon emissions, particularly when cleaner regions are within acceptable latency bounds. The proposed model formulates the carbon-aware serverless routing problem as a constrained optimization over geo-distributed cloud regions and introduces an SLA-constrained carbon-aware routing policy that achieves optimal carbon reduction within the SLA-feasible region, evaluated using real carbon intensity measurements across 5 primary AWS deployments. Experimental results show that the proposed policy achieves up to 46.8% carbon reduction while maintaining zero SLA violations across all evaluated thresholds. The system reduces carbon by an average of 27.4% under mixed workloads, and the routing overhead is very low (less than 0.02% of total request latency). A scalability study across 12 AWS regions spanning 6 continents demonstrates that average carbon savings increase from 27.4% to 47.5% as routing flexibility expands under mixed workloads. The proposed work contributes to SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) by enabling low-carbon routing decisions. These results indicate that cloud systems can achieve significant carbon savings without compromising user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种SLA约束下的碳感知无服务器路由策略，在跨地理区域的云部署中，通过优化路由决策减少碳排放，实验表明最高可实现46.8%的碳减排，同时保持零SLA违规。
AI.motivation: 现有云部署中标准路由机制仅以延迟为导向，忽略了各区域电网碳排放强度的动态变化，导致碳排放增加。作者希望在不牺牲用户体验的前提下降低云计算碳排放。
AI.method: 将碳感知无服务器路由问题建模为跨地理分布式云区域的约束优化问题，提出SLA约束下的碳感知路由策略，使用真实碳排放数据（覆盖5个主要AWS部署区域）进行评估。
AI.result: 所提策略实现最高46.8%碳减排，零SLA违规；混合负载下平均减排27.4%；路由开销极低（占总延迟不到0.02%）；扩展到12个AWS区域后，平均碳节省从27.4%提升至47.5%。
AI.conclusion: 云系统可以在不牺牲用户体验的前提下实现显著的碳减排，该工作对联合国可持续发展目标SDG 13（气候行动）和SDG 7（可负担清洁能源）有贡献。

title: Multi-Objective Structured Pruning of LLMs for Latency and Model Size Optimization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved widespread adoption because of their strong reasoning and query-response capabilities. However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deployment on edge devices. In the coarse-grained stage, multi-objective depth pruning removes entire attention and MLP blocks to reduce computational load and memory usage. In the subsequent fine-grained stage, Parallel Bayesian Optimization (PBO) searches for the optimal layer-wise pruning ratios for pruning under latency constraints, while importance-based strategies rank the specific components to be pruned within each layer's allocated budget. Experimental results show that our approach reduces model complexity with minimal impact on commonsense reasoning tasks and zero-shot performance. Our method achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and model size, making it suitable for edge deployment. Across multiple LLMs at 37.5% and 50% pruning ratios, the proposed approach achieves better performance on commonsense reasoning tasks than existing methods while significantly reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种硬件感知的多目标结构化剪枝框架，通过粗粒度深度剪枝和细粒度并行贝叶斯优化，在边缘设备上实现LLM的高效部署，在降低模型复杂度的同时保持推理性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在嵌入式/边缘计算环境部署面临延迟、内存和能耗的严格限制，现有剪枝方法在联合优化层、注意力头和MLP维度时计算成本高且易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 两阶段结构化剪枝框架：1) 粗粒度阶段：多目标深度剪枝，移除完整的注意力块和MLP块；2) 细粒度阶段：使用并行贝叶斯优化搜索最优逐层剪枝率，并基于重要性策略在每层预算内排序待剪枝组件。
AI.result: 在37.5%和50%剪枝率下，该方法在常识推理任务上优于现有方法，同时显著降低推理成本，在准确率、延迟和模型大小之间取得了良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的硬件感知多目标剪枝框架能有效降低LLM复杂度，对常识推理和零样本性能影响最小，适合边缘部署。

title: CORE: A Unified Cascaded Ordinal Relevance Estimation Framework for E-commerce Search
summary: Ranking relevance is a fundamental task in e-commerce search, directly affecting ranking quality and consumer experience. Although inherently an ordinal classification problem, it is commonly formulated as conventional multi-class classification, which overlooks the natural order among relevance levels and assigns equal penalties to adjacent and distant misclassifications. This mismatch leads to suboptimal learning objectives for practical relevance evaluation. To address this issue, we propose a unified cascaded binary classification framework applicable to both large language model inference and online BERT-based inference, which reformulates relevance estimation as a sequential decision process and decomposes multi-class prediction into a series of ordered binary judgments from higher to lower relevance tiers. For large language models, we design a step-wise reasoning procedure with pruning strategies and tier-specific reward functions. For the online BERT model, we replace the conventional classification head with multiple level-wise binary classifiers and distill the capabilities of large language models into the online model. Extensive offline industrial benchmark evaluations and online A/B experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves relevance performance, reducing the online bad-case rate by 15.94\%. Further analyses suggest that tier-wise modeling is effective for relevance estimation.

AI.tldr: 针对电商搜索中相关性排序忽视标签顺序的问题，提出统一级联二分类框架，将多分类分解为从高到低的有序二分类决策，在LLM推理中引入逐步推理与剪枝策略，在BERT模型上使用层级二分类头并蒸馏LLM能力，在线bad-case率降低15.94%。
AI.motivation: 传统多分类公式忽视相关性等级间的天然顺序，导致相邻误判与远距离误判赋予相同惩罚，优化目标与真实评估需求不匹配。
AI.method: 将相关性估计建模为顺序决策过程，分解为从高到低的有序二分类判断；针对LLM设计逐步推理、剪枝策略与层级奖励函数；针对在线BERT模型，用多个层级二分类头替换传统分类头，并蒸馏LLM能力。
AI.result: 离线工业基准评测和在线A/B实验均显著提升相关性表现，在线bad-case率降低15.94%。
AI.conclusion: 层级式建模对相关性估计有效，统一级联二分类框架兼具LLM与BERT模型适配性，为电商搜索相关性排序提供了更优方案。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Explainable AI on Trust in AI-Assisted Code Review
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. To appear in Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering (PACMSE), Vol. 3, No. ISSTA, Article ISSTA093 (ISSTA 2026). Published under CC BY 4.0. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21457282
summary:
Background: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate code review, but the reasoning behind their decisions remains hard to understand. Developers struggle to assess the validity of LLM-generated reviews, making it difficult to gauge how much trust to place in them. The role of Explainable AI (XAI) in code review and its impact on trust remain underexplored.
  Objective: We study the influence of XAI on developer trust in AI-assisted code reviews.
  Method: We conducted a within-subjects user study with 34 participants, comparing three LLM-based code review systems with varying levels of XAI support: Condition A (detailed explanation and review feedback), Condition B (review feedback only), and Condition C (no explanations). Participants reviewed real-world code change requests alongside the AI-generated reviews. We measured trust perceptions, agreement with the AI recommendation, the reasoning given for each decision, and the time taken.
  Results: The level of explanation significantly influences both trust and agreement with AI recommendations, but in different ways. Full explanations (A) yield the highest perceived trust (M = 3.99/5) but not the highest agreement, whereas moderate explanations (B) achieve the highest agreement (89.22%). This could suggest that more explanation prompts developers to question AI recommendations more frequently. No explanations (C) results in the lowest trust and agreement. Explanation level did not significantly affect review time. The most commonly cited reasons for decisions were code readability and correctness.
  Conclusion: Incorporating XAI into code review significantly changes trust perceptions and agreement with AI recommendations. These results inform the design and evaluation of trustworthy AI-based code review systems, as well as studies on the human factors of AI-assisted software development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过用户实验发现，XAI解释级别显著影响开发者对AI代码审查的信任和同意率，但两者并非正相关——完整解释获得最高信任但非最高同意率，适度解释反而获得最高同意率。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于自动化代码审查，但其决策推理难以理解，开发者难以评估AI生成审查的有效性，XAI在代码审查中的作用及其对信任的影响尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 进行了一项34人被试内用户研究，比较三种不同XAI支持级别的LLM代码审查系统：条件A（详细解释+审查反馈）、条件B（仅审查反馈）、条件C（无解释）。参与者审查真实代码变更请求，测量信任感知、同意率、决策理由和用时。
AI.result: 解释级别显著影响信任和同意率。完整解释（A）获得最高信任（M=3.99/5），适度解释（B）获得最高同意率（89.22%），无解释（C）信任和同意率最低。解释级别未显著影响审查时间。最常见的决策理由是代码可读性和正确性。
AI.conclusion: 将XAI纳入代码审查显著改变了信任感知和AI建议同意率，为可信AI代码审查系统的设计与评估提供了依据，也为人机协作软件开发中的人因研究提供了参考。

title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
summary: Activation Oracles (AOs) are language models trained to answer natural-language questions about another model's internal activations. They offer a flexible interface for reading hidden information from model states, especially when relevant information is internally represented but absent or incomplete in visible behavior. However, AOs are themselves learned systems: their answers are shaped by training data, objectives, and learned reporting behavior, rather than being neutral readouts of represented information. We study this in a controlled Taboo Word Guessing setting, where subject models are fine-tuned to internally use a hidden concept while avoiding direct disclosure. Contrary to the expectation that an AO trained on such a subject becomes a specialist reader, we find that fine-tuned AOs can become concept-specific anti-readers: they selectively fail to recover the concept persistently present during their own training. This failure is not simply explained by absence of the concept from the subject or oracle representations: the target remains decodable inside the oracle, while LogitLens and layer-ablation analyses indicate that the failure arises in the AO readout pathway. Our results show that behavioral leakage, representation-level decodability, and AO-verbalizability can come apart, raising a reliability concern for learned interpretability interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究激活预言机（AO）——一种用自然语言回答其他模型内部激活状态的语言模型。在禁忌词猜测的受控实验中，作者发现，当主体模型被微调为内部使用隐藏概念但避免直接泄露时，AO不仅没有成为更好的专业读者，反而会变成概念特异性的"反读者"：它选择性地无法恢复自己训练过程中持续存在的概念。这种失败并非源于概念在表示层面的缺失，而是出现在AO的读出路径中。研究表明，行为泄露、表示层可解码性与AO可言语化三者可能彼此分离，对可解释性接口的可靠性提出质疑。
AI.motivation: 激活预言机（AO）作为一种灵活的解释性工具，被用于读取模型内部隐藏信息，但其本身也是一个学习系统，其输出受训练数据、目标和学习到的报告行为影响，而非中立的内部信息读取器。作者希望探究AO在受控环境下是否真正可靠地反映模型内部表示。
AI.method: 在禁忌词猜测（Taboo Word Guessing）设定下进行受控实验：主体模型被微调为内部使用隐藏概念但避免直接披露。训练AO读取主体模型的激活状态，并分析AO能否恢复该隐藏概念。使用LogitLens和逐层消融分析等方法定位失败原因。
AI.result: 微调后的AO变成概念特异性的"反读者"：它选择性地无法恢复自己训练期间持续存在的概念。这种失败不是由于概念在主体或预言机表示中的缺失——目标概念在预言机内部仍可解码。LogitLens和层消融分析表明，失败出现在AO的读出路径（readout pathway）中。
AI.conclusion: 行为泄露、表示层可解码性与AO可言语化三者可以相互分离。这揭示了基于学习的可解释性接口存在可靠性问题——AO并非中立的内部信息读取器，其输出可能受到训练动态的扭曲。

title: CrossSpine: Multi-scale Cross-sequence Attention with Anatomical Priors for Automated Pfirrmann Grading
summary: Automated grading of Lumbar Disc Degeneration is essential for the objective quantification of structural changes associated with low back pain. Observing that baseline models underperformed on our data, we propose a framework designed to overcome these limitations. First, we present the Cross-sequence Attention Spine (CrossSpine) framework, a novel architecture that employs a cross-sequence attention mechanism to adaptively fuse features from different MRI sequences at multiple spa- tial scales. Second, we contribute a meticulously curated dataset aimed at automated Pfirrmann grading. Finally, we introduce an IVD-aware classification technique that integrates anatomical disc-level information, enabling the model to learn level-specific degeneration priors. Our experi- ments demonstrate the superiority of this approach: CrossSpine achieved a relative improvement exceeding 125% in the Macro F1 score, while boosting the Mean AUPRC by 99% and the Mean AUROC by 36% com- pared to the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossSpine框架用于腰椎间盘退变自动分级，通过跨序列注意力机制融合多MRI序列特征，结合IVD-aware分类技术利用椎间盘水平先验信息，在Macro F1、Mean AUPRC和Mean AUROC上分别提升125%、99%和36%。
AI.motivation: 现有基线模型在腰椎间盘退变自动分级任务上表现不佳，缺乏有效融合不同MRI序列信息及利用解剖学椎间盘级别先验知识的方法。
AI.method: 1) CrossSpine框架：采用跨序列注意力机制自适应融合不同MRI序列的多尺度特征；2) 构建了专门用于Pfirrmann分级的精标注数据集；3) IVD-aware分类技术：整合解剖学椎间盘级别信息，让模型学习级别特定的退变先验。
AI.result: 相比基线，Macro F1提升125%+，Mean AUPRC提升99%，Mean AUROC提升36%。
AI.conclusion: CrossSpine框架在多序列MRI融合和椎间盘水平先验利用上显著优于基线，为腰椎间盘退变自动分级提供了更准确有效的方案。

title: From Hybrid Mechanistic--Data-Driven Modeling Toward Neuro-Symbolic AI: What, Why, and How
summary:
Hybrid mechanistic/data-driven models, which combine first-principles with learned components, are increasingly used in process engineering and scientific machine learning. Common hybrid modeling designs are specified primarily through their architectures and training losses, which offers a limited basis for a shared semantic interface to compare or verify them across domains, with comparatively little attention paid to epistemic uncertainty in the mechanistic part.
  We bridge hybrid modeling and neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI by reconstructing these designs as instances of NeSy interface. The resulting translation, Hybrid-to-NeSy (H2N), places mechanistic knowledge on the language side, learned modules on the belief side, and validity domains together with constraints on the logic side. For each design, H2N then yields an explicit NeSy inference functional and a logic-belief decomposition.
  From this decomposition we derive two metrics: structural violation rate (SVR), measuring whether the learned belief respects the mechanistic structure; and belief dispersion (BD), measuring how concentrated the learned plausibility is, serving as a hybrid model's epistemic uncertainty in its mechanistic part. We instantiate H2N on a case study of a structured hybrid model for binary classification under label noise and show that models with higher SVR and BD exhibit greater variability in held-out accuracy. Under structural distribution shift, H2N further quantifies a model's uncertainty during extrapolations, whereas test accuracy reveals the same shift only post hoc.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Hybrid-to-NeSy (H2N) 框架，将混合建模（机理+数据驱动）转化为神经符号 (NeSy) 接口，并由此导出两个新指标：结构违反率 (SVR) 和信念离散度 (BD)，用于衡量混合模型中机理部分的认知不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有混合建模设计主要通过架构和训练损失来定义，缺乏统一的语义接口来跨域比较或验证，且对机理部分的认知不确定性关注不足。
AI.method: 将混合建模设计重构为神经符号 (NeSy) 接口实例：机理知识放在语言侧，学习模块放在信念侧，有效性域和约束放在逻辑侧。从逻辑-信念分解中导出两个指标：SVR（衡量学习信念是否尊重机理结构）和 BD（衡量学习可信度的集中程度，即机理部分的认知不确定性）。
AI.result: 在标签噪声下的二分类结构化混合模型案例上，SVR 和 BD 更高的模型在留出精度上表现出更大的变异性；在结构分布偏移下，H2N 能量化外推中的不确定性，而测试精度只能事后揭示同一偏移。
AI.conclusion: H2N 为混合建模提供了统一的 NeSy 语义接口，导出的 SVR 和 BD 指标能有效监测混合模型中机理部分的认知不确定性，并且在外推场景下比传统测试精度更早地反映分布偏移。

title: Source-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Reliability Prior Approach
summary: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines rank retrieved documents by semantic similarity alone, without accounting for source provenance or credibility. This work evaluates a simple and interpretable modification to RAG retrieval ranking that incorporates domain-informed source reliability priors. Each document is assigned a prior lambda(s) based on its source type, and retrieval scores are reweighted using score(q, d) = sim(q, d) * lambda(s). The framework is evaluated against a similarity-only baseline on a 120-document health-domain corpus. In this controlled setting, source-aware reranking improves Precision@5 from 0.48 to 0.72 and reduces average adversarial document retrieval under the evaluated threat model, where low-credibility sources are identifiable via metadata. All experiments were executed on Rosie, the high-performance computing cluster at the Milwaukee School of Engineering, which provided the GPU-accelerated infrastructure necessary to run the full experimental pipeline reliably and reproducibly. These results suggest a potential mitigation strategy for source quality degradation in RAG pipelines, within the limits of the experimental setup described.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合源可靠性先验的RAG检索排序改进方法，通过文档来源类型赋予先验权重λ(s)，重新计算检索得分。在120篇健康领域文档的实验中，该方法将Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并降低了对抗性文档的检索率。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG管道仅基于语义相似度排序文档，忽略了文档来源的可信度和出处，导致低质量或不可信来源的文档可能被优先检索，影响生成质量。
AI.method: 为每个文档基于其来源类型分配先验权重λ(s)，检索得分由语义相似度sim(q,d)与来源权重λ(s)相乘得到，即score(q,d)=sim(q,d)*λ(s)，实现源感知的重排序。
AI.result: 在120篇健康领域文档的受控实验中，源感知重排序将Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并在评估的威胁模型下降低了低可信来源对抗性文档的平均检索率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种简单可解释的RAG管道源质量退化缓解策略，但有效性受限于实验设置条件。

title: Unifying Generative Recall and Multi-Objective Ranking in a Single Decoder-Only Sequence
summary: Modern industrial recommendation systems typically separate recall and ranking into two independent stages. Although this cascade supports corpus-level retrieval and fine-grained multi-objective scoring, it causes objective inconsistency, information loss at the candidate hand-off, and redundant user-side context computation. Meanwhile, the generative recall and ranking scaling share a common Transformer-based modeling philosophy, where architectural consistency creates a natural opportunity for unified integration. However, direct sharing remains challenging since the two tasks require different information visibility and optimization methods. Therefore, we propose \textbf{UniR$^2$}, a \textbf{Uni}fied decoder-only Transformer that unifies Generative \textbf{R}ecall and Multi-Objective \textbf{R}anking within a single heterogeneous sequence comprising user context, SID trajectory, and item features. Within this sequence, the generated trajectory serves as a representation bridge between recall and ranking, where Dual-Query Prefix-Causal Attention provides task-specific visibility. The two tasks share the base attention weights but retain separate optimization boundaries, with ranking-side LoRA preserving ranking adaptability without disrupting the generative backbone. Extensive offline experiments on large-scale industrial data demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of UniR$^2$ for both recall and ranking. Long-term online A/B tests on Kuaishou platform further show consistent positive gains, validating the practicality of unified model in large-scale recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UniR²，一个统一的decoder-only Transformer模型，通过异构序列（用户上下文、SID轨迹、物品特征）和Dual-Query Prefix-Causal Attention机制，在共享参数基础上实现生成式召回与多目标排序的统一，解决了工业推荐系统中召回与排序两阶段分离导致的客观不一致、信息丢失和计算冗余问题。大规模离线实验和快手平台长期在线A/B测试验证了其有效性和效率。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统的召回与排序两阶段分离导致了三个核心问题：目标不一致、候选传递时的信息丢失、以及用户端上下文的重复计算。同时，生成式召回和排序缩放均基于Transformer架构，存在架构一致性，但直接共享参数面临信息可见性和优化方法不同的挑战。
AI.method: 提出UniR²，一个统一的decoder-only Transformer模型。核心创新包括：(1) 构建包含用户上下文、SID轨迹和物品特征的异构序列；(2) 生成的SID轨迹作为召回和排序之间的表征桥梁；(3) Dual-Query Prefix-Causal Attention机制为两个任务提供特定的信息可见性；(4) 共享基础注意力权重但保留独立优化边界，排序侧使用LoRA保持排序适应性而不破坏生成式骨干网络。
AI.result: 大规模工业数据离线实验证明了UniR²在召回和排序上的有效性和效率；在快手平台的长期在线A/B测试中观察到一致的正面效果，验证了统一模型在大规模推荐系统中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: UniR²通过统一的decoder-only Transformer架构成功融合了生成式召回与多目标排序，为工业推荐系统提供了一种消除两阶段不一致、减少信息丢失和计算冗余的有效解决方案。

title: Verification-Conditioned Use: A Qualitative Study on How Generative AI Reshapes Learning, Autonomy, and Market Entry for Junior Software Developers
summary: Objective: to investigate how the use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools affects the early stages of a career in software development, from the perspective of the newcomers themselves. Method: thirteen interns and junior developers were interviewed individually, by videoconference. Interviews were analyzed using the six phases of Braun and Clarke's thematic analysis, with inductive coding and a semantic approach. Results: sixteen themes emerged, organized around a central concept: verification-conditioned use. Across the study's four research questions (usage patterns, learning, autonomy, and market entry), the criterion that most often decides between AI and manual work is not deadline or task complexity, but the ability to check the result. Two themes expose tensions in newcomers' self-perception: the autonomy paradox (feeling more capable yet less in ownership of the result) and the first-person denial of dependence. Together, these findings point to a theoretical contribution, the formative paradox: the shallow learning that AI induces makes it harder to build the very critical-judgment competence that, according to participants, the market has begun to demand. Conclusion: what makes AI use sustainable, from participants' own point of view, is not the tool itself but the individual practice of reviewing before accepting, refusing to use AI without understanding it, asking the tool for explanations, and keeping deliberate practice outside of AI-assisted work.

AI.tldr: 通过对13名实习生和初级开发人员的访谈，研究了生成式AI工具如何影响软件开发的早期职业阶段。核心发现是"验证条件性使用"——新人是否使用AI，关键取决于能否验证AI的输出结果。研究揭示了两个矛盾现象：自主性悖论（感觉更有能力但对自己产出的所有权感更低）和第一人称否认依赖。最终提出"形成性悖论"理论贡献：AI诱导的浅层学习反而削弱了市场所需的批判性判断能力。
AI.motivation: 了解生成式AI工具如何从新人自身的视角影响软件开发的早期职业阶段，填补现有研究中对新入行开发者体验和认知的关注不足。
AI.method: 对13名实习生和初级开发者进行视频会议一对一访谈，采用Braun和Clarke的六阶段主题分析法，使用归纳编码和语义学方法对访谈数据进行分析。
AI.result: 提炼出16个主题，围绕"验证条件性使用"这一核心概念组织。四个研究问题（使用模式、学习、自主性、市场进入）中最关键的决策标准不是截止日期或任务复杂度，而是能否验证结果。发现两个自我感知张力：自主性悖论（感觉更有能力但所有权感更低）和第一人称否认依赖。提出理论贡献"形成性悖论"：AI诱发的浅层学习反而削弱了市场所需的批判性判断能力。
AI.conclusion: 从参与者视角看，AI使用的可持续性不在于工具本身，而在于个人实践：在接受前审查、拒绝不理解的使用、要求AI提供解释、以及在AI辅助工作之外保持刻意练习。

title: LA-RL: Label-Aware Self-Reflection for Reinforcement Learning in Information Extraction
summary: Large language models show strong promise for information extraction (IE), but existing reflection-based correction methods are often misaligned with structured extraction outputs. Free-form self-reflection can flag an error, yet it rarely identifies whether the failure is a missing span, wrong label, boundary mismatch, invalid relation type, or reversed argument order. We introduce LA-RL (Label-Aware Reflective Reinforcement Learning), an outcome-supervised framework that guides IE self-correction with task-grounded diagnostic labels. A single backbone first predicts an extraction, diagnoses task-specific error labels, and then revises its output conditioned on the diagnosis. Training starts from diagnostic data labeled by an annotation model for cold-start supervised fine-tuning and proceeds through two GRPO stages that reward final extraction quality, format validity, and first-pass correctness, without a process reward model. Experiments on named entity recognition, relation extraction, and event extraction show consistent same-backbone gains over SFT, including 6.83 average F1 on SciER relation extraction, about 20 F1 on out-of-distribution relation extraction, and 14.80 trigger F1 plus 17.50 argument F1 on DuEE1.0. Ablations show that reflection structure is task-sensitive: stronger constraints benefit relation extraction, whereas named entity recognition needs less restrictive correction under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 提出了LA-RL（标签感知反思强化学习），一个面向信息抽取的自我修正框架，通过任务级错误标签指导模型进行诊断与修正，在多项IE任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反思的修正方法在结构化信息抽取输出上存在对齐问题，自由形式的自我反思难以识别具体失败类型（如缺失跨度、标签错误、边界不匹配、无效关系类型或参数顺序颠倒），需要更精确的错误诊断机制。
AI.method: 提出LA-RL框架，采用单骨干模型先预测抽取结果，再诊断任务特定的错误标签，最后基于诊断结果进行修正。训练分为两步：先用标注模型生成诊断数据进行冷启动监督微调，再通过两个GRPO阶段对最终抽取质量、格式有效性和首轮正确性进行奖励，无需过程奖励模型。
AI.result: 在NER、RE和EE任务上均超越SFT基线：SciER关系抽取平均F1提升6.83，跨域关系抽取约20 F1，DuEE1.0上触发词F1提升14.80、论元F1提升17.50。
AI.conclusion: 反思结构具有任务敏感性：关系抽取需要更强约束，而命名实体识别在领域迁移下需要更少的修正限制。

title: Open Your Model's Eyes: Video and Context-Aware Multimodal Backchannel Prediction
summary: Backchannels, which signal listener states like empathy and understanding, are fundamental to natural human interaction. However, current approaches rely solely on audio and text. This omits crucial visual cues, such as facial expressions and gestures, as well as broader conversational contexts, which are necessary for accurate prediction. In this paper, we introduce Context-Aware Multimodal Alignment for Backchannel Prediction (CAMA-BC), a novel framework that leverages visual information through Multi-Layer Multimodal Alignment (MMA). Our alignment process comprises two stages. First, Context Alignment (MMA-CA) utilizes unlabeled dialogues with videos to capture conversational contexts. Next, Backchannel Alignment (MMA-BA) fine-tunes the representations specifically for backchannel prediction. Experimental results show that CAMA-BC significantly outperforms both existing methods and simple multimodal baselines, with particular effectiveness in recognizing complex backchannels such as empathy.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMA-BC框架，通过多层多模态对齐方法融合视觉信息（面部表情、手势等），显著提升对话中反馈信号（尤其是共情类复杂反馈）的预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有反馈信号预测方法仅依赖音频和文本，忽视了面部表情、手势等关键视觉线索以及更广泛的对话上下文，导致预测不准确。
AI.method: 提出CAMA-BC框架，包含两阶段多层多模态对齐：(1) 上下文对齐阶段，利用未标注对话视频捕获对话上下文；(2) 反馈对齐阶段，微调表示以专门用于反馈信号预测。
AI.result: CAMA-BC显著优于现有方法及简单的多模态基线，尤其在识别共情等复杂反馈信号方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 引入视觉信息的多模态对齐方法对提升反馈信号预测（尤其是复杂类型）至关重要，为更自然的人机交互系统提供了新方向。

title: MEMENTO: Memory-Guided Memetic Code-as-Policy Evolution
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks require policies that execute many dependent actions before task success can be observed. Representing policies as executable control pro- grams (code-as-policy) enables their decision logic to be inspected and revised after rollout evaluation. Revised programs can then be executed and compared by rollout performance, framing policy improvement as execution-guided program search. Evo- lutionary methods driven by large language models (LLMs) provide a natural mecha- nism for this search by generating variants and selecting high-performing candidates. However, existing approaches primarily select among independently generated vari- ants and lack a sequential local improvement phase. We introduce MEMENTO, a memory-guided single-elite memetic framework for code-as-policy evolution. ME- MENTO first evolves a rollout evaluator that maps policy rollouts to scalar fitness and structured feedback metrics. Fitness selects accepted candidates and the next elite, while feedback metrics condition policy proposals generated by memory-guided hill-climbing, macro-mutation, and crossover. We evaluate MEMENTO on two long- horizon embodied domains: Robosuite Franka Tower-of-Hanoi manipulation and AI2- THOR household interaction. MEMENTO outperforms Eureka and REvolve, adapted as code-as-policy evolutionary baselines, in task success and generalization to held- out Robosuite object configurations and unseen AI2-THOR scenes. Ablations show that zero-shot generation and unevolved evaluators fail to solve either domain, and that removing policy-search branches reduces performance. Finally, we deploy the best-evolved Robosuite policy on a physical Franka robot, demonstrating the feasibil- ity of sim-to-real transfer of the evolved code-as-policy. Code, prompts, and videos are available at: https://github.com/sygkounas/MEMENTO.

AI.tldr: MEMENTO提出了一种基于记忆引导的memetic框架，用于代码即策略的进化优化，在长周期具身任务中通过进化评估器与记忆引导的局部搜索（爬山、宏变异、交叉）提升策略性能，在Robosuite和AI2-THOR两大领域超越Eureka和REvolve基线，并成功实现sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 长周期具身任务中，策略需要执行大量依赖动作才能观察任务成功状态，现有LLM驱动的进化方法主要从独立生成的变体中做选择，缺乏顺序的局部改进阶段，导致优化效率不足。
AI.method: 提出MEMENTO框架：(1) 进化出一个rollout评估器，输出标量适应度和结构化反馈指标；(2) 适应度用于筛选候选策略和选择精英；(3) 结构化反馈用于指导记忆引导的三种策略搜索分支：hill-climbing（局部爬山）、macro-mutation（宏变异）和crossover（交叉），实现持续迭代优化。
AI.result: 在Robosuite Franka Tower-of-Hanoi和AI2-THOR任务中，MEMENTO在任务成功率和泛化能力上均优于Eureka和REvolve基线；消融实验显示零样本生成和未进化评估器均无法解决问题，移除任一搜索分支均导致性能下降；最终成功将进化策略部署到物理Franka机器人上。
AI.conclusion: MEMENTO证明了结合记忆引导的局部搜索与进化策略在代码即策略范式中的有效性，并且通过sim-to-real迁移展示了其在实际机器人中的应用潜力。

title: The Scaffold Effect in Coding Agents: Harness Choice as a Hidden Variable in Coding-Agent Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Preliminary work; under review at the 5th DL4C Workshop @ ICML 2026
summary: Public leaderboards for coding agents typically rank systems by model name and pass rate, while the surrounding harness (the scaffold that issues tools, manages context, and decides when to stop) is often under-specified. Model-to-model comparison is valid when the harness is fixed; when it varies, performance and efficiency conflate model and scaffold effects. We evaluate Qwen 3.6 Plus and MiniMax M2.5 across three open-source harnesses (Goose, OpenCode, OpenHands-SDK) on a stratified 50-task subset of Terminal-Bench Pro. Harness choice induces up to a 40x difference in tokens per solved task, while paired within-model pass-rate differences remain 0-8 percentage points (95% paired-task bootstrap CIs include zero except for the largest gap). Failure fingerprints replicate across models (REASON for Goose, VERIFY/MAX_TURNS for OpenHands-SDK, idle-loop/TIME for OpenCode), indicating harness-level biases that are largely model-independent. For human-centered coding-agent evaluation, model name alone is an incomplete comparison unit: harness-model pairs determine real-world cost, latency, and oversight burden; no-action turns are a per-task wait tax, not just a token tax. We therefore recommend selecting harness-model pairs by pass rate under token/latency budgets, and reporting token usage, latency, and full harness specifications alongside any model comparison. We release anonymized configs, raw trial logs, aggregated snapshots, and analysis scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文发现编码智能体的评估中，脚手架（harness）选择会导致每解决任务的token消耗差异高达40倍，而模型间通过率差异仅0-8个百分点，建议将harness-模型配对作为评估单元。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体排行榜只报告模型名称和通过率，忽略了脚手架（harness）的影响，导致性能与效率评估中模型与脚手架效果混杂。
AI.method: 在Terminal-Bench Pro的50个任务子集上，用三个开源脚手架（Goose、OpenCode、OpenHands-SDK）评估两个模型（Qwen 3.6 Plus和MiniMax M2.5），采用配对任务Bootstrap统计方法。
AI.result: 脚手架选择导致每解决任务token消耗差异高达40倍；同一模型在不同脚手架上的通过率差异仅0-8个百分点（95%置信区间大多包含零）；失败模式（REASON、VERIFY/MAX_TURNS、idle-loop/TIME）在不同模型间可复现。
AI.conclusion: 模型名称不能作为评估的完整单元，应使用harness-模型配对；推荐在token/延迟预算下选择配对，并同时报告token使用量、延迟和完整脚手架规格。

title: Evaluating RAG for French immigration law: a benchmark and baseline study
summary: International recruitment in France requires navigating a layered legal framework absent from existing legal AI benchmarks. We present a publicly available benchmark and first comparative evaluation for this domain, covering permit-type recommendation, required-document retrieval, and legal citation coverage. Comparing a parametric LLM baseline against dense retrieval augmentation at two model scales (Qwen3.5-9B and -27B) on 52 annotated synthetic profiles, we find that retrieval improves administrative guidance at both scales, most notably permit-type accuracy. Our results confirm that retrieval grounding is important for more reliable administrative guidance in this domain, and motivate further investigation of hybrid retrieval strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对法国国际招聘中复杂的法律框架，构建了公开基准并首次进行对比评估，涵盖许可类型推荐、所需文件检索和法律引用覆盖。研究发现，检索增强（RAG）能显著提升大模型在行政指导任务中的表现，尤其提高了许可类型推荐的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有法律AI基准未覆盖法国国际招聘中多层级法律框架的复杂性，缺乏针对该领域的可用评估基准。
AI.method: 构建公开基准，包含许可类型推荐、所需文件检索和法律引用覆盖三类任务。使用52个带注释的合成档案，对比纯参数化LLM（Qwen3.5-9B和27B）与稠密检索增强方法的性能。
AI.result: 检索增强在两种模型规模上均提升了行政指导表现，其中许可类型推荐的准确性提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强对于提高该领域行政指导的可靠性至关重要，并建议进一步探索混合检索策略。

title: Reasoning or Memorization: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Chinese Xiehouyu Riddles?
comment: 20 pages; exp 3 is work in progress
summary: In this paper, we push the boundary of LLM reasoning by testing them in a Chinese language game, xiehouyu, with novel xiehouyu created by linguists that had not existed before to avoid data contamination. We use multiple-choice questions (MCQ), free-form explanation generation, and new xiehouyu creation to evaluate LLMs' ability to understand and create xiehouyu. In MCQ, we use the delta of accuracy ($Δ_{acc}$) between existing but low-frequency xiehouyu and novel ones as an index for memorization. $Δ_{acc}$ for native speakers is very low, suggesting similar processing mechanisms. However, we found that frontier Chinese models have on average a $Δ_{acc}$ of 23.6\%, while English-centric models tested have a mean $Δ_{acc}$ of 5.1\%, suggesting that frontier Chinese models are likely trained with much larger Chinese data, thus memorizing more low-frequency xiehouyu. For novel xiehouyu, Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrated remarkable ability with acc 92.6, which is 24\% higher than human accuracy. In xiehouyu creation, those created by LLMs receive much worse ratings than those by humans. These results suggest that claims about the reasoning abilities of LLMs may need careful re-examination considering the data contamination issue, and that LLMs' creativity in language-related tasks may still be behind human experts, at least in Chinese xiehouyu.

AI.tldr: 本文通过创造全新的歇后语（避免数据污染），测试LLM在中文语言游戏中的推理能力，发现前沿中文模型存在严重记忆化问题（Δ_acc达23.6%），而Gemini 3.1 Pro在新歇后语选择题上超越人类24%，但在创作任务上LLM仍远逊于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理能力评估存在数据污染问题，模型可能依赖记忆而非真正推理。作者希望通过在测试中使用从未出现过的新歇后语，区分模型的真实推理能力与记忆效应。
AI.method: 由语言学家创造全新的歇后语，设计三项评估任务：1) 多项选择（既有低频 vs 全新歇后语，用准确率差值Δ_acc衡量记忆程度）；2) 自由形式解释生成；3) 新歇后语创作。对比人类表现与不同语言范式的LLM（中文模型 vs 英文中心模型）。
AI.result: 中文模型Δ_acc平均23.6%（记忆严重），英文模型平均5.1%；Gemini 3.1 Pro在新歇后语选择题上准确率92.6%，超过人类24%；但在创作任务中，LLM生成的歇后语评分远低于人类。
AI.conclusion: LLM的推理能力宣称需谨慎对待（数据污染问题），且至少在中文歇后语领域，LLM的创造性仍落后于人类专家。

title: Calibration-Free 3D Multi-Camera People Tracking for Indoor Environment
summary: Multi-Camera People Tracking (MCPT) traditionally relies on precise intrinsic and extrinsic camera calibration to project 2D detections into a unified 3D world coordinate system.However, manual calibration constitutes a major bottleneck in large-scale dataset generation from unconstrained video archives.  This work proposes a unified calibration-free 3D MCPT framework that infers geometric structure directly from visual data using deep foundation models.  The system integrates anchor-free detection (YOLOX), robust tracking (BoT-SORT), omni-scale appearance embedding (OsNet), pose estimation (HRNet via MMPose), and transformer-based geometric reconstruction using the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT). A pose-guided 3D lifting strategy projects head keypoints onto a reconstructed manifold, eliminating dependence on ground-plane homography. Global identity association is formulated as hierarchical agglomerative clustering under a joint appearance-geometry cost with strict velocity gating. Evaluation on the AI City Challenge 2024 demonstrates a HOTA score of 53.13% without access to ground-truth calibration matrices, establishing a strong baseline for purely vision-based 3D tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需相机标定的多摄像头3D行人追踪框架，利用深度基础模型从视觉数据中直接推断几何结构，在AI City Challenge 2024上取得53.13%的HOTA分数，为纯视觉3D追踪建立了强基线。
AI.motivation: 传统多摄像头行人追踪（MCPT）依赖精确的内外参标定来将2D检测投影到统一3D坐标系，但手动标定是从非约束视频档案生成大规模数据集的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 集成无锚点检测（YOLOX）、鲁棒追踪（BoT-SORT）、全尺度外观嵌入（OsNet）、姿态估计（HRNet/MMPose）以及基于Transformer的几何重建（VGGT）；采用姿态引导的3D提升策略将头部关键点投影到重建流形上，消除地平面单应性依赖；全局身份关联被形式化为联合外观-几何代价下的层次凝聚聚类，并带有严格的速度门控。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2024上，无需真实标定矩阵即可达到53.13%的HOTA分数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了纯视觉驱动的3D多摄像头追踪的可行性，为无需人工标定的追踪系统提供了强有力的基线方法。

title: Frustratingly Simple Black-Box Adaptation of Language Models via Logit Bias
comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Appendix included. Code available at https://github.com/Ofek-Israeli/logit_bias_lm_adaptation
summary: Many organizations aim to adapt language models for internal use, both to improve performance on domain-specific tasks and to address privacy concerns around sensitive data. However, such adaptation remains non-trivial: it often requires operationally challenging fine-tuning of open-source models or ad hoc prompt optimization. We study a minimal alternative based on a simple API-level control: allowing users to bias the model's logits with a user-defined vector. We develop a black-box method for learning a single context-independent logit-bias vector, added at every decoding step, without modifying model weights or requiring gradients. Starting from a KL-regularized reinforcement learning (RL) objective, we characterize when such a fixed logit-bias vector can approximate the optimal prefix-dependent correction and derive a closed-form inverse-propensity estimator from rollouts, rewards, and token probabilities. Empirically, this simple decoding-time intervention improves over base models on mathematical and reasoning benchmarks while using far fewer trainable parameters than conventional fine-tuning. Our results suggest that learned logit bias is a lightweight mechanism for adapting language models under minimal access requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级方法：通过学习一个固定的logit偏置向量（在每步解码时添加），在不修改模型权重或需要梯度的情况下，仅利用API级别的控制来适配语言模型。该方法从KL正则化强化学习目标出发，推导出固定偏置向量何时能近似最优前缀相关校正，并给出闭合形式的逆倾向性估计器。实验表明，该方法在数学和推理任务上优于基础模型，且参数量远少于传统微调。
AI.motivation: 许多组织希望将语言模型适配到内部使用，以提升领域任务性能并解决敏感数据的隐私问题，但现有方法（如微调开源模型或优化提示词）操作复杂。因此，本文探索一种更简单的替代方案——仅通过API级别的logit偏置控制来实现模型适配。
AI.method: 提出一种黑盒方法：学习一个上下文无关的固定logit偏置向量，在每步解码时添加。从KL正则化强化学习目标出发，推导固定偏置向量近似最优前缀相关校正的条件，并利用rollout、奖励和token概率得到闭合形式的逆倾向性估计器。整个过程无需修改模型权重或计算梯度。
AI.result: 在数学和推理基准上，该解码时干预方法优于基础模型，且使用的可训练参数远少于传统微调方法。
AI.conclusion: 学习logit偏置是一种轻量级的语言模型适配机制，适用于最小化访问权限要求（仅需API）的场景。

title: MM-ShiftKV: Decode-Aware Prefill-Stage KV Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its memory footprint grows linearly with context length and becomes a major bottleneck due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent prefill-stage KV selection methods estimate KV importance from prefilling statistics, implicitly assuming that prefilling-time queries are representative of those encountered during decoding. We show that this assumption breaks down in multimodal inference, where decoding-time queries exhibit substantially larger variance than prefilling-stage representations, leading to unstable KV importance estimation under tight cache budgets. As a result, small ranking errors can disproportionately discard semantically critical visual tokens and degrade grounding and reasoning performance. We propose MM-ShiftKV, a training-free, decode-aware and strictly prefill-only KV selection method. MM-ShiftKV approximates decoding-time query behavior during prefilling by constructing variance-expanded query proxies and estimates prompt KV importance based on their aggregated attention mass. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that MM-ShiftKV consistently outperforms existing methods under strict KV-cache budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/MM-ShiftKV.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大模型KV缓存中解码阶段查询方差大导致预填充阶段重要性估计不准的问题，提出无需训练的MM-ShiftKV方法，通过构造方差扩展查询代理来模拟解码行为，在严格缓存预算下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存选择方法在预填充阶段估算token重要性时，隐含假设预填充阶段的查询能代表解码阶段，但多模态推理中解码阶段查询方差远大于预填充阶段，导致在严格缓存预算下重要性估计不稳定，容易丢弃关键视觉token，影响定位和推理性能。
AI.method: 提出MM-ShiftKV方法，是一种无需训练、解码感知且严格仅用预填充信息的KV选择方法。通过构造方差扩展的查询代理来近似解码阶段的查询行为，并基于聚合注意力权重估算Prompt KV的重要性。
AI.result: 在多模态基准测试上，MM-ShiftKV在严格的KV缓存预算下始终优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 解码阶段查询方差大是导致多模态大模型KV缓存重要性估计失效的关键因素，MM-ShiftKV通过预填充阶段模拟解码行为有效缓解了该问题。

title: Robust Interpretation of Historical Documents in Knowledge Graphs Through Query Inference and Execution
summary:
The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has redefined how users interact with information in digital environments. However, their widespread and often indiscriminate integration has raised significant concerns regarding reliability and trustworthiness issues that are particularly critical when accessing digital libraries and historical archives. How can one leverage the generalization capacity of an LLM without losing the level of accountability required for an archival institution? In this paper, we present an agentic retrieval system designed to deliver more accurate and verifiable access to historical data while preserving much of the flexibility associated with unconstrained LLMs. As a contribution to historical document analysis, we compare traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with an agentic GraphRAG architecture in their ability to deliver historical information under realistic conditions, including the presence of OCR and transcription errors.
  We introduce a semi-symbolic framework that integrates word-spotting techniques for post-OCR correction with a knowledge graph representation that enables the agent to access information through synthesized queries. The interleaved collaboration between word spotting and code generation allows the agent to construct strong retrieval queries that are robust to misinterpretation and hallucination, while still leveraging approximate search when noise and uncertainty, common in historical document analysis, would otherwise hinder precise retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种半符号化的智能检索系统，结合词点检测与知识图谱，在保留LLM灵活性的同时提升历史档案检索的准确性和可验证性，并对比了传统RAG与GraphRAG在OCR错误下的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM在数字图书馆和历史档案中广泛应用，但其可靠性和可信度不足；如何在保留LLM泛化能力的同时，达到档案机构所需的问责标准，是核心动机。
AI.method: 提出半符号化框架，集成词点检测（word-spotting）进行OCR后纠错，并构建知识图谱表示；通过智能体（agent）利用代码生成合成查询，实现词点检测与代码生成的交错协作，构建鲁棒的检索查询。
AI.result: 在包含OCR和转录错误的真实条件下，对比了传统RAG与智能体GraphRAG架构的历史信息检索表现，所提方法对噪声和不确定性具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 智能体GraphRAG架构结合半符号化方法，能有效兼顾LLM的灵活性与历史档案检索所需的准确性和可验证性，是对历史文档分析的有力贡献。

title: Do LLM Debates Repeat Arguments Differently Across Languages?
summary: LLM debate is usually evaluated by final answers, but transcripts also reveal whether later turns develop new argumentative content or return to earlier claims in new wording. We study this process with \textit{prior-argument similarity}, an aggregate diagnostic comparing extracted argument units with earlier units in the same debate. In controlled eight-turn debates over 71 motions, six languages, and four model agents, Chinese is the only tested language with a consistently positive gap relative to English across three multilingual embedding models. The gap persists across agents, turn positions, regression adjustment, metric variants, extraction-length controls, a second-extractor subset, and cross-encoder tail rescoring. Manual calibration shows weak item-level alignment but a high-similarity tail enriched for substantive repetition. A diversity-aware prompt lowers prior-argument similarity across languages, yet does not significantly narrow the Chinese--English gap. These findings suggest that multilingual debate evaluation should measure argumentative development over time and report mitigation effects in both average and gap terms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“先前论据相似度”指标，发现中文辩论比英文更倾向于重复而非发展新论点，且该差距在多种控制下依然稳健，提示多语言辩论评估需关注论点发展。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM辩论评估通常只关注最终答案，忽略了对话过程中论据是否真正发展（引入新内容）还是仅换句话重复先前说法。
AI.method: 提出“先前论据相似度”（prior-argument similarity）指标，在71个议题、6种语言、4种模型的8轮辩论中提取论据单元并计算与早期单元的相似度。
AI.result: 中文是唯一在所有三种多语言嵌入模型上始终比英文呈现更高相似度（更多重复）的语言；该差距在多种控制（agent、轮次、回归调整、指标变体、提取长度、第二提取器、交叉编码器尾部重打分）下依然存在；多样性提示虽降低各语言的相似度，但未能显著缩小中英差距。
AI.conclusion: 多语言辩论评估应当衡量论据随时间的发展程度，并同时报告平均值和语言间差距的缓解效果。

title: Generative Augmentation for EEG Motor Imagery Classification: A Class-Conditional VAE with Cycle-Consistent Decoder Refinement
summary: We investigate whether a generative model can supply useful synthetic motor-imagery (MI) electroencephalography (EEG) trials that improve the accuracy of independent downstream classifiers. We train a class-conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) with an integrated latent classifier on the Zhou motor-imagery dataset, using the learned per-class prior as a generator: sampling the prior for a given label and decoding it into a synthetic, label-consistent signal. A constraint on the covariance matrix of the generated data encourages preservation of covariance structure, and the model is trained with a schedule that alternates ordinary VAE training with a decoder-focused phase that sharpens the generative pathway used for augmentation. We measure the effect of adding synthetic trials to the training set under two evaluation protocols -- within-user (pooled 60/20/20 split across subjects) and cross-user (leave-one-subject-out, LOSO) -- across four representative EEG classification pipelines: Common Spatial Patterns with Linear Discriminant Analysis (CSP+LDA), tangent-space features with a Support Vector Machine (TGSP+SVM), Minimum Distance to Riemannian Mean (MDM), and a neural network based on EEGNetv4 (henceforth EEGNet). Results are aggregated across independent augmentation draws, random seeds (within-user), or leave-one-subject-out folds (cross-user), with uncertainty reported as 95\% confidence intervals (Student's $t$-distribution) computed over per-seed/per-fold averages. We find that synthetic EEG from the CVAE is most credible as a source of class-structured, covariance-like data rather than as a substitute for real raw EEG: it can raise the point estimate for MDM, but the broader augmentation claim remains conservative -- observed gains are small and classifier-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了类条件变分自编码器（CVAE）生成的合成运动想象脑电信号能否提升下游分类器的性能，结果表明增益较小且依赖分类器类型。
AI.motivation: 探究生成模型能否产生有用的合成MI-EEG数据，以提高独立下游分类器的分类准确率，缓解真实EEG数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 使用CVAE在Zhou运动想象数据集上训练，集成潜在分类器，通过采样每类先验生成类别一致的合成信号；约束生成数据的协方差矩阵以保持协方差结构；采用交替训练调度（普通VAE训练与解码器聚焦阶段交替）；在两种评估协议（用户内和跨用户LOSO）下，使用四种分类管道（CSP+LDA, TGSP+SVM, MDM, EEGNet）进行测试。
AI.result: 合成EEG对MDM的点估计有提升，但整体增益较小且依赖分类器类型；合成数据更像是有类别结构的协方差数据，而非真实原始EEG的替代品。
AI.conclusion: CVAE生成的合成MI-EEG对分类性能的提升有限且不稳健，其价值更在于提供类别结构化信息，而非替代真实EEG数据。

title: Same Predictions, Different Reasons: The Effect of Quantization on Model Explanations
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become a practical solution for deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained edge devices by compressing high-precision floating-point weights into low-precision representations without requiring retraining. Past research has demonstrated that quantization largely preserves classification accuracy; however, whether it also preserves the model's internal reasoning remains an open question. This study presents a systematic evaluation on how static PTQ affects the interpretability / explainability of five widely used CNN architectures: VGG19, ResNet18, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet161, and MobileNetV2 at INT8 and INT4 precision. We employ a dual interpretability framework that combines Grad-CAM for spatial attention analysis with LIME for input-level feature attribution, and systematically compare full-precision and quantized models on two binary classification datasets. Interpretability is evaluated using three complementary metrics: the Pearson correlation coefficient, structural similarity index, and top-20% IoU to capture distributional and structural variations in model explanations, supplemented by deletion/insertion faithfulness analysis. The results show that classification accuracy is not a reliable indicator of interpretability stability under reduced precision. DenseNet161 maintains strong feature consistency across both precision levels, whereas EfficientNet-B0, despite achieving competitive spatial attention and classification accuracy at INT8 precision, exhibits a substantial degradation in input-level feature attribution. These findings have direct implications for the trustworthy deployment of quantized models in applications with high interpretability requirements, demonstrating that architecture selection is as important as the quantization strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了静态后训练量化（PTQ）对五种CNN架构（VGG19、ResNet18、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet161、MobileNetV2）在INT8和INT4精度下的可解释性影响。发现分类精度不能可靠指示可解释性稳定性，DenseNet161保持最佳特征一致性，而EfficientNet-B0在INT8下虽保持良好空间注意力和分类精度，但输入级特征归因显著退化。
AI.motivation: 已有研究证明量化能大致保持分类精度，但量化是否保留模型内部推理机制仍不清楚。本文旨在系统评估PTQ对模型可解释性的影响，填补量化模型在可解释性信任度方面的研究空白。
AI.method: 采用双可解释性框架：Grad-CAM（空间注意力分析）结合LIME（输入级特征归因）。在INT8和INT4精度下比较五种CNN架构。使用三种互补指标（皮尔逊相关系数、结构相似性指数、top-20% IoU）评估可解释性，辅以删除/插入忠实度分析。
AI.result: 分类精度不是可解释性稳定性的可靠指标。DenseNet161在两个精度下均保持强特征一致性；EfficientNet-B0在INT8下空间注意力和分类精度良好，但输入级特征归因显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 量化模型在高可解释性需求的应用中部署时，架构选择与量化策略同等重要。不同架构对量化的鲁棒性差异显著，需根据应用场景选择合适架构。

title: TriSP: Tri-Signal Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks but their deployment is constrained by the memory and compute cost of their parameters. Structured pruning addresses this by removing entire structures such as attention heads and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neurons to produce smaller dense models that run efficiently on standard hardware. However, existing methods rely on either gradient-based importance estimation, which is memory-prohibitive, or activation-based statistical proxies, which do not directly measure the effect of removal on the loss. Furthermore, the interaction between the importance criterion and the post-pruning recovery strategy has not been systematically studied. We propose TriSP (Tri-Signal Structured Pruning), an importance metric that combines weight magnitude scaled by activation norm with first-order gradient sensitivity via a geometric mean, producing a channel-level score that captures both structural and loss-sensitivity signals. Combined with adaptive per-layer budget allocation and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) recovery, TriSP achieves the lowest perplexity and highest zero-shot accuracy across all tested configurations, reaching 6.80 WikiText-2 perplexity at 20% pruning on LLaMA-7B. Inference throughput improves by 82% at 50% pruning, while still maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TriSP方法，结合权重幅度、激活范数和一阶梯度敏感性进行结构化剪枝，在LLaMA-7B上20%剪枝率下达到6.80困惑度，50%剪枝率下推理吞吐量提升82%。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法要么需要消耗大量内存的梯度估计，要么使用激活统计代理无法直接衡量移除对损失的影响，且重要性准则与剪枝后恢复策略的交互未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出TriSP重要性度量，通过几何均值结合权重幅度、激活范数和一阶梯度敏感性，生成通道级分数；配合自适应逐层预算分配和LoRA恢复。
AI.result: 在所有测试配置中取得最低困惑度和最高零样本准确率；LLaMA-7B在20%剪枝率下WikiText-2困惑度6.80；50%剪枝率下推理吞吐量提升82%且性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TriSP方法在结构化剪枝中有效平衡了效果与效率，通过三信号融合和适配恢复策略实现了优异的剪枝性能。

title: DeCoRAG: Cognitive Decoupling and Semantic-Aware Cropping for Complex Document Understanding
summary: Advancing multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for complex document understanding presents a formidable dual dilemma of accuracy and efficiency, particularly in graph RAG. Processing structurally sparse yet visually dense layouts, such as extracting a tiny data marker from a financial chart, often incurs computationally prohibitive token overhead while still triggering catastrophic hallucination. However, multimodal Graph RAG pipelines rely on graph-construction stages that assume Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can resolve sparse semantics within high-density layouts. We challenge this assumption, revealing that forcing VLMs to localize visual evidence, interpret semantics, and extract relations triggers a "Visual Attention Sink," a mechanism driving catastrophic semantic loss, while full-page processing incurs massive computational overhead. Controlled interventions verify that this failure is boundary-driven rather than content-specific and that semantic anchoring mitigates it. To fundamentally correct this flawed paradigm, we introduce DeCoRAG, a multimodal Graph RAG pipeline that shifts knowledge processing from coupled visual-semantic reasoning to "Cognitive Decoupling." Rather than passively processing raw pixels, its graph-construction stage establishes a macroscopic Semantic Anchor to neutralize the attention sink. This anchor subsequently drives our Region-Aware Pruning and Cropping (RAP-Crop) mechanism, shifting the reasoning space from dense, noisy backgrounds to purified, intent-driven semantic clusters. The resulting graph supports hybrid retrieval and answer generation. Across complex document benchmarks, DeCoRAG improves the semantic pass rate by up to 12.5 percentage points over the strongest baseline and generalizes to DocVQA. RAP-Crop reduces offline graph-construction prompt tokens by 40.8% without sacrificing end-to-end accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeCoRAG，一种多模态图RAG流水线，通过"认知解耦"（先建立语义锚点，再执行区域感知裁剪）来缓解VLM在密集文档理解中的"视觉注意力塌陷"问题，在提升准确率的同时降低40.8%的图构建阶段token开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态图RAG在处理结构稀疏但视觉密集的文档（如金融图表）时存在双重困境：一是VLM在高密度布局中定位视觉证据和提取关系时会发生"视觉注意力塌陷"，导致语义丢失和幻觉；二是全页处理带来巨大的计算开销。本文挑战了现有图RAG依赖VLM解决稀疏语义的假设，并证明该失败是边界驱动的而非内容特定的。
AI.method: 提出DeCoRAG流水线，核心是"认知解耦"范式：1）图构建阶段先建立宏观"语义锚点"来中和注意力塌陷；2）基于该锚点驱动"区域感知剪枝与裁剪（RAP-Crop）"机制，将推理空间从密集背景转移到净化后的语义簇；3）支持混合检索和答案生成。
AI.result: 在复杂文档基准上，DeCoRAG的语义通过率比最强基线提升12.5个百分点；泛化到DocVQA任务；RAP-Crop在保持端到端精度的前提下，将离线图构建的提示词token减少40.8%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了VLM失败是边界驱动而非内容特定，并通过语义锚点可以缓解该问题；认知解耦范式从根本上修正了现有图RAG的缺陷，兼顾了准确性与效率。

title: CRAFT: Learn the Schema, Execute the Plan
summary: Enterprise coding agents translate natural-language analytical requests into executable code over proprietary APIs, schemas, and metric definitions. Yet the prevailing deployment pattern injecting exhaustive schema and tool documentation into each prompt increases inference overhead, complicates schema evolution, and undermines reliability in multi-turn analysis. We investigate whether stable schema knowledge and tool-use behavior can instead be acquired through post-training while preserving the consistency required for production-facing analytics. We present CRAFT, a two-stage post-training recipe for schema-grounded coding agents. First, schema-stripped PLAN supervised fine-tuning learns domain-structured plans and executable behaviors from validated trajectories without exhaustive prompt-time schema injection. Second, execution-shaped reinforcement learning aligns the policy for tool selection, code quality, plan-code consistency, and recovery from failed executions. Training trajectories are curated through a Tri-Gate filter combining execution validation, data-integrity checks, and LLM-judge reasoning audit. We evaluate CRAFT for planned rollout in advertising analytics, covering campaign performance analysis, metric drill-downs, entity-level performance analysis, and multi-turn analytical refinement. The enterprise evaluation environment incorporates beta APIs as the agent-facing tool surface and spans 25 schema-linked core entities and 30 agentic workflows. Relative to a schema-stuffed baseline, CRAFT improves composite Agent Score by +9.6 pp, consistency by +4.1 pp, and multi-turn coherence by +4.2 pp, while reducing input-token burden by approximately 9x and schema-discovery loops by up to 5x. We further report deployment tradeoffs, reward-shaping limitations, and training-infrastructure extensions required for multi-turn tool-use reinforcement learning in enterprise settings.

AI.tldr: 提出CRAFT两阶段后训练方法，使编码智能体通过后训练获取模式知识与工具使用行为，无需在提示中注入完整模式文档，在广告分析场景中实现性能提升与9倍输入token缩减。
AI.motivation: 当前企业编码智能体将完整模式与工具文档注入每个提示，导致推理开销大、模式演化复杂、多轮分析可靠性差。本文探索能否通过后训练让智能体稳定习得模式知识与工具行为，同时保持生产级一致性。
AI.method: 两阶段后训练方法CRAFT：1) PLAN阶段——模式剥离的有监督微调，从验证轨迹中学习领域结构化计划和可执行行为，无需提示时注入完整模式；2) 执行形状强化学习阶段——对齐工具选择、代码质量、计划-代码一致性和失败恢复策略。训练轨迹通过Tri-Gate过滤器（执行验证+数据完整性检查+LLM推理审计）筛选。
AI.result: 相比注入完整模式的基线，CRAFT在Agent Score上提升9.6个百分点，一致性提升4.1个百分点，多轮连贯性提升4.2个百分点；输入token负担减少约9倍，模式发现循环减少最多5倍。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT有效证明了企业级编码智能体可以通过后训练获取稳定的模式知识和工具使用能力，在降低推理开销的同时提升多轮分析性能，为生产环境部署提供了可行方案。

title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Context-Injected Fine-Tuning for Legal QA in Bangladesh
summary: A small language model can receive the governing statutory provision and still answer incorrectly. We test whether fine-tuning on examples containing relevant law improves later use of retrieved law. We curate 2{,}165 bilingual QA records from six Bangladeshi acts and three schedules, then fine-tune Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B. Evaluation uses the 2022 and 2023 Bangladesh Bar Council exams in Bangla and machine-translated English, with no retrieval, BM25, or FAISS, scored by strict consistency over three seeded runs. At 0.8B, fine-tuning raises the 2022 English FAISS score from 2 to 34 of 100. Gains at 0.8B and 2B survive paired testing, but the 4B model has no detectable net gain: Bangla improves while several English conditions regress. Fine-tuning also reduces answers that drift from Bangla into mostly English from 44.0--53.2\% to 0.2--0.7\%, with adjusted $p<.001$ at every scale. Retrieval quality is therefore not the only bottleneck. Small bilingual legal models also differ in how they use supplied law and whether they answer in the requested language. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/momahadi/bangladesh-legal-qa-dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了微调小语言模型（0.8B、2B、4B）使用孟加拉法律QA数据后，是否能提升检索法律条文时的回答准确率。结果显示，0.8B和2B模型有明显提升，但4B模型在英文条件下出现倒退；微调还显著减少了语言漂移（从孟加拉语混入英语）。作者指出，检索质量并非唯一瓶颈，模型规模和语言使用方式同样关键。
AI.motivation: 现有小语言模型即使获取了正确的法律条文，仍可能回答错误。本文想探究：通过微调让模型学习包含相关法律的示例，是否能改善其对检索到法律条文的利用能力。
AI.method: 从孟加拉国六部法案和三个附表构建了2165个双语QA数据，对Qwen3.5的0.8B、2B、4B三个规模模型进行微调。评估使用2022和2023年孟加拉律师资格考试题目（孟加拉语及机器翻译英语），检索方式包括无检索、BM25、FAISS，评价指标为三次不同随机种子下的严格一致性分数。
AI.result: 0.8B模型微调后，2022年英语FAISS得分从2提升至34（满分100）。0.8B和2B在配对检验下显著提升；4B模型整体无净收益——孟加拉语提升但多个英语条件下降。微调还将语言漂移（从孟加拉语混入英语）从44.0%-53.2%降至0.2%-0.7%，所有规模下调整后p<0.001。
AI.conclusion: 检索质量不是唯一瓶颈。小规模双语法律模型在使用提供的法律条文以及使用哪种语言回答方面存在差异，模型规模和语言控制能力同样重要。

title: Fast Fourier Convolutional GAN for 30 m Clear-Sky Land Surface Temperature Gap-Free Reconstruction
summary: Satellite-derived Land Surface Temperature (LST) provides spatially comprehensive data that ground stations cannot match. However, its utility is frequently limited by severe data gaps due to the presence of clouds. As LST is essential for understanding land-atmosphere interactions, numerous methods have been proposed to address this challenge. Yet, the development of a scalable and adaptable pipeline for generating gap-free LST datasets and reconstructing cloud-contaminated pixels remains challenging. Moreover, the reconstruction of extensive missing regions in fine-spatial-resolution observations is particularly difficult. To address this challenge, we propose a Multimodal Fast Fourier Convolutional GAN for reconstructing cloud-contaminated pixels in fine-resolution (30 m) Landsat imagery to generate gap-free clear-sky LST products. The method leverages Fast Fourier Convolution to enable a global receptive field across the image, and is guided by a stack of data consisting of satellite observations and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data. Across all LST quantiles, the interquartile range of scene-averaged RMSE (computed over reconstructed pixels) is consistently between 0.8 K and 1.8 K. The proposed approach enables the recovery of extensive missing regions, including scenes with more than 70% cloud-induced gaps, while relying on auxiliary data that are readily available at a near-global scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模态快速傅里叶卷积生成对抗网络（MFFC-GAN）的方法，用于重建Landsat卫星30米分辨率地表温度数据中因云污染导致的缺失像素，生成无间隙的晴空LST产品。该方法利用快速傅里叶卷积实现全局感受野，并结合合成孔径雷达（SAR）等多模态辅助数据，即使在超过70%云覆盖的场景下也能有效恢复大范围缺失区域，场景平均RMSE的IQR稳定在0.8K-1.8K之间。
AI.motivation: 卫星地表温度数据因云覆盖存在严重数据间隙，现有重建方法缺乏可扩展且自适应的通用流程，尤其难以处理高分辨率（如30米Landsat）影像中的大范围缺失区域。
AI.method: 提出多模态快速傅里叶卷积生成对抗网络（MFFC-GAN），利用快速傅里叶卷积（FFC）实现全局感受野，以卫星观测和SAR数据等多模态数据为引导，重建云污染像素。
AI.result: 在所有LST分位数上，场景平均RMSE的IQR稳定在0.8K-1.8K之间；可恢复超过70%云覆盖的大范围缺失区域。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了高分辨率LST数据中云污染像素的重建难题，依赖全球近覆盖的辅助数据，具有良好的可扩展性和实用性。

title: Spatial Prediction of Soil Microplastics and Organic Matter Using Graph Attention Networks
summary: Accurate estimation of soil microplastics and organic matter is essential to assess ecosystem health and support sustainable land use. This study presents a graph-based deep learning approach using Graph Attention Networks (GATs) to model spatial dependencies among 91 georeferenced soil samples. By incorporating spatial coordinates, soil properties, and land use data, a two-layer GAT architecture was developed to capture local interactions. The final model showed strong performance, achieving RMSEs of 625.06 ($R^2 = 0.87$) for microplastics and 0.43 ($R^2 = 0.91$) for organic matter. However, cross-validation results revealed limited generalization, probably due to the small sample size and sparse graph structure. These findings demonstrate the potential of GATs for spatial soil prediction and underscore the need for dense datasets and improved graph connectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图注意力网络（GAT）的深度学习方法，利用91个地理参考土壤样本的空间关系预测土壤微塑料和有机质含量。模型在测试集上表现优异（微塑料RMSE=625.06, R²=0.87；有机质RMSE=0.43, R²=0.91），但交叉验证显示泛化能力有限，主要受限于小样本量和稀疏图结构。
AI.motivation: 准确估算土壤微塑料和有机质含量对于评估生态系统健康和可持续土地利用至关重要，现有方法未充分利用样本间的空间依赖关系。
AI.method: 基于图注意力网络（GAT）的两层架构，将91个样本的坐标、土壤属性和土地利用数据建模为图结构，利用注意力机制捕捉局部空间相互作用。
AI.result: 微塑料预测RMSE=625.06 (R²=0.87)，有机质预测RMSE=0.43 (R²=0.91)；但交叉验证显示泛化能力有限。
AI.conclusion: GAT在空间土壤预测中具有潜力，但需要更密集的数据集和优化的图连接结构来提升模型泛化能力。

title: ParBench: A Benchmark for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Parallel Code Translation
summary:
Modern compute-intensive software must migrate across a changing ecosystem of accelerators, programming APIs, compiler stacks, and portability layers, including CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. Large language models and autonomous coding agents are increasingly proposed for such migration, but the field lacks reliable ways to measure whether they preserve the low-level parallel semantics that make translations behaviorally valid, including thread indexing, synchronization, memory management, host-device coordination, and API-specific execution structure.
  We present ParBench, a kernel-centric benchmark framework for evaluating LLM-based parallel API translation under executable, reproducible conditions. ParBench fixes the surrounding build, run, and verification infrastructure through declarative benchmark specifications and asks models to translate only the computational kernels. It draws on multiple open-source HPC suites and covers representative cross-API translation directions among CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. To test whether success reflects robust translation rather than surface-form memorization, ParBench includes AST-driven, intended behavior-preserving, baseline-validated source augmentation. Evaluations on state-of-the-art open and proprietary LLMs show persistent barriers to reliable parallel code translation, including direction asymmetry, multi-file coordination, incomplete API adaptation, and uneven robustness to source-level perturbations. Code is available at https://github.com/Scientific-Computing-Lab/ParBench.

AI.tldr: ParBench 是一个用于评估大语言模型在并行API（如CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL等）之间翻译内核代码能力的基准框架，通过固定构建/运行/验证基础设施、AST驱动的源码增强等方式，揭示了当前LLM在并行语义保持、方向对称性、多文件协调等方面的不足。
AI.motivation: LLM用于并行API迁移的可靠性缺乏系统评估，现有方法无法有效检测翻译是否保留了底层并行语义（如线程索引、同步、内存管理等）。
AI.method: 构建ParBench框架：(1) 通过声明式基准规范固定编译、运行和验证环境；(2) 模型仅需翻译计算内核，避免外围基础设施干扰；(3) 使用AST驱动的源码增强（行为保持且基线验证）以区分真正理解和表面记忆；(4) 覆盖CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL、OpenMP target offload之间的多种翻译方向。
AI.result: 对多个开源和商业LLM的评估揭示了四个主要障碍：翻译方向不对称性、多文件协调困难、API适配不完整、对源码扰动的鲁棒性不足。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在可靠并行代码翻译方面仍存在系统性瓶颈，ParBench为未来改进提供了可复现的评测基准。代码已开源。

title: One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation
summary:
Multimodal recommendation leverages item multimodal features alongside collaborative signals to capture user preferences. While item-item graphs have become a key building block in advanced models, existing methods typically construct them with noisy similarity edges and limit their role to a single function of item-item representation propagation, leaving substantial potential untapped.
  In this paper, we propose IIMRec, a framework that constructs a single high-quality item-item graph during preprocessing and systematically reuses it across three stages of the recommendation pipeline: representation enhancement, interaction graph enhancement, and optimization enhancement. The graph is built by fusing semantic and co-occurrence signals, then refined via Neighborhood Consistency Edge Reweighting (NCER), which applies the triadic closure principle to amplify structurally reliable edges and suppress spurious ones. Once constructed, the graph is leveraged in three complementary ways: (1) Item-item propagation with a Residual II Gate (RIG) that adaptively controls per-item absorption of semantic neighborhood signals for representation enhancement; (2) A content-guided UI graph expansion that introduces virtual user-item edges through high-confidence semantic neighbors for interaction graph enhancement; (3) II-Neighbor BPR Augmentation (INA) that treats top neighbors of positive items as discounted soft positives for optimization enhancement.
  We provide theoretical analysis showing that NCER reduces the spectral noise-to-signal ratio, RIG converges to a non-degenerate gating regime, and INA yields a tighter generalization bound. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that IIMRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while running faster and consuming less GPU memory, with particularly strong gains under cold-start and sparse-interaction conditions.

AI.tldr: IIMRec通过预处理构建高质量物品-物品图，并在表示增强、交互图增强和优化增强三个阶段复用该图，结合NCER噪声抑制、RIG自适应门控和INA软正样本增强，在四个数据集上超越SOTA且资源消耗更低。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐中物品-物品图构建存在噪声边问题，且仅用于单一表示传播功能，未能充分挖掘其潜力。
AI.method: 提出IIMRec框架：1) 预处理阶段融合语义与共现信号，经NCER（基于三元闭包原理）构建高质量物品-物品图；2) 三阶段复用：RIG门控表示增强、内容引导UI图扩展、INA邻居BPR增强优化。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上一致超越SOTA，运行更快、GPU内存消耗更低，在冷启动和稀疏交互条件下优势尤其明显。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析证明NCER能降低频谱噪声信号比、RIG收敛到非退化门控机制、INA提供更紧的泛化界，验证了多阶段复用高质量物品-物品图的有效性。

title: Two Regimes of Chain-of-Thought Unfaithfulness: Behavioral Detection Fails Where Models Are Wrong
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) explanations support oversight only if they are faithful: the stated reasoning must actually produce the answer. Auditing black-box (behavioral) detection of unfaithful CoT against FaithCoT-Bench's human annotations, we find answer correctness structures the problem at every level. Answer incorrectness alone (an oracle diagnostic, not a deployable detector) outperforms every purpose-built signal (AUROC 0.696), because 69% of annotated unfaithfulness occurs on incorrect answers. Stratifying by correctness splits detection into two regimes: on correct answers, behavioral signals moderately separate faithful from post-hoc reasoning (0.63-0.67); on incorrect answers, where most unfaithfulness lives, no tested signal is detectably above chance (replicated on all four models for benchmark-wide signals). The standard step-removal metric anti-correlates with human labels; this inversion reproduces on the benchmark's released scores and on hint-dependent counterfactually labeled traces. Linear probes decode the behaviorally blind regime in Llama-3.1-8B and the correct-answer regime in Qwen-2.5-7B, with no shared, positively aligned direction detected across regimes; instructed answer-first traces (7 models) transfer to neither annotated regime, while hint-induced unverbalized answer flips do, in model- and source-dependent settings. We also independently verify and resolve a documentation-data mismatch in the benchmark's label semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了链式思维推理的忠实性检测问题，发现答案正确性是关键混淆因素：69%的不忠实推理出现在错误答案中。在正确答案上，行为信号尚可区分忠实与事后推理；但在错误答案上，所有检测方法均无效。标准步移除指标与人工标注负相关，线性探针无法跨场景泛化。
AI.motivation: 链式思维（CoT）解释只有在忠实（即推理过程真实产生答案）时才能有效支持人类监督。然而现有黑箱检测方法识别不忠实推理的效果有限，作者希望系统理解不同检测信号在不同场景下的有效性边界。
AI.method: 基于FaithCoT-Bench人工标注数据集，对比多种黑箱行为检测信号与答案正确性这一"神谕"信号的检测效果；进行答案正确性分层分析；测试步移除（step-removal）指标的一致性；使用线性探针分析模型内部表征；在7个模型上进行跨场景迁移实验。
AI.result: 答案错误本身（AUROC 0.696）超过所有专用检测信号；69%的不忠实出现在错误答案中；正确答案上行为信号中等有效（0.63-0.67），错误答案上所有信号均不高于随机；步移除指标与人工标注负相关；线性探针在不同场景无共享正向方向；跨模型迁移仅在特定条件下有效。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性是CoT忠实性检测的根本结构因素，当前行为检测信号在不忠实集中出现的错误答案场景中完全失效，需要根本性的新方法。

title: Benchmarking the Domain Gap: Model Selection Instability Under Domain Shift in Video Capsule Endoscopy
summary: Video capsule endoscopy (VCE) classification is typically evaluated within a single dataset, yet clinical deployment demands robustness across acquisition sources, labeling policies, and patient populations. We examine this gap using Kvasir-Capsule, Capsule Vision 2024 (CV2024), and a shared-label subset of Galar. We fine-tune a suite of general-domain pretrained backbones on the official Kvasir-Capsule folds under a standardized protocol and evaluate the same checkpoints on two non-source targets within a documented shared-label decision space. We find that the predictive value of in-domain ranking is target-dependent: Kvasir-Capsule ranking aligns more closely with Galar than with CV2024, while the two non-source targets agree only weakly.
