Consequently, the strongest in-domain backbone leads on one target yet falls to mid-pack on the other, and no single evaluation target reliably predicts the others. A second CV2024-trained configuration set reproduces this target-dependent instability. We conclude that capsule endoscopy model selection should report cross-target ranking stability rather than peak single-dataset performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视频胶囊内镜（VCE）分类模型在不同数据集间的泛化能力，发现同一模型在不同目标数据集上的表现排名不一致，表明仅依赖单一数据集评估不可靠，应报告跨目标的排名稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有VCE分类评估通常只基于单一数据集，但临床部署需要模型在不同采集源、标注策略和患者群体中保持鲁棒性，因此必须检验跨数据集的泛化差异。
AI.method: 在Kvasir-Capsule上微调多个通用预训练骨干网络，并在标准协议下评估；然后将同一检查点应用于Capsule Vision 2024和Galar的共享标签子集，比较跨目标的表现排名。
AI.result: Kvasir-Capsule上的排名与Galar更一致，而与CV2024较弱；两个非源目标之间仅弱相关；最佳源域模型在一个目标上领先，但在另一个目标上仅排中游；无单一评估目标能可靠预测其他目标的表现。
AI.conclusion: 胶囊内镜模型选择应报告跨目标排名稳定性，而非仅追求单一数据集上的最佳性能。

title: Efficient Learning of Truncated Boolean Product Distributions: Influence to the Rescue
summary:
Learning the natural parameters $z \in \mathbb{R}^n$ of discrete distributions $μ_z$ from independent samples constrained to a subset $S \subseteq \{0,1\}^n$ is a foundational challenge in high-dimensional statistics. Existing methods for efficiently estimating truncated Boolean product distributions, notably the work of [Fotakis et al' COLT'20, Algorithmica '22], require either strong local connectivity assumptions on $S$ -- a property denoted fatness -- or stringent anti-concentration assumptions and necessitate the total mass of the truncation set to be a constant with respect to $n$. Moreover, the results in [Fotakis et al' COLT'20, Algorithmica '22] suffer from sample complexities that scale as $Ω(2^n)$ if the mass of $S$ is exponentially small in $n$.
  In this work, we circumvent these limitations by analyzing the geometry of $S$ under the measure $μ_z$. We refine the existing parameter estimation guarantees under the fatness assumption, improving the prior sample complexity to $O( \log n / ε^2)$ for $\ell_\infty$-recovery, matching the untruncated minimax rate. We further generalize fatness using the notion of influence utilized in the analysis of Boolean functions and provide sufficient conditions for efficient inference. Notably, unlike previous work, our method does not require sampling at arbitrary parameterizations of the model. Lastly, we establish a theoretical lower bound demonstrating the sample complexity exhibits an intrinsic exponential dependence on the width of the model and the minimum distance between elements in the set.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从受限子集S中学习截断布尔乘积分布的自然参数z的问题。现有方法依赖强局部连通性（fatness）或反集中假设，且样本复杂度在S质量指数小时呈Ω(2^n)。本文通过分析S在测度μ_z下的几何结构，将fatness假设下的样本复杂度提升至O(log n/ε²)，达到无截断时的最优极小化速率；利用布尔函数中的影响力概念推广了fatness；并证明了样本复杂度与模型宽度及集合中元素最小距离的指数依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 现有高效估计截断布尔乘积分布的方法[Fotakis et al.]存在三大局限：(1) 要求S具有强局部连通性（fatness）或反集中假设；(2) 要求截断集的总质量相对于n为常数；(3) 当S质量指数小时样本复杂度达Ω(2^n)。亟需克服这些限制。
AI.method: (1) 分析S在测度μ_z下的几何结构；(2) 在fatness假设下将样本复杂度改进至O(log n/ε²)；(3) 利用布尔函数中的影响力概念推广fatness，给出高效推理的充分条件；(4) 建立理论下界。
AI.result: (1) fatness假设下ℓ∞恢复的样本复杂度降至O(log n/ε²)，匹配无截断时的极小化最优速率；(2) 通过影响力概念泛化了fatness条件；(3) 证明了样本复杂度对模型宽度和集合元素最小距离存在指数依赖的下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文显著推进了截断布尔乘积分布参数估计的理论边界：改进了fatness假设下的样本复杂度至最优，通过影响力概念扩展了可处理的问题类别，并揭示了样本复杂度的内在指数下界，证明了现有方法的局限性本质上是不可避免的。

title: Lexical discovery in unknown environments orchestrated by Large Language Models
summary: Populations of autonomous agents deployed in unknown environments (e.g. planetary or deep-sea exploration) must develop shared vocabularies to refer to entities that have no name in any human language. We propose the Neuro-Symbolic Lexical Discovery (NSLD) framework, in which a population of LLM-based agents plays a referential game over out-of-distribution visual referents, autonomously self-organising a shared alien lexicon. Each agent combines a frozen CLIP vision encoder with a private FAISS vector index and a text-only LLM. Crucially, discovered alien words are anchored to natural language via semantic proximity in the embedding space, enlarging the human vocabulary with new perceptually grounded words. Consensus is reached in simulations with populations of up to twenty agents and ten visual referents. Convergence dynamics are characterised through three analytical models achieving R^2 > 0.95, representing a first step towards pre-deployment planning in autonomous exploration missions.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号词汇发现（NSLD）框架，让基于LLM的智能体群体通过指涉游戏自主形成共享的外星词汇，并用嵌入空间语义锚定扩展人类词汇库。
AI.motivation: 在未知环境（如行星或深海探索）中，自主智能体群体需要为无人类语言命名的实体发展共享词汇，现有方法无法解决这一完全自主的词汇发明问题。
AI.method: NSLD框架：群体LLM智能体通过指涉游戏（referential game）学习视觉指代物，每个智能体结合冻结CLIP视觉编码器、私有FAISS向量索引和纯文本LLM，发现的词汇通过嵌入空间语义邻近性锚定到自然语言。
AI.result: 在最多20个智能体和10个视觉指代物的模拟中达成共识，通过三个分析模型刻画收敛动力学，R² > 0.95。
AI.conclusion: NSLD实现了自主智能体群体从零发明共享词汇并扩展人类语言，为自主探索任务中的预部署规划提供了理论工具。

title: LaRec: Unleashing LLM-based Latent Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great promise in recommendation due to superior reasoning abilities. However, existing methods mainly rely on explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT), resulting in verbose reasoning texts and inefficient response times. latent reasoning aims to balance efficiency by thinking within a continuous latent space, yet it faces two major challenges: (1) Lack of Fine-grained Supervision: Latent reasoning relies solely on feedback from the final labels, providing sparse supervisory signals that struggle to effectively guide the optimization of multiple hidden reasoning steps. (2) Single Reasoning Path: The deterministic nature of latent reasoning impedes the exploration of users' diverse interests and preferences, thereby limiting the recommendation capabilities of LLMs. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{$LaRec$}, an efficient generative recommendation framework designed to unleash the potential of latent reasoning in LLMs. $LaRec$ consists of two core stages: First, we design Latent Pre-training that empowers LLMs with latent reasoning capabilities by providing rich supervisory signals to the latent space reasoning via step-level alignment and process direction alignment. Second, we introduce Personalized RL-tuning. Specifically, we construct a personalized Gaussian Mixture Distribution for each user based on their historical interests. By randomly sampling distinct reasoning starting points from this distribution during training, we guide the LLMs to traverse diverse reasoning paths within the latent space, enabling efficient exploration of user's multi-faceted interests. Experiments on multiple datasets show that $LaRec$ significantly outperforms existing baselines with comparable efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出LaRec框架，通过潜在空间预训练和个性化强化学习调优，解决大语言模型在推荐任务中潜在推理的稀疏监督和单路径问题，在保持效率的同时显著提升推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐方法依赖显式思维链导致响应慢，而潜在推理面临两个问题：(1)缺乏细粒度监督，仅依靠最终标签信号难以优化隐藏推理步骤；(2)单一推理路径无法探索用户多样兴趣。
AI.method: LaRec包含两个阶段：(1)潜在预训练：通过步骤级对齐和过程方向对齐为潜在空间推理提供丰富监督信号；(2)个性化RL调优：为每个用户构建个性化高斯混合分布，从中随机采样不同推理起点，引导LLM探索多样化潜在推理路径。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，LaRec显著优于现有基线方法，且保持相当的效率。
AI.conclusion: LaRec通过潜在空间推理的细粒度监督和多样化路径探索，有效平衡了推荐效率与性能，为LLM在推荐系统中高效应用提供了新范式。

title: How Well Can AI Generate Backlogs from App Mockups?
comment: Accepted at the AIRE Workshop, IEEE 34th International Requirements Engineering Conference (RE) 2026
summary: Creating sprint backlogs requires considerable effort, as items such as epics, user stories, and tasks can be missed or inconsistently specified. We propose a multimodal approach to support backlog generation from visual app mockups, an artifact available at early project stages. We evaluate three prompting strategies on GPT-4o: a zero-shot baseline, Compositional Chain-of-Thought (CCoT) for vision-language reasoning, and a persona-driven prompt. We study seven app development projects across two countries and interview developers about the results. Overall, we observed that the baseline prompt favours recall over precision, whereas CCoT is more balanced, achieving average F1 scores of 52-66% for epics and user stories. Tasks were more challenging to generate accurately. Precision gains were most consistent when adding architectural context, particularly for backend tasks (precision gains up to 35%). Interviews with developers revealed that up to 26% of false positives were still considered useful, reflecting the creative and open-ended nature of backlog creation. To capture this, we propose a new measure called Revised Recall, which complements ground-truth evaluation with developer assessments. Our findings suggest that hybrid prompting with architectural context can assist backlog generation from early mockups, though results vary by item type and developer oversight remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态方法，利用视觉应用原型（mockups）自动生成冲刺待办列表（sprint backlogs），对比了三种提示策略（零样本、组合思维链CCoT、角色提示），发现带架构上下文的混合提示策略效果最佳，并提出了新的评估指标"修正召回率"。
AI.motivation: 创建冲刺待办列表需要大量人工投入，容易出现遗漏或不一致问题。现有方法缺乏对早期项目阶段可用的人工制品（如视觉原型）的利用，因此需要自动化支持。
AI.method: 采用多模态方法，将视觉app原型作为输入；在GPT-4o上评估三种提示策略：零样本基线、组合思维链（CCoT）用于视觉-语言推理、以及角色驱动提示；在七个app开发项目中进行研究，并采访开发者评估结果；提出新指标"修正召回率"（Revised Recall）以捕捉开发者的主观判断。
AI.result: 基线提示偏向召回率而非精确率；CCoT更加平衡，史诗和用户故事的F1分数达52-66%；任务生成难度较大；加入架构上下文后精确率提升最稳定（后端任务精确率提升高达35%）；26%的假阳性的仍被开发者认为有用。
AI.conclusion: 混合提示结合架构上下文有助于从早期原型生成待办列表，但效果因条目类型而异，开发者的人工审查仍然是必要的。

title: Mwando: Leveraging AI to Preserve and Teach shiKomori
summary: This paper presents Mwando, a virtual educational assistant designed to support the teaching and preservation of shiKomori, the language of the Comoros Islands. The system covers the four main dialectal variants (shiNgazidja, shiMwali, shiNdzuani and shiMaore) through a knowledge base constructed from phrases, proverbs, dictionaries and grammar lessons. A multi-agent architecture combining vector search, a knowledge graph and web search fallback enables accurate and context-aware responses. Evaluation on 500 queries demonstrates strong performance on vocabulary lookup and grammar explanations, while qualitative case studies illustrate both capabilities and current limitations. This work represents an initial step toward computational support for shiKomori and provides a blueprint for developing AI-powered educational tools for other low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Mwando，一个面向科摩罗语shiKomori的虚拟教育助手，采用多智能体架构（向量搜索+知识图谱+网络搜索回退），覆盖四种方言变体，在500次查询评估中表现良好，为低资源语言教育AI工具提供了蓝图。
AI.motivation: shiKomori作为科摩罗群岛的语言，属于低资源语言，缺乏计算支持和数字化教育工具，面临消亡风险。作者旨在通过AI技术辅助该语言的教学与保存。
AI.method: 构建了包含短语、谚语、词典和语法课程的知识库，覆盖四种主要方言变体。采用多智能体架构，结合向量搜索、知识图谱和网络搜索回退机制，实现准确且上下文感知的问答响应。
AI.result: 在500个查询上的评估显示，该系统在词汇查找和语法解释方面表现强劲。定性案例研究既展示了能力也指出了当前局限。
AI.conclusion: Mwando是shiKomori计算支持的初步尝试，为其他低资源语言开发AI驱动的教育工具提供了可复制的蓝图。

title: Cortex: Compact Behavior Cloning for Quake with Frozen Visual Features
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, made with heavy assistance from LLM
summary: We study how far a deliberately simple behavioral-cloning policy can progress in a visually rich first-person game before adding reinforcement learning or explicit memory. Cortex is a compact Quake policy with 10.98 million trainable parameters in a six-layer transformer over a frozen DINOv3 encoder. It is trained on the Quake subset of the public Pixels2Play corpus: 6,849 recordings (about 474.7 hours), represented as 17.09 million cached decision frames with keyboard and mouse actions. One sampled training epoch uses 517,048 four-frame windows and takes 3.3 minutes of policy-head optimization on one RTX 5080, excluding one-time feature extraction. We evaluate two independent batches of 20 stochastic, 120-second episodes on Quake E1M1. Cortex does not complete the level, but every episode reaches the opening door, button room, and gate descent; 19 of 20 episodes in each batch record at least one kill. Under the same time-controlled harness, released P2P-150M and NitroGen checkpoints remain shallower in five matched-duration episodes each. These comparisons are limited by small reference samples and different native interfaces. Ablations show that denser visual tokens improve combat and survival, while longer optimization and naive action history improve offline metrics without consistently improving play. The remaining failures are consistent with covariate shift and motivate targeted corrective data. We release the policy implementation, checkpoint, and a representative rollout.

AI.tldr: Cortex是一个基于行为克隆的Quake游戏策略模型，使用六层Transformer和DINOv3编码器，在公开数据集上训练。虽然无法完整通关，但能完成部分关卡并击杀敌人，优于同类型基线模型。研究揭示了视觉令牌密度、优化时长等因素对性能的影响，并为后续强化学习或记忆机制的引入提供了基准。
AI.motivation: 探究一个纯粹的行为克隆策略（不依赖强化学习或显式记忆）在视觉丰富的第一人称游戏中能达到何种程度，为后续引入更复杂机制建立基准。
AI.method: 使用六层Transformer（10.98M参数）结合冻结的DINOv3视觉编码器，在Pixels2Play数据集的Quake子集（6849条记录，约474.7小时）上进行行为克隆训练。输入为四帧窗口，优化策略头部。
AI.result: Cortex无法完整通关，但每个测试回合都能到达开门、按钮室等关键位置；19/20的回合完成击杀。在相同条件下优于P2P-150M和NitroGen基线模型。消融实验表明密集视觉令牌提升战斗和生存能力，优化时间和动作历史提升离线指标但不稳定改善实际表现。
AI.conclusion: 纯粹的行为克隆在复杂第一人称游戏中能取得一定进展但受限于协变量偏移，需要针对性修正数据或引入更高级机制（如强化学习、记忆）来进一步突破。

title: Learning from the Descent Direction: Adaptive Gradient Descent under One-Sided Hölder Regularity
summary: We study adaptive gradient descent for continuously differentiable, possibly nonconvex objectives under one-sided Hölder regularity. Unlike classical Hölder- or Lipschitz-gradient assumptions, which control the full gradient variation, our condition bounds only the directional term appearing in the descent inequality. This can allow less conservative step sizes when large gradient changes are orthogonal to, or favorable along, the update direction. We propose an adaptive scalar-step method based on an estimate of positive one-sided Hölder curvature, combined with a simple sufficient-decrease safeguard. For nonconvex objectives on a convex region containing the accepted update segments, we prove an explicit best-iterate stationarity bound with a rate determined by the Hölder exponent. Unlike predetermined diminishing step-size schemes, the method adapts to the local descent geometry. We evaluate the approach on two full-batch benchmarks designed to separate directional curvature from full gradient variation. On a binary classification problem, the method achieves the lowest final cross-entropy, objective value, and gradient norm, together with the largest classification margin among the compared scalar gradient methods. On a nonconvex Hölder regression problem, it attains the lowest final objective gap and gradient norm. These results indicate that one-sided Hölder curvature is an effective adaptive step-size signal when full-gradient variation is inflated by directions that do not hinder descent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于单侧 Hölder 曲率的自适应梯度下降方法，适用于非凸目标函数。该方法仅约束下降方向上的梯度变化，而非全梯度 Lipschitz 条件，从而允许更大的步长。结合充分下降保障，在凸区域上证明了最佳迭代点的平稳性界。实验表明，该方法在二分类和非凸 Hölder 回归任务上优于其他标量梯度方法。
AI.motivation: 传统 Lipschitz 梯度条件过于保守，因为梯度变化中与下降方向正交或有利的分量不必要地限制了步长。本文旨在利用单侧 Hölder 光滑性来解耦"有用"与"无用"的梯度变化，实现更自适应、更高效的步长选择。
AI.method: 提出基于估计的正单侧 Hölder 曲率的自适应标量步长方法，结合充分下降保障机制（sufficient-decrease safeguard）。在包含接受更新段的凸区域上分析非凸目标的平稳性，导出依赖于 Hölder 指数的显式最佳迭代点收敛率。
AI.result: 在二分类全批基准上，该方法取得最低交叉熵、目标值和梯度范数，以及最大分类边界。在非凸 Hölder 回归问题上，达到最低最终目标差距和梯度范数。
AI.conclusion: 单侧 Hölder 曲率是一种有效的自适应步长信号，尤其当全梯度变化因不阻碍下降的方向而被放大时，该方法能显著优于传统标量梯度方法。

title: Structure Over Scale: Schema-Constrained Causal Graphs for RAG
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) grounds answers in structured knowledge, but current systems extract entities and relationships exhaustively, producing graphs whose size and construction cost scale with corpus length rather than with the reasoning a query requires. We introduce HCG-RAG (Hierarchical Causal Graph RAG), which replaces open-ended extraction with schema-constrained causal graphs: an automated pipeline distills a corpus into a fixed, typed vocabulary of causal variables and materializes a compact two-tier graph over it. Our schema-constrained graphs match entity-relation baselines on answer quality at a fraction of the cost: 3-20x fewer nodes, 8x-135x fewer build-time LLM calls than the most LLM-intensive baseline (MS-GraphRAG), and graphs compact enough for a domain expert to audit, correct, and extend. On medical and clinical benchmarks, including a neurologist-validated epilepsy dataset, HCG-RAG matches or exceeds the best entity-relation systems. An ablation isolates the causal graph as a structured retrieval filter, contributing +6 percentage points (pp) over embedding-only retrieval. Across all domains with discoverable hierarchical causal structure, only methods imposing higher-level organization outperform flat entity-relation retrieval, indicating that what is placed in the graph matters more than how many nodes it contains.

AI.tldr: 提出HCG-RAG（层次因果图RAG），用模式约束的因果图替代开放信息抽取，在保持回答质量的同时大幅降低图规模和构建成本（节点减少3-20倍，LLM调用减少8-135倍），并通过消融实验证明因果图结构本身贡献了+6个百分点的检索提升。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG系统对语料进行穷举式实体关系抽取，导致图的规模和构建成本随语料长度线性增长，无法根据查询所需的推理复杂度自适应，效率低下且难以审校。
AI.method: 提出HCG-RAG框架：1）自动化流水线将语料蒸馏为固定、类型化的因果变量词汇表；2）构建紧凑的两层因果图（层级因果图）；3）利用因果图作为结构化检索过滤器进行RAG。
AI.result: 在医疗和临床基准上（含神经科医师验证的癫痫数据集），HCG-RAG匹配或超越最佳实体关系系统。节点减少3-20倍，构建时LLM调用减少8-135倍。消融实验：因果图作为结构化检索过滤器贡献+6个百分点（相较于纯嵌入检索）。
AI.conclusion: 在具有可发现层次因果结构的所有领域中，只有施加高层级组织的方法才能超越扁平实体关系检索；图里放什么比放多少节点更重要。

title: Evaluating Fuzz Testing for Reinforcement Learning Agents
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains such as robotics, autonomous driving, and drone control, where unexpected behaviors may lead to severe real-world consequences. Fuzz testing has recently emerged as a promising method for exploring the vast state spaces of RL agents and exposing crashes. Although numerous RL fuzzing methods have been proposed, existing studies often differ in evaluation settings, baselines, and metrics, making it difficult to draw reliable conclusions about their relative effectiveness and practical usefulness. To address this gap, we present the first comprehensive empirical study that systematically evaluates RL fuzzing methods from four complementary perspectives: effectiveness, diversity, efficiency, and practical utility. We benchmark five state-of-the-art methods alongside random testing under unified configurations across three environments of increasing complexity (MountainCar, BipedalWalker, and CARLA), and further assess the downstream usefulness of detected crashes for agent robustness improvement and safety monitoring. Our results reveal several key insights. For instance,throughput-oriented methods like MDPFuzz demonstrate superior effectiveness and efficiency in crash discovery, while methods explicitly designed to encourage exploration like SeqDivFuzz excel at uncovering diverse crash behaviors. We also show that fuzzing-generated crashes can meaningfully improve agent robustness and enable accurate safety monitoring with strong cross-method generalization. Beyond these empirical findings, we distill actionable guidance for both researchers and practitioners, highlighting the benefits of combining complementary fuzzing strategies and adopting multi-level diversity analysis to achieve more comprehensive and practical RL testing.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对强化学习模糊测试方法进行了系统性的实证研究，从有效性、多样性、效率和实用性四个维度评估了五种SOTA方法，揭示了不同方法的优势与局限，并为研究人员和实践者提供了可操作的指导建议。
AI.motivation: 现有RL模糊测试方法在评估设置、基线和指标上差异巨大，难以比较其相对有效性和实用价值，亟需一个统一的系统性研究来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在统一配置下，从有效性、多样性、效率和实用性四个互补视角，对五种SOTA方法及随机测试进行基准评估，涉及三个复杂度递增的环境（MountainCar、BipedalWalker、CARLA），并进一步评估检测到的崩溃对智能体鲁棒性提升和安全监控的下游价值。
AI.result: 吞吐量导向方法（如MDPFuzz）在崩溃发现的有效性和效率上表现最优；鼓励探索的方法（如SeqDivFuzz）在发现多样化崩溃行为方面表现出色；模糊测试生成的崩溃可用于提升智能体鲁棒性，并支持跨方法泛化的安全监控。
AI.conclusion: 组合互补的模糊测试策略和采用多级多样性分析，能够实现更全面、更实用的RL测试，为研究与实践提供了可操作的指导。

title: The Cross-Domain Generalization Cost of Offensive Language Detection
summary: Offensive language detection models generally suffer performance degradation when deployed across datasets and across languages, yet most existing studies stop at reporting this phenomenon and lack a systematic methodology for decomposing the causes of degradation into attributable components and quantifying the cost of remediation. This paper proposes a diagnosis and optimization framework composed of three coordinated technical components. First, a zero-shot transfer loss decomposition that separates the performance degradation from OLID to MLMA into two independently measurable components, namely dataset effect and language effect. Second, a controlled fine-tuning protocol that quantifies both adaptation efficiency and the hidden damage inflicted on the source task by comparing few shot learning curves under continued fine-tuning and cold-start starting points. Third, three joint training strategies incorpo rating temperature sampling and experience replay, which offer a controllable Pareto trade-off between improving multilingual capability and preserving source-task performance. Experiments built on this framework show that the dataset effect dominates the zero-shot transfer loss and substantially outweighs the language effect. Few-shot adaptation without a replay mechanism, though data-efficient, inflicts source task damage 4 to 9 times greater than that of the joint training strategies, and its damage magnitude is highly unstable. The three joint training strategies trade 3.2 to 4.1 percentage points of source-task performance for 8.1 to 42.6 percentage points of multilingual capability gain, forming a clear and controllable Pareto trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个诊断与优化框架，将跨数据集和跨语言的攻击性语言检测模型性能下降分解为数据集效应和语言效应，并通过受控微调与联合训练策略实现可控的帕累托权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多仅报告性能下降现象，缺乏系统性方法来分解性能损失的成因并量化修复成本。
AI.method: 提出三部分框架：(1) 零样本迁移损失分解，将性能下降拆分为数据集效应与语言效应；(2) 受控微调协议，通过少样本学习曲线量化适应效率及对源任务的隐藏损害；(3) 三种联合训练策略（含温度采样与经验回放），实现多语言能力与源任务性能的帕累托权衡。
AI.result: 数据集效应主导零样本迁移损失，远超语言效应；无回放机制的少样本适应对源任务的损害是联合训练策略的4-9倍；三种联合训练策略以损失源任务3.2-4.1个百分点的性能，换取多语言能力8.1-42.6个百分点的提升，形成可控的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该框架系统地解构了迁移损失来源，并提供了可量化的优化路径，验证了联合训练策略在多语言能力与源任务性能间实现有效权衡的可行性。

title: A Diagnostic Gap Framework for Evaluating Reconstruction Fidelity in Weakly Supervised Mammography
summary: Weakly supervised pipelines for medical imaging have become increasingly popular over the years. These systems often include multiple stages and components, such as reconstruction, generation, and localization, yet standard evaluation metrics provide limited insight into whether clinically relevant information is preserved across each stage. We present the diagnostic gap framework, a practical evaluation tool that measures decision preservation and explanation preservation as a function of measured reconstruction fidelity. To isolate the effect of reconstruction from localization, we evaluate on curated lesion ROI crops using a fidelity ladder of three class-conditional reconstructors---VQ-VAE-GAN, VAE-GAN, and diffusion (SDEdit)---spanning a twenty-fold range in perceptual distance (LPIPS 0.029--0.584). At autoencoder fidelity, both decision and explanation are preserved: AUC changes remain within $\pm$0.005 and attribution similarity (HiResCAM, Grad-CAM++) stays high. At diffusion fidelity, both collapse: pooled AUC drops by 0.253 and mass-pathology AUC falls below chance. The diagnostic gap is thus a measurable function of reconstruction fidelity rather than an intrinsic cost of reconstruction, and the framework provides an architecture-agnostic instrument for identifying when and where multi-stage pipelines lose diagnostic signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"诊断差距框架"(diagnostic gap framework)，通过测量决策保留和解释保留来评估医学成像中多阶段流水线各阶段是否丢失临床相关信息。实验使用三种不同保真度的条件重构器(VQ-VAE-GAN、VAE-GAN、SDEdit)在病变ROI上进行测试，发现诊断差距是重构保真度的可测量函数，而非重构的固有代价。
AI.motivation: 现有的弱监督医学成像流水线包含多个阶段（重构、生成、定位等），但标准评估指标无法揭示每个阶段是否保留了临床相关信息，缺乏衡量诊断信息保留程度的实用工具。
AI.method: 提出诊断差距框架，通过决策保留(AUC变化)和解释保留(归因相似度)作为重构保真度函数进行评估。在病变ROI数据上，使用三种条件重构器(VQ-VAE-GAN、VAE-GAN、SDEdit)构建保真度阶梯(LPIPS 0.029-0.584)，隔离重构对定位的影响。
AI.result: 自编码器保真度下：AUC变化在±0.005内，归因相似度(HiResCAM、Grad-CAM++)保持高水平。扩散保真度下：合并AUC下降0.253，肿块病理AUC低于随机水平。诊断差距是重构保真度的可测量函数。
AI.conclusion: 诊断差距并非重构的固有代价，而是可测量的重构保真度函数。该框架提供了一种与架构无关的工具，用于识别多阶段流水线在何时何处丢失诊断信号。

title: Beyond Directed Acyclic Graphs: Causal Zeros and Causal Differential Equations
summary: Pearl's structural causal model (SCM) framework, built on directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and the do-calculus, is the dominant formal language for causal reasoning. Yet it carries two structural restrictions: every relationship must be pre-specified as a directed causal edge, and feedback cycles are forbidden. This paper examines two classes of phenomena that strain these restrictions. First, symmetric physical and economic constraints, the ideal gas law being the canonical case, carry no intrinsic causal direction. Direction emerges only under intervention, and which variable is solved for must be specified as part of the intervention. We formalize such constraints as causal zeros within an Extended Causal Model by adding an activation operator, subject to local solvability and graph-admissibility conditions. Second, for the class of finite-propagation state-space systems considered here, we treat apparent instantaneous cycles as artifacts of suppressed time and ground both causal zeros and feedback in Causal Differential Equations (CDEs). In these, the transient regime is a time-unrolled acyclic causal process, and causal zeros arise as the defining functions of attracting equilibrium manifolds; periodic and chaotic attractors define further regimes of the same dynamics, treated through attractor-relative intervention. We give the extended do-calculus, identifiability conditions, counterfactual semantics, and open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Pearl的结构因果模型，通过引入因果零点（causal zeros）和因果微分方程（CDEs），处理对称物理约束（如理想气体定律）和反馈循环（如有限传播状态空间系统），并给出扩展的do-calculus、可识别性条件和反事实语义。
AI.motivation: 传统SCM框架要求所有关系预指定为有向因果边且禁止反馈循环，无法处理对称物理约束（无内在因果方向）和瞬时循环（时间抑制产生的伪像）。
AI.method: 1）提出Extended Causal Model，引入激活算子（activation operator）形式化因果零点，受局部可解性和图可接受性约束；2）使用Causal Differential Equations (CDEs)将反馈循环归因于时间展开的瞬时过程，吸引子（平衡、周期、混沌）作为因果零点定义函数。
AI.result: 给出了扩展的do-calculus、可识别性条件、反事实语义，并指出开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 对称约束和反馈现象可以在统一的扩展因果框架下形式化处理，弥补了传统SCM的局限性。

title: xMIx: High-Performance Serving-Time Platform for Mechanistic Interpretability Apps
summary:
Mechanistic interpretability (MI) has emerged as a powerful approach for analyzing and intervening in inference computations, with a growing number of applications such as jailbreak attempt detection, truthfulness evaluation, and hallucination detection. Unfortunately, MI deployment in production model-serving systems is currently not practical, as most existing MI frameworks introduce prohibitively high runtime overheads. The fundamental problem is that MI functions do not compose cleanly with served models: they fragment deployment, often force draining requests and rebuilding serving state, and conflict with critical performance optimizations such as continuous batching and CUDA-graph execution, essential for production deployments.
  We present xMIx, a serving-native framework for deploying MI applications in production inference serving environments. xMIx enables attaching MI functions to a predefined set of locations in the model runtime, interposing on activations within the layers and residual streams. xMIx supports conditional invocation of MI functions depending on the outputs in preceding model layers. Multiple MI applications can be deployed in a single model instance. xMIx compiles them all into the serving path but activates them dynamically at runtime only when necessary, with negligible performance cost, and without requiring a separate model instance or alternative execution stack.
  We integrate xMIx with the vLLM serving system and evaluate it across three major models and seven diverse MI applications. xMIx achieves performance comparable to native vLLM execution, incurring a slowdown of 1.3% mean inter-token latency (ITL), 1.2% for tail P99 ITL, 2.6% for mean time to first token (TTFT), and 1.6% for mean total token throughput (TTT).

AI.tldr: xMIx是一个服务原生的机械可解释性（MI）框架，通过将MI函数编译到模型服务路径中并按需动态激活，在vLLM系统中实现了接近原生性能（ITL仅增加1.3%，TTFT增加2.6%），使得MI应用能够高效部署在生产推理服务环境中。
AI.motivation: 现有MI框架在生产模型部署中引入过高运行时开销，它们与模型服务不兼容（碎片化部署、强制请求排空、重建服务状态），且与连续批处理和CUDA图形执行等关键性能优化冲突，导致MI应用无法在实际生产环境中实用。
AI.method: xMIx将MI函数附加到模型运行时的预定义位置（层和残差流中的激活），支持基于前序层输出的条件调用，将多个MI应用编译到服务路径中，但在运行时仅按需动态激活，无需单独模型实例或替代执行栈。
AI.result: 集成到vLLM系统中，跨3个模型和7个MI应用评估，平均ITL仅降低1.3%，P99 ITL降低1.2%，平均TTFT降低2.6%，平均TTT降低1.6%，性能接近原生vLLM执行。
AI.conclusion: xMIx证明了MI应用可以在生产推理服务环境中以极低的性能开销实现部署，解决了MI从研究到生产的关键鸿沟。

title: Do Diagrams Help Large Language Models Reason? Evidence from Syllogistic Reasoning
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 15th International Conference on the Theory and Application of Diagrams (Diagrams 2026)
summary: Diagrams are widely used to support logical reasoning, and prior studies suggest that representations such as Euler diagrams can improve human reasoning performance. Recent work has also explored their effects on large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we compare four representational conditions for syllogistic reasoning: natural language, logical notation, linear diagrams, and Euler diagrams. Using 285 problems from Ando et al. (2024), we evaluate two contemporary LLMs, Claude 3.5~Sonnet and GPT-4o-mini. Our results show that diagrammatic representations do not consistently improve performance. Although the models perform well on entailment and contradiction problems, they struggle with neutral problems and often make systematic conversion errors. Overall, the results suggest that the tested models gain limited benefit from diagrams in logical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图和欧拉图四种表示方式在LLMs（Claude 3.5 Sonnet和GPT-4o-mini）的三段论推理任务中的表现。结果表明，图表表示并未持续提升性能，模型在蕴含和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中立问题上存在困难，且常犯系统性转换错误。
AI.motivation: 探讨图表表示（如欧拉图）是否能像提升人类推理能力一样，提升大语言模型的逻辑推理表现。
AI.method: 使用Ando等人（2024）的285个三段论推理问题，在四种表示条件（自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图、欧拉图）下评估Claude 3.5 Sonnet和GPT-4o-mini两个LLMs。
AI.result: 图表表示并未持续提升LLM的推理性能；模型在蕴含和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中立问题上表现较差，且存在系统性转换错误。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs从图表表示中获得的有益帮助有限，图表在逻辑推理任务中对模型的提升作用不明显。

title: AI-generated Images Challenge Visual Trust in High-risk Scenarios
summary: Rapid advances in image generation are eroding the evidentiary value of visual content in settings where authenticity can affect public safety and personal reputation. Yet existing detection benchmarks rarely examine synthetic images in public- and individual-safety contexts, where misleading visual content may carry substantial risks. Here we introduce SafeIMG, a safety-oriented benchmark spanning 12 public- and individual-safety scenarios generated using GPT Image 2. Unlike benchmarks centred on generic imagery and image-level labels, SafeIMG evaluates not only whether detectors recognise synthetic images, but also whether their decisions reflect human-identified anomalies. To this end, SafeIMG provides human annotations that localise suspicious regions and explain local artefacts and higher-level commonsense or physical inconsistencies. We evaluate specialized synthetic-image detectors and vision-language models (VLMs), and find that neither provides reliable detection. The strongest VLM identifies only 49.5% of generated images, whereas the best specialised detector identifies 33.1%, compared with 81.7% accuracy for human evaluators. Model explanations cover only 29.8\% of human-annotated anomalies and predominantly capture local defects in text, faces and hands. Their coverage falls to 15.0% for commonsense conflicts and 12.0% for physical inconsistencies, while detection performance deteriorates further after dissemination-induced image degradation. These findings show that current detectors lack the accuracy, explanatory alignment and robustness needed to evaluate AI-generated images reliably across public- and individual-safety settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeIMG，一个面向公共与个人安全的AI生成图像检测基准，涵盖12个安全场景。评估发现，现有检测器（最佳VLM仅49.5%准确率，最佳专用检测器仅33.1%）远低于人类（81.7%），且模型解释仅覆盖29.8%的人标注异常，在常识冲突和物理不一致上覆盖率更低（15.0%和12.0%），检测性能在图像降质后进一步恶化。
AI.motivation: 现有检测基准多聚焦于通用图像和图像级标签，缺乏对公共安全和个人声誉保护场景（如虚假证据、深度伪造等）的关注。这些场景中误导性视觉内容可能造成严重后果，但尚无专门评估框架。
AI.method: 构建SafeIMG基准，包含12个公共与个人安全场景的生成图像；提供人类标注的异常定位和解释（局部伪影、常识矛盾、物理不一致等）；评估专用合成图像检测器与视觉语言模型（VLMs）的检测性能、解释对齐度和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 最佳VLM仅识别49.5%生成图像，最佳专用检测器仅33.1%，远低于人类的81.7%。模型解释仅覆盖29.8%人类标注异常，其中常识冲突覆盖15.0%，物理不一致覆盖12.0%。图像降质后检测性能进一步下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前检测器在准确性、解释对齐度和鲁棒性上均无法满足公共与个人安全场景下可靠检测AI生成图像的需求，亟需开发更安全导向的检测方法。

title: Hidden Boundary Motion in Transformer Optimization: Function-Space Orthogonalization of Affine Weight and Bias Updates
summary:
Weights and biases are normally optimized as separate parameter tensors, yet they do not represent separate functions when the input to an affine layer has nonzero mean. For an affine map $z=Wx+b$ with input mean $μ$, a weight update contains a sample-independent displacement $ΔWμ$ that is functionally indistinguishable from a bias update. We call this hidden contribution \emph{boundary motion} and decompose each update into a centered, sample-varying \emph{shape} component and a shared \emph{boundary} component. On a four-layer Transformer trained from scratch on IMDb, the bias-like term $g_bμ^	op$ has a median norm equal to 0.664 of the raw weight-gradient norm across affine layers and training checkpoints. More strikingly, the median ratio $
orm{ΔWμ}/
orm{Δb}$ is 134.7, while $
orm{ΔWμ}/
orm{Δb+ΔWμ}$ is 0.994. Thus, under AdamW, the observed boundary motion is almost entirely realized through the weight matrix rather than the explicit bias.
  We implement a diagnostic optimizer, Shape--Boundary Orthogonal AdamW (SBO-AdamW), that optimizes $g_W-g_bμ^	op$ and $g_b$ with independent Adam states and compensates the weight-induced boundary displacement. In a single-seed experiment, SBO-AdamW raises validation accuracy from 81.68\% to 85.81\% and validation-selected test accuracy from 78.73\% to 82.73\%, with the best validation checkpoint occurring at step 800 instead of step 3000. However, the moving-batch-center compensation produces severe bias-coordinate drift and strongly reduces boundary energy. The present evidence therefore supports hidden boundary motion as an important optimization mechanism, but it does not yet establish a final general-purpose optimizer. A stable centered-affine parameterization is identified as the required next step.

AI.tldr: 本文发现仿射层中权重更新包含与偏置更新功能等效的"边界运动"成分，并通过SBO-AdamW优化器分离该成分，提升了Transformer在IMDb上的验证准确率（81.68%→85.81%），但存在偏置坐标漂移问题，需进一步研究稳定参数化方法。
AI.motivation: 权重和偏置在仿射层输入均值非零时存在功能重叠，权重更新中的样本无关位移ΔWμ与偏置更新不可区分，现有优化方法未考虑这一隐藏成分。
AI.method: 将权重更新分解为形状（shape）和边界（boundary）成分；设计SBO-AdamW优化器，独立优化去偏后的权重梯度和偏置梯度，并补偿权重引起的边界位移。
AI.result: 四层Transformer在IMDb上：边界项中位数范数为原始权重梯度范数的0.664；||ΔWμ||/||Δb||中位数134.7，||ΔWμ||/||Δb+ΔWμ||中位数0.994；SBO-AdamW将验证准确率从81.68%提升至85.81%，测试准确率从78.73%提升至82.73%，最佳验证点从3000步提前至800步。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏边界运动是重要的优化机制，但当前补偿方法导致偏置坐标漂移和边界能量下降，需要稳定的中心化仿射参数化作为下一步方向。

title: An Agentic Orchestration of Atomistic Simulations
summary: Atomistic simulations are central to materials design, but their execution involves complex, multi-step workflows that require significant human expertise. Here, we present an agent-based system embedded within the URSA (Universal Research and Scientific Agent) framework that automates the design, execution, and validation of atomistic simulations, demonstrated using the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS) tool. Our system autonomously selects interatomic potentials, constructs and runs simulations, and performs iterative error recovery within a closed-loop workflow. We evaluate the scientific reliability of the agent by benchmarking its outputs against LAVA, a high-throughput toolkit for LAMMPS and the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) calculations. Our framework reduces manual intervention and trial-and-error, thereby improving the rigor, reproducibility, and scalability of atomistic modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于URSA框架的智能代理系统，能够自动完成原子级模拟的设计、执行和验证全流程，显著减少人工干预，提高建模的严谨性、可重复性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 原子级模拟工作流程复杂、多步骤且依赖大量人工专业知识，存在效率低、可重复性差的问题，亟需自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 基于URSA框架构建智能代理系统，该系统可自主选择原子间势函数、构建并运行模拟、在闭环工作流中执行迭代错误恢复，并使用LAMMPS工具进行验证。
AI.result: 系统成功实现原子模拟全流程自动化，通过与LAVA高通量工具包的基准对比验证了其科学可靠性，有效减少了人工试错。
AI.conclusion: 该代理系统能够提升原子尺度建模的严谨性、可重复性和可扩展性，为材料设计中的自动化模拟提供了可行方案。

title: MPR-CiteG: Enhancing RAG with Multi-Portfolio Retrieval and Citation-Grounded Generation
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. The 1st International Workshop on Retrieval-Driven Generative AI & ScienceON AI Challenge 2025@CIKM
summary: This paper presents the MPR-CiteG framework, which achieved second place in the ScienceON AI Challenge by addressing two fundamental challenges in generative AI: inefficient retrieval and the absence of source verification. We propose a dual-component system, termed MPR-CiteG, in which the Multi-Portfolio Retriever (MPR) efficiently retrieves diverse and relevant information, while the Citation-Grounded Generation (CiteG) module ensures that every generated output remains factually consistent and explicitly attributed to its source. MPR-CiteG represents a significant step toward building more trustworthy and accurate LLMs that are not only capable of generating information but also of grounding their responses in reliable evidence, thereby mitigating common issues like model hallucination. Extensive experiments on the challenge dataset validate the effectiveness and reliability of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/2noweyh/MPR-citeG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MPR-CiteG框架，通过双组件系统（多组合检索器MPR+引证生成模块CiteG）解决生成式AI的检索低效和缺乏来源验证问题，在ScienceON AI挑战赛中获第二名，有效提升LLM输出的可信度与准确性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI存在两大基础挑战：检索效率低下（无法高效获取多样且相关的信息）以及缺乏来源验证（生成内容无法追溯可信证据），导致模型幻觉问题频发。
AI.method: 提出双组件系统MPR-CiteG：1) Multi-Portfolio Retriever (MPR) 高效检索多样且相关信息；2) Citation-Grounded Generation (CiteG) 模块确保每个生成输出在事实上保持一致且明确归属来源。
AI.result: 在挑战赛数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性和可靠性，最终在ScienceON AI挑战赛中取得第二名成绩。
AI.conclusion: MPR-CiteG是构建更可信、更准确的LLM的重要一步，能够将生成内容基于可靠证据，有效缓解模型幻觉问题。

title: Advancing All-Weather Building Damage Mapping to the Instance Level: Outcomes and Insights from the 2026 Bright Challenge
summary: Rapid post-disaster response requires timely, building-level information on whether structures remain intact, are damaged, or are destroyed. Post-event optical imagery, however, may be unavailable because of cloud, smoke, or darkness. The Bright Challenge evaluated all-weather building damage mapping from a submeter-resolution pre-event optical image and a post-event SAR image. Participants were required to detect and delineate each building and assign exactly one of three mutually exclusive damage labels. The challenge extended the globally distributed \textsc{Bright} dataset with instance-level annotations for about 291,000 buildings across 16 disaster events spanning seven disaster types. The final phase was evaluated exclusively on two 2025 events absent from training: a wildfire event in California and a hurricane in Jamaica. A total of 157 participants made 1,289 submissions, and 46 teams entered the final phase. The two winning solutions achieved test mAPs of 0.182 and 0.181, approximately 8.7 times the public baseline of 0.021, but remained far below the best in-domain holdout score of 0.513. Across teams ranked in both phases, performance declined sharply and the rank order changed substantially. The two leading solutions independently favored modality-specific encoding, staged or late optical--SAR fusion, and an optical-dominant separation of building localization from damage recognition. The winning method additionally used scene-aware threshold adjustment and pseudo-label adaptation. These results identify cross-event generalization and stable severity discrimination as the principal remaining challenges. All data, annotations, baseline code, and winning solutions are publicly available at https://github.com/ChenHongruixuan/BRIGHT.

AI.tldr: BRIGHT挑战赛利用灾前光学图像与灾后SAR图像进行全天候建筑物损毁评估，157名参赛者提交了1289个方案。最优方案mAP仅0.182，远低于域内最优0.513，跨事件泛化仍是主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 灾后快速响应需要及时的建筑物级别信息，但灾后光学图像常因云层、烟雾或黑暗而不可用，亟需全天候的建筑物损毁评估方法。
AI.method: BRIGHT挑战赛构建了包含约29.1万栋建筑、16个灾害事件（7种灾害类型）的标注数据集，要求参赛者基于灾前亚米级光学图像和灾后SAR图像，对每栋建筑进行检测、分割并分配三种互斥损毁标签之一。最终阶段在两个2025年新事件（加州野火和牙买加飓风）上评估。
AI.result: 157名参赛者提交1289个方案，46支队伍进入最终阶段。两个获胜方案mAP分别为0.182和0.181，约为公共基线（0.021）的8.7倍，但远低于域内最优得分（0.513）。跨阶段排名变化显著，性能下降严重。
AI.conclusion: 跨事件泛化和稳定的损毁程度判别是当前主要挑战。领先方案倾向于模态特定编码、分阶段或晚期光学-SAR融合、以及以光学为主导的定位-识别分离策略。数据、代码和方案已公开。

title: Distribution-Specific Curvature Control with Finite-Sample Guarantees for Open-Weight Safety
summary: A short fine-tuning run can undo the safety guards of an open-weight model---retraining a refusal-trained assistant to aid weapons development or produce hate speech. Preventing such harmful fine-tuning while retaining benign adaptability remains difficult: the only prior method with an explicit curvature certificate, spectral deformation, inflates curvature globally and thereby obstructs benign adaptation along with harmful adaptation. We propose HarmAlign, which applies function-preserving spectral deformation along a estimated contrastive activation subspace. We derive finite-sample bounds for the estimated subspace energy and the resulting local harmful-distribution curvature lower bound. A stability--progress dichotomy for constant-step gradient descent turns the certified curvature into conditional convergence-rate control. Empirically, within a fixed-architecture, finite-budget first-order threat model, HarmAlign blocks direct fine-tuning and three data- or objective-adaptive attacks across a hazardous-knowledge relearning setting and a harmful-assistance fine-tuning setting, while the protected benign tasks remain trainable. The block persists across the tested first-order optimizer variants over every attack checkpoint, and under out-of-distribution harmful fine-tuning, and it extends to important cases in our threat model: accidental safety degradation and emergent misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarmAlign方法，通过在估计的对比激活子空间上进行保函数谱变形，在保持良性任务可训练性的同时，阻止有害微调攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（如谱变形）全局扩展曲率，在阻止有害适应的同时也阻碍了良性适应，缺乏对有害微调的选择性防护。
AI.method: HarmAlign在估计的对比激活子空间上进行保函数谱变形，推导了有限样本界来保证子空间能量和局部有害分布曲率下界，并利用稳定性-进展二分法控制条件收敛率。
AI.result: 在固定架构、有限预算的一阶威胁模型下，HarmAlign能阻止直接微调及三种数据/目标自适应攻击，同时良性任务仍可训练，防护持久且可推广到意外安全退化和新出现的不对齐情况。
AI.conclusion: HarmAlign实现了对有害微调的选择性防护，证明了曲率证书方法可以在不牺牲良性适应性的前提下保障模型安全。

title: HyCE-RAG: Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires systems to retrieve evidence from multiple documents and connect scattered facts into a coherent reasoning process. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mainly relies on semantic similarity between a query and text chunks, and therefore often fails to model structural relations among entities, facts, and evidence units. Graph-based RAG improves this by introducing graph-structured knowledge, but pairwise edges are still limited in representing higher-order associations involving multiple entities and contexts. We propose HyCE-RAG, a Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework for explainable multi-hop question answering. HyCE-RAG organizes entities, relations, and contextual evidence into hyperedges, builds a query-aware evidence hypergraph, and performs confidence propagation over entity--hyperedge incidence structures. It then uses confidence-guided evidence assembly to select, connect, and rank evidence paths before answer generation. The scoring process jointly considers semantic relevance, entity connectivity, evidence coverage, relation reliability, extraction confidence, and propagated confidence. By providing the language model with structured evidence chains rather than flat retrieved passages, HyCE-RAG supports more faithful and interpretable reasoning. Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and two GraphRAG-Bench subsets show that HyCE-RAG consistently outperforms standard RAG and graph-based RAG baselines in answer accuracy, context relevance, and faithfulness. These results suggest that hypergraph-based evidence organization is a promising direction for post-retrieval reasoning in complex question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出HyCE-RAG框架，利用超图结构组织实体与证据，通过置信度传播和证据链组装，提升多跳问答的可解释性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG依赖语义相似度检索，难以建模实体间的结构关系；图RAG虽引入图结构知识，但成对边仍无法充分表达多实体间的高阶关联。
AI.method: 将实体、关系和上下文证据组织为超边，构建查询感知的证据超图；在实体-超边关联结构上执行置信度传播；通过置信度引导的证据组装选择、连接和排序证据链；联合考虑语义相关性、实体连通性、证据覆盖率、关系可靠性、提取置信度和传播置信度进行评分。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue及两个GraphRAG-Bench子集上，HyCE-RAG在答案准确率、上下文相关性和忠实度上一致优于标准RAG和图RAG基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于超图的证据组织是后检索推理中处理复杂问答的一个有前景的方向，能够支持更忠实和可解释的推理过程。

title: A Frozen 12B Beats Frontier Models on Verified Work: 100% Accuracy, 0 Tokens, Bit-Exact, Forever
comment: Industry experience report. 14 pages, 8 figures. Public testbench: https://corbenic-galahad-bench.hf.space; companion repository with SHA-256 provenance manifest: https://github.com/corbenicai/galahad-bench
summary: Improving a language model today means retraining it: enormous compute, a new opaque model each cycle, non-deterministic output. We take the opposite path: the model stays frozen, and a persistent memory of verified solutions grows beside it. Once a problem family is solved and has passed an independent verification step that never consults the answer key, every new instance of that family is answered at zero generation tokens, bit-exact, deterministically. Across 180 fresh instances spanning nine problem families, four architectures from four vendors - dense and mixture-of-experts - each score 180/180 at zero generation tokens per answer: execution-bound capability decoupled from parameter scaling. A negative control attributes the capability fully to the memory: emptied, it solves nothing. The same verify-before-store contract holds for open-ended reasoning: 88/88 consistency-gated acceptances across all four models, machine-checked formal proof, and reasoning-method transfer at 77/80. Memory selection takes 1.4 microseconds; a full reuse completes in 6-23 ms at 36 mWh. Approximate similarity retrieval selects the wrong item 94.3% of the time on a 4,500-item verified store where exact addressing makes zero errors. The store also serves as working context at a scale no shipped engine matches: a 6,000,000-token movable window on a single 46 GB GPU at flat memory, where vLLM stops at 30,399 tokens and SGLang silently truncates past 32,000. On published benchmarks, frontier models remain far ahead of any 12B at raw from-scratch reasoning; on everything this system has solved and verified, the comparison inverts: a frontier API call pays a fresh generation pass on every query, forever, while verified reuse costs zero tokens and returns the identical bits every time. A public testbench with free, rate-limited access accompanies this report: https://corbenic-galahad-bench.hf.space

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需重新训练模型的增量学习方法：模型冻结，通过持久化已验证解法的记忆库实现零生成token、确定性的精确推理。在180个新实例上取得180/180的满分，并支持大规模工作上下文（600万token可移动窗口）。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型改进需重新训练，成本高、非确定、不透明。解决已有问题族时，每次查询仍需完整推理，效率低下。
AI.method: 冻结模型参数，构建持久化已验证解法的记忆库。新实例通过精确寻址匹配已解决问题族，跳过生成步骤直接返回答案。关键约束：验证步骤不得参考标准答案，确保独立正确性。
AI.result: 九大问题族180个实例，四种架构（含密集型和MoE）全部零token满分。负对照显示记忆库清空后系统无法解决任何问题。88/88一致性验证接受，77/80推理方法迁移。相似检索94.3%错误，精确寻址零错误。记忆库可作为600万token工作上下文。
AI.conclusion: 验证-存储-复用的范式可高效解决已覆盖问题，零token、确定、精确。但在未解问题上仍远逊于前沿模型，说明该方法与参数缩放互补，而非替代。

title: The JEPA Paradox in Language: The Geometry of Linguistic Alternatives
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are effective for images, video, and audio, yet deterministic JEPA-style latent prediction has not become a standard objective for text encoders. We argue that this gap reflects a mismatch between squared-error latent prediction and the conditional structure of language. The key requirement is conditional concentration: given a context and target location, the target representation should lie near a single meaningful point. Local image prediction often satisfies this through spatial continuity, whereas masked text can admit multiple valid token or span completions whose representations need not share a coherent center. We formalize this mismatch through three conditions---predictability, non-collapse, and low conditional variance---and show how their failure creates centroid degeneracy and collapse pressure in text. Matched I-JEPA and T-JEPA experiments reveal the predicted sequence: mutual-information saturation and elevated target variance precede train--validation instability, effective-rank degeneration, cosine collapse, and poor downstream transfer. The same pattern appears across five independent data seeds, indicating that it is not a sampling artifact. These results do not rule out predictive learning for language; they show that text-compatible JEPA objectives must preserve multiple plausible completions rather than compress them into a single latent point.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了确定性JEPA式潜在预测（如均方误差）与文本的天然不兼容性：因为语言具有多重合法补全的特性，强制压缩为单一潜在表示会导致坍塌问题；作者通过形式化三个条件和实验验证了这一现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管JEPA在图像、视频、音频领域表现优异，但确定性JEPA式潜在预测尚未成为文本编码器的标准目标；作者认为这一差距源于平方误差潜在预测与语言条件结构之间的不匹配。
AI.method: 作者形式化了三个条件（可预测性、非坍塌、低条件方差），指出文本因存在多个有效补全而导致中心退化与坍塌压力；通过I-JEPA与T-JEPA的对比实验验证了预测序列。
AI.result: 实验表明：互信息饱和与目标方差升高先于训练-验证不稳定性、有效秩退化、余弦坍塌及下游迁移性能下降；该模式在五个独立数据种子中一致出现。
AI.conclusion: 研究不否定预测学习在语言中的潜力，但指出文本兼容的JEPA目标必须保留多个合理补全，而非将其压缩为单一潜在点。

title: Post-Operative Glioma Segmentation via Loss Stabilization, Normalization and Subspace Attention
comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026)
summary: Tracking residual tumor after surgery is essential for catching recurrence early, but automating post-operative glioma segmentation remains a difficult task. Although transformer-based architectures, such as SwinUNETR, achieved impressive results, few studies test how well they generalize across clinical protocols. In this paper, we conduct an ablation study on the MU-GLIOMA-POST and UCSF-ALPTDG datasets and show that the standard Generalized Dice Loss (GDL) is unstable under domain shift: the Whole Lesion (WL) Dice drops from 0.88 on the internal validation set to 0.73 on the external UCSF test set. To address this, we pair brain-masked percentile normalization with voxel-level contrastive learning. We also propose a Subspace-Aware Class Attention (SACA) module that re-calibrates the bottleneck features and raises Enhancing Tumor (ET) sensitivity by 8% (9.1% relative improvement) on internal validation. Ensembling these refinements with nnU-Net brings every stable configuration to a WL Dice of 0.94, and the SACA variant ensemble achieves the best boundary error (HD95) of 2.92 mm on MU-GLIOMA-POST.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了术后胶质瘤自动分割中Transformer架构（如SwinUNETR）在跨临床协议下的泛化性问题，发现标准GDL损失在域迁移时不稳定（WL Dice从0.88降至0.73）。提出脑掩膜百分位归一化、体素级对比学习及子空间感知类注意力模块（SACA），将增强肿瘤敏感性提升8%，最终通过集成达到WL Dice 0.94、HD95 2.92mm的最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 术后残留肿瘤追踪对早期复发检测至关重要，但自动化术后胶质瘤分割任务困难。尽管SwinUNETR等Transformer架构表现优异，但很少有研究测试它们在跨临床协议下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 在MU-GLIOMA-POST和UCSF-ALPTDG数据集上进行消融研究。提出三项改进：1）脑掩膜百分位归一化；2）体素级对比学习；3）子空间感知类注意力模块（SACA）用于重新校准瓶颈特征。最终将改进方法与nnU-Net集成。
AI.result: 标准GDL损失在域迁移下不稳定（WL Dice从0.88降至0.73）。SACA模块使增强肿瘤敏感性提升8%（相对提升9.1%）。集成方法在所有稳定配置下达到WL Dice 0.94，SACA集成变体在MU-GLIOMA-POST上达到最佳边界误差HD95为2.92mm。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了术后胶质瘤分割中域迁移问题的严重性，提出的归一化、对比学习与注意力机制结合有效提升了模型的泛化能力和分割精度，SACA模块对增强肿瘤的敏感性提升尤为显著。

title: Spectral-Aware Analytic Class-Incremental Learning for Long-Tailed Distributions
summary: Analytic Continual Learning (ACL) offers a computationally efficient alternative to gradient-based approaches. Recent ACL methods are based on Recursive Least Squares (RLS) and have achieved the state-of-the-art results compared to other alternatives. However, they falter significantly in Class-Incremental Learning scenarios characterized by Long-Tailed distributions. While the ill-conditioning of the autocorrelation (Gram) matrix is a known limitation of RLS, we demonstrate that class imbalance exacerbates this issue into a distinct spectral pathology: "tail" classes suffer from severe spectral collapse, rendering their subspaces numerically indistinguishable from noise. Standard Ridge Regression ($L_2$) fails to address this effectively as it applies isotropic regularization - a uniform penalty that is insufficient to stabilize the tail without over-shrinking the head. To address this, we propose Geometry-Spectral Rectification (GSR), a theoretically grounded framework that treats long-tailed learning as a spectral regularization problem. Unlike standard isotropic regularization (Ridge) which uniformly penalizes all eigenvalues, GSR acts as an anisotropic spectral filter, selectively inflating the collapsed eigenvalues of tail classes. We construct a structured, data-dependent spectral perturbation matrix $Δ$ that selectively inflates collapsed tail eigen-directions of the Gram matrix. Theoretical analysis proves that GSR guarantees an improved stable rank for the Gram matrix, ensuring numerical stability. Extensive experiments show that GSR establishes a new state-of-the-art for analytic CIL, offering a superior trade-off between computational efficiency and robust generalization in long-tailed settings.

AI.tldr: 针对解析式持续学习在长尾类增量场景中因自相关矩阵谱坍缩导致的性能下降问题，提出一种各向异性谱正则化方法GSR，通过构建结构化数据依赖的扰动矩阵选择性放大尾部类坍缩特征值，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升长尾场景下的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有解析式持续学习方法（基于RLS）在长尾类增量场景中性能严重下降，原因是类别不平衡加剧了自相关矩阵的病态条件，导致尾部类出现"谱坍缩"——其特征子空间在数值上与噪声无法区分。标准岭回归（各向同性L2正则化）对所有特征值施加均匀惩罚，无法有效稳定尾部类却过度收缩头部类。
AI.method: 提出几何-谱校正框架（GSR），将其视为谱正则化问题。与各向同性的Ridge不同，GSR作为各向异性谱滤波器，选择性地放大尾部类坍缩的特征值。具体构造一个结构化的、数据依赖的谱扰动矩阵Δ，该矩阵有针对性地放大Gram矩阵中尾部类坍缩的特征方向。
AI.result: 理论分析证明GSR能保证Gram矩阵的稳定秩得到改善，确保数值稳定性。大量实验表明，GSR在解析式类增量学习中取得了新的最优性能，在长尾设置下实现了计算效率与鲁棒泛化之间的优越平衡。
AI.conclusion: GSR通过各向异性谱正则化有效解决了长尾类增量场景中解析式持续学习的谱坍缩问题，相比各向同性的Ridge回归更适用于类别不平衡分布。

title: Differencing the Diffusion Trajectory toward Uncertain Components for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Diffusion models have become a widely used framework for probabilistic time series forecasting, modeling the distribution of future values given an observed history. In time series forecasting, however, the future continues the observed history, creating an asymmetry the standard diffusion process leaves unaddressed, with slowly-varying content largely determined by the observed continuity while higher-frequency dynamics carry most of the residual uncertainty. Existing diffusion-based forecasters decouple this asymmetry through an external rule before generation, leaving the corruption trajectory blind to which parts of the target the history can already anchor. We propose DiffDiff, a diffusion framework that embeds this predictability asymmetry into the diffusion trajectory itself, so that a single end-to-end diffusion process becomes aware of which parts of the target the history can already anchor. DiffDiff makes the forward operator step-dependent so that the noisy intermediate state progressively shifts from the target itself toward its second-order differenced structure, while a conditioning pathway supplies the denoiser with both value-domain and differential history information balanced by a stage-adaptive gate at each diffusion step. The terminal distribution approaches a standard Gaussian, preserving compatibility with existing samplers. On seven benchmarks across four prediction horizons, DiffDiff outperforms six diffusion baselines, and our analysis confirms that DiffDiff concentrates the diffusion's generative effort on the most uncertain components of the target while relieving it from rebuilding the history-anchored content.

AI.tldr: DiffDiff提出了一种将可预测性不对称性嵌入扩散轨迹本身的扩散框架，通过步进依赖的前向算子使噪声中间状态逐步从目标本身向二阶差分结构转移，并利用阶段自适应门控平衡值域和差分历史信息，在7个基准上优于6种扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散预测器通过外部规则在生成前解耦历史可锚定内容与高频不确定性，但扩散轨迹本身对目标中哪些部分已被历史锚定是盲目的，导致生成效率低下。
AI.method: 提出DiffDiff框架：(1) 步进依赖的前向算子，使噪声中间状态从目标本身逐步向其二阶差分结构转移；(2) 条件路径向去噪器提供值域和差分历史信息，并通过阶段自适应门控平衡两者；(3) 终端分布接近标准高斯，保持与现有采样器兼容。
AI.result: 在7个基准数据集和4个预测时长上，DiffDiff优于6种扩散基线方法，且分析证实该方法将生成能力集中在最不确定的成分上，减少了重建历史锚定内容的负担。
AI.conclusion: 通过将预测不对称性融入扩散轨迹自身，DiffDiff实现了更高效的端到端概率时间序列预测，让模型自动聚焦于不确定性高的成分。

title: Do Current Retrievers Cover All the Evidence? A Controlled Study of Conjunctive Cross-Page Retrieval
summary: Finding a long document relevant to a multi-part request is not the same as establishing that it contains every requested piece of evidence. We study this gap for conjunctive document retrieval, where two or three explicit conditions must be supported on different pages of one document. We use n-Clue as a controlled measurement instrument: 1{,}000 queries over 2{,}021 documents pair all-condition golds with naturally occurring documents that satisfy only a subset, and a complete-first success requires a top-10 gold to precede every released subset qrel. Across 70 configurations, condition-wise decomposition improves two dense backbones by 6.8--7.3 points and lexical--visual fusion adds 8.7, while four generic rerankers all reduce Gold-NDCG; these directions replicate on a four-source stress set. Scaling one dense family from 0.6B to 8B changes complete-first success by 0.0 points. The strongest displayed hybrid illustrates the resulting gap: it finds a gold for 81.1\% of queries but succeeds complete-first on only 35.8\%, and the gap persists across condition count, target length, candidate density, query rendering, and the four-source stress set. Finally, page-aware visual systems surface stored support for every condition on only 5.1--5.3\% of queries. These results identify condition coverage, rather than gold discovery alone, as the central bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多条件文档检索（conjunctive document retrieval）中的“完整优先成功”问题，即检索系统能否在top-10结果中优先返回满足所有查询条件的文档。通过n-Clue数据集（1000个查询、2021篇文档）和70种配置实验，发现条件分解能提升密集检索骨干模型6.8–7.3点，词法与视觉融合提升8.7点，但通用重排序器反而降低Gold-NDCG。随着模型规模从0.6B扩展到8B，完整优先成功率为0.0提升。最强混合系统虽能查全81.1%查询的gold文档，但仅35.8%实现完整优先成功。结论指出：条件覆盖（condition coverage）比单纯发现gold文档更关键。
AI.motivation: 现有检索评估主要关注相关性判断，忽略了多条件文档检索中“一个文档需同时满足多个条件”的特殊挑战。用户实际需求常为复合型（如“需要包含A、B、C证据的文档”），但现有方法未能区分“找到相关文档”与“找到包含所有条件的文档”。
AI.method: 构建n-Clue控制数据集（1000查询/2021文档），包含所有条件子集（金标准、部分满足、子集满足等）。使用70种配置（密集检索、词法-视觉融合、通用重排序器）进行实验，评估指标为Gold-NDCG和“完整优先成功”（complete-first success，即top-10中gold先于任何部分满足文档出现）。
AI.result: 条件分解（condition-wise decomposition）提升密集模型6.8–7.3点Gold-NDCG；词法-视觉融合额外提升8.7点；通用重排序器（如BERT-rank等）反而降低性能。模型规模从0.6B增至8B无提升。最强混合系统在81.1%查询中能找到gold，但仅35.8%实现完整优先成功。页面感知视觉系统（page-aware）仅5.1–5.3%查询能展示所有条件支持证据。
AI.conclusion: 多条件文档检索的核心瓶颈不是发现gold文档的能力，而是确保条件覆盖（condition coverage），即检索结果必须优先包含满足全部条件的文档。现有方法在条件覆盖上存在显著差距，通用重排序和规模扩展均无法解决该问题，需专门设计条件感知检索策略。

title: Guiding Language Models to Be More Empathetic: Culturally Sensitive Mental Health Advice Generation Through Human-LLM Collaboration
summary: Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), their ability to generate empathetic mental health counseling responses in low-resource languages remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we curate 625 authentic mental health cases from three complementary sources: (1) publicly available Facebook posts discussing mental health concerns, (2) transcripts from the Bangladeshi television program "Ami Akhon Ki Korbo", and (3) anonymized student questionnaire responses covering diverse emotional and psychological challenges. Based on these cases, we build an evaluation corpus comprising advice written by licensed clinical psychologists and responses generated by three modern proprietary LLMs: GPT-4o Mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. We further propose the Role-Playing Reflective Chain-of-Thought Advisory Framework (RP-RCAF), a task-specific prompting strategy that combines expert-authored few-shot examples with structured self-reflection to produce supportive, culturally aware, and ethically aligned counseling through a compassionate advisor persona. We also introduce the Grok 4-Based Response Evaluation and Scoring Framework (G-REFS), which integrates automated assessment with expert psychologist validation across emotional sensitivity, cultural appropriateness, linguistic clarity, and ethical soundness. Experimental results show that RP-RCAF consistently outperforms conventional prompting across all evaluated models and produces responses that more closely align with professional psychological counseling.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了低资源语言（孟加拉语）心理健康咨询数据集，提出角色扮演反思思维链框架（RP-RCAF）和G-REFS评估框架，实验表明该提示策略在情感敏感度、文化适切性等维度显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在低资源语言下的共情式心理健康咨询能力尚未被充分探索，缺乏相应的评估数据和专门的方法论。
AI.method: 从Facebook帖子、电视节目转录和学生问卷中收集625个真实心理案例，构建包含心理学家建议和三种大模型（GPT-4o Mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Pro）回复的评估语料；提出RP-RCAF（角色扮演反思思维链）提示策略和G-REFS（结合自动评估与专家验证的）评分框架。
AI.result: RP-RCAF在所有评估模型上一致优于传统提示方法，生成的回复更接近专业心理咨询标准。
AI.conclusion: RP-RCAF框架能有效提升LLM在低资源语言心理健康咨询中的共情能力与文化适配性，G-REFS提供了可靠的评估手段。

title: Beyond Error-vs-Discard Characteristic: Toward Stable and Reliable Evaluation for Face Image Quality Assessment
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment (FIQA) aims to estimate the utility of facial images for reliable recognition. The evaluation of FIQA methods is predominantly based on the Error-versus-Discard Characteristic (EDC), which evaluates performance by progressively discarding low-quality samples and measuring recognition error on the retained subset. In this work, we demonstrate that the widely used EDC protocol has fundamental limitations: Test-Set Divergence and Threshold Drift, which together limit the reliability and comparability of FIQA methods. To address this, we propose discard-based EDC variants and a rank-based Rank Consistency Evaluation (RCE) metric that operates on the entire test set without discarding samples, using a fixed decision threshold. Extensive experiments on five datasets, four face recognition models, and 15 state-of-the-art FIQA methods demonstrate both the limitations of EDC and the effectiveness of the proposed approaches in enabling a more reliable and comparable evaluation. Despite evaluated on face images only, the limitations arise from the EDC protocol rather than the biometric modality, suggesting a broader applicability to biometric quality assessment in general.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了人脸图像质量评估（FIQA）中广泛使用的EDC评估协议存在测试集漂移和阈值漂移两大根本性缺陷，并提出基于丢弃的EDC变体和基于排名的RCE指标，在五个数据集、四个识别模型和15种FIQA方法上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有FIQA评估依赖EDC协议，但该协议存在根本性缺陷（测试集漂移和阈值漂移），导致评估结果不可靠且难以跨方法比较，需要更稳健的评估方案。
AI.method: 提出两种改进：一是基于丢弃策略的EDC变体；二是全新的基于排名的RCE指标，该指标在整个测试集上运行、无需丢弃样本、使用固定决策阈值。
AI.result: 在5个数据集、4个识别模型、15种FIQA方法上的实验证实了EDC的局限性，并验证了所提方法能实现更可靠和可比较的评估。
AI.conclusion: EDC协议的缺陷不限于人脸模态，可能普遍适用于生物特征质量评估领域；所提方法为FIQA提供了更可靠的评估基础。

title: Discrepancy-Rounded Fair Bandits with Static and Time-Varying Exposure Floors
summary: Minimum-exposure constraints arise in recommendation, content curation, and regulated allocation when each provider, arm, or group must receive guaranteed exposure inside a period rather than only in aggregate. We study stochastic bandits with exact exposure floors and show that the right object is a rounding problem: a fractional fair schedule is realized as integral pulls, and the exposure error is exactly a discrepancy vector. The main contribution is a blockwise model with time-varying floors. BDQ-UCB satisfies every block floor deterministically and has fair regret governed by the nonmandatory budget $R$, not the horizon $T$, with high-probability regret $O(\sqrt{KR\log(KT)})$. A MOSS residual variant attains $O(\sqrt{KR})$, and a matching lower bound gives the minimax rate $Θ(\sqrt{KR})$, even with positive mandatory exposure; a kl-UCB$^{++}$ residual rule adds instance-dependent optimality. The formulation becomes essential for overlapping group floors: per-arm rounding can violate a group constraint by $Ω(s)$ in the group size, whereas Beck--Fiala null-space rounding meets every group floor within the block budget with violation below the arm degree $t$, and composes with UCB at the same $R$-parametrized regret. For learned group plans, we close disjoint systems at $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{KT})$, give a dual-ledger decomposition explaining why naive index rules fail under overlap, and prove a plan-sampling rule that is pathwise feasible under an initial cover-slack condition and attains a conditional $\widetilde O(\sqrt{KT})$ guarantee, leaving the condition-free overlap rate open. Experiments on synthetic floors, MovieLens-100k genre exposure, and deployment stress tests show exact feasibility without penalty tuning and regret competitive with tuned Lagrangian baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机Bandits中具有最小曝光约束（exposure floors）的问题，提出基于块状模型（blockwise model）与时间变化曝光下限的BDQ-UCB算法，将分数公平调度转化为整数拉取，并利用Beck-Fiala零空间舍入处理重叠组约束，实现了参数化于非强制预算R而非时间T的遗憾界，理论匹配极小化最优下界，实验验证了可行性与竞争性。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统、内容策展和受监管分配中，每个提供方、臂或组必须在每个时间段内获得保证的最低曝光量，而不仅仅是长期平均。现有方法难以在每一轮（block）内确定性满足曝光下限，且重叠组约束下简单舍入会导致违反程度随组大小线性增长，亟需更精细的随机化舍入与持续学习框架。
AI.method: 1. 将曝光约束转化为分数公平调度的确定性舍入问题，误差视为离散度向量；2. 提出BDQ-UCB算法，在每一block内确定性满足所有曝光下限；3. 引入MOSS残差变体达到O(√KR)遗憾；4. 针对重叠组约束，采用Beck-Fiala零空间舍入，将违反上界控制在臂度t内；5. 提出双重账本分解解释朴素索引规则在重叠约束下失败的原因；6. 设计满足初始覆盖松弛条件的路径可行规划采样规则。
AI.result: BDQ-UCB实现O(√(KR log(KT)))高概率遗憾；MOSS残差变体达到O(√KR)；匹配下界Θ(√KR)；kl-UCB⁺⁺残差规则实例级最优；Beck-Fiala舍入在重叠组中违反上界为O(t)；不重叠系统闭式遗憾为Θ̃(√KT)；条件性路径可行保证̃O(√KT)；实验在合成数据、MovieLens-100k和部署压力测试中均精确满足约束且遗憾与调参Lagrangian基线竞争。
AI.conclusion: 曝光下限约束下的随机Bandits问题本质是分数舍入问题，块状模型+零空间舍入可高效处理时变及重叠约束；遗憾由非强制预算R而非时间T主导；但条件-free的重叠约束最优遗憾仍是开放问题。

title: Chart Deception in Vision-Language Models: From Vulnerability to Mitigation
summary: Information visualizations are widely used to communicate patterns, trends, and outliers, yet deceptive design choices-such as truncated or inverted axes, distorted aspect ratios, inappropriate encodings, and misleading color mappings-can systematically alter interpretation while preserving the underlying data. As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for chart understanding and analytical reasoning, assessing their robustness to such deceptive visualizations has become critical for trustworthy data analysis. We introduce VisDeception, the first controlled paired benchmark for evaluating the robustness of VLMs to misleading chart designs. The benchmark contains 1,600 paired faithful and misleading charts spanning eight major categories of deceptive visualization tactics, where each misleading chart is paired with a faithful counterpart generated from the same underlying data. To isolate deception-induced reasoning errors from baseline chart-understanding errors, we introduce the Deception Score, a paired evaluation metric that quantifies how misleading visualizations shift model responses away from the faithful interpretation of the data. Across 32,000 responses from 10 state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that even advanced models remain highly vulnerable to deceptive visual manipulations. To improve robustness, we further propose an inference-time multi-agent mitigation framework that grounds reasoning in structured chart metadata extracted from the visualization before answer generation, enabling models to reduce the influence of deceptive visual cues without requiring explicit user instructions. Together, our findings reveal important reliability gaps in current chart-understanding systems and establish benchmark-driven evaluation, deception-aware metrics, and structured reasoning as promising directions for developing more trustworthy VLMs for visual analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisDeception基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）在欺骗性图表下的鲁棒性，并提出了Deception Score指标和基于多智能体的推理增强框架，实验发现当前先进VLMs仍高度脆弱于欺骗性视觉操纵。
AI.motivation: 视觉信息可视化中存在的欺骗性设计（如截断坐标轴、扭曲比例等）会系统性地改变用户对数据的理解，而VLMs越来越多地被用于图表理解与分析，亟需评估其在欺骗性可视化下的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建包含1,600对忠实/欺骗图表的VisDeception基准，涵盖8类欺骗策略；提出Deception Score配对评估指标衡量欺骗导致的推理偏差；设计多智能体推理框架，在生成答案前提取结构化图表元数据以缓解欺骗影响。
AI.result: 对10个先进VLM的32,000个响应进行测试，发现即使是最先进的模型对欺骗性视觉操纵仍然高度脆弱。提出的多智能体框架能有效提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 当前图表理解系统存在显著可靠性差距，基准驱动评估、欺骗感知度量和结构化推理是发展更可信VLMs的有效方向。

title: Integrating Factual and Normative Industrial Knowledge via Constraint-Aware Graph Attention for Process Plan Recommendation
summary: Integrating heterogeneous industrial knowledge, including factual relations and decision constraints, remains a core challenge in industrial information systems. Machining process planning exemplifies this problem because engineers must select operations by combining material properties, feature characteristics, and quality requirements. Existing methods rely mainly on similarity retrieval or classification, without a unified ranking objective or standardized evaluation. We propose PCA-GAT, which formulates machining process plan recommendation as a knowledge graph enhanced collaborative filtering problem. Bayesian Personalized Ranking provides the learning objective, while Recall@K and NDCG@K define evaluation. The knowledge graph supplies semantic structure when collaborative signals are sparse. Four domain constraints, material compatibility, precision requirements, feature applicability, and operation sequencing, are introduced as attention biases during graph propagation. Type-specific weights learn their importance, and an adaptive gate adjusts their influence using local context. On a real aerospace dataset with 115 parts and 507 plans, PCA-GAT achieves Recall@1 = 0.9087 and strong cold-start robustness, with about half the degradation of the strongest baseline under severe sparsity. Ablation studies show that knowledge graph enrichment is essential, constraints add value, and ungated constraint injection can hurt performance. The learned weights identify material-operation compatibility as the dominant factor, consistent with domain expertise. Results on three public benchmarks show no degradation when constraints are absent, supporting generalization beyond manufacturing. This study establishes a standardized recommendation protocol for engineering process planning and benchmarks seven methods across three categories, showing that knowledge representation is the main bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 提出PCA-GAT，将机加工艺规划建模为知识图谱增强的协同过滤问题，利用贝叶斯个性化排序和四种领域约束实现高精度推荐，在航空数据集上Recall@1达0.9087，并具有强冷启动鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 工业异构知识（事实关系+决策约束）的集成缺乏统一框架，现有方法主要依赖相似性检索或分类，缺少统一的排序目标和标准化评估。
AI.method: 基于PCA-GAT（知识图谱增强协同过滤），以贝叶斯个性化排序为学习目标，引入四种领域约束（材料兼容性、精度要求、特征适用性、工序排序）作为图传播中的注意力偏置，使用类型特定权重和自适应门控调节约束影响。
AI.result: 航空数据集上Recall@1=0.9087；冷启动场景退化仅为最强基线的一半；消融实验验证了知识图谱、约束机制和门控的必要性；材料-操作兼容性被识别为最主导因素；三个公开基准上无退化。
AI.conclusion: 建立了工程工艺规划的标准化推荐协议，基准测试表明知识表示是主要瓶颈，所提方法在制造与非制造领域均有效。

title: Language Shapes Instruction Hierarchy Compliance in Multilingual LLMs
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/g1moon/Language-Shapes-IH
summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) requires models to prioritize instructions by source, ensuring that higher-priority instructions override lower-priority ones. Despite its importance for safe and controllable deployment, existing evaluations have focused almost exclusively on English, leaving it unclear whether IH compliance remains stable in multilingual settings. We introduce XIH-Bench, a benchmark for multilingual IH evaluation with both same-language and cross-language conflicts across six languages, four domains, and three IH settings. Across models, we find two consistent patterns. First, IH compliance exhibits a clear language-dependent asymmetry: a language that strengthens compliance in the higher-priority position can become disruptive in the lower-priority position. Second, cross-language conflicts yield higher compliance than same-language conflicts, a phenomenon we term the Language Boundary Effect. We further show that language specialization can make lower-priority instructions in model-favored languages harder to override, creating multilingual reliability and security risks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XIH-Bench基准，用于多语言环境下指令层级（IH）的评估，发现IH遵从存在语言依赖性不对称和语言边界效应，且模型偏好的语言会使低优先级指令更难被覆盖，带来可靠性风险。
AI.motivation: 现有IH评估几乎只关注英语，多语言场景下IH遵从性是否稳定尚不明确，缺乏多语言IH基准。
AI.method: 构建XIH-Bench基准，涵盖六种语言、四个领域、三种IH设置，包含同语言和跨语言冲突场景。
AI.result: 1）IH遵从存在语言依赖性不对称：语言在高优先级位置增强遵从，在低优先级位置可能破坏遵从；2）跨语言冲突的遵从度高于同语言冲突（语言边界效应）；3）模型偏好语言中的低优先级指令更难被覆盖，引发多语言安全风险。
AI.conclusion: 多语言环境下IH遵从性存在系统性偏差，需要关注语言相关的不对称性和边界效应带来的安全挑战。

title: Real-time Reconstruction of Human Visual Perception from fMRI
summary: Real-time closed-loop neurofeedback based on functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has led to important scientific and clinical advances. However, the sophistication of the analysis methods used in real-time fMRI lags behind the state-of-the-art in fMRI decoding, largely due to computational factors: Most advanced decoding pipelines do not fit within the envelope of real-time processing, where the analysis needs to be conducted in a matter of seconds and without leveraging data acquired later in the session. Here, we present a real-time compatible adaptation of a computationally intensive state-of-the-art pipeline for reconstructing perceived natural images (MindEye2), and we demonstrate that reliable fine-grained decoding is still achievable in this setting. Using RT-Cloud, an open-source, scalable cloud-based platform, we performed a real-time scan where we decoded single-trial visual perception within seconds after an image was shown to the participant. Finally, we use simulated analyses to document the factors driving changes in performance from offline to real-time analysis. This work serves as a proof-of-concept that it is feasible to deploy these powerful fMRI decoding pipelines in real-time analysis, paving the way for their use in brain-computer interfaces for scientific discovery and clinical treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何在实时fMRI分析中部署原本计算密集的先进神经解码流水线（MindEye2），通过RT-Cloud平台实现了在几秒内解码单次视觉感知图像，并分析了从离线到实时性能变化的关键因素，为脑机接口和临床应用开辟了道路。
AI.motivation: 实时fMRI闭环神经反馈虽有重要的科学和临床价值，但其分析方法远远落后于最先进的fMRI解码技术，主要障碍在于计算因素——大多数先进解码流水线无法在几秒钟内完成实时处理，且无法利用后续采集的数据。
AI.method: 对计算密集型的MindEye2流水线进行实时兼容改造；使用开源、可扩展的云平台RT-Cloud进行实时扫描；在参与者看到图像后几秒内解码单次视觉感知；通过模拟分析对比离线与实时分析性能差异。
AI.result: 成功在实时设置下实现了可靠的细粒度解码，能够在图像呈现后秒级时间内解码单次视觉感知；找到了从离线到实时分析性能变化的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 证明了将强大的fMRI解码流水线部署到实时分析中是可行的，为将其用于脑机接口、科学发现和临床治疗铺平了道路。

title: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
summary: Verbalized Machine Learning (VML) parameterizes a model as a natural-language prompt that an LLM evaluates as f(x; theta). The framework is interpretable, but it commits to a single hypothesis with no measure of uncertainty, and that hypothesis varies substantially across optimization runs on the same data. We propose the Verbalized Particle Posterior (VPP), which treats verbalized learning as a Bayesian inference problem: maintain a population of natural-language hypotheses as particles, update them with Metropolis-Hastings (VPP-MH) or Sequential Monte Carlo (VPP-SMC), and predict by Bayesian model averaging. Both algorithms treat the LLM as a black box, requiring no access to logits or gradients. A distinctive consequence follows. In classical Bayesian learning, model selection sits outside the posterior; in VPP both model structure and parameters share a single language space, and the posterior ranges over both. We evaluate VPP on regression, classification, and rule-discovery benchmarks. It improves over a single VML run on every benchmark and matches or exceeds an oracle-best ensemble of independent VML runs on most, while eliminating the catastrophic single-run failures that VML occasionally produces. Because each particle is a human-readable hypothesis, the posterior is itself something a reader can inspect, seeing in plain text which explanations the data supported and which it ruled out.

AI.tldr: 提出Verbalized Particle Posterior (VPP)，将口头化机器学习转化为贝叶斯推断问题，通过粒子群（自然语言假设）进行MCMC或SMC采样，实现不确定性量化与贝叶斯模型平均，在多个基准上优于单次VML运行。
AI.motivation: VML虽可解释，但仅依赖单一假设，缺乏不确定性度量，且不同优化运行间假设差异大。需要一种能够量化不确定性、稳定且保持可解释性的框架。
AI.method: 维护一个由自然语言假设组成的粒子群，使用Metropolis-Hastings或Sequential Monte Carlo算法更新这些粒子，将LLM视为黑盒（无需logits或梯度），通过贝叶斯模型平均进行预测。
AI.result: 在回归、分类和规则发现基准上，VPP全面优于单次VML运行；在大多数基准上匹配或超过oracle最优独立VML集成；消除了VML偶发的灾难性单次运行失败。
AI.conclusion: VPP不仅提升了性能与稳定性，还实现了模型结构和参数在统一语言空间上的后验推断，且每个粒子是人工可读的假设，使后验本身可被人类审查。

title: DeepLook: Deeper Thinking with Lookahead
summary: Inference-time scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model reasoning, often delivering larger gains on difficult reasoning tasks than parameter scaling alone. However, existing approaches remain inefficient in how compute is allocated within a reasoning trace. Motivated by the observation that reasoning failures often exhibit an early onset of uncertainty before a wrong answer become explicit, we introduce DeepLook, a training-free monitor-and-intervene decoding framework that concentrates lookahead compute at uncertainty bottlenecks. DeepLook aggregates token-level confidence into segment-level signals, triggers when confidence drops relative to recent history, and explores candidate continuations with fixed-horizon lookahead. Branches are ranked by Average Lookahead Confidence (ALC), the average segment-level confidence over rollout continuations, then pruned and aggregated through voting. On four competition-style mathematics benchmarks across DeepSeek-R1-8B, Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B, DeepLook shifts the accuracy--token-cost Pareto frontier: it improves accuracy over DeepConf-low in 11 of 16 settings while reducing dataset-level token generation by 87.3% on average, including gains of +3.1 on AIME25 with Qwen3-32B and +8.8 on BRUMO25 with GPT-OSS-20B. These results show that selective, future-aware intervention yields substantially stronger accuracy--cost trade-offs than uniformly scaling complete reasoning trajectories. Code is available here.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepLook框架，通过监控token级置信度并在不确定性瓶颈处执行前瞻性干预，在不训练的情况下提升推理效率，在多个数学基准上提升了准确率并平均减少了87.3%的token生成量。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法在推理轨迹内计算分配效率低下，观察到推理失败往往在错误答案明确之前就出现早期不确定性，因此需要一种更精细、前瞻性的计算分配策略。
AI.method: DeepLook是一种无需训练的解码框架：1) 将token级置信度聚合为segment级信号；2) 当置信度相对近期历史下降时触发干预；3) 以固定视界进行前瞻搜索候选延续；4) 使用平均前瞻置信度(ALC)对分支排序；5) 通过剪枝和投票聚合得到最终输出。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-8B、Qwen3-32B、GPT-OSS-20B和GPT-OSS-120B上评估，在16个设置中有11个提升了准确率，同时平均减少87.3%的token生成量。具体包括Qwen3-32B在AIME25上+3.1，GPT-OSS-20B在BRUMO25上+8.8。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、未来感知的干预相比均匀扩展完整推理轨迹能实现更强的准确率-成本权衡，代码已开源。

title: From transcription to semantic corpus analysis: unsupervised learning of sentence representations for ancient languages
summary: Automatic Text Recognition (ATR) now supplies digital humanities with large volumes of unstructured, heterogeneous, and often noisy text in ancient languages. Downstream semantic analysestext reuse identification, alignment, and semantic search-rely on sentence embeddings, yet existing methods transfer poorly to ancient languages: generic multilingual encoders underperform, specialized language models yield anisotropic representation spaces, and labeled similarity data is unavailable. We study two fully unsupervised strategies - TSDAE and contrastive sentence embedding (CSE) - that adapt a specialized token-level language model into a corpus-specific sentence encoder using only raw sentences. On the philologically central case of biblical reuse in patristic literature (2,935 expert-verified parallels in Latin and Ancient Greek, from Augustine, Jerome, and Athanasius), we decompose reuse identification into two separately evaluated tasks-binary detection and correspondence retrieval-and benchmark the adapted encoders against multilingual, specialized, distilled, and supervised fine-tuned baselines, as well as on artificially noised data simulating HTR artifacts and scribal abbreviations. The adapted encoders outperform all baselines on both tasks, with complementary profiles: TSDAE leads detection given a large in-domain corpus, while CSE leads retrieval, reaches its optimum with as few as 4-8k raw in-domain sentences-a few tens of seconds of training on a laptop GPU-and transfers across works and authors, including to noisy post-ATR text when retrained directly on it. UMAP atlases relate the geometric effect of each strategy to the measured gains, and the full pipeline-segmentation, fine-tuning, cross-corpus semantic search-is made available to non-specialists through the online tool Paraphrasis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种无监督策略（TSDAE和CSE）将专家级token语言模型适配为语料专用的句子编码器，在教父文献中圣经复用的检测与检索任务上显著优于多语言、专用、蒸馏及监督微调基线，仅需少量无标注原文即可训练，且对HTR噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动文本识别为数字人文提供了大量古语言文本，但现有句子嵌入方法在古语言上表现不佳：通用多语言编码器性能差，专用模型产生各向异性的表示空间，且缺乏标注相似度数据，因此需要完全无监督的适配方案。
