AI.method: 采用两种无监督策略——TSDAE（去噪自编码）和对比句子嵌入（CSE），将专门的token级语言模型适配为语料专属的句子编码器。将复用识别分解为二元检测和对应检索两个独立任务，并在拉丁语和古希腊语的教父文献上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 两种适配编码器在两个任务上均超越所有基线；TSDAE在拥有大规模领域语料时检测最优，CSE在检索任务上领先，且仅需4k-8k句原文即可在笔记本GPU上数秒训练达到最优；两者均能跨作品、跨作者迁移，并在直接重训练后对含HTR噪声的文本同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 无监督句子编码适配策略能有效解决古语言文本的下游语义分析难题，CSE在资源有限场景下尤具优势，完整流程已通过在线工具Paraphrasis向非专业用户开放。

title: GEMCo: A Validated, Ethically Releasable Proxy for Inaccessible Counselling Data
summary: This paper presents GEMCo, a releasable, human-written proxy for inaccessible counselling data: 86 complete German e-mail counselling conversations (728 messages), expert-authored cases and counsellor sessions with trained role-players. It is validated against a held-out reference of 124 real counselling conversations. The proxy and the real conversations are measured against each other in counsellor strategies and client emotions. The gap is detectable but small. A generative validation supports the analysis. The validation method itself generalises to any domain where real data cannot be shared but a human-made proxy can. Privacy and ethics keep real counselling data closed. GEMCo carries none by design and can be released -- a first step toward language research in this domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GEMCo，一个可公开的、由人类撰写的心理咨询对话代理数据集（86封完整德语邮件咨询对话，728条消息），经验证与真实咨询数据差距小且可检测，为无法共享真实数据的领域提供了研究替代方案。
AI.motivation: 真实心理咨询数据因隐私和伦理限制无法公开，阻碍了该领域的语言研究发展，亟需一种可公开、高质量的数据替代方案。
AI.method: 构建了GEMCo数据集：由专家撰写案例并训练角色扮演者完成86封完整德语邮件咨询对话；通过咨询师策略和客户情绪两个维度与124组真实咨询数据进行对比验证，并辅以生成式验证方法。
AI.result: 代理数据与真实数据在咨询策略和客户情绪上存在可检测但较小的差距，生成式验证支持了分析结论。
AI.conclusion: GEMCo可作为心理咨询语言研究的第一个可公开数据集，其验证方法可推广至任何真实数据无法共享但可构建人工代理的领域。

title: Cheap Probes Predict Expensive Training in 3D-CT Vision--Language Models
summary: Picking the frozen image encoder for a 3D~CT vision--language model (VLM), together with the token-compression scheme on top of it, is a search over many candidates. There are several encoders, several ways to compress their tokens, and several token budgets, and the combinations grow fast. Comparing them the usual way means fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on each combination, and running the whole sweep this way needs far more compute than most groups can spend. We ask whether a cheap probe on the encoder's cached embeddings can stand in for that comparison. We build an image-grounded probing benchmark over (encoder $\times$ compression) cells, with clinical attribute families and two validation gates, scale-sanity and probe-separability, that keep each attribute well-scaled and decodable. These gates are the main methodological contribution. On this benchmark we compare a range of read-out heads, and in a preliminary study we pair each probe with its matched downstream task. The early signal is encouraging: the cheap probe orders the candidates in close agreement with expensive fine-tuning, at about $r\approx0.95$ on the cells measured so far. We read this as an ordinal claim, a ranking predictor rather than an exact estimate, and we are explicit about where it stays preliminary. If it holds up, encoder and compression choices can be screened in minutes with frozen-token probes, with full training spent only on the finalists.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本方法，通过探测预冻结的3D CT图像编码器嵌入特征来替代昂贵的全模型微调，以高效筛选图像编码器与token压缩方案的最佳组合。该方法构建了基于临床属性族的探测基准，并通过scale-sanity和probe-separability两个验证门控保证属性尺度合理且可解码。初步实验表明，廉价探测与昂贵微调的组合排序高度一致（约r≈0.95）。
AI.motivation: 在3D CT视觉-语言模型中，选择图像编码器及其token压缩方案需要大量计算资源（需对每种组合微调大语言模型）。现有方法计算成本过高，多数团队难以承受。因此，需要一种廉价但可靠的代理指标来预筛选候选组合。
AI.method: 构建图像接地探测基准，覆盖(编码器×压缩)组合单元；设计临床属性族（clinical attribute families）作为探测任务；引入两个验证门控：scale-sanity（确保属性尺度合理）和probe-separability（确保属性可解码）；比较多种读出头（read-out heads）；通过初步研究将探测结果与下游微调任务配对。
AI.result: 廉价探测与昂贵微调的组合排序高度一致，相关系数约r≈0.95（基于已测量的单元）。该方法将筛选时间从数天/周缩短至分钟级。
AI.conclusion: 如果该方法得到进一步验证，编码器和压缩方案的选择可以通过冻结token探测在几分钟内完成筛选，仅对最终候选方案进行全训练。当前结果仍处于初步阶段，但信号积极。

title: Learned Interventions in Lean 4 grind
summary: Lean~4's \grind{} tactic combines congruence closure, \ematch{}ing, and case-splitting into a single automated solver, and like any such solver, it relies on hand-tuned heuristics to decide what to instantiate and where to case-split. These heuristics are tempting targets for learning, but there is a catch: because \grind{}'s search is non-monotone, a learned heuristic that helps one proof can break another, and an always-on replacement usually nets out near zero. We avoid this by invoking a learned intervention only after stock \grind{} has already failed: a failure-triggered cascade that, by construction, cannot lose a proof \grind{} already had. We apply it to two of \grind{}'s internal decisions. A cost-aware \ematch{} filter solves slightly more problems and runs about 5\% faster. A lookahead step, proves five theorems it otherwise times out on. We also report the negative result that motivated the design: across four feature-based models, statically predicting the correct case split is no better than random, because whether a split explodes is a runtime property that the features do not capture. Our results suggest that learning within theorem-proving tactics is most effective as a mechanism for deciding when and how to spend bounded search, backed by a reliable symbolic fallback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了故障触发的级联学习机制（failure-triggered cascade），在Lean~4的\grind{}策略失败后才调用学习到的启发式策略，从而在不损失原有证明能力的前提下提升自动化定理证明性能。实验表明cost-aware的\ematch{}过滤提升约5%速度，lookahead步骤额外证明5个超时定理，但静态预测case split效果不佳。
AI.motivation: \grind{}策略依赖手工调优的启发式规则来决定实例化和case-split的位置，但这些启发式规则难以通过机器学习直接替代，因为搜索过程非单调——学习到的启发式可能帮助一个证明却破坏另一个，导致整体收益几乎为零。因此需要一种安全的、不会损失已有证明能力的学习介入方式。
AI.method: 提出故障触发的级联机制（failure-triggered cascade）：仅在标准\grind{}策略失败后才调用学习到的干预策略，从而保证不会损失原有证明能力。将该机制应用于两个内部决策：（1）cost-aware的\ematch{}过滤器；（2）lookahead步骤（前瞻性探索）。
AI.result: cost-aware的\ematch{}过滤器在解决更多问题的同时运行速度提升约5%；lookahead步骤额外证明了5个原本会超时的定理。负面结果：基于四种特征模型的静态case split预测效果与随机猜测相当，因为case split是否爆炸是运行时属性，特征无法捕获。
AI.conclusion: 在定理证明策略中，学习最有效的应用方式是作为决定何时以及如何分配有界搜索的机制，并配备可靠的符号化后备方案。故障触发级联设计保证了安全性，同时能在有界搜索场景下带来实际收益。

title: Group Preference Collapse in Personalized Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Personalized multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aim to generate user-specific responses, but existing methods mainly rely on profile-level information and overlook diverse user preferences. We identify group preference collapse, where multi-user personalized MLLMs become insensitive to individual preferences and drift toward dominant population-level choices due to suppressed preference signals and unreliable preference use during generation. We propose PrefMoE, a preference-centric framework that separates stable profile information from preference-related representations. PrefMoE decomposes preferences into shared prototypes and personalized residuals, preserves individualized residuals with imbalance-aware learning, counterfactual pseudo-user augmentation, and residual decorrelation, and routes profile and preference factors through separate LoRA adaptation paths. Experiments across multiple MLLM backbones show that PrefMoE improves preference-sensitive personalization while substantially reducing preference collapse. Project page: https://prefmoe.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出PrefMoE框架，通过分离稳定画像与偏好表征、设计共享原型与个性化残差、以及非平衡感知学习等策略，解决多用户个性化多模态大模型中存在的群组偏好坍缩问题。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化MLLM主要依赖画像级信息，忽略用户多样化偏好，导致多用户场景下模型对个体偏好不敏感，倾向于生成群体层面的主导性响应（群组偏好坍缩）。
AI.method: 1) 将偏好分解为共享原型和个性化残差；2) 采用非平衡感知学习、反事实伪用户增强和残差解相关技术保留个性化残差；3) 通过分离的LoRA适配路径分别处理画像和偏好信息。
AI.result: 在多个MLLM骨干网络上验证，PrefMoE显著提升偏好敏感个性化能力，同时大幅减少偏好坍缩现象。
AI.conclusion: PrefMoE通过偏好为中心的框架有效缓解了群组偏好坍缩，实现更精准的个性化生成。

title: DSCH-Loss: A Dynamic Semantic Channel Objective for Deep Semantic Hashing
summary: Semantic hashing methods for generating short binary hash codes that allow efficient approximate nearest neighbor search in high-dimensional data spaces have gained extensive consideration in recent years. Deep learning-based methods offer better semantic capturing capabilities than traditional approaches relying on manual feature engineering. Moreover, they enable a data-driven approach to semantic hashing across diverse data modalities, yielding high-quality cross-modal hash codes within a shared Hamming space. Previous work investigated the properties of this Hamming space and introduced a loss function based on predefined so-called semantic channels with fixed width and Hamming distances derived from label similarities. However, this formulation also introduced discontinuities into the loss landscape, complicating optimization. Based on these observations, we propose a newly designed loss function, Dynamic Semantic Channel Hashing (DSCH), using dynamically sized and positioned semantic channels in order to avoid loss landscape discontinuities. Furthermore, we endorse the use of tie-aware Mean Average Precision (mAP) as evaluation metric as it addresses the ambiguity in sample retrieval ordering, which emerges from the discreteness of hash code distances. Finally, multiple experimental settings conducted on two popular datasets and incorporating two different model architectures provide strong evidence that training using the DSCH objective outperforms training using other state-of-the-art loss functions. In a total of 35 out of 40 cross-modal and intra-modal retrieval tasks, models trained with DSCH achieve significantly higher tie-aware mAP scores across all four tested hash code lengths, showing compelling results across model architecture and used dataset. The mAP score uplifts are consistent and amount up to 1.75 percentage points compared to the respective second best.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的损失函数DSCH（动态语义通道哈希），通过动态调整语义通道的大小和位置来避免优化中的不连续性，并在检索评估中采用考虑平局的mAP指标。实验表明，DSCH在35/40项检索任务中优于现有方法，mAP提升最高达1.75个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有的语义哈希方法中，基于预定义固定宽度语义通道的损失函数会导致损失景观不连续，增加了优化难度。作者旨在解决这一缺陷，设计更平滑、更有效的损失函数。
AI.method: 提出DSCH损失函数，采用动态大小和位置的语义通道替代固定通道，消除损失景观的不连续性；同时采用考虑平局的mAP作为评估指标，解决哈希码距离离散性带来的检索排序歧义问题。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、两种模型架构下，DSCH在40项检索任务中的35项上取得最优结果，mAP提升最高达1.75个百分点，且效果在不同哈希码长度下均一致。
AI.conclusion: DSCH作为一种新的损失函数，能有效解决语义通道固定导致的优化问题，显著提升跨模态和模态内检索性能，具有较好的泛化能力。

title: EmoTrace: An Emotion Trajectory-Centered Framework for Psychological Support Dialogue Generation
summary: Using large language models (LLMs) to assist psychological counseling is an important task in the field of natural language processing. The construction of high-quality psychological support dialogue corpora serves as a critical foundation for training counseling-oriented conversational models. However, existing data generation approaches generally suffer from several limitations, including emotionally stable seekers, limited variation in emotional dynamics, and a high degree of compliance with counselors' guidance. These issues result in LLM that lack the capability to effectively respond to emotionally unstable scenarios. In addition, counselor responses are typically driven by problem-solving objectives, thereby overlooking the role of emotion-focused interaction, which are essential in psychological counseling. To address these gaps, we propose EmoTrace, a multi-turn dialogue corpus generation framework centered on modeling seekers' emotional trajectories. we construct seekers' cognitive profile and introduce a seeker module with emotional schemas and an associated activation mechanism, a counselor module, and an emotional trajectory control module, thereby enhancing the layering of the seeker's emotional expression and the counselor's targeted empathic expression. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches in terms of emotional richness and empathy quality.

AI.tldr: 提出了EmoTrace框架，通过建模求助者的情绪轨迹来生成高质量的心理咨询对话语料，解决了现有方法中情绪稳定、缺乏动态变化和过度顺从等问题，在情绪丰富度和共情质量上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有心理支持对话语料生成方法存在求助者情绪过于稳定、情绪动态变化有限、过度顺从咨询师引导等问题，导致LLM无法有效应对情绪不稳定场景；同时咨询师回复通常以问题解决为目标，忽视了情绪聚焦互动的重要性。
AI.method: 提出EmoTrace多轮对话语料生成框架，核心是建模求助者的情绪轨迹。构建求助者认知画像，引入包含情绪图式及激活机制的求助者模块、咨询师模块和情绪轨迹控制模块，增强求助者情绪表达的层次性和咨询师针对性共情表达。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法在情绪丰富度和共情质量方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模求助者情绪轨迹生成对话语料，能有效提升心理咨询对话系统的情绪响应能力和共情质量，弥补了现有数据生成方法的不足。

title: Hybrid Semantic and Spectral Ensemble for Robust Synthetic Image Source Attribution
comment: Peer-reviewed and accepted to the DLMMDD Challenge Workshop at the 35th International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026). 7 pages, 1 figures
summary: The rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) models has necessitated robust Synthetic Image Source Attribution (SIA) methodologies. A critical challenge in SIA is the distribution shift between pristine training images and real-world deployed images, which undergo unknown post-processing operations such as JPEG compression and blurring. In this work, proposed for the DLMMDD Challenge at ICANN 2026, we introduce a dual-branch ensemble framework fusing Semantic Deep Learning with Mathematical Forensic Feature Extraction. The semantic branch employs EfficientNet-B0 regularized with Exponential Moving Averaging (EMA) and Label Smoothing. The forensic branch extracts 126 mathematical features -- including SVD spectral profiles and Local Binary Patterns -- from high-pass noise residuals, compressed via Truncated SVD and classified with XGBoost. Evaluated on a dataset of 10 generators where 55% of the test set is degraded, our approach achieves a private leaderboard accuracy of 95.60%. Furthermore, the entire pipeline is highly computationally efficient, requiring no GPU acceleration and executing end-to-end on a standard CPU in under 6.5 hours, highlighting the practicality and scalability of mathematical forensics for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双分支集成框架，结合语义深度学习（EfficientNet-B0 + EMA + 标签平滑）与数学取证特征提取（126维特征 + Truncated SVD + XGBoost），用于文本到图像模型的来源归属。在10个生成器、55%测试集被退化的条件下，取得95.60%的私有排行榜准确率，且无需GPU，端到端CPU运行时间<6.5小时。
AI.motivation: 现有合成图像来源归属方法在真实部署场景下面临严重的分布漂移问题——测试图像经过未知的后处理操作（如JPEG压缩、模糊），与训练时使用的原始图像分布不一致，导致性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出双分支集成框架：1) 语义分支：使用EfficientNet-B0，结合指数移动平均（EMA）和标签平滑进行正则化训练；2) 取证分支：从高通噪声残差中提取126维数学特征（包括SVD谱轮廓、局部二值模式等），经Truncated SVD降维后使用XGBoost分类。最终两分支结果集成。
AI.result: 在DLMMDD Challenge数据集（10个生成器，55%测试集经过退化处理）上，私有排行榜准确率达到95.60%。整个流程无需GPU，端到端在标准CPU上运行时间不超过6.5小时。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了数学取证特征在真实世界合成图像来源归属中的实用性和可扩展性，兼顾了高准确率与极低的计算资源需求，适合实际部署。

title: Bayesian Complete-Pooling in Cross-Subject Classification for Motor Imagery Electroencephalogram
summary: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have long sought calibration-free operation, but classifiers are typically benchmarked by discrimination alone, blind to whether predicted probabilities are well calibrated - a meaningful gap given nonstationary electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and the risk of overconfident point-estimate classifiers under distribution shift. We conducted a large-scale study contrasting Bayesian complete-pooling models against frequentist baselines for cross-subject, left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery EEG classification across 20 datasets. Six frequentist pipelines were each paired with an analogous Bayesian pipeline sharing identical feature engineering, fit via Markov chain Monte Carlo posterior sampling. Our primary metric was the Brier score, decomposed into reliability and resolution, alongside AUROC for discrimination and Shannon entropy for sharpness. Each metric was analyzed via random-effects meta-analysis (REML, Knapp-Hartung adjustment), verified by leave-one-out influence analysis. Bayesian complete-pooling produced statistically but not practically significant improvements in reliability and increases in predictive uncertainty (lower sharpness); Brier score, resolution, and discrimination showed no significant differences. Between-study heterogeneity was low across all metrics, though the reliability result was sensitive to leave-one-out removal. We additionally profiled computational cost, finding that Bayesian pipelines consumed roughly thirteen times more energy than their frequentist counterparts, a cost that remains modest relative to common household appliances. These results suggest that Bayesian complete-pooling alone offers limited practical benefit for cross-subject motor imagery classification, and that partial-pooling across subjects and sessions is a more promising direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实验对比贝叶斯完全池化模型与频率学派基线在跨被试运动想象脑电分类中的表现，发现贝叶斯方法在可靠性上有统计显著但无实际意义的提升，且计算成本高出约13倍，认为完全池化贝叶斯方法实用价值有限，部分池化是更有前景的方向。
AI.motivation: 脑机接口长期追求免校准操作，但传统分类器仅关注判别能力，忽略了概率预测的校准性。由于脑电信号非平稳且点估计分类器在分布漂移下容易过度自信，评估校准性具有实际意义。
AI.method: 在20个数据集上对比6组频率学派流程与对应的贝叶斯完整池化流程（共享特征工程，MCMC后验采样）。主要指标为Brier分数（分解为可靠性和分辨率），辅以AUROC（判别力）和香农熵（锐度），通过随机效应元分析（REML, Knapp-Hartung调整）和留一法影响分析进行统计检验。
AI.result: 贝叶斯完全池化在可靠性上有统计显著但非实际意义的改善，预测不确定性增加（锐度降低）；Brier分数、分辨率和判别力无显著差异。研究间异质性低，但可靠性结果对留一法剔除敏感。贝叶斯流程能耗约为频率学派的13倍，但能耗绝对值仍低于常见家用电器。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯完全池化对跨被试运动想象分类的实用收益有限，未来应关注跨被试和跨session的部分池化方法。

title: Evaluating LLMs as Interpretable Controllers for Dynamical Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for decision-making and reasoning tasks, yet their potential as controllers for physical systems remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether LLMs can function as interpretable controllers for a dynamic thermal environment, examining their ability to follow setpoints, interpret natural-language commands, reason about actuator effects, and incorporate prior model-based knowledge. Five LLMs of varying scales are evaluated under multiple scenarios, including settings with penalties on heater or fan usage and cases where the models have access to a physics-based prediction tool. The results show that control performance depends on model complexity: while low- and mid-scale models frequently misinterpret actuator dynamics or generate inconsistent reasoning, high-complexity models such as Qwen-3~14B and GPT-4o achieve accurate temperature tracking, stable actuator usage, and coherent explanations aligned with physical principles. Incorporating a physics-based model significantly improves control smoothness and energy efficiency by enabling anticipatory decision-making. A detailed reasoning taxonomy further reveals a clear progression from causal misinterpretation in smaller models to cohesive and temporally aware reasoning in larger ones. The findings demonstrate that LLMs can act as interpretable controllers when sufficiently capable and appropriately grounded in domain knowledge, highlighting promising opportunities for hybrid model-based and language-driven control strategies that can provide plausible explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）作为动态热环境可解释控制器的能力，发现高复杂度模型（如Qwen-3~14B和GPT-4o）能实现精确的温度跟踪和稳定控制，而结合物理模型可显著提升控制平滑度和能效。
AI.motivation: LLMs在决策和推理任务中应用广泛，但作为物理系统控制器的潜力尚未被充分探索。本文旨在探究LLMs能否充当动态热环境的可解释控制器，并评估其在不同场景下的控制性能。
AI.method: 选取五种不同规模的LLMs，在多种场景下进行评估，包括设定点跟踪、自然语言指令解读、执行器效应推理以及有无物理模型辅助的情况。通过控制性能和推理质量两个维度进行系统分析，并构建推理分类法。
AI.result: 低/中规模模型常误解执行器动态或产生不一致推理；高复杂度模型（Qwen-3~14B, GPT-4o）实现了精确温度跟踪和稳定控制。引入物理模型显著提升控制平滑度和能效。推理分类法显示从小型模型的因果误解到大型模型的时间连贯推理的递进趋势。
AI.conclusion: 当具备足够能力和领域知识基础时，LLMs可以作为可解释控制器。这为混合模型驱动和语言驱动的控制策略提供了有前景的方向，能够提供合理的控制解释。

title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
summary: Reliable visual document understanding requires a model to attribute each answer to the evidence regions that support it. Recent benchmarks and systems express this step through a coordinate interface: the model outputs the coordinates of bounding boxes that mark the evidence regions in the document. Under this interface, vision-language models often fail to identify the right regions even when the answer is correct, a failure known as Attribution Hallucination. We present a study that investigates whether this failure is partially limited by what the model can express through coordinates. On a verified bilingual CiteVQA subset, we compare the coordinate interface with a language interface in which the model outputs only text, quoting its evidence verbatim, and a multimodal retriever returns the location of each quote as a page region proposed by a layout parser (tables and figures are quoted through their captions or notes); the comparison is repeated over six open vision-language models. Compared with the coordinate interface, evidence recall rises from at most 8 points to between 26 and 47 and the hallucination rate roughly halves, with little change in answer quality. Building on this comparison, we use the same quote-and-retrieve pipeline as a training scaffold: because region-level evidence labels are expensive to collect for long documents, we introduce a GRPO recipe whose reward is a judge's reading of the gold answer and crops of the retrieved regions, training the model to quote better evidence without any region labels and raising an 8B backbone's strict attributed accuracy from 22.4 to 33.8. These findings indicate a practical path to improve attribution"without a coordinate interface and without costly region-level supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉文档理解中的归因幻觉问题，发现使用坐标接口（输出边界框坐标）会导致模型即使答案正确也常定位错误区域。作者提出语言接口（输出文本引用证据，通过检索器定位），将证据召回率从最多8分提升至26-47分，幻觉率减半。并基于此设计了无需区域标注的GRPO训练方法，将严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉文档理解模型在坐标接口下即使答案正确也常无法定位正确证据区域（归因幻觉），作者怀疑这是坐标表达能力的限制所致。
AI.method: 1. 对比坐标接口与语言接口（引用-检索管线）：模型输出文本引用，多模态检索器通过布局解析器定位引用区域；2. 基于该管线设计GRPO训练框架：奖励函数基于金标准答案与检索区域的匹配度，无需区域级标注。
AI.result: 语言接口相比坐标接口：证据召回率从≤8分提升至26-47分，幻觉率减半，答案质量几乎不变。GRPO训练将8B模型的严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。
AI.conclusion: 语言接口比坐标接口更适合文档归因任务，且结合引用-检索管线可有效缓解归因幻觉，避免昂贵的区域级标注成本。

title: An empirical investigation into the properties of standard word embeddings
comment: African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) - South Africa, University of the Western Cape
summary:
The embedding of word sequences into continuous vector spaces has been one of the most important developments in Natural Language Processing in the recent past. Such embeddings have found application in areas such as Automatic Speech Recognition, Machine Translation, Sentiment Analysis and many more. This essay reviews the various mechanisms that have been proposed for the calculation of word embeddings, investigates popular toolkits and embedding matrices that are available in the public domain, and experiments with one or more selected implementations to better understand their characteristics.
  La représentation vectorielle continue de mots a été l'un des développements les plus importants dans le domaine du traitement automatique du langage naturel au cours des dernières années. Ces représentations ont trouvé application dans des domaines tels que la reconnaissance vocale, la traduction automatique, l'analyse des sentiments, etc. Ce travail passe en revue les différents mécanismes proposés pour le calcul de ces vecteurs de mots, étudie les kits d'outils populaires et les matrices disponibles publiquement en ligne, et expérimente avec une ou plusieurs implémentations sélectionnées pour mieux comprendre leurs caractéristiques.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了词嵌入（word embeddings）的各种计算机制、流行的工具包和公开可用的嵌入矩阵，并通过实验分析了所选实现的特征。
AI.motivation: 词序列的连续向量嵌入是NLP领域近年最重要的发展之一，广泛应用于语音识别、机器翻译、情感分析等任务，有必要系统综述其计算方法与特性。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，回顾了多种词嵌入计算机制，调研了公开可用的工具包和嵌入矩阵，并对选定的实现进行了实验分析。
AI.result: 系统梳理了词嵌入的不同计算机制，列出了流行的工具包和公开嵌入矩阵，并通过实验揭示了所选实现的关键特征。
AI.conclusion: 本文对词嵌入领域进行了全面回顾，为研究者提供了机制、工具和实验特征的综合参考。

title: ID-V2V: Identity-Preserving Video Restylization
summary: In visual storytelling, human performances are central to creative intent and narrative meaning. However, preserving human identity and performance while enabling flexible visual edits remains challenging for generative video models. We formalize this challenge as identity-preserving video restylization, which propagates scene, lighting, and style changes specified by an edited keyframe across a source video, while preserving facial likeness and performance, including expressions, eye gaze, and lip synchronization. A key obstacle is the absence of paired training data, as identity-preserving restylized video pairs are rare in real-world settings. To address this, we propose a decoupling of source-grounded identity preservation and edit-driven video synthesis. Our key insight is that facial appearance and expression should remain invariant, with illumination being the primary permissible variation. We therefore cast identity preservation as a video relighting problem, while modeling visual edit propagation as controlled video synthesis guided by the edited keyframe. Building on this formulation, we introduce ID-V2V, a video-to-video generative framework integrating complementary control signals: relit facial regions and facial normal maps tightly constrain facial likeness and performance, while edited keyframes and depth sequences enable flexible and temporally coherent generation. This design enables constructing training pairs from a single video, eliminating the need for scarce paired data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ID-V2V significantly outperforms existing methods in preserving facial likeness and fine-grained facial performance, supports both single- and multi-subject scenarios, and delivers high visual quality, highlighting its potential as a human-centric tool for real-world content production. The code is available at: https://github.com/Eyeline-Labs/ID-V2V.

AI.tldr: 提出ID-V2V框架，通过将身份保持问题分解为视频重光照（保持面部外观和表情不变）和编辑驱动的视频合成（通过关键帧和深度序列引导），实现了身份保持的视频重风格化，无需成对训练数据，在面部相似度和表演保持上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在视觉叙事中，人类表演是创意意图和叙事意义的核心，但现有生成式视频模型在实现灵活视觉编辑的同时，难以保持人类身份和表演（包括表情、视线和唇形同步）。主要障碍是缺乏成对训练数据。
AI.method: 提出解耦策略：将身份保持视为视频重光照问题（面部外观和表情不变，仅光照可变），将视觉编辑传播视为由编辑关键帧引导的受控视频合成。构建ID-V2V框架，集成重光照面部区域、面部法线图（约束面部相似度和表演）、编辑关键帧和深度序列（实现灵活时序一致生成），从而从单一视频构建训练对。
AI.result: 在面部相似度和细粒度面部表演保持上显著优于现有方法；支持单主体和多主体场景；生成高视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: ID-V2V作为以人为中心的工具，在真实世界内容生产中具有潜力，解决了身份保持视频重风格化的数据稀缺问题。

title: Finite-Time Analysis of the Natural Policy Gradient in Finite-Horizon Markov Decision Processes
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures (each with two subfigures), 1 table. Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC 2026)
summary: Natural Policy Gradient (NPG) is a well-established Reinforcement Learning algorithm that underlies widely used methods such as Trust Region Policy Optimization and Proximal Policy Optimization, both of which have demonstrated strong empirical success. In this paper, we study exact NPG in finite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with known dynamics and horizon-dependent transition kernels. We provide the first finite-time convergence guarantees for this algorithm in this setting, for which we consider both constant and increasing step size regimes. With a constant step size $η_t=η$, we prove that NPG converges sublinearly with a rate of $\mathcal{O}(H^{2}/t)$ after $t$ iterations, where $H$ is the horizon length. We also extend this constant step size analysis to linear MDPs in an exact population-projection oracle under a full support projection distribution, recovering the same sublinear rate as in the tabular setting. Furthermore, with increasing step sizes, we prove that this algorithm achieves a linear convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}\left(\left(1-\frac{1}{\vartheta_ρ}\right)^t\right)$ for a problem-dependent constant $\vartheta_ρ> 1$, and the horizon-only robust schedule of the form $η_t=η_0(H/(H-1))^t$ where $η_0>0$ and $H \geq 2$, attains this same geometric rate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限时域MDP中精确自然策略梯度(NPG)算法的收敛性，给出了常步长下的$\mathcal{O}(H^{2}/t)$次线性收敛率和递增步长下的线性收敛率，并扩展到线性MDP设定。
AI.motivation: 尽管NPG是TRPO、PPO等成功算法的理论基础，但其在有限时域MDP（含时变转移核）中的精确形式缺乏有限时间收敛保证，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 分别分析常步长和递增步长两种策略下的精确NPG算法收敛性；对线性MDP采用全支持投影分布下的精确population-projection oracle进行分析。
AI.result: 常步长下收敛率为$\mathcal{O}(H^{2}/t)$；线性MDP中同样可达该次线性率；递增步长下达到线性收敛率$\mathcal{O}((1-1/\vartheta_ρ)^t)$，且步长$\eta_t=\eta_0(H/(H-1))^t$可实现该几何速率。
AI.conclusion: 首次为有限时域MDP中精确NPG算法提供有限时间收敛保证，证明了步长策略对收敛速度的关键影响。

title: Tokengeist: Multi-Turn Attribution Tracing in Agentic Conversations
summary: When a language model produces a response in a multi-turn conversation, which tokens from prior turns shaped that answer, and how did those dependencies propagate across prior turns? Existing context attribution methods process the full context in a single pass, recovering surface-level dependencies but missing the layered, non-linear structure of real-world dialogues and multi-step reasoning tasks. We introduce multi-turn context attribution (MTCA): given a target span in a model response, the task of tracing attribution backward across turns to identify not only which prior turns were directly relevant, but also how those turns themselves depended on earlier context. We propose Tokengeist, an attribution-method-agnostic and scalable framework that recovers full dependency paths by casting attribution as a recursive traversal of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) over conversation turns. We will release MTCABench, a benchmark of 3,845 target spans across 665 multi-turn conversations, annotated with gold provenance graphs reaching depths of up to 14, across four dependency types. Across four open-weight models, flat attribution methods fail to recover multi-hop dependencies, achieving under 20% source recall, while Tokengeist reaches 90%. Our results reveal systematic failure modes of single-pass attribution -- which we term provenance collapse -- and motivate attribution methods that reason recursively across turns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多轮对话中的归因任务（MTCA），并设计Tokengeist框架，通过递归遍历有向无环图来追溯跨轮次的依赖路径。在MTCABench基准上，Tokengeist达到90%的源召回率，远超单次归因方法的20%以下，揭示了“归因崩塌”问题。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文归因方法仅单次处理全部上下文，只能捕捉表层依赖关系，无法处理多轮对话和复杂推理任务中层叠、非线性的依赖结构。
AI.method: 提出Tokengeist，一种与归因方法无关的可扩展框架，将归因转化为对对话轮次有向无环图（DAG）的递归遍历，逐层回溯依赖路径。
AI.result: 在4个开源模型上，单次归因方法源召回率低于20%，而Tokengeist达到90%。并发布包含3,845个目标片段、665个多轮对话的MTCABench基准。
AI.conclusion: 单次归因存在系统性失败模式（归因崩塌），需要跨轮次递归推理的归因方法。

title: Formally Verified Synthesizable Floating-Point Data Types in ARCH HDL
summary: We report the design and end-to-end verification of first-class IEEE-754 binary32 (FP32) and bfloat16 (BF16) arithmetic for ARCH, a hardware description language intended to be generated by language models. Every operator - comparisons, conversions, add, sub, mul, and fused multiply-add (FMA) - is described once against a single bit-vector IR and rendered three ways from one source: synthesizable SystemVerilog, an SMT-LIB model, and a Lean 4 proof model. The three artifacts cannot drift apart structurally, and the residual per-node printer correspondence is machine-checked: a Yosys-to-SMT miter proves the emitted SystemVerilog equivalent to the SMT model for all 24 operators. Verification splits at the solver-tractability frontier: multiplier-free operators (comparisons, add/sub over all 2^64 inputs, conversions, and all binary BF16 arithmetic) are proved exhaustively equivalent to the SMT-LIB FloatingPoint theory; the SAT-hard multiplier-bearing operators (FP32 mul and FMA) are proved correctly rounded in Lean, sorry-free, against a value-level round-to-nearest-even specification over exact dyadic values. Physical characterization exposed the FMA as the timing outlier: its exact-wide 470-bit datapath does not pipeline in our flow. We reimplemented it as a bounded 98-bit guard/round/sticky datapath that pipelines to 268 MHz on Nangate45, and proved, in Lean and over all 2^96 inputs, that it is bit-identical to the exact-wide reference, so it inherits the reference's proven correct rounding. The equivalence is tractable precisely because the shared multiplier appears on both sides and cancels: neither a SAT solver nor the proof ever solves a multiplier equivalence. (The BF16 FMA is deliberately an FP32-accumulating fusion, characterized as exactly that.) All machine-checked claims are pinned to a tagged open-source release.

AI.tldr: 本文在ARCH硬件描述语言中实现了IEEE-754 FP32/BF16算术单元，通过单一源码同时生成SystemVerilog、SMT-LIB和Lean 4证明模型，三者结构一致且可机器验证。无乘法器操作符（如比较、加减法）通过SMT穷举验证所有输入；FP32乘法和FMA在Lean中证明正确舍入。FMA通过98-bit保护位/舍入位/粘滞位数据路径实现流水线化至268 MHz，并经Lean证明与精确宽参考位一致。
AI.motivation: 解决硬件描述语言（特别是面向LLM生成的ARCH）中浮点算术单元的设计正确性问题，确保从同一源码生成的多种表征（综合代码、形式化模型、定理证明模型）之间不会结构漂移，且正确性可机器验证。
AI.method: 单一bit-vector IR描述所有操作符，三路渲染（SystemVerilog、SMT-LIB、Lean 4）；Yosys-to-SMT miter验证Verilog与SMT模型的等价性；无乘法器操作符通过SMT穷举验证；乘法器操作符在Lean中证明正确舍入；FMA采用98-bit guard/round/sticky数据路径优化流水线，利用乘法器对称性消去来简化等价性证明。
AI.result: 所有24个操作符的SystemVerilog与SMT模型等价性通过Yosys-to-SMT miter验证；无乘法器操作符（包括所有2^64输入的加减法、转换、所有BF16运算）穷举等价于SMT-LIB FloatingPoint理论；FP32乘法和FMA在Lean中无sorry证明正确舍入；FMA在Nangate45上流水线至268 MHz；98-bit路径与精确宽路径在所有2^96输入上经Lean证明位一致。
AI.conclusion: 成功实现了首个端到端机器验证的IEEE-754 FP32/BF16硬件算术单元设计，展示了在硬件设计中结合穷举验证、SMT求解和定理证明的分层验证策略的可行性，且所有声明均已标记开源发布。

title: Gaze-Anchored Social Net: Decoding Implicit Relations via Joint Modeling
comment: Accepted by ICPR(The International Conference on Pattern Recognition), Eye Tracking Techniques, Applications and Challenges (ETTAC 2026)
summary: Human gaze does more than point to visual targets; it serves as a subtle indicator of social intent within static images, whereas standard models typically process individuals independently, treating gaze as an i.i.d. quantity or predicting social semantics in isolation. Recent multi-person methods attempt to address this but often treat social relations as rigid, post-hoc classifications decoupled from the gaze estimation process. This oversimplification fails to capture the nuanced nature of social intent, which acts as an underlying driver of gaze behavior rather than a secondary categorical output. We address these limitations by proposing ANCHOR, a target-centric paradigm designed to decode gaze-anchored social intent by modeling the joint distribution of visual attention and latent implicit relations. Our approach surfaces these dependencies as the latent structural scaffolding of gaze behavior. The architecture utilizes a relational attention mechanism to capture fine-grained interpersonal links, leveraging feature-wise modulation for efficient multi-person parsing from a single vision backbone. To stabilize the training of this coupled formulation, we implement an optimization synergy to resolve the inherent conflicts between spatial gaze accuracy and latent social reasoning. This approach ensures robust generalization by seeking stable, flat minima while simultaneously harmonizing competing task gradients. We validate our framework on an extended benchmark featuring dense multi-person annotations and novel social influence rankings. Our results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and provide the first quantitative evidence that implicit social hierarchies can be robustly disentangled and learned directly from static gaze patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出ANCHOR框架，通过目标中心范式联合建模注视行为与潜在社会意图，在静态图像中实现隐式社会层级的可学习解码，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将社会关系视为与注视估计解耦的刚性后验分类，忽略了社会意图作为驱动注视行为的潜在因素这一本质。
AI.method: 提出目标中心范式ANCHOR：1）关系注意力机制捕捉细粒度人际链接；2）特征级调制实现单骨干网络的多人体解析；3）优化协同策略协调空间注视精度与潜在社会推理之间的冲突。
AI.result: 在密集多人体标注扩展基准上达到SOTA性能，首次定量证明隐式社会层级可直接从静态注视模式中稳健解耦和学习。
AI.conclusion: 注视行为中蕴含的社会意图是可学习的潜在结构，通过联合建模可有效解码隐式社会关系。

title: Label-free Industrial Fault Detection via Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning: A System for Run-to-Failure Prognostics
summary: Machinery fault detection (MFD) remains heavily reliant on supervised learning, which struggles with the scarcity of fault labels in real-world settings. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers a framework to model the sequential nature of degradation, current ``RL-based'' MFD methods reduce the problem to a static contextual bandit (CB) formulation: by ignoring state transitions and discarding the temporal discount factor, they collapse to standard supervised classification. We propose an adversarial inverse reinforcement learning (AIRL) framework that treats MFD as an offline IRL problem. Unlike reconstruction-based approaches that rely on static error margins, or CBs that ignore dynamics, our method recovers an intrinsic "health" reward directly from observational state transitions, requiring neither manual reward engineering nor fault labels. On three run-to-failure benchmarks (HUMS2023, IMS, XJTU-SY), AIRL is the only method achieving non-saturated post-detection consistency across all datasets, while CB baselines fail to detect gradual degradation and reconstruction models collapse into always-anomalous states. Code and data: https://github.com/dhirajneupane/AIRL-MFD-DN.

AI.tldr: 提出对抗逆强化学习框架(AIRL)解决机械故障检测中标签稀缺问题，通过从状态转换中恢复内在"健康"奖励，无需人工设计奖励或故障标签，在三个基准数据集上优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 监督学习依赖故障标签且难以获取，现有"基于RL"的MFD方法实际上退化为静态上下文赌博机（忽略状态转移和时间折扣因子），无法捕捉退化过程的时序特性。
AI.method: 采用离线逆强化学习框架，通过对抗训练从观测到的状态转移中学习内在奖励函数（健康程度），避免手动设计奖励函数和依赖标签。
AI.result: 在HUMS2023、IMS、XJTU-SY三个全生命周期数据集上，AIRL是唯一在所有数据集上实现非饱和检测后一致性的方法；CB基线无法检测渐进退化，重建模型陷入"始终异常"状态。
AI.conclusion: AIRL框架有效解决了无标签下的时序退化检测问题，恢复了真正意义上的强化学习机制，而非退化为分类问题。

title: Decentralized Granular Access Control for Agentic AI Systems in Critical Infrastructure
summary: The deployment of autonomous AI agents in production infrastructure introduces fundamental security challenges that traditional role-based access control (RBAC) models cannot address. Unlike deterministic automation, AI agents exhibit stochastic behavior, making conventional trust models insufficient for governing their access to critical systems. This paper presents a decentralized, multi-layered access control architecture designed specifically for agentic AI systems operating in critical cloud infrastructure. Our framework introduces four key innovations: (1) a compound identity model that binds agent actions to delegated human authority, (2) a hierarchical permission system spanning five granularity levels from global platform access to per-parameter constraints, (3) a decentralized policy ownership model where tool teams independently govern their authorization boundaries, and (4) progressive trust escalation with safety interlocks that prevent autonomous agents from executing high-risk operations. We ground our design in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) threat taxonomy and demonstrate how each architectural decision mitigates specific attack vectors. Deployed in production at a major cloud provider managing network infrastructure across hundreds of datacenters, the system enforces granular access control for 20+ specialized AI agents and 60+ deterministic playbooks processing thousands of operations daily while maintaining zero unauthorized write operations over eight months of production deployment. We present empirical data on access pattern distributions, denial rates, and the effectiveness of layered authorization in preventing privilege escalation by non-deterministic actors.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向AI智能体的去中心化多层访问控制架构，包含复合身份模型、五级权限系统、去中心化策略所有权和渐进式信任升级，在主要云厂商生产环境中实现零未授权写入操作。
AI.motivation: 传统基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）模型无法应对AI智能体随机行为带来的安全挑战，需要设计新的信任模型来约束智能体对关键系统的访问。
AI.method: 提出了四种创新设计：1) 将智能体行为与人类授权绑定的复合身份模型；2) 从全局平台到单参数约束的五层粒度权限系统；3) 工具团队独立管理授权边界的去中心化策略模型；4) 防止自主智能体执行高风险操作的渐进式信任升级与安全互锁机制。
AI.result: 在数百个数据中心的云生产环境中部署，管理20+专用AI智能体与60+确定性playbook，日处理数千次操作，八个月内实现零未授权写入操作。
AI.conclusion: 该多层架构能有效解决AI智能体在关键基础设施中的非确定性行为带来的安全风险，为智能体系统在严监管环境下的部署提供了可行的安全治理方案。

title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs
summary: As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents Zhijing, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, and 71 task paradigms. It controls question format, narrative perspective, and context length across 284 shared scenarios and 3,481 expert-verified instances. Evaluation of 20 representative LLMs reveals substantial headroom: the best model achieves only 72.08% overall accuracy, and none of the 17 secondary dimensions reaches the 90% near-ceiling band. For internalization, we develop Zing, a diagnosis-driven training recipe combining supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Across five social-cognition benchmarks, Zing consistently outperforms its base models, with Zing-27B-Stage2 achieving the best average score and Zing-32B-Stage2 remaining competitive with DeepSeek-V4-Pro. For deployment-time grounding, we build Actio, a harness-controlled inference architecture that routes four typed supports into reasoning: PRISM for procedural guidance, Starling for runtime mental-state representation, SAGE for reusable experience, and gated RAG for external social and normative knowledge. Across five base models and three benchmarks, the full harness improves 14 of 15 model-benchmark pairs and is best or tied for best in 8, demonstrating the effectiveness of typed runtime support. Together, these results show that socially intelligent LLMs require coordinated advances in evaluation, parametric internalization, and deployment-time grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向大语言模型的社交智能综合框架Zhijing，包含三个核心组件：SoMBench（基于心理学的社交智能评测基准）、Zing（诊断驱动的训练方法）和Actio（部署阶段的推理架构）。实验表明当前LLM在社交智能上仍有较大提升空间，而该框架在评估、内部化和落地三个方面均取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正从孤立任务求解转向长期服务人类环境，需要具备社交智能（推断心理状态、追踪社会关系、规范推理和情境适应行为），但当前缺乏系统的测量、内化和落地方法。
AI.method: 提出了三部分框架：1) SoMBench评测基准：3个主维度、17个子维度、71个任务范式，涵盖284个共享场景和3,481个专家验证实例；2) Zing训练方法：结合监督微调、on-policy蒸馏和基于rubric的强化学习；3) Actio推理架构：四种类型化支持（PRISM程序性指导、Starling运行时心理状态表示、SAGE可复用经验、gated RAG外部知识）。
AI.result: 20个代表性LLM评测中，最佳模型仅达72.08%准确率，17个子维度均未达到90%天花板；Zing-27B-Stage2在多个社交认知基准上取得最佳平均分；Actio在5个基础模型和3个基准上改善了14/15个模型-基准对。
AI.conclusion: 社交智能LLM需要在评测、参数内部化和部署时接地三个方面协同推进，该框架在这三个方面均展现了有效性。

title: Robustifying pathology foundation models via fine-tuning
summary: Pathology foundation models (FMs) produce powerful tile-level representations which remain sensitive to scanner and staining variability, undermining deployment across laboratories. We develop a novel fine-tuning recipe that improves the robustness of pathology FMs to acquisition factors. Applied to ten different FMs, our fine-tuning strategy consistently improves robustness for every model as well as downstream performance, with no observed trade-off. On average, it raises the PathoROB robustness index by 23% (from 0.72 to 0.87) and increases the overall cross-benchmark performance by 43% on Patho-Bench, HEST and THUNDER combined, with individual gains reaching up to 72% in robustness (Phikon-v2) and 76% in performance (Midnight-12k). We publicly release the fine-tuned versions of Phikon-v2 (Phaet) and Midnight-12k (Mascaret) at https://huggingface.co/wearewaiv/models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型微调策略，能提升病理学基础模型对扫描仪和染色变异的鲁棒性，在10个模型上平均将鲁棒性指标提升23%、跨基准性能提升43%，且无性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型对扫描仪和染色差异敏感，这限制了其在不同实验室间的部署和应用。
AI.method: 开发了一种新型微调策略，应用于10种不同的病理基础模型，以增强其对获取因素的鲁棒性。
AI.result: PathoROB鲁棒性指标平均提升23%（从0.72到0.87），跨基准性能平均提升43%（Patho-Bench、HEST和THUNDER），Phikon-v2鲁棒性提升达72%，Midnight-12k性能提升达76%。
AI.conclusion: 该微调策略能一致提升所有模型的鲁棒性和下游性能，且无性能权衡，并公开了微调后的模型Phaet和Mascaret。

title: Recycling computational processes of dynamic programming for combinatorial optimization problems: a reservoir computing approach
summary: Reusing previously computed results is a long-standing principle for reducing computational cost, but such reuse has largely been confined to a single problem's computation. Sharing computational processes across multiple simultaneously solved problems remains possible in principle, yet designing algorithms that exploit nontrivial cross-task relationships is difficult to do manually. Here, we use machine learning to discover such algorithms automatically. Specifically, based on reservoir computing, we propose a method that uses computation results recorded by dynamic programming for combinatorial optimization problems as features for linear regression, leveraging them to assist other combinatorial optimization computations. We validate the approach on the traveling salesman and subset sum problems. Multiplexing the dynamic programming process improves approximation accuracy over generic features and reduces computation time compared with independent solutions. These results suggest a new form of computation, distinct from conventional computational design, in which multiple processes efficiently share and recycle intermediate results and states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的方法，利用动态规划计算的结果作为特征，通过线性回归辅助解决多个组合优化问题，实现了计算过程的跨任务共享与复用，并在旅行商问题和子集和问题上验证了该方法在近似精度和计算效率上的优势。
AI.motivation: 传统计算复用局限于单一问题，而跨任务共享计算过程虽在理论上可行，但手动设计能利用跨任务关系的算法非常困难。因此，作者希望用机器学习自动发现这类算法。
AI.method: 基于储层计算（reservoir computing）思想，将动态规划求解组合优化问题过程中产生的中间结果作为特征，通过线性回归来辅助其他组合优化问题的计算，实现计算过程的复用。
AI.result: 在旅行商问题和子集和问题上：1）复用动态规划过程相比通用特征提高了近似精度；2）相比独立求解显著减少了计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提出了一种新的计算范式——多个计算过程可以高效地共享和回收中间结果与状态，与传统的独立计算设计有本质区别。

title: DynaResize: Runtime GPU Reallocation for Disaggregated LLM Post-Training
summary: RL-based LLM post-training increasingly disaggregates Rollout and Training across separate GPU resources, but static GPU partitioning suffers from severe pipeline bubbles under long-tail rollout latency. We present DynaResize, a runtime GPU reallocation system that dynamically switches GPUs between Rollout and Training to balance stage execution times without changing RL semantics. DynaResize decomposes resizing into fine-grained operations and removes non-startup-critical work from the critical path through communicator reuse, bounded state staging, and hysteresis-based resizing. Experimental results show that DynaResize can improve end-to-end throughput by 66.5% and reduce total execution time by 33% over the optimal static configuration, while hiding 27% of role-switching overhead.

AI.tldr: DynaResize是一个动态GPU重分配系统，通过在RL训练和推理阶段之间灵活切换GPU资源，解决了静态分区带来的流水线气泡问题，提升吞吐量66.5%，缩短执行时间33%。
AI.motivation: 基于RL的LLM后训练中，Rollout和Training使用不同GPU资源，但静态GPU分区在长尾延迟下会产生严重的流水线气泡，导致资源利用率低下。
AI.method: 将GPU重分配分解为细粒度操作，通过通信器复用、有界状态暂存和基于滞后的重分配策略，将非启动关键工作移出关键路径。
AI.result: 相比于最优静态配置，端到端吞吐量提升66.5%，总执行时间减少33%，角色切换开销隐藏27%。
AI.conclusion: DynaResize能有效缓解静态分区的气泡问题，在不改变RL语义的前提下动态平衡阶段执行时间，显著提升训练效率。

title: How Context Attribution Handles What the Model Already Knows
summary: Context attribution methods for large language models (LLMs) identify which input context contributes to the model response. Recent works show the initial success in attributing the con- tributive score of the contexts. However, we observe that when the context overlaps with the training data, these methods can- not disentangle in-context from in-weight (IW) contributions, producing unreliable scores. Based on this observation, in this work, we introduce: 1) an evaluation protocol that relies on four new metrics (base-model context attribution score (BCS), cross-model context attribution consistency (CAC), attribution preservation score (APS), source separation pre- cision (SSP)) and 2) a benchmark dataset (WMDP-Cyber++) with ground-truth provenance labels to systematically assess attribution under IW overlap. In our experiments across four well-known context attribution methods, we demonstrate that they provide unfaithful attribution when the knowledge from the context also exists in the weights. Finally, we adapt these methods for source separation (IW vs. in-context learning (ICL)) and show that they cannot do the disentanglement based on the contributive score

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM上下文归因方法在上下文与训练数据重叠时无法区分上下文贡献和权重贡献，提出了包含四个新指标（BCS, CAC, APS, SSP）的评估协议和WMDP-Cyber++基准数据集，实验证明现有方法在知识重叠场景下给出不可靠归因，且无法基于贡献分数进行源分离。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文归因方法在上下文与训练数据存在知识重叠时，无法区分in-context贡献和in-weight贡献，导致归因分数不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 提出包含BCS、CAC、APS、SSP四个新指标的评估协议；2) 构建WMDP-Cyber++基准数据集，包含真实来源标签；3) 在四种主流归因方法上实验验证；4) 尝试将这些方法用于源分离。
AI.result: 实验表明现有归因方法在上下文知识也存在于权重中时会给出不忠实的归因，且无法基于贡献分数有效区分IW和ICL贡献。
AI.conclusion: 现有上下文归因方法在处理知识重叠场景时存在根本性缺陷，需要新的方法来实现可靠的源分离归因。

title: Spatial-IQ: Deconstructing Spatial Intelligence via Hierarchical Capability Tests
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at visual interpretation but fail on spatial reasoning tasks that humans solve reliably. Existing benchmarks evaluate these models as black boxes, limiting their ability to identify the underlying causes of lower performance: when a model fails a spatial reasoning task, it remains difficult to ascertain whether the hurdle is perceptual, such as recognizing object boundaries, or cognitive, such as reasoning about occlusion to infer hidden geometry. We introduce Spatial-IQ, a hierarchical diagnostic framework that decomposes object counting in stacked 3D structures into 9 perceptual and cognitive sub-tasks organized by the developmental stages of human spatial cognition, with mental rotation as an additional target probe. Using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, we procedurally generated a diverse dataset of roughly 80,000 stacked 3D structures with per-task ground truth. We evaluate models across three output formats (free-response text, multiple-choice images, and image editing) alongside a human baseline. The Spatial-IQ framework shows that top-performing models often succeed at the target task (object counting) without succeeding on the lower-level sub-tasks intended to support it, and that models differ in how much of these hierarchical chains they preserve, often revealing shortcut behavior that raw target-task accuracy alone would obscure. Finally, we demonstrate that training models with chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision over our hierarchical sub-tasks, combined with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, significantly improves both spatial consistency across sub-tasks and target-task accuracy, supporting the value of the proposed decomposition as both a diagnostic tool and a training signal.

AI.tldr: 提出Spatial-IQ诊断框架，将3D堆叠结构中的物体计数任务分解为9个感知与认知子任务，发现顶级MLLM在子任务上存在捷径行为，结合层次化CoT监督与强化学习可显著提升空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在空间推理任务上表现不佳，且现有基准将模型视为黑盒，无法区分失败原因是感知问题（如识别物体边界）还是认知问题（如推理遮挡关系）。
AI.method: 提出Spatial-IQ层次化诊断框架，将堆叠3D结构中的物体计数分解为9个感知和认知子任务（按人类空间认知发展阶段组织），使用NVIDIA Isaac Sim生成约8万张带真实标注的数据集，评估三种输出格式（自由文本、多选图像、图像编辑），并结合CoT监督与强化学习进行训练。
AI.result: 顶级模型在目标任务（物体计数）上表现良好，但在底层子任务上并未成功，存在捷径行为；不同模型保留层次化推理链的程度不同；结合层次化CoT监督与可验证奖励的强化学习显著提升了子任务的空间一致性和目标任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的层次化分解既可作为诊断工具识别模型缺陷，也可作为训练信号提升空间推理能力。

title: Mini-batch Noise Lowers Sharpness via Dominant-Subspace Fluctuations
summary: During SGD training, the gradients often align strongly with the dominant subspace spanned by the top-$k$ eigenvectors of the Hessian of the loss. While this seems to naturally imply that loss reduction mainly occurs within this space, prior work has shown that updates within this dominant subspace make no meaningful progress in reducing the loss. In this work, we argue that the dominant subspace is better understood not as the main space for loss reduction, but as a key subspace for explaining the sharpness dynamics of mini-batch SGD. To explain the role of the dominant subspace in reducing top-$k$ sharpness, we show how the averaged gradient over fluctuations in the dominant directions produces a sharpness correction term, and derive a sharpness correction term induced by mini-batch noise in the dominant directions. Experimental results show that adding the derived correction term to GD brings the sharpness evolution of GD closer to that of SGD.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了SGD训练中梯度与Hessian矩阵主导特征子空间的对齐现象，指出该子空间并非主要损失降低空间，而是解释mini-batch SGD锐度动力学（sharpness dynamics）的关键。作者推导了由小批量噪声引起的锐度修正项，实验证明将该修正项加入GD可使其锐度演化更接近SGD。
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现梯度与Hessian主导子空间对齐，但该子空间内的更新对损失降低无实质贡献，这一矛盾需要解释。本文旨在揭示主导子空间在SGD训练中的真正作用。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，展示了主导方向上的梯度波动平均会产生锐度修正项（sharpness correction term），并推导了由mini-batch噪声诱导的修正项形式；通过实验验证将修正项加入GD后锐度演化与SGD的一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，在GD中加入推导的锐度修正项后，其锐度演化曲线与SGD更为接近，验证了理论分析的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 主导特征子空间的主要作用是解释SGD的锐度动力学（sharpness dynamics），而非损失降低；通过锐度修正项可以桥接GD与SGD在锐度演化上的差异。

title: Opti-Q: A Constraint-Based Optimization Framework for Multi-LLM Question Planning
summary: While large language models (LLMs) enable strong question answering (QA), budgeted deployment is complicated by nondeterminism and heterogeneous resource profiles (cost, latency, and energy). We present OPTI-Q, a database-inspired, cost-based optimizer that implements a plan-before-execute paradigm for multi-LLM orchestration. OPTI-Q models LLM invocations as physical operators in an execution DAG and, for each question, searches for plans that optimize answer quality (QoA) while trading off financial cost, latency, and energy under user-specified resource constraints. Plans can include sequential operators that pass intermediate answers as context and parallel/blend operators that run models concurrently and merge their outputs. To search this space without executing each candidate plan, OPTI-Q uses PERFDB, a statistics catalog populated and refreshed from benchmarks and execution traces, to estimate the QoA and resource costs of both individual operators and composed subplans. Using these estimates, OPTI-Q performs Pareto-frontier search and selects a final plan based on user preferences. On MMLU-Pro and SimpleQA under user-specified budgets, OPTI-Q improves average QoA by ~58% and ~41% over baselines at comparable cost, demonstrating that database-style planning yields better quality-resource trade-offs for multi-LLM QA.

AI.tldr: OPTI-Q 是一个受数据库启发的成本优化器，通过在多个LLM之间执行计划-执行范式，在预算约束下优化问答质量与资源消耗的权衡，在MMLU-Pro和SimpleQA上分别提升约58%和41%的QA质量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在问答任务中表现出色，但实际部署时面临非确定性和异构资源消耗（成本、延迟、能耗）的挑战，缺乏在预算约束下高效编排多LLM的方案。
AI.method: 提出OPTI-Q，将LLM调用建模为执行DAG中的物理算子，通过PERFDB统计目录估计质量与资源消耗，进行帕累托前沿搜索，根据用户偏好选择最优执行计划。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro和SimpleQA数据集上，与基线相比，OPTI-Q在相近成本下分别提升约58%和41%的平均问答质量。
AI.conclusion: 数据库风格的规划方法能够在多LLM问答场景中实现更好的质量-资源权衡，验证了将数据库优化技术引入LLM编排的有效性。

title: AdaKAN: A dual-branch adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold network for medical image segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation is a fundamental task in computer-aided diagnosis, yet it remains challenging due to the complexity of anatomical structures and the variability across imaging modalities. In this paper, we propose AdaKAN, an Adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) that synergistically integrates convolutional operations with a novel efficient KAN (EffiKAN) block, comprised of an efficient attention mechanism and an adaptive KAN (AdaptKAN) module. This module features a dual-branch design: one branch employs a KAN layer with Bernstein polynomial activations for globally smooth and stable function approximation, while the other branch performs channel-wise refinement through projection operations and adaptive scaling. AdaKAN adopts a U-shaped architecture that effectively captures both long-range dependencies and fine-grained local features, overcoming the limitations of conventional convolutional and Transformer-based segmentation models. Skip connections are employed to preserve spatial details during encoding and facilitate accurate reconstruction during decoding. Extensive experiments conducted on diverse medical imaging datasets demonstrate that AdaKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in segmentation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaKAN，一种自适应KAN网络，通过融合卷积操作和高效KAN块（包含注意力机制与双分支AdaptKAN模块），在U形架构下实现医学图像分割，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割因解剖结构复杂性和成像模态多样性而具有挑战性，传统卷积和Transformer模型存在长程依赖与局部特征捕捉的局限性。
AI.method: 提出AdaKAN，采用U形架构，融合卷积与EffiKAN块；EffiKAN包含高效注意力机制和双分支AdaptKAN模块（一支用Bernstein多项式激活的KAN层进行全局平滑逼近，另一支通过投影和自适应缩放进行通道级精炼）；跳跃连接保留空间细节。
AI.result: 在多个医学影像数据集上的大量实验表明，AdaKAN在分割准确性上达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: AdaKAN有效克服了传统卷积和Transformer分割模型的局限性，在医学图像分割任务中表现出色。

title: All in One: Generative Modeling as Mean-Field Game Design
summary: Mean-field games (MFGs) offer a unifying lens on continuous-time generative modeling: a cost tuple recovering twelve prominent models---Continuous Normalizing Flows, OT-Flow, Score-based Models, Schrödinger Bridges, and more---as special cases of one variational problem. Yet two dimensions of this space remain entirely unexplored: the interaction term $\mathcal{I}$ is set to zero in many existing models, and the rich family of MFG solvers has never been applied to generative modeling. We address both gaps with MFGLab an open-source PyTorch library whose primary API is the cost tuple: all twelve models are specified by four composable cost functions, and the training loop, log-Jacobian, and reverse-ODE sampler are shared automatically. We additionally propose DI-Flow, a novel cost design that uses a differentiable entropy functional to encourage mode coverage, and provide learning-based MFG solvers that substantially outperform neural training on stochastic-dynamics rows. Experiments on two 2-D benchmarks confirm that the unified API is lossless relative to hand-coded implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFGLab库，通过均值场博弈统一了12种连续时间生成模型，并引入DI-Flow新方法和学习型MFG求解器。
AI.motivation: 现有连续时间生成模型虽多，但缺乏统一框架；交互项$\mathcal{I}$在多数模型中未使用，且MFG求解器未被应用于生成建模。
AI.method: 提出MFGLab（基于PyTorch的开源库），以成本元组作为统一API；提出DI-Flow，使用可微熵函数促进模式覆盖；引入学习型MFG求解器。
AI.result: 统一API在2D基准测试中无损复现了手写实现的结果；学习型MFG求解器在随机动力学任务上显著优于神经训练。
AI.conclusion: MFG框架能有效统一多种生成模型，DI-Flow和MFG求解器拓展了该领域的新方向。

title: CHS-SQL: A Text-to-SQL approach based on Confidence-Guided Heuristic Search Schema Linking process
summary: Recently, there have been several works in the Text-to-SQL domain that utilize Small Language Models (SLMs) for training. These approaches achieve performance close to that of large models in generating SQL, using only the computational power of a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, while also ensuring data security. Most existing methods filter out redundant tables and columns during Schema Linking to improve Text-to-SQL accuracy. However, they do not consider the precision-recall trade-off when selecting the candidate schema subset. Our research found that both the precision and recall of Schema Linking directly affect the final SQL accuracy. Therefore, we propose a novel framework for efficiently fine-tuning SLMs on Text-to-SQL tasks, CHS-SQL, that not only balances precision and recall but also improves overall performance on Text-to-SQL tasks. Its main innovation lies in the Schema Linking phase, where a heuristic search combined with model internal confidence is employed to achieve an optimal precision-recall trade-off. This elaborated mechanism maximizes the precision of relevant schema candidates for the generated SQL queries while suppressing irrelevant noise. The same strategy is further applied during SQL generation to refine candidate queries while helping the SLM to avoid trapping in a local optimum. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on Text-to-SQL tasks via SLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出CHS-SQL框架，通过在Schema Linking阶段使用启发式搜索结合模型内部置信度来平衡精确率与召回率，从而提升小型语言模型在Text-to-SQL任务上的性能，并取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在Schema Linking时未考虑精确率与召回率的权衡问题，而研究发现两者直接影响SQL生成质量，因此需要一种能平衡二者并提升整体性能的方法。
AI.method: 提出CHS-SQL框架：在Schema Linking阶段采用启发式搜索结合模型内部置信度，实现精确率与召回率的最优权衡；该策略还应用于SQL生成阶段，帮助SLM避免陷入局部最优。
AI.result: 在Text-to-SQL任务上使用SLM取得了最优（SOTA）结果，仅需单张RTX 4090即可训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过平衡Schema Linking的精确率和召回率，可以显著提升SLM在Text-to-SQL任务上的表现，CHS-SQL是一种高效且实用的解决方案。

title: Indic DiarBench: A Multilingual Joint Diarization and ASR Benchmark for Indian Languages
summary: In this work, we introduce Indic DiarBench, a speaker diarization and ASR benchmark dataset spanning all 22 scheduled languages of India. This corpus comprises approximately 108 hours of natural multi-speaker audio from near-field meetings, far-field recordings, and in-the-wild audios. All annotations are human-corrected with time-aligned speaker attributed transcriptions. The dataset captures conversational nuance prevalent in Indian speech, such as English code-mixing, dialectal variation, and frequent speaker overlap. To establish a baseline for joint ASR and diarization capabilities we evaluate leading systems including commercial speech APIs and multimodal large language models. Indic DiarBench is released as an open-access resource to advance inclusive, multilingual speech technology research for Indian languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Indic DiarBench，一个涵盖印度22种语言的说话人日记化与ASR基准数据集，约108小时多说话人音频，含人工校正标注，并评估了主流系统性能。
AI.motivation: 印度语言种类繁多（22种官方语言），现有说话人日记化和ASR数据集在多语言、多方言、英语混码、说话人重叠等印度语言特有场景下严重不足，缺乏公开基准。
AI.method: 构建了108小时的多说话人音频数据集，覆盖近场会议、远场录音和野采音频三类场景；所有标注经过人工校正，包含时间对齐的说话人归属转录；评估了商业语音API和多模态大语言模型。
AI.result: 建立了联合ASR与说话人日记化能力的基线结果，展示了商业系统在印度语言多说话人场景下的表现。
AI.conclusion: Indic DiarBench作为开放资源发布，旨在推动包容性、多语言的印度语言语音技术研究。

title: Small-Pollinator Detection in Cluttered Field Video
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Code, experiment notebooks, and implementation details: https://github.com/OnurOnal7/buzzspot-pollinator-detection
summary: Detecting pollinators in field video is challenging: targets are small, visually similar, and observed against cluttered vegetation under blur and occlusion. We present a systematic empirical study of small-pollinator detection under a practical single-GPU compute budget. Using the BuzzSpot challenge dataset, we compare YOLO and RF-DETR models across input resolutions and evaluate sliced inference, class-gated fusion, size-routed ensembling, and post-hoc temporal processing. RF-DETR Large at 1344-pixel resolution achieved our best hidden-test result, reaching 0.405 mAP50:95 and outperforming the 1120-pixel model (0.379) and the best single-model YOLO26m baseline (0.366). The strongest gains came from adopting RF-DETR and increasing its input resolution, indicating that detector choice and input resolution were more effective levers than added inference-time complexity; the resolution gain was strongest for small objects and the rarer bumblebee and moth classes. Sliced-inference fusion, size-routed ensembling, and warm-started 1536-pixel continuation did not surpass this result, while post-hoc temporal processing did not improve the leaked diagnostic evaluation. Error analysis identified bee-hoverfly discrimination as the clearest remaining bottleneck: neighboring frames rarely supplied correctly classified hoverfly evidence for post-hoc correction. These findings motivate learned feature-level temporal aggregation before the final classification decision.

AI.tldr: 系统比较了YOLO和RF-DETR在小目标传粉昆虫检测任务中的表现，发现RF-DETR Large（1344像素）达到最佳mAP50:95（0.405），检测器选择和输入分辨率比增加推理复杂度更有效，错误分析揭示蜜蜂-食蚜蝇判别是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 野外视频中传粉昆虫检测面临目标小、视觉相似、背景杂乱、模糊和遮挡等挑战，现有方法在GPU计算预算有限的情况下，缺乏对小目标检测器选择和输入分辨率影响的系统研究。
AI.method: 使用BuzzSpot挑战数据集，对比YOLO和RF-DETR模型在不同输入分辨率下的性能，评估切片推理融合、类别门控融合、尺寸路由集成和事后时间处理策略。
AI.result: RF-DETR Large在1344像素分辨率下达到最佳结果0.405 mAP50:95，优于1120像素模型（0.379）和最佳YOLO26m基线（0.366）。分辨率提升对小目标和稀有类别（熊蜂、蛾）效果最显著。切片推理融合等方法未能超越此结果。
AI.conclusion: 检测器选择和输入分辨率比增加推理复杂度更关键；蜜蜂-食蚜蝇判别是主要瓶颈，需要学习驱动的特征级时间聚合来改进。

title: Multi-Agent Privacy Game in Federated Learning: A Unified Mean-Field View
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without centralising their data, yet privacy remains a persistent concern because the shared model updates can leak information about local datasets. Existing privacy-preserving methods either inject calibrated noise into client updates, limiting their composition guarantees, or formulate client privacy choices as a multi-agent game whose Nash equilibrium becomes intractable as the number of clients grows. We bridge these two lines of work by formulating privacy-preserving federated learning as a mean-field privacy game: each client strategically chooses its own privacy budget while interacting with the population only through a single mean-field statistic. The mean-field limit yields a tractable equilibrium for arbitrarily many clients, accommodates heterogeneous client preferences, and inherits an exponentially decaying privacy guarantee through a log-Sobolev contraction. The framework recovers the entropic privacy baseline as the homogeneous special case and the multi-agent privacy game as the finite-population case. Experiments on quadratic regression, logistic regression, and MNIST demonstrate that the proposed framework attains the privacy-utility trade-off of the entropic baseline while delivering a personalized privacy guarantee that the homogeneous baseline cannot express.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将隐私保护联邦学习建模为平均场隐私博弈，每个客户端策略性选择自己的隐私预算，通过与人口的平均场统计交互，在任意客户端数量下都能得到可处理的均衡解，同时具备指数衰减的隐私保证。实验表明该方法能实现与熵基线相当的隐私-效用权衡，并提供个性化隐私保证。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护联邦学习方法要么通过注入噪声（组合保证有限），要么将隐私选择建模为多智能体博弈（纳什均衡在客户端增多时变得棘手）。本文旨在桥接这两种方法，提出一种可扩展且可处理的隐私保护联邦学习框架。
AI.method: 将隐私保护联邦学习建模为平均场隐私博弈：每个客户端策略性选择自己的隐私预算，通过与人口的平均场统计交互。利用平均场极限得到任意客户端数量下可处理的均衡解，通过log-Sobolev收缩继承指数衰减的隐私保证。
AI.result: 在二次回归、逻辑回归和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，所提框架能达到与熵基线相当的隐私-效用权衡，同时提供同质基线无法表达的个性化隐私保证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架作为同质情况下的熵基线和有限人口情况下的多智能体隐私博弈的统一泛化，为大规模联邦学习提供了可扩展且个性化的隐私保护方案。

title: TokenMem: Faithful Knowledge Injection for Frozen LLMs
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but suffers from knowledge conflicts: when retrieved information contradicts parametric memory, the shared self-attention pathway produces unpredictable outputs. We present TokenMem, a lightweight memory system that injects knowledge into frozen LLMs through a dedicated cross-attention channel, bypassing competition with parametric memory in the residual stream. TokenMem trains only a thin gating adapter ($\sim$3-7M parameters) via a two-phase curriculum: first learning general knowledge utilization, then strengthening faithful compliance under counterfactual knowledge. In controlled experiments on five models spanning three families (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, OLMo-3-7B), TokenMem achieves 69-70% Knowledge Compliance (KC) on counterfactual benchmarks, compared to 20-52% for vanilla RAG, a gap of up to 49 percentage points. Ablation studies show that the two-phase curriculum is critical: removing Phase 2 collapses KC to near-zero. Mechanistic analysis reveals that the gate adapter learns a conflict-aware, layer-specific injection strategy without explicit supervision.

AI.tldr: TokenMem通过专用交叉注意力通道向冻结LLM注入知识，避免与参数记忆竞争，在反事实基准上知识合规率达69-70%（对比RAG的20-52%），仅需训练约3-7M参数的门控适配器。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）中存在知识冲突问题：当检索信息与模型参数记忆矛盾时，共享自注意力路径会产生不可预测的输出，需要一种能有效解决此冲突的轻量级方法。
AI.method: 提出TokenMem：通过专用交叉注意力通道向冻结LLM注入知识，训练薄门控适配器（约3-7M参数），采用两阶段课程学习——先学习通用知识利用，再增强反事实知识下的忠实遵从。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、OLMo-3-7B五个模型上，反事实基准中知识合规率达69-70%，远超RAG的20-52%，差距最高达49个百分点。消融实验表明两阶段课程学习至关重要，去除第二阶段后KC降至接近零。
AI.conclusion: TokenMem通过专用交叉注意力通道和两阶段训练，有效解决了知识冲突问题，门控适配器无需显式监督即可学习冲突感知的逐层注入策略。

title: Earnings25: A Comprehensive 500-Hour Speech Benchmark for Finance
summary: We introduce Earnings25, a finance-domain benchmark for evaluating automatic speech recognition (ASR) on English-language earnings calls under realistic conditions. Earnings25 comprises two complementary test sets: (i) testset-full, 498 hours of full English-language S&P 500 earnings calls from Q4 2025, and (ii) testset-segmented, a 46-hour industry-balanced set of 290 segments sampled from English-language U.S. earnings calls in 2025. The benchmark provides aligned transcripts and structured metadata, including speaker roles, industry labels, and call structure, enabling speaker- and industry-aware evaluation beyond aggregate word error rate (WER). We report reproducible baselines for Whisper and Parakeet-TDT using standardized scoring.

AI.tldr: 提出了Earnings25金融领域ASR基准，包含498小时完整财报电话会议和46小时分段测试集，提供对齐文本和结构化元数据，支持超越WER的细粒度评估。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR基准缺乏针对金融领域（尤其是财报电话会议）的真实场景评估，且标准WER指标无法反映说话人角色、行业差异等细粒度表现。
AI.method: 构建了两个互补测试集：testset-full（498小时完整S&P 500财报电话会议）和testset-segmented（46小时290个行业平衡片段）。提供对齐转录和结构化元数据（说话人角色、行业标签、会议结构），支持角色/行业感知评估。基于Whisper和Parakeet-TDT报告可复现基线。
AI.result: 两个互补测试集的构建完成，以及Whisper和Parakeet-TDT在标准化评分下的可复现基线结果。
AI.conclusion: Earnings25为金融领域ASR提供了更全面的评估框架，能揭示不同说话人角色和行业条件下的性能差异，是对传统WER指标的补充。

title: Controlling Embedding Spaces with Text-Conditioned Transformations
summary: Multimodal embedding spaces in models like CLIP enable powerful capabilities such as semantic similarity retrieval and cross-modal zero-shot classification. These embeddings compress high-level semantics into a single vector, which comes at the cost of primarily expressing a dominant semantics like main object while suppressing other important attributes such as camera angle or color tone. We propose a text-conditioned transformation of visual embeddings that makes such attributes explicitly accessible. Given a natural language description of an attribute category (e.g., "color" or "art style"), a network generates an affine transformation that emphasizes the specified attribute. Conditioning on text enables it to learn many attributes simultaneously, accessing them at inference time through an intuitive interface. The network is trained to align transformed embeddings with the frozen latent space, enabling retrieval using existing large-scale embeddings without any re-encoding. When applied to a full set, the same mechanism transforms the latent space for attribute disentanglement tasks such as multi-clustering. By operating directly in latent space, our method provides a unified and efficient framework for controlling embedding spaces, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance across both attribute-based retrieval and multi-attribute organization tasks with near-zero inference cost. Project page: https://joefioresi718.github.io/ControlEmbed_webpage/

AI.tldr: 本文提出ControlEmbed，通过文本条件生成仿射变换来操控CLIP等模型的视觉嵌入空间，使隐藏的属性（如颜色、艺术风格）显式可用，实现零成本的高效属性检索与多属性聚类。
AI.motivation: CLIP等多模态嵌入空间将高维语义压缩为单一向量，但主要表达主体对象等主导语义，而抑制了相机角度、色调等重要属性，作者希望让这些属性能够被显式访问和控制。
AI.method: 给定属性类别的自然语言描述（如"颜色"或"艺术风格"），一个网络生成仿射变换来增强指定属性。通过文本条件，模型可同时学习多种属性，推理时通过直观接口访问。变换后的嵌入与冻结的潜在空间对齐，无需重新编码即可利用现有大规模嵌入进行检索。
AI.result: 在基于属性的检索和多属性组织任务上达到最先进性能，且推理成本近乎为零。
AI.conclusion: ControlEmbed提供了一种统一高效的框架，直接在潜在空间中操作，无需重新编码即可控制嵌入空间，在多个任务上表现优异。

title: Online Policy Evaluation for MDPs with Dynamic UBSR Measures
summary: Developing efficient function-approximation methods for policy evaluation is a fundamental challenge in risk-aware reinforcement learning. Existing approaches either focus on restrictive classes of risk measures or rely on access to a simulator, limiting their applicability in fully online settings. In this work, we propose computationally efficient online learning algorithms for policy evaluation in Markov decision processes (MDPs) with dynamic utility-based shortfall risk (UBSR) measures under linear function approximation. Specifically, we introduce the UBSR-TD algorithm, establish conditions under which it converges almost surely, and develop several variants designed to accelerate convergence. Our formulation shows that existing policy evaluation algorithms for risk-neutral MDPs can be readily adapted to dynamic UBSR settings by incorporating a loss function into the temporal-difference error. Numerical experiments support our theoretical findings, and an application to a perishable inventory management problem with shelf-life uncertainty demonstrates the practical effectiveness of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于线性函数近似的在线学习算法UBSR-TD，用于马尔可夫决策过程中的动态效用型短期风险策略评估，并通过损失函数改造时序差分误差，实现了风险中性方法向风险敏感场景的迁移，实验验证了其在易腐库存管理等实际问题中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的风险感知强化学习方法要么局限于特定类型的风险度量，要么依赖模拟器访问，难以在完全在线环境中应用。因此，需要一种计算高效、适用于在线场景且支持通用风险度量的策略评估方法。
AI.method: 提出UBSR-TD算法，通过将损失函数引入时序差分误差，将风险中性MDP的策略评估方法适配到动态效用型短期风险（UBSR）场景，并设计了多种加速收敛的变体。
AI.result: 理论证明了UBSR-TD在特定条件下的几乎必然收敛性；数值实验验证了算法有效性；在含保质期不确定性的易腐库存管理问题中展示了实际应用效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过损失函数改造时序差分误差是一种简洁而有效的方式，可将现有风险中性策略评估算法推广至动态UBSR风险敏感场景，在保证收敛性的同时具备在线学习的高效性。

title: Masked Distillation: Internalizing the Chain-of-Thought in Language Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) produce long, explicit chains of intermediate steps before generating a final answer at inference time. These intermediate traces dominate latency, memory usage, and serving cost, even though the final answer correctness is not causally related to the trace correctness and the trace length is not a reliable indicator of the problem complexity. This raises a natural question: can the computation expressed in these intermediate tokens be internalized into the parameters of a language model, enabling it to produce answers directly (or with much shorter intermediate traces)? We introduce \textit{masked distillation}, a knowledge-distillation framework in which a student LLM is trained to predict only the solution tokens conditioned on the question, while a reasoning teacher provides feedback on the student's responses after conditioning on the question and its own CoT trace. We instantiate this framework in two settings: (i) a \textit{self-distillation} setting, in which the same model serves as the teacher in thinking mode and as the student in non-thinking mode, and (ii) a \textit{dual-model} setting, in which a larger reasoning teacher supervises a separate smaller non-thinking student over the solution tokens. By treating intermediate tokens as a scaffold which reasoning models use to fit over the solution tokens, We additionally vary the length of intermediate-token scaffolding the student is supervised on, interpolating between full internalization (the student emits only the solution) and no internalization (the student emits the full trace before the answer). We evaluate the framework through controlled experiments on two reasoning domains: GSM8K (grade-school arithmetic) and Countdown (a number-puzzle search task).

AI.tldr: 本文提出**掩码蒸馏（masked distillation）**框架，让学生语言模型仅基于问题预测答案，同时让推理教师（带CoT）提供反馈。通过控制中间推理痕迹的长度，实现从完全内化（直接输出答案）到无内化（输出完整推理链）的插值。在GSM8K和Countdown任务上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在推理时生成冗长的中间推理链，这些中间token主导了延迟、内存和推理成本，但最终答案的正确性并不与中间痕迹的正确性因果相关，且痕迹长度也不是问题复杂度的可靠指标。因此，作者希望将这些中间计算“内化”到模型参数中，使模型能直接或更简短地输出答案。
AI.method: 提出**掩码蒸馏框架**：学生LLM被训练为仅基于问题预测解决方案token；教师模型（带CoT推理链）在给定问题+自身CoT条件下对学生回答提供反馈。具体实现两种设置：(i) 自蒸馏：同一模型既充当思考模式的教师，又充当非思考模式的学生；(ii) 双模型：较大的推理教师监督较小的非思考学生。通过控制学生监督的中间token长度，实现从完全内化（仅输出答案）到无内化（输出完整推理链）的插值。
AI.result: 在GSM8K（小学数学）和Countdown（数字谜题搜索）两个推理领域的受控实验中验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 中间推理token可以视为推理模型拟合解决方案token的"脚手架"，通过掩码蒸馏可以将这种中间计算内化到模型参数中，从而在减少推理成本的同时保持答案正确性。

title: Understanding Tone-Dependent Inference Cost in Large Language Models
summary: We examine how prompt tone affects both accuracy of the LLM answers and inference cost as reflected in output-token consumption. Experiments were performed to understand the trade-offs between accuracy and inference cost on a 570 Question MMLU dataset for LLM models prompted in seven different tones from sycophantic to threatening. Our results show that the output-token-length variation substantially exceeded accuracy variation across all models. Output-token consumption varied by up to 44.3% across tone conditions. We also analyzed the tradeoff between the accuracy of the answers and the average output token length in the reasoning process. For the ChatGPT models 4o and 5-nano, the rude tone is quite dominant. For the Gemini models 2.5 Flash and 2.5 Flash Lite, the rude and neutral tones are dominant on the Pareto-optimal frontier. We find that prompt tone influences not only answer quality but also the amount of billable inference resources consumed by modern LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了提示语气（从谄媚到威胁共七种）如何影响LLM的答案准确性和推理成本（以输出token消耗衡量）。在570题MMLU数据集上实验发现，输出token长度变化（最高达44.3%）远超准确性变化。ChatGPT模型中粗鲁语气占优，Gemini模型中粗鲁和中立语气处于帕累托最优前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注提示词的内容和结构，但忽略了提示语气对LLM性能与推理成本的双重影响。作者希望量化不同语气在准确性与经济成本之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 在570道MMLU问题上，使用七种不同语气（从谄媚到威胁）对多个LLM模型（ChatGPT 4o、5-nano；Gemini 2.5 Flash、2.5 Flash Lite）进行提示，测量答案准确性和输出token消耗，并分析帕累托最优前沿。
AI.result: 输出token长度变化高达44.3%，远超准确性变化。对于ChatGPT模型，粗鲁语气在帕累托前沿占优；对于Gemini模型，粗鲁和中立语气占优。
AI.conclusion: 提示语气不仅影响答案质量，还显著影响可计费的推理资源消耗，提示语气的选择需要在准确性和成本之间进行权衡。

title: Layering Virtual Try-On
summary: In the real world, fashion is about layering: adding a jacket over a shirt, or a sequence of adding and removing layers, rather than just a single-layer swap. This fundamental real-world task remains a challenge in existing Virtual Try-On (VTON) methods, which excel at single-layer replacement but are not designed to layer or de-layer an existing outfit. This paper proposes Layering Virtual Try-On (LVTON), a layering benchmark and method that preserves an existing outfit while enabling sequential layering. We find that current VTON paradigms are fundamentally ill-equipped for LVTON, as their reliance on cloth-agnostic representations and single-item datasets discards essential layering context. Our key insight is that the LVTON challenge must be disentangled into two distinct competencies: (1) General VTON Priors (e.g., deformation, identity preservation) and (2) Specific Layering Knowledge (e.g., layering order and occlusion reasoning). First, our model obtains general VTON priors by being trained on data produced by an automatic data generation pipeline that synthesizes samples from fashion videos via segmentation and inpainting. Second, the model is fine-tuned on a small, dedicated LVTON dataset to learn the layering logic. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on our LVTON benchmark and demonstrates superior generalizability on traditional VTON benchmarks, setting new state-of-the-art results when fine-tuned and exhibiting zero-shot capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层虚拟试穿（LVTON），解决现有方法无法处理的衣物叠穿与脱卸问题。通过将任务解耦为通用VTON先验和特定分层知识，利用自动化数据生成管道和专用小数据集训练，在LVTON基准和传统VTON任务上均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中穿搭涉及叠穿（如外套内搭衬衫）的层次化操作，但现有虚拟试穿方法仅支持单层替换，无法处理叠穿或脱衣顺序等关键任务。
AI.method: 将LVTON解耦为两个能力：1）通用VTON先验（变形、身份保留），通过自动数据生成管道从时尚视频合成样本训练；2）特定分层知识（叠穿顺序、遮挡推理），通过小规模专用LVTON数据集微调获得。
AI.result: 在LVTON基准上达到SOTA，在传统VTON基准上微调后刷新SOTA，并展现出零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 现有VTON范式因依赖衣物无关表示和单件数据集而无法处理叠穿问题；将分层知识从通用VTON能力中解耦是解决该问题的关键。

title: MixQuant: Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: Mixed-precision quantization improves the accuracy of post-training quantization by allocating higher bitwidths to sensitive layers, but existing methods solve the allocation for a single fixed memory budget. In practice the budget varies across deployments and is unknown at calibration time. Adaptive quantization addresses this with one offline calibration that serves any budget, yet current methods score layer sensitivity in a manner that does not consider its dependency on quantization levels of other layers. We show that a layer's sensitivity depends strongly on the bitwidths of its upstream layers and that this dependence shifts the resulting preferred bit allocation. We propose MixQuant, a technique-agnostic adaptive framework that wraps any base quantizer. MixQuant marginalizes each layer's distortion over random quantized upstream configurations to obtain budget-agnostic scores, calibrates the quantizer's parameters on plans the allocator itself produces, and penalizes allocations that leave layers at the lowest bitwidths. A single greedy pass then serves any budget at deployment. Across Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-2-7B, and Mistral-7B under AWQ and GPTQ, MixQuant outperforms adaptive and mixed-precision baselines in every setting, improving average accuracy by up to 8 points and reducing perplexity from 12.43 to 10.70 at the tightest budget, while matching an ILP solver at negligible deployment cost.

AI.tldr: MixQuant提出了一种技术无关的自适应量化框架，通过边缘化每层在上游随机量化配置下的失真，实现单次离线校准后即可服务任意内存预算的混合精度量化，在多个大模型上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有混合精度量化方法针对固定内存预算进行比特分配，而实际部署中预算未知且多变；现有自适应量化方法在评估层敏感性时未考虑层间量化依赖关系，导致分配次优。
AI.method: 提出MixQuant框架：(1) 通过边缘化每层在上游随机量化配置下的失真，获得与预算无关的敏感性分数；(2) 在分配器自身产生的方案上校准量化器参数；(3) 惩罚将层留在最低比特的分配方案；最后通过单次贪心遍历即可服务于任意预算。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-2-7B、Mistral-7B上，结合AWQ和GPTQ，MixQuant在所有设置下优于自适应和混合精度基线，平均准确率提升最高8个点，最紧预算下困惑度从12.43降至10.70，且以极小部署成本匹配ILP求解器性能。
AI.conclusion: 层敏感性强烈依赖于其上游层的量化比特数，MixQuant通过考虑这种依赖关系实现了更优的预算无关分配，为实际部署中灵活、高效的混合精度量化提供了有效方案。

title: VlogReward: Learning Multi-Dimensional Evaluation for Vlog Editing
summary: The rapid rise of vlogs as a personalized storytelling medium has created a demand for automated systems to evaluate and refine vlog editing plans. However, vlog assessment is highly subjective and remains challenging due to a lack of standardized criteria, dataset and benchmark, and effective reward models. To address these challenges, we define a comprehensive vlog evaluation framework guided by professional vlog creators and product managers, establishing a taxonomy of six key dimensions, i.e., Creativity, Consistency, Concept Design, Cinematography, Narration, and Pacing.
