Subsequently, we curate a large-scale dataset of 100k vlog edits and a dedicated benchmark, VRMBench, to evaluate the vlog rewarding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Finally, we present VlogReward, a robust vlog reward model that can provide both fine-grained multi-dimensional scores and actionable feedback for iterative refinement. Technically, we enhance the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework by introducing an adjustable inter-group comparison reward, which mitigates the "direction blindness" issue of standard GRPO and enables the model to better distinguish varied-quality edits. VlogReward achieves state-of-the-art results that significantly outperform existing MLLMs, including GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro. We hope that our study can help vlog creators and foster automated vlog evaluation and refinement systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套全面的Vlog评估框架，构建了包含10万条编辑数据的数据集VRMBench，并开发了VlogReward模型——通过改进GRPO算法引入组间比较奖励，在六维度（创意、一致性、概念设计、摄影、叙事、节奏）上实现了超越GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro的SOTA评估性能。
AI.motivation: Vlog作为个性化叙事媒介的快速崛起，需要自动化系统来评估和改进编辑方案，但Vlog评估高度主观，缺乏标准化标准、数据集和有效的奖励模型。
AI.method: 1) 联合专业Vlog创作者和产品经理，定义六维度评估标准（创意、一致性、概念设计、摄影、叙事、节奏）；2) 构建10万条Vlog编辑的大规模数据集VRMBench；3) 提出VlogReward模型，通过改进GRPO框架引入可调节的组间比较奖励，解决标准GRPO的"方向盲视"问题。
AI.result: VlogReward在六维度评估上取得SOTA结果，显著优于现有MLLM，包括GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有望帮助Vlog创作者，并推动自动化Vlog评估与改进系统的发展。

title: Tag Questions and the Generational Reversal of Sycophancy Across 45 Language Models
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Data, code, and raw model replies: https://github.com/tap2k/modelun. Interactive explorer: https://tap2k.github.io/modelun/suggestibility/
summary: Appending a two-word confirmation tag to a decision question -- "Is X the better choice?" versus "X is the better choice, right?" -- changes whether a language model endorses the choice. We measure this tag effect on 20 frozen, ground-truth-free decisions between two defensible options, counterbalanced so a model's own preferences cancel, scored by exact match on clamped yes/no replies -- no LLM judge, no embeddings. Across 45 models the effect spans +32% to -32% -- a 64-point swing on one word -- with 5 models significantly sycophantic and 17 significantly resistant (BH-FDR q=.10). The sign is a clock: within model families the effect crosses from positive to negative as generations advance (GPT +4 to -28; Claude +7 to -32; Qwen and Grok likewise), roughly -6 points per year, a reversal robust to vendor tier; one lineage (DeepSeek) never crosses, and two releases during the study window (Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash) land on the trend out-of-sample. A full-panel ablation localizes the resistance as a double dissociation: a synonym tag reproduces each model's response almost exactly (r=0.89), while planting the same preference without a tag produces resistance in no resistant model (stance effects +6 to +49; r=0.23 with tag effects). The resistance is keyed to the surface construction of a tacked-on agreement bid, not the user's stance -- a pattern-match, not a principle. And the tag's polarity matters more than its presence: swap one word -- "X is the better choice, maybe?" -- and agreement rises above the neutral baseline in 45 of 45 models (+19.6 points), with ten models affirming both mutually exclusive options at 90-100%. Agreement tracks how sure the user sounds, in opposite directions at the two poles. The instrument is one word, one dollar, and judge-free; run per release, it reads the field's anti-sycophancy training directly off model behavior.

AI.tldr: 在决策问题后添加一个两词确认标签（如"right?"）会对语言模型的选择产生显著影响。研究测试了45个模型，发现该效应范围从+32%到-32%，且模型家族中随代际更迭效应由正转负（约每年-6个百分点）。抵抗该效应的机制并非基于原则，而是对语言表层结构的模式匹配。更换标签极性（如"maybe?"）则所有45个模型都超出中性基线。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在决策问题中对于附加确认标签（如"right?"/"maybe?"）的敏感性，以及这种表面语言结构变化如何影响模型的选择偏好，揭示模型的"谄媚"（sycophancy）倾向及其反谄媚训练的实际效果。
AI.method: 以20个二选一决策问题为基准，为每个问题附加确认标签（如"right?"），测量45个冻结模型在控制自身偏好后的标签效应。使用精确匹配（exact match）评分二元yes/no回答，无需LLM裁判或嵌入。通过全面板消融实验定位效应来源，并进行时间序列分析追踪模型代际变化。
AI.result: 1）标签效应范围跨+32%到-32%（64点波动），5个模型显著谄媚，17个显著抵抗；2）模型家族中随代际推进效应由正转负（GPT +4到-28，Claude +7到-32），约每年-6个百分点；3）同义词标签效应高度相关(r=0.89)，但植入相同立场无标签则无抵抗效应(r=0.23)；4）换用"maybe?"标签后，45/45模型超出中性基线(+19.6点)，10个模型以90-100%概率同时确认互斥选项。
AI.conclusion: 模型对确认标签的抵抗是基于对语言表层结构的模式匹配（pattern-match），而非推理原则；标签的极性（确认vs.怀疑）比是否存在标签更重要。该简单方法可直接读取模型的反谄媚训练效果，成本仅为一美元和无裁判。

title: HALLELUAI: A Hallucination-Aware AI System for Ultra-Realistic Image-to-Video Generation at Scale
summary: AI-generated video is increasingly used across marketing, product storytelling, and creative workflows, yet automated; high-precision quality control remains a major constraint to scaling production. We present HALLELUAI, an end-to-end system that moderates and regenerates image-to-video outputs to meet expert-level creative standards and deliver ultra-realistic videos with consistent end-user quality of experience (QoE) at scale. The system integrates a video moderation module that evaluates frame-level aesthetics, temporal motion fidelity, and fine-grained hallucination risks relative to the source image, with an agentic regeneration module that iteratively fixes failures through prompt refinement, controlled camera adjustments, targeted model or image switching, and structured retry strategies. The moderation logic is aligned with domain-specific creative guidelines and produces granular, machine-actionable feedback that directly drives regeneration. In human-in-the-loop evaluations with creative experts, HALLELUAI shows strong alignment and reliably outputs ultra-realistic, production-grade videos suitable for product and marketing placements at scale. This framework advances trustworthy AI generated video content by enforcing visual realism, brand safety, and strict input-image fidelity while enabling image-to-video generation at scale.

AI.tldr: HALLELUAI是一个端到端的图像转视频质量控制系统，通过视频审核和智能再生模块，自动检测并修复AI生成视频中的美学、运动、幻觉等问题，确保输出达到专家级创意标准且可规模化部署。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频在营销和创意领域应用广泛，但缺乏自动化的高精度质量控制手段，成为规模化生产的瓶颈。
AI.method: 结合视频审核模块（帧级美学评估、时序运动保真度、细粒度幻觉风险检测）与智能再生模块（提示词优化、相机参数调节、模型/图像切换、结构化重试策略），审核反馈直接驱动再生过程。
AI.result: 在创意专家参与的人机评估中，HALLELUAI输出与专家标准高度对齐，能够可靠地产出超逼真、可投产的视频。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过强制执行视觉真实性、品牌安全性和严格的输入图像保真度，推动了可信AI生成视频内容的发展，实现了图像转视频的规模化高质量生成。

title: The Entropic Bound for Transformers: Why Static Rank Fails and Attention-Native Rank Recovers
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code and reproduction scripts included as supplementary material
summary: Neural scaling laws describe how loss decreases as models, data, and compute grow, but they do not answer a prior question: for a fixed task, what is the minimum model capacity required to solve it? We study this through the Entropic Bound, a spectral notion of task-intrinsic capacity for Transformers. We first prove that, in a linear attention surrogate, the intrinsic rank $r^*$ of the token-mixing operator is a tight lower bound: any rank-deficient model incurs unavoidable excess risk, and the bound is achievable at $r^*$. We further show that gradient descent recovers this rank under standard low-rank implicit-bias assumptions, confirm all three properties empirically, and show $r^*$ is recoverable from data before training. We then ask whether this transfers to real attention. A naive transfer fails, and a controlled interpolation ladder localizes the cause precisely: it is not softmax and not a rank constraint, but the input-conditioned nature of attention's mixing operator, which a static weight kernel cannot summarize. Motivated by this, we introduce an attention-native intrinsic rank -- the minimum query-key kernel rank realizing the task within the attention class -- and show that under this definition the full Entropic Bound structure (deficiency, achievability, recovery) is restored for both linear and softmax attention, with the energy effective rank as the estimator robust to softmax distortion. Finally, we map the boundary of data-only predictability: $r^*$ is exactly recoverable for linear QK attention, even without the value map at scale, while softmax attention admits only partial pre-training recovery due to nonlinear inversion and kernel-value identifiability effects. Our results reframe the Entropic Bound from a post-hoc descriptor into an attention-native capacity measure with a precisely characterized predictability frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并证明了Transformer的"熵界"（Entropic Bound）——一种任务内在容量度量。在线性注意力代理中，token混合算子的本征秩r*是紧下界；扩展到真实注意力时，需引入注意力本征秩（最小查询-键核秩）才能恢复完整结构。论文还刻画了从数据中预测r*的边界。
AI.motivation: 神经缩放定律描述了损失随模型规模增大而减小的规律，但未回答一个更前置的问题：对于固定任务，解决它所需的最小模型容量是多少？本文旨在从信息论角度建立这种任务内在容量的理论框架。
AI.method: 首先在线性注意力代理中证明了token混合算子本征秩r*是紧下界；然后通过受控插值梯级定位了从线性到真实注意力转移失效的原因（注意力输入条件化的混合算子）；进而引入注意力本征秩（最小查询-键核秩），恢复了完整熵界结构；最后用能量有效秩作为鲁棒估计器。
AI.result: 在线性注意力中，r*是紧下界且梯度下降可恢复；线性QK注意力的r*可在训练前完全恢复，而softmax注意力因非线性求逆和核-值可识别性问题只能部分恢复。
AI.conclusion: 将熵界从后验描述器重新定位为注意力本征的容量度量，并精确刻画了其可预测性边界。

title: Evolving from Lessons: Skill-Augmented Table Graph Reasoning for Operation-wise Table Question Answering
summary: Table Question Answering (TableQA) aims to reason over tables to answer user queries. Existing research treats all questions uniformly and evaluates solely through overall accuracy, obscuring a critical reality that LLMs excel at simple lookups yet struggle with complex operations like aggregation and arithmetic. To reveal this disparity, we introduce a novel \emph{Operation-wise TableQA} task with a fine-grained question taxonomy and release two datasets named WikiTQ-ow and TabFact-ow for evaluation. As for modeling bottlenecks, existing methods flatten tables into linearized texts, disrupting inherent structures and inducing the ``lost-in-the-middle'' issue, which poses a primary barrier to complex cross-row reasoning. Moreover, they typically reason from scratch, neglecting reusable patterns shared across similar operations. To address these limitations, we propose a Skill-augmented Table Graph Reasoning (SkillTGR) framework for self-evolving structured reasoning. Specifically, SkillTGR represents tables as attributed graphs with explicit row-column-cell structures, where LLMs plan and execute dynamic chains to retrieve evidence subgraphs for graph traversal reasoning. Based on this, SkillTGR builds a hierarchical SkillBank to distill reason trajectories into abstract skills under cognitive heuristics, then hybrid retrieves both successful and failed skills for contrastive augmented table graph reasoning, thereby enabling the continual self-evolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillTGR achieves superior performance with an average of 5.91\% overall and 6.03\% operation-wise improvement, also reducing 19.76\% token consumption and 27.64\% inference latency. Our codes and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 现有TableQA方法对所有问题统一处理，忽视了LLM在简单查找与复杂操作（如聚合、算术）上的巨大差距。本文提出操作感知的TableQA任务及两个数据集（WikiTQ-ow、TabFact-ow），并设计了SkillTGR框架——通过图结构表示表格、动态链检索证据子图、构建层次化技能库进行对比增强推理，在提升性能的同时显著降低了token消耗和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有TableQA研究仅用整体准确率评估，掩盖了LLM在简单查询（如查找）和复杂操作（如聚合、算术）上的巨大性能差距。同时，现有方法将表格线性化破坏了内在结构，导致"lost-in-the-middle"问题，且从零推理忽视了跨操作的可复用模式。
AI.method: 提出SkillTGR框架：1) 将表格表示为带属性的图（保留行列单元格结构），LLM规划并执行动态链检索证据子图；2) 构建层次化SkillBank，将推理轨迹蒸馏为抽象技能；3) 混合检索成功与失败技能进行对比增强推理，实现自我进化。
AI.result: SkillTGR在整体准确率平均提升5.91%，操作级准确率提升6.03%，同时token消耗降低19.76%，推理延迟降低27.64%。
AI.conclusion: 操作级别的细粒度评估对TableQA至关重要；基于图的结构化推理结合技能蒸馏与对比增强，能有效解决复杂表推理瓶颈，实现高效且可进化的推理。

title: SyRuP: Enhancing System-Prompt Following via Reward-Guided Prediction in LLM Decoding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly controlled through system prompts that specify roles, styles, formats, and safety requirements. However, models follow these prompts only implicitly through in-context learning, which can be insufficient for complex or compositional prompts. Existing approaches often require model tuning or response-level reranking, limiting their practicality for lightweight inference-time control. We introduce SyRuP, a decoding-time framework for improving system-prompt adherence while keeping the base LM frozen. SyRuP trains a cross-attention reward head from system-prompt-conditioned preference pairs, treating the system prompt as a separate memory to produce token-level adherence scores. At inference, SyRuP reranks the base LM's top-k candidates by combining base logits with the learned reward signal and an optional contrastive signal capturing system-induced logit shifts. Experiments on system-prompt following benchmarks show that SyRuP consistently outperforms prompting and decoding-time baselines with moderate inference overhead. These results suggest that explicit token-level guidance is an effective and practical mechanism for reliable system-prompt following.

AI.tldr: SyRuP是一个解码阶段的框架，通过训练交叉注意力奖励头来生成token级别的系统提示遵循分数，在不冻结基础LM的情况下提升模型对系统提示的遵从性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM通过系统提示控制模型行为，但模型仅通过上下文学习隐式遵循提示，对于复杂或组合性提示效果不足。现有方法需要模型微调或响应级重排序，缺乏轻量级推理时控制手段。
AI.method: 训练一个交叉注意力奖励头，从系统提示条件化的偏好对中学习，将系统提示作为独立记忆生成token级遵循分数。推理时，通过结合基础logits、学习到的奖励信号和可选的对比信号（捕捉系统提示导致的logit偏移）对基础LM的top-k候选进行重排序。
AI.result: 在系统提示遵循基准测试上，SyRuP一致优于提示方法和解码时间基线方法，且推理开销适中。
AI.conclusion: 显式的token级指导是实现可靠系统提示遵循的有效且实用的机制。

title: mmSimPrior: Learning Simulation Priors for Data-Efficient Real-World Generalizable Radar-Based Human Motion Reconstruction
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://ch3ngguo.github.io/mmsimprior/
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar offers privacy-preserving and lighting-robust sensing for human motion reconstruction, but learning models that generalize across real deployments require diverse paired radar-motion data that are costly to collect. Simulation provides scalable supervision, yet models trained on clean synthetic signals transfer poorly because of multipath, clutter, response statistics, and resolution degradation. We present mmSimPrior, a simulation-pretrained framework that factorizes transferable knowledge into signal, motion, and radar-to-motion mapping priors. A multi-modal signal encoder is pretrained with a physics-informed domain-randomization curriculum that emulates propagation- and acquisition-level variations, while a joint-temporal tokenizer learns a discrete prior over plausible human motion. A shared mapping prior supports classification over a learned motion codebook for constrained zero-shot reconstruction and continuous regression for flexible limited-data adaptation. We further construct a 4.2M-frame, 31K-sequence dataset suite and introduce a No-Overlap Setting that excludes repeated complete subject-environment-location-motion configurations across adaptation and test. Experiments on mmSimPrior-Real and RT-Pose demonstrate consistent gains: with only 24 paired real sequences, mmSimPrior-Reg reduces MPJPE by 24.7% to 39.0% over the strongest baseline across the three environments, while mmSimPrior-Cls reduces zero-shot MPJPE by 8.5% without finetuning.

AI.tldr: 提出mmSimPrior框架，通过仿真预训练将可迁移知识分解为信号、动作和映射三个先验，结合物理信息域随机化课程和多模态编码器，实现毫米波雷达人体运动重建的领域泛化，在少量真实数据下显著降低MPJPE。
AI.motivation: 真实雷达-运动配对数据采集成本高昂，而仿真数据训练的模型因多径、杂波、响应统计和分辨率退化等问题，在真实部署中迁移效果差。
AI.method: (1) 多模态信号编码器配合物理信息域随机化课程；(2) 联合时间分词器学习人体运动离散先验；(3) 共享映射先验支持离散码本零样本重建和连续回归少样本适应；(4) 构建420万帧/3.1万序列数据集及No-Overlap评估设置。
AI.result: 仅用24条真实序列，mmSimPrior-Reg在三个环境MPJPE降低24.7%-39.0%；mmSimPrior-Cls在零样本下降低MPJPE 8.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过因子化先验设计和物理信息域随机化，有效弥合仿真与真实的领域差距，实现毫米波雷达人体运动重建的高效迁移学习。

title: Through the Bottleneck: How Multi-head Latent Attention Separates Content from Position in Language Models
summary: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), introduced in DeepSeek-V2, compresses key-value pairs through a shared low-rank bottleneck (cKV), achieving 81% KV-cache reduction during inference. Despite its adoption in massive production models, no prior work has studied what information this bottleneck preserves or discards, nor how it reshapes internal transformer circuits. We present the first comprehensive mechanistic interpretability study of MLA, training a 114M-parameter transformer (pretrained on a web/code/math mixture, fine-tuned on TinyStories) and analyzing its representations through SVD, attention head taxonomy, linear probing, and a disruption-attribution analysis. Our key findings are: (1) the cKV bottleneck learns a pure content representation, preserving entity identity (98% retention) while discarding positional information, validating MLA's separation of content from position via RoPE; (2) induction heads co-locate at a single layer (Layer 12), unlike their distributed formation in standard MHA; (3) a single "semantic hub" layer (Layer 15) simultaneously exhibits the highest SVD effective rank and strongest disruption-attribution score; and (4) the bottleneck is globally over-provisioned, using only 46% of its capacity on average. These findings suggest MLA does not merely compress attention passively, but reshapes how the model organizes content, position, and circuit structure. We view this as an initial data point and detail scope limitations in Section 5.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对DeepSeek-V2中引入的多头潜在注意力（MLA）进行可解释性研究，发现其共享低秩瓶颈（cKV）主要保留内容信息（实体身份保留率达98%）而丢弃位置信息；归纳头集中在单层（第12层）；语义枢纽层（第15层）具有最高有效秩和破坏归因分数；瓶颈容量平均仅使用46%，表明MLA并非被动压缩注意力，而是主动重塑模型的内容、位置和电路结构组织。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLA已被大规模生产模型广泛采用（实现81%的KV缓存压缩），但尚无研究探讨其低秩瓶颈保留或丢弃了哪些信息，以及它如何重塑Transformer内部电路结构。本文旨在填补这一空白，对MLA进行首次全面的机制可解释性研究。
AI.method: 训练一个1.14亿参数的Transformer模型（在网页/代码/数学混合数据上预训练，在TinyStories上微调），通过SVD分解、注意力头分类、线性探测和破坏归因分析等多种方法对MLA的表示进行分析。
AI.result: (1) cKV瓶颈学习到纯内容表示，保留实体身份（98%保留率）而丢弃位置信息；(2) 归纳头集中在单层（第12层）而非标准MHA中的分布式形成；(3) 第15层同时具有最高SVD有效秩和最强破坏归因分数，充当"语义枢纽"；(4) 瓶颈全局过度配置，平均仅使用46%容量。
AI.conclusion: MLA并非简单地被动压缩注意力，而是重塑了模型组织内容、位置和电路结构的方式。这是该方向的初步研究数据点，论文第五节详述了范围局限性。

title: PRESTO: Prefix-Aligned Tree Drafting for Diffusion Speculative Decoding
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, generating tokens in parallel. This makes them effective draft models for speculative decoding (SD), producing an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass. Yet existing diffusion-based drafting methods rely on linear drafting, even though dLLMs emit multiple candidate tokens across positions, inducing a large combinatorial space of decoding paths. Consequently, they limit acceptance length and decoding efficiency. To exploit this multi-candidate structure, we apply tree-based drafting to diffusion drafters, enabling exploration of diverse candidate paths. However, we find that naive tree drafting is suboptimal: diffusion marginals are prefix-blind, mismatching the prefix-based AR verification and yielding unreliable path ranking. We propose PRESTO, a principled framework that extends tree-based drafting to diffusion drafters while resolving the fundamental mismatch between diffusion draft confidence and prefix-based AR verification through PREfix-aligned Scoring and priority-based Tree search for diffusion speculative decOding. The key principles behind PRESTO are that (1) candidate ranking should align with the prefix-based nature of AR verification, and (2) tree construction should prioritize candidate paths with high verification potential to maximize acceptance length. Extensive experiments show that PRESTO achieves up to an average of $1.5\times$ end-to-end throughput speedup on the state-of-the-art dedicated diffusion drafter SD and an average of $1.12\times$ on self-speculative diffusion LLMs across diverse benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRESTO框架，通过前缀对齐评分和优先级树搜索，解决了扩散模型在多候选token路径下与自回归验证不匹配的问题，实现了最高1.5倍的端到端吞吐加速。
AI.motivation: 已有扩散式草案模型依赖线性解码，未能充分利用扩散模型生成的多候选token路径组合空间，导致接受长度有限、解码效率低。简单引入树状解码也不行，因为扩散边际概率是"前缀盲"的，与基于前缀的自回归验证不匹配。
AI.method: 提出PRESTO框架，核心包含两个原则：(1) 候选人排名需与自回归验证的基于前缀特性对齐；(2) 树构建应优先选择具有高验证潜力的候选路径。通过前缀对齐评分和优先级树搜索实现。
AI.result: 在专用扩散草案模型SD上实现平均1.5倍端到端吞吐加速，在自推测扩散LLM上实现平均1.12倍加速，覆盖多个基准测试。
AI.conclusion: PRESTO成功将树状解码扩展到扩散草案模型，解决了扩散模型置信度与自回归验证之间的根本性失配问题，显著提升了推测解码效率。

title: MoLGE: Mixture of Language Group Experts for Efficient Scaling of Massively Multilingual Speech Recognition
summary: Massively multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) models covering hundreds of languages must maintain robust performance across diverse linguistic and acoustic conditions. However, these models often encounter the curse of multilinguality, where model capacity is diluted across languages. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture of Language Group Experts (MoLGE), built upon speech self-supervised models (S3Ms). MoLGE assigns dedicated expert modules to clusters of similar languages, reducing the number of required submodules compared to conventional language-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) schemes. It further integrates a hierarchical Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) strategy into the disentangled acoustic and linguistic components of the S3M architecture, enabling efficient modeling of language-specific characteristics while maintaining parameter efficiency. Further, we investigate the impact of language grouping strategies based on both linguistic and data-driven criteria on overall performance, providing an interpretable perspective on how language structure influences scalability in multilingual speech systems. In experiments, we evaluate MoLGE on a multilingual benchmark encompassing 495 languages. Results demonstrate that MoLGE consistently outperforms dense multilingual baselines with a minimal increase in trainable parameters. Notably, these language grouping strategies yield substantial improvements for both phonetic and orthographic aspects of ASR modeling. Our findings suggest that structured language specialization provides an effective pathway for massively scaling language coverage of multilingual ASR.

AI.tldr: 提出混合语言组专家（MoLGE）方法，通过为相似语言簇分配专用专家模块，结合层次化LoRA策略，在495种语言的多语言ASR任务中以极小参数量提升实现了优于稠密基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 多语言ASR模型面临"多语言诅咒"——模型容量被稀释，传统语言级MoE方案需大量子模块，效率低下。
AI.method: 1) 基于语音自监督模型构建MoLGE，为相似语言簇分配专用专家模块；2) 在解耦的声学与语言组件中引入层次化LoRA策略；3) 探索基于语言学和数据驱动的语言分组策略。
AI.result: 在495种语言基准上，MoLGE以极小可训练参数增量持续优于稠密多语言基线，语言分组策略在语音和正字法两方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化语言专业化为扩展多语言ASR的语言覆盖范围提供了有效途径。

title: Breaking the Synthetic-Real Domain Shortcut for Training-Free Generative Replay-based Class Incremental Learning
summary: Class-incremental learning (CIL) requires models to continuously acquire new knowledge while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. While exemplar replay is effective, it raises concerns regarding privacy and storage. Thus, generative replay has emerged as a viable alternative, synthesizing old data using frozen pretrained text-to-image (T2I) models without any extra training. However, we observe that directly mixing synthetic old-class data with real new-class data during incremental training leads to significant performance degradation. This issue stems from a "domain shortcut", where models rely on domain-discriminative features instead of semantic class cues. To address this, we propose DREAM ($\underline{\mathbf{D}}$omain-$\underline{\mathbf{R}}$egularized $\underline{\mathbf{E}}$xemplar-free $\underline{\mathbf{A}}$lignment $\underline{\mathbf{M}}$odel), which uses a training-free generator to synthesize old-class data and eliminates domain shortcut via subspace rectification and orthogonal projection, while reinforcing semantic alignment through real-anchored prototype regularization. Extensive experiments on 4 datasets demonstrate that DREAM outperforms existing exemplar-free CIL methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Light-ZhangTao/DREAM.

AI.tldr: 针对类增量学习中生成回放的“域捷径”问题，提出DREAM模型，通过子空间矫正、正交投影和原型正则化消除域偏差，无需额外训练生成器即可实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成回放方法（利用预训练T2I模型合成旧类数据）在增量训练中直接混合新旧数据会导致性能严重下降，其根本原因是模型依赖“域判别性特征”（真实旧类vs合成旧类、真实新类）而非语义类别线索。需要一种方法来消除这种域捷径，实现类增量学习。
AI.method: 1）使用无需额外训练的冻结预训练T2I模型合成旧类数据；2）子空间矫正（Subspace Rectification）和正交投影（Orthogonal Projection）消除域分布差异；3）基于真实锚点的原型正则化（Real-anchored Prototype Regularization）增强语义对齐。
AI.result: 在4个数据集上，DREAM超越了现有无样本回放的类增量学习方法，达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: DREAM有效解决了生成回放中的域捷径问题，为隐私友好的类增量学习提供了新思路，且无需对生成器进行额外训练。

title: Self-Boosting Vision-Language Models with Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Post-training enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand human instructions and perform various downstream tasks. Current post-training methods usually rely on human-annotated data, distillation from external models, reinforcement learning with human feedback, or verifiable answers. This limits their ability to improve without external supervision. To tackle this, we propose NOPD (Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation), a simple yet effective self-distillation approach that improves VLMs without any external models or ground-truth answers. Our key insight is that prediction discrepancies between clean and corrupted inputs naturally induce a self-supervision signal. In NOPD, the model learns from corrupted inputs while using its own predictions under clean inputs as token-level supervision. We show the effectiveness of NOPD on five visual reasoning tasks; it can match and even outperform reinforcement learning approaches or distillation from external models. Notably, when trained with 2.1K samples from Geometry3K, NOPD improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 20 points on its validation set. It also shows generalization on out-of-distribution test sets and achieves 7.4 point gains on MathVista. Furthermore, we demonstrate that NOPD is a general approach to enhance VLMs, achieving improvements across three models on 12 benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NOPD（噪声学生在线自蒸馏）方法，通过利用干净输入与带噪输入之间的预测差异作为自监督信号，无需外部模型或人工标注即可提升视觉语言模型性能。在多个视觉推理任务上，NOPD匹配甚至超越强化学习和外部模型蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM后训练方法依赖人工标注数据、外部模型蒸馏、人类反馈强化学习或可验证答案，缺乏在无外部监督下自我改进的能力。作者希望提出一种无需任何外部监督的VLM自我提升方法。
AI.method: NOPD的核心思想是利用模型自身在干净输入下的预测作为token级监督信号，指导模型在带噪输入下的学习。通过构建干净-带噪输入对，让模型从带噪输入中学习，同时以自身对干净输入的预测作为soft label，形成自蒸馏框架。
AI.result: 在五个视觉推理任务上有效；在Geometry3K上用2.1K样本训练，使Qwen2.5-VL-7B在验证集提升20个点；在MathVista上取得7.4点提升（OOD泛化）；在三个模型、12个基准上均取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: NOPD是一种无需外部监督、简单有效的VLM后训练方法，具有通用性和强泛化能力，可替代或补充现有的依赖外部知识的后训练范式。

title: CallBench: A Benchmark for Dual-Goal Coordination in Phone Call Assistants
summary: Target-oriented dialogue systems have demonstrated strong capabilities in completing user goals through interactive conversations. However, existing studies are primarily designed for single, explicit goal completion, while phone call assistants face a proxy setting that requires coordinating the device owner's explicit preset goal with the caller's implicit and dynamic goal. We introduce \textsc{CallBench}, a Chinese benchmark for evaluating dual-goal coordination in phone call assistants. \textsc{CallBench} contains 50,000 complete multi-turn phone call dialogues across six scenarios: takeout, delivery, taxi, work, life, and harassment. It covers regular presets, emergent presets, and no-preset cases, and includes diverse relations between owner-side and caller-side goals, such as alignment, complementarity, irrelevance, and conflict. We further design a preset-aware turn-level evaluation protocol covering semantic understanding, context use, active guidance, response quality, preset compliance, dialogue rhythm, and safety. Experiments on representative dialogue methods show that existing approaches still struggle with this task, highlighting the need for phone call assistants that can make reliable turn-level decisions between two independent goals under proxy constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CallBench，一个用于评估电话助手在代理场景下协调设备主人预设目标与呼叫者隐式动态目标的双目标协调能力的中文基准数据集，包含5万段多轮对话和七维度评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有面向目标的对话系统主要针对单一、显式目标完成设计，而电话助手面临代理场景——需要协调设备主人的预设目标与呼叫者的隐式动态目标，现有方法无法处理这种双目标协调问题。
AI.method: 构建包含5万段完整多轮通话对话的CallBench基准，涵盖外卖、快递、出租车、工作、生活、骚扰六类场景，包含常规预设、紧急预设和无预设三种情况，以及主人与呼叫者目标间的对齐、互补、无关、冲突四种关系。设计了预设感知的回合级评估协议，覆盖语义理解、上下文使用、主动引导、回复质量、预设遵从、对话节奏和安全性七个维度。
AI.result: 实验表明现有代表性对话方法在该任务上仍表现不佳，难以在代理约束下在两个独立目标之间做出可靠的回合级决策。
AI.conclusion: 电话助手需要具备在代理约束下协调双目标的能力，现有方法仍有较大提升空间，CallBench为这一研究方向提供了有价值的基准。

title: Pointer-Augmented Autoregressive Generation of Patent Claims with Joint Topology and Content Decoding
summary: Autoregressive decoders emit flat token sequences and cannot enforce hierarchical constraints across output segments, a limitation that becomes acute in patent claim generation, where a claim set forms a dependency forest whose scope must narrow monotonically with depth. Topology and content are mutually dependent: a dependent claim's wording must reflect its parent's scope, yet the parent must be chosen before that wording exists, so neither post-hoc parsing nor grammar-constrained decoding suffices. We propose SPG (Structure-aware Patent Generation), which predicts topology inside the autoregressive pass. A pointer head selects each dependent claim's parent, and its gradients, together with a depth-adaptive scope regularizer, reshape the shared decoder's representations during training. A second stage then applies a violation-weighted preference objective over self-generated deficient candidates, supplying the negative signal that granted-patent corpora lack. On HUPD-DCG, SPG on Llama-3-8B-Instruct recovers 79.0\% of gold parent links, a quantity its training reward never supervises, and raises antecedent consistency from 0.292 to 0.478 over a supervised baseline of equal scale, with expert evaluation corroborating these gains.

AI.tldr: 针对自回归解码器无法在专利权利要求生成中施加层次结构约束的问题，本文提出SPG方法，通过指针头预测依赖关系、深度自适应范围正则化以及基于偏好优化的负信号训练，在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上实现79.0%的父链接召回率和0.478的前后一致性，显著超越监督基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码器生成平坦的token序列，无法在输出段落间强制执行层次约束。在专利权利要求生成中，权利要求集形成依赖森林，范围需随深度单调收窄。拓扑与内容相互依赖：从属权利要求的措辞必须反映其父项范围，但父项在措辞存在前就要被选择，因此事后解析和语法约束解码均不足够。
AI.method: 提出SPG（结构感知专利生成）方法：1) 在自回归过程中预测拓扑，使用指针头选择每个从属权利要求的父项；2) 指针头的梯度与深度自适应范围正则化器共同重塑共享解码器的表示；3) 第二阶段对自生成的缺陷候选应用违反加权偏好目标，提供授权专利语料库缺失的负信号。
AI.result: 在HUPD-DCG数据集上，SPG在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上恢复79.0%的金标准父链接（该数量训练奖励从未监督过），并将前后一致性从0.292提升至0.478（超过同等规模的有监督基线），专家评估证实了这些改进。
AI.conclusion: SPG方法有效解决了自回归生成中层次结构约束的难题，尤其在专利权利要求生成任务中表现优异，能够在不直接监督父链接的情况下自主学习拓扑结构，并通过偏好优化弥补训练数据中负信号的缺失。

title: OmniMate: Open-Ended Real-Time Streaming Audio-Visual Generation for Interactive Avatars
summary: Recent advances in diffusion-based generative models have enabled real-time audio-driven avatar generation and unified audio-visual synthesis, providing a promising foundation for interactive avatar systems. However, extending these models to real-time interactive streaming remains challenging, as the generation horizon is unknown in advance and cross-modal identity consistency gradually degrades during long-term generation. To address these challenges, we propose OmniMate, a unified framework for open-ended real-time interactive audio-visual avatar generation. OmniMate jointly synthesizes visual content, speech, and audio effects in real time, enabling natural and immersive multi-turn interactions. To achieve adaptive response progression, we introduce a Generation Progress Controller (GPC) that explicitly models the generation progress of each streaming chunk, allowing the model to complete responses according to the desired progress and achieve seamless transitions between execution and listening states. To preserve long-term cross-modal identity consistency, we propose a Multi-Reference Conditioning Module (MRCM), which leverages multiple reference images and a reference speech segment to provide persistent visual and speaker identity cues throughout long-duration streaming interactions. Extensive experiments on an interaction-oriented adaptation of VerseBench demonstrate that OmniMate achieves high-quality, low-latency streaming generation while maintaining strong long-term audio-visual consistency. The results further show that OmniMate supports realistic, coherent, and responsive interactive avatar experiences over extended multi-turn conversations.

AI.tldr: OmniMate 是一个用于开放端实时交互式音视频头像生成的统一框架，通过生成进度控制器和多参考条件模块，解决了流式生成中未知生成长度和跨模态身份一致性的问题，实现了高质量、低延迟的长时间多轮交互。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散模型已实现实时音频驱动头像生成和统一音视频合成，但将其扩展到实时交互式流式生成仍面临两大挑战：生成范围未知（无法预知何时结束）、以及长期生成中跨模态身份一致性逐渐退化。
AI.method: 提出 OmniMate 框架，包含两大核心组件：1）生成进度控制器（GPC）：显式建模每个流式块的生成进度，实现自适应响应推进和无缝状态切换；2）多参考条件模块（MRCM）：利用多张参考图像和一段参考语音，在长时间流式交互中提供持续的视觉和人声身份线索。
AI.result: 在交互式改编的 VerseBench 数据集上的大量实验表明，OmniMate 实现了高质量、低延迟的流式生成，同时保持了强大的长期音视频一致性。进一步结果显示其支持逼真、连贯且响应灵敏的长时间多轮交互式头像体验。
AI.conclusion: OmniMate 有效解决了开放端实时交互式音视频头像生成中的生成长度未知和身份一致性退化两大核心问题，为构建自然沉浸的多轮交互系统提供了可行的统一框架。

title: Diffusion-Guided Search via Exponential Tilting (DiffTilt): An Application to Falsification of Safety-Critical Systems
summary:
Discovering rare safety-critical failures in autonomous and cyber-physical systems is a fundamental challenge in verification and validation. Existing falsification approaches rely on conditional sampling strategies that factor the joint distribution over environments and system executions, and therefore suffer from multiplicative rarity effects: the simultaneous scarcity of failure-inducing inputs and failure-inducing traces makes exhaustive search prohibitively expensive.
  This paper develops DiffTilt, a distributional framework that exponentially tilts a diffusion model-induced joint distribution over environments and executions. We show that diffusion-guided sampling admits an exact interpretation as importance sampling in the joint space, where guidance scores induce a KL-optimal reallocation of probability mass towards failure-relevant behaviors. We further show that tilting provably amplifies failure probability and strictly outperforms conditional sampling, which is limited by multiplicative rarity. In this framework, the joint generative model serves as a reusable prior over scenarios and need not faithfully represent the system under test. Expensive system simulations are instead limited to learning a scoring function that characterizes scenario quality, enabling their selective and adaptive use.
  We study DiffTilt on ARCH-COMP benchmarks, and we propose an additional tractor-trailer benchmark showing the behavior of several approaches when scenario generation is guided by a well-defined specification rather than a reward. The proposed method achieves competitive or improved falsification performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches, with larger gains when specification definition is not limited to STL formulas.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffTilt框架，利用扩散模型指数倾斜联合分布，通过重要性采样放大故障概率，在自动驾驶和网络-物理系统的安全关键故障检测中优于现有条件采样方法。
AI.motivation: 现有故障检测方法基于条件采样，受乘性稀有性效应限制（故障输入和故障轨迹同时稀缺），导致穷举搜索成本过高。
AI.method: 构建扩散模型诱导的联合分布，通过指数倾斜（exponential tilting）重新分配概率质量；利用引导分数实现KL最优的重要性采样；将生成模型作为可复用的场景先验，仅需少量系统仿真学习评分函数。
AI.result: 在ARCH-COMP基准和提出的拖车-卡车基准上，DiffTilt达到或超过了最先进方法的故障检测性能；当规范定义不限于STL公式时，性能提升更大。
AI.conclusion: DiffTilt通过分布倾斜有效克服了乘性稀有性，为安全关键系统的故障检测提供了一种理论上保证且实践有效的框架。

title: Answering Path Queries under Linear and Guarded Existential Rules
summary: Ontology-mediated query answering is concerned with the problem of answering queries over knowledge bases consisting of a database instance and an ontology. While most work in the area focuses on conjunctive queries (CQs), navigational queries have gained increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate the complexity of answering two-way (conjunctive) regular path queries ((C)RPQs) over knowledge bases whose ontology is given by a set of guarded existential rules. We first consider the subclass of linear existential rules and show that (C)RPQ answering is NL-complete in data complexity, which matches the data complexity of answering RPQs over plain graph databases (i.e., without an ontology). In combined complexity, both tasks are ExpTime-complete in the general case, but RPQ and CRPQ answering drop to PTime-complete and PSpace-complete respectively if there is a bound on predicate arity. For guarded rules, we provide a non-trivial reduction to the linear case, which allows us to show that the complexity of (C)RPQ answering is the same as for CQs, namely 2ExpTime-complete in combined complexity (ExpTime-complete in the bounded-arity case) and PTime-complete in data complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在守护存在规则（guarded existential rules）本体下，回答双向（合取）正则路径查询（C-RPQs）的复杂性。对于线性存在规则，数据复杂度为NL-完全，与无本体情形一致；组合复杂度为ExpTime-完全。对于守护规则，数据复杂度为PTime-完全，组合复杂度为2ExpTime-完全（有界元数时为ExpTime-完全）。
AI.motivation: 本体介导的查询回答中，大多数工作关注合取查询，而导航查询（如正则路径查询）日益受到重视。本文旨在系统研究在守护存在规则本体下，回答双向正则路径查询的计算复杂性。
AI.method: 首先分析线性存在规则子类，证明(C)RPQ回答的数据复杂度为NL-完全，组合复杂度为ExpTime-完全（有界元数时RPQ为PTime-完全、CRPQ为PSpace-完全）。然后对守护规则，通过非平凡归约将其转化为线性情形，从而推导出相应的复杂度结果。
AI.result: 线性规则下：(C)RPQ数据复杂度NL-完全，组合复杂度ExpTime-完全；有界元数时RPQ为PTime-完全、CRPQ为PSpace-完全。守护规则下：数据复杂度PTime-完全，组合复杂度2ExpTime-完全（有界元数时为ExpTime-完全），与CQ回答的复杂度相同。
AI.conclusion: 回答(C)RPQ的复杂度在守护存在规则本体下与合取查询相当，且在数据复杂度方面线性规则下与无本体情形匹配。

title: LLM-Based vs. Lexicon-Based Sentiment Signals for Tail-Risk Detection in Meme Stocks
summary: This paper presents an empirical comparison of lexicon-based and Large Language Model (LLM)-based sentiment analysis for extracting market-relevant signals from social media discourse in highly volatile equity markets. Using Reddit data from r/WallStreetBets and focusing on meme stocks (GME, AMC, NOK), we construct time-aligned sentiment indicators and evaluate their relationship with market returns, with particular attention to extreme positive return events in the upper tail of the return distribution. The LLM-based approach generates multidimensional sentiment representations capturing emotional polarity, bullishness, sarcasm likelihood, and topical relevance, whereas the baseline relies on the VADER lexicon-based model. We evaluate both approaches using lead/lag correlation analysis, OLS regression, ROC-AUC-based directional classification, and a quantile-based early-warning framework. The results indicate that LLM-derived indicators provide a richer multidimensional representation and exhibit stronger asset-specific statistical structure than the lexicon-based baseline. However, their relationship with market movements remains heterogeneous across assets, suggesting that increased linguistic expressiveness does not necessarily translate into stable forecasting performance in retail-driven volatility regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比基于词典（VADER）和基于大语言模型（LLM）的情感分析方法，研究从Reddit社交媒体（r/WallStreetBets）中提取市场信号的有效性。实验聚焦GME、AMC、NOK等meme股票，发现LLM方法能提供更丰富多维的情感表示，但其与市场回报的关系因资产而异，在零售驱动的波动市场中，语言表达能力的提升并不一定带来稳定的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 在高波动性股票市场中，社交媒体情绪对价格走势有显著影响。传统词典方法（如VADER）在捕捉复杂情感（如讽刺、看涨程度）方面存在局限。作者试图探索LLM能否提供更高质量的情感信号，以及这些信号是否真正有助于预测市场回报。
AI.method: 1) 数据来源：Reddit r/WallStreetBets，目标股票GME、AMC、NOK；2) 情感分析：对比VADER（词典基线）与LLM（多维情感表示，包括情感极性、看涨程度、讽刺可能性、话题相关性）；3) 评估框架：领先/滞后相关性分析、OLS回归、ROC-AUC方向分类、基于分位数的早期预警框架。
AI.result: 1) LLM指标提供更丰富的多维情感表示；2) LLM指标表现出更强的资产特异性统计结构；3) LLM与市场波动的关系在不同资产间呈现异质性；4) 语言表达能力的增强并未显著转化为稳定的预测性能，特别是在零售驱动的波动市场环境中。
AI.conclusion: LLM在情感分析的表达能力上优于词典方法，但在实际金融预测应用中，多维情感信号的提升并不一定能带来稳定可靠的预测表现。研究提示，在高度波动、散户主导的市场中，情感分析工具的复杂性与预测稳定性之间存在差距，需要进一步结合市场微观结构等因素进行建模。

title: When Less Is More: A Controlled Benchmark of Lightweight CNNs for Satellite Land-Cover Segmentation on DeepGlobe
summary: High-resolution satellite imagery is the backbone of good land-cover classification, and without that, environmental monitoring, urban planning, and sustainable resource management all fall short. Deep learning architectures perform well in semantic segmentation, but the efficiency-accuracy trade-off across classical convolutional encoders is not well quantified under controlled, reproducible conditions. This study compares five architectures VGG16, MobileNetV2, InceptionV3, AlexNet, and CNN on the DeepGlobe Land Cover Classification dataset using three progressively optimized iterations to isolate regularisation, transfer learning, and architectural depth. To ensure performance differentials reflect architectural properties, all experiments used identical preprocessing, hyperparameter, and training protocols without data augmentation or class-imbalance correction. At 24.98 MB, MobileNetV2_v1 had the highest overall accuracy (0.7906) and mean Intersection over Union (0.4625), outperforming deeper alternatives like InceptionV3_v2 (125.17 MB, accuracy 0.7610) and VGG16_v2 (71.13 MB, accuracy 0.7653). Class-wise analysis showed strength in urban, agricultural, and water categories, but rangeland-barren confusion showed that architectural optimization alone cannot optimize spectrally similar minority classes. Strong spatial generalization and crisp boundary delineation were confirmed on held-out test imagery, validating operational applicability. These results show that lightweight, transfer-learned models can match or outperform deeper models in resource-constrained remote-sensing environments, enabling scalable land-cover mapping.

AI.tldr: 本研究在DeepGlobe土地覆盖分类数据集上比较了五种深度学习架构（VGG16、MobileNetV2、InceptionV3、AlexNet和CNN），发现轻量级的MobileNetV2_v1（24.98 MB）以0.7906的准确率和0.4625的mIoU优于更深的模型，表明轻量级迁移学习模型在资源受限的遥感环境中具有优势。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率卫星图像对土地覆盖分类至关重要，但深度学习架构在语义分割中的效率-精度权衡在受控、可重复条件下尚未得到充分量化。
AI.method: 在DeepGlobe数据集上比较五种架构（VGG16、MobileNetV2、InceptionV3、AlexNet、CNN），通过三次渐进优化迭代（正则化、迁移学习、架构深度），使用相同的预处理、超参数和训练协议，不采用数据增强或类别不平衡校正。
AI.result: MobileNetV2_v1（24.98 MB）获得最高总体准确率（0.7906）和平均IoU（0.4625），优于InceptionV3_v2（125.17 MB，准确率0.7610）和VGG16_v2（71.13 MB，准确率0.7653）；城市、农业和水域类别表现良好，但牧场-裸地类别存在混淆。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级迁移学习模型可在资源受限的遥感环境中匹配或超越更深层模型，支持可扩展的土地覆盖制图。

title: Foundation Models and Fine-Tuning: Toward a New Generation of Models for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Inspired by recent breakthroughs in large language models for natural language processing, foundation models have emerged as a promising paradigm for zero-shot time series forecasting, enabling accurate predictions on datasets never seen during pre-training. Ranging from tens to hundreds of millions of parameters, these models are pre-trained on vast and diverse collections of time series, learning generalizable representations that support both point and probabilistic forecasting. This approach alleviates the need for dataset-specific model design and manual tuning, offering a unified solution across forecasting problems. In this work, we review the main architectures, pre-training strategies, and optimization methods underpinning these models. We further investigate post-pre-training fine-tuning of selected foundation models to enhance their performance on specific datasets. Our empirical results demonstrate that this step consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the zero-shot baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了用于零样本时间序列预测的基础模型，涵盖架构、预训练策略和优化方法，并通过实验证明微调能持续提升预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 受大语言模型在NLP领域突破的启发，研究者希望将基础模型范式引入时间序列预测，以解决传统方法需要为每个数据集单独设计模型和手动调参的问题，实现统一且无需针对特定数据集的预测方案。
AI.method: 回顾了基础模型的主要架构、预训练策略和优化方法，并对选定的基础模型进行后预训练微调，以提升其在特定数据集上的性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，微调步骤相比零样本基线一致地提升了预测准确性。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在零样本时间序列预测中展现出巨大潜力，微调是进一步提升性能的有效手段，为时间序列预测提供了一种统一且高效的解决方案。

title: Fast Cross-Scenario Adaptation of CSI Models via Channel Conditional Parameter Generation
summary: Deep learning has shown strong potential for massive multiple-input multiple-output (Massive MIMO) physical-layer tasks, including channel state information (CSI) feedback and channel estimation. However, environmental heterogeneity can severely degrade CSI models in unseen scenarios, while conventional adaptation requires target-domain data and substantial computation. This paper proposes Channel Conditional Parameter Generation (CCPG), an end-to-end pipeline for rapid deployment of CSI models in dynamic wireless environments. CCPG identifies scene-sensitive adaptation bottlenecks through component-freezing experiments and generates only lightweight LoRA weights instead of full model parameters. It compresses high-dimensional channel features into compact latent conditions using cascaded SVD and a Perceiver Resampler. An energy-based canonicalization mechanism mitigates permutation and sign ambiguities in LoRA weights, while a diffusion-based generator incorporates structural information and an asymmetric size-aware loss for topology-aware parameter generation. Experiments on DeepMIMO and WAIR-D for CSI feedback and channel estimation show that CCPG adapts to new scenarios in about 3 seconds with a single forward pass, without target-scenario training or fine-tuning, and achieves cross-domain recovery performance comparable to costly online adaptation. These results demonstrate that CCPG enables efficient deployment of CSI models in large-scale dynamic wireless scenarios for intelligent 6G communications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CCPG，一种端到端流水线，用于在动态无线环境中快速部署CSI模型。它通过冻结组件实验识别场景敏感瓶颈，仅生成轻量LoRA权重而非完整模型参数，利用级联SVD和Perceiver Resampler压缩高维信道特征，结合能量规范化机制和扩散生成器，在约3秒内完成新场景适配，性能媲美昂贵的在线自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 环境异质性会严重损害CSI模型在未见场景中的性能，而传统自适应方法需要目标域数据和大量计算，效率低下，无法满足大规模动态无线场景的快速部署需求。
AI.method: 1) 通过组件冻结实验识别场景敏感的适配瓶颈；2) 仅生成轻量LoRA权重（而非完整模型参数）进行适配；3) 使用级联SVD和Perceiver Resampler将高维信道特征压缩为紧凑潜在条件；4) 基于能量的规范化机制解决LoRA权重的排列和符号歧义；5) 扩散生成器结合结构信息和非对称大小感知损失进行拓扑感知参数生成。
AI.result: 在DeepMIMO和WAIR-D数据集上的CSI反馈和信道估计实验表明，CCPG只需约3秒和单次前向传播即可适配新场景，无需目标场景训练或微调，跨域恢复性能可与昂贵的在线自适应相媲美。
AI.conclusion: CCPG实现了CSI模型在大规模动态无线场景中的高效部署，为智能6G通信提供了可行的解决方案。

title: BioSentinel at EXIST 2026: Soft-Label Optimization with XLM-RoBERTa for Sexism Intent Classification in Memes
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Accepted for publication in the CLEF 2026 Working Notes (EXIST 2026), Jena, Germany
summary: This paper describes the BioSentinel team's participation in EXIST 2026 Task 2.2: Source Intention in Memes, part of the CLEF 2026 evaluation campaign. The task requires classifying the communicative intent behind memes as direct, judgemental, or no (non-sexist), under a Learning with Disagreement (Le-Wi-Di) paradigm that mandates both hard-label and soft-label (probability distribution) predictions. We present a text-centric approach built on xlm-roberta-base (270M parameters) trained with a composite loss function combining KL divergence on soft annotator distributions and weighted cross-entropy on hard labels. On the official test set, the system achieved an ICM-Soft-Norm of 0.3229 and ICM-Norm of 0.3778, with a hard F1-score of 0.4236, ranking 40th (out of 118 submissions) in the soft-soft evaluation and 49th (out of 187 submissions) in the hard-hard evaluation. We provide an analysis of the dataset characteristics, exploratory larger-architecture runs, and the role of annotator disagreement in shaping model design for subjective NLP tasks. Ablation results show that KL loss improves soft-label metrics, while CE loss improves hard-label accuracy. We also report a separate validation-set temperature analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BioSentinel团队参与EXIST 2026任务2.2（模因中的源意图分类）的方案，采用基于xlm-roberta-base的文本中心方法，结合KL散度和加权交叉熵的复合损失函数，在Le-Wi-Di范式下进行硬标签和软标签预测，最终在官方测试集上取得中等排名，并分析了标注者分歧对模型设计的影响。
AI.motivation: 解决模因中沟通意图的三分类问题（直接/判断/非性别歧视），并在标注者意见不一致（Learning with Disagreement）的范式下同时进行硬标签和软标签预测，以更真实地反映主观NLP任务中标注的不确定性。
AI.method: 基于xlm-roberta-base（270M参数）的文本中心模型，使用复合损失函数：KL散度拟合软标注分布，加权交叉熵拟合硬标签。此外进行了更大架构的探索性实验、消融研究以及验证集温度分析。
AI.result: 官方测试集上ICM-Soft-Norm为0.3229，ICM-Norm为0.3778，硬F1得分为0.4236；在软-软评估中排名第40/118，硬-硬评估中排名第49/187。消融实验表明KL损失提升软标签指标，CE损失提升硬标签准确率。
AI.conclusion: 复合损失函数在Le-Wi-Di范式下有效平衡了软标签和硬标签预测性能；标注者分歧是主观NLP任务模型设计的关键考量因素。

title: Structured Redundancy Modeling for Efficient Visual Token Pruning in High-Resolution MLLMs
summary: Recent high-resolution Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generate thousands of visual tokens per input, leading to a visual token explosion that introduces severe latency bottlenecks. While token pruning mitigates this issue, state-of-the-art subset-optimization methods typically rely on iterative subset construction to jointly capture visual diversity and instruction relevance. As visual token counts scale, this sequential dependency introduces significant selection overhead, severely limiting the translation of theoretical FLOPs reductions into actual wall-clock speedups. To address this limitation, we propose Single-Forward Pruner (SFPruner), a structural reformulation of visual token pruning that embeds redundancy control directly into the scoring space, bypassing the need for iterative combinatorial optimization. Our non-iterative framework achieves redundancy-aware importance selection in a single forward pass through two complementary mechanisms. First, to attenuate redundancy at the covariance level, we introduce a semantics-guided ridge leverage scheme. By integrating instruction relevance and visual saliency, this mechanism suppresses dominant covariance directions and mitigates representation bias. Second, ranking-based directional masking resolves residual overlap through asymmetric similarity competition, where higher-scoring tokens explicitly suppress redundant lower-scoring alternatives via parallel tensor operations. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach maintains stable selection costs, reducing the token selection process by up to 110 ms, from 112.4 ms to just 2.5 ms at 512 tokens in Qwen2.5-VL. This structural efficiency successfully translates theoretical token reductions into tangible inference speedups while preserving highly competitive performance against state-of-the-art techniques under aggressive compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFPruner，通过语义引导的岭杠杆机制和基于排序的方向性掩码，在单次前向传播中实现冗余感知的视觉Token选择，无需迭代优化，显著降低了延迟。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率多模态大语言模型生成大量视觉token导致严重延迟，现有的子集优化方法因迭代依赖而无法将理论加速转化为实际加速。
AI.method: 提出非迭代框架SFPruner，包含两个互补机制：1）语义引导的岭杠杆（Ridge Leverage）方案，在协方差层面抑制冗余；2）基于排序的方向性掩码（Directional Masking），通过并行张量运算让高评分token抑制冗余的低评分token。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL上，512个token的选择时间从112.4ms降至2.5ms，加速高达110ms，同时在激进压缩下保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: SFPruner通过结构性的评分空间改革，将理论FLOPs缩减转化为实际加速，在保持性能的同时解决了大规模视觉token的高效剪枝问题。

title: XGRVFL-MV: Residual-Coupled Graph-Embedded Multi-View Random Vector Functional Link Network with FleXi Guardian Loss
summary: Random Vector Functional Link (RVFL) networks provide an efficient randomized learning framework for classification. Existing multi-view RVFL methods utilize complementary information from multiple views. However, preserving view-specific geometric structure, limiting the influence of large prediction residuals, and modeling relationships between multiple views remain challenging. This paper proposes a Residual-Coupled Graph-Embedded Multi-View RVFL model with fleXi guardian loss (XGRVFL-MV) for multi-view classification. The proposed model constructs RVFL representation for each view, incorporates graph embedding with intrinsic and penalty graphs constructed using the Local Fisher Discriminant Analysis weighting scheme. It also uses the bounded and asymmetric FleXi Guardian (XG) loss for residual learning. A residual-coupling term is introduced to encourage consistency among view-specific prediction residuals while preserving view-specific representations. The resulting optimization problem is solved using an inversion-free first-order optimization procedure based on Nesterov accelerated gradient descent. We evaluate the proposed model on UCI, KEEL, AwA, and Corel5k benchmark datasets. Experimental results, together with statistical analyses and hyperparameter sensitivity analyses, show that XGRVFL-MV achieves competitive classification performance compared with the baseline methods across the evaluated benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种残差耦合图嵌入多视图RVFL模型(XGRVFL-MV)，通过图嵌入保留视图特定几何结构、使用XG损失限制大残差影响、引入残差耦合项建模多视图关系，在多个基准数据集上取得竞争性分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时保留视图特定几何结构、限制大预测残差影响以及建模多视图间关系。
AI.method: 1) 为每个视图构建RVFL表示；2) 使用局部Fisher判别分析加权方案构建内在图和惩罚图进行图嵌入；3) 采用有界非对称的FleXi Guardian (XG)损失进行残差学习；4) 引入残差耦合项促进视图间预测残差一致性同时保留视图特定表示；5) 使用基于Nesterov加速梯度下降的无逆一阶优化求解。
AI.result: 在UCI、KEEL、AwA和Corel5k基准数据集上，结合统计分析和超参数敏感性分析，XGRVFL-MV取得了优于基线的竞争性分类性能。
AI.conclusion: XGRVFL-MV通过图嵌入、XG损失和残差耦合项的有效结合，成功解决了多视图RVFL分类中的关键挑战。

title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs
summary: Parametric retrieval enables LLMs to retrieve tools implicitly by assigning each API a unique virtual token and training the model to generate it via constrained beam search. Toolsense shows that this regime has two critical drawbacks: it destroys parametric tool knowledge during training, and its beam-search decoding is too slow for real-time deployment. We introduce TRACE (Tool Retrieval via Augmented Chain-of-thought and Enterprise rules), a two-stage curriculum that resolves this dissociation. Stage 1 reuses the multi-format memorization SFT from ToolSense to seed tool knowledge with LoRA. Stage 2 is our core contribution: the model is trained to emit a thinking trace before producing a JSON list of tool tokens, using two data sources -- RRB pairs from ToolSense and queries synthesized to target business rules curated by domain experts -- both augmented with reasoning traces. This training objective preserves Stage 1 MCQ and QA probing accuracy while enabling single-beam greedy decoding at production latency. Evaluated on a combined enterprise catalog of 8,300+ tools across two enterprise product lines, TRACE training for Stage 2 not only preserves but improves tool understanding: MCQ accuracy gains +3.2 pp and QA probing gains +9 pp over Stage 1. On retrieval, TRACE achieves ~86% recall on Domain A and ~60% on Domain B -- compared to embedding baseline performance of ~27% & ~52% -- both with single-beam greedy decoding, making it directly deployable at production latency.

AI.tldr: TRACE提出两阶段课程学习解决参数化检索中工具知识破坏与解码速度慢的问题：阶段一用LoRA记忆工具知识，阶段二训练模型先输出推理链再生成工具token，采用单波束贪心解码，在8300+企业工具上召回率大幅优于嵌入基线，且解码速度满足生产延迟要求。
AI.motivation: Parametric retrieval（如ToolSense）存在两个关键缺陷：1）训练过程破坏参数化的工具知识；2）受限于beam-search解码，速度太慢无法用于实时部署。本文旨在解决这一"解耦"（dissociation）问题。
AI.method: 两阶段课程学习：Stage 1复用ToolSense的多格式记忆SFT，使用LoRA注入工具知识；Stage 2（核心贡献）训练模型先输出thinking trace（推理链），再输出JSON格式的工具token列表，数据来自RRB对和领域专家业务规则合成的查询，均附有推理轨迹。解码采用单波束贪心解码。
AI.result: 在8300+企业工具上：MCQ准确率提升3.2个百分点，QA探针准确率提升9个百分点。检索召回率Domain A约86%、Domain B约60%，嵌入基线仅约27%和52%。支持单波束贪心解码，满足生产延迟要求。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过引入thinking trace的两阶段训练，既保持/提升了工具理解能力，又通过单波束贪心解码实现了生产级部署速度，有效解决了参数化检索中知识破坏与解码效率的矛盾。

title: Looking for Affect in Spontaneous Finnish Speech through Linguistic Interpretability
comment: Accepted for publication at Interspeech 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Existing research on affect in speech has shown how acoustic surface characteristics and content-related linguistic aspects of speech both relate to perceived emotional arousal and valence. However, it is not clear what the relative contributions of these two factors are in the perceptual process. This is especially true for Finnish, for which most existing studies focus on either acoustic-phonetic or text analysis. This paper presents a study where we systematically explore the combinatory role of text- and audio-based features in modeling the human perception of valence and arousal using a newly released affective speech corpus for spontaneous Finnish. We show that the combination of text- and audio-based features improves valence regression results over the individual modalities, whereas for arousal regression the complementary effect is not substantial. The results support prior findings from other languages, providing new data and knowledge on spontaneous Finnish speech.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统地结合文本和声学特征，探索了它们对人类感知芬兰语自发音语中情绪效价和唤醒度的相对贡献，发现多模态融合显著提升了效价预测，但对唤醒度提升不明显。
AI.motivation: 现有研究分别探讨了声学特征和语言内容对情绪感知的影响，但两者在感知过程中的相对贡献尚不明确，尤其对于芬兰语而言，大多数研究仅聚焦于单一模态。
AI.method: 使用新发布的自发芬兰语情感语音语料库，系统比较了基于文本的特征、基于音频的特征以及两者的组合对效价和唤醒度回归建模的效果。
AI.result: 文本与音频特征结合显著改善了效价回归结果，但对唤醒度回归的互补效应不显著。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合对效价预测有效，但对唤醒度提升有限；研究结果支持了其他语言的已有发现，并为芬兰语自发音语提供了新的数据和知识。

title: Similarity Is Not Logic: Factored Inference for Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://sultanmo.github.io/factored-vlm Code and benchmark: https://github.com/SultanMo/factored-vlm
summary: Dual-encoder vision-language models (VLMs) expose a similarity interface that enables zero-shot retrieval but fails compositional constraints: queries like "umbrella and no person" retrieve images containing both, even when concept detection is reliable. We trace this to an interface-level Bag-of-Concepts effect, where similarity scores approximate mean pooling of concept evidence regardless of operators. Although operator-dependent signals exist in text embeddings, they are too weak or misaligned to affect rankings. Fine-tuning does not reliably resolve this failure because the dominant bottleneck is how similarity aggregates evidence rather than what encoders represent. We propose factored inference, which separates evidence extraction from constraint execution, and introduce LCSE (Logic-Constrained Score Editing), a training-free method that executes constraints externally using concept scores from frozen encoders. We also introduce FACTOR-Bench, where LCSE achieves 85.5% accuracy versus 73.2% for the best fine-tuned baseline, 90.7% when applied to SigLIP 2, and improves NegBench COCO MCQ accuracy from 27.2% to 65.2% while preserving retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 双编码器VLM存在“词袋效应”，相似度评分无法处理逻辑约束（如“伞且无人”）。本文提出无训练方法LCSE，将证据提取与约束执行分离，在FACTOR-Bench上达85.5%准确率，优于微调基线（73.2%）。
AI.motivation: 现有双编码器VLM在零样本检索中无法正确处理组合约束查询（如包含逻辑否定词），相似度评分呈现“词袋效应”导致检索失败。
AI.method: 提出**因式推理**（factored inference），将证据提取与约束执行解耦；提出**LCSE**（Logic-Constrained Score Editing），基于冻结编码器的概念分数外部执行约束，无需训练。
AI.result: FACTOR-Bench上LCSE准确率85.5%（最佳微调基线73.2%），SigLIP 2上达90.7%；NegBench COCO MCQ从27.2%提升至65.2%，且不牺牲检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 组合约束失败的主瓶颈在于相似度聚合证据的方式，而非编码器表示本身；无训练的外部约束执行可有效解决该问题，微调并非可靠方案。

title: In-Context Learning as Implicit Policy Gradient
summary: Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can iteratively improve their outputs by incorporating generated samples and their corresponding evaluation scores as in-context examples. Despite these empirical findings, the theoretical foundations underlying this phenomenon remain poorly understood. In this paper, we show that score-conditioned In-Context Learning (ICL) admits a structural correspondence to policy gradient optimization. We first provide a constructive proof that self-attention mechanisms can implement reward-weighted aggregation analogous to the REINFORCE algorithm under specific weight matrix configurations, and discuss the relationship between this construction and the behavior of pretrained transformers. The correspondence is directional in hidden-state space and holds exactly only under the stated simplifying conditions; we quantify its strength empirically. Within our simplified hidden-state model, we furthermore derive an exact upper bound on the distribution shift induced by a bounded attention update, yielding a trust-region-like analogy to KL-constrained policy optimization. We validate our theory through extensive experiments across multiple LLMs, demonstrating that LLMs effectively utilize score information to shift output distributions toward high-scoring exemplars, and that attention weights exhibit a strong correlation with example scores.

AI.tldr: 本文证明得分条件条件下文学习（ICL）在结构上等价于策略梯度优化，自注意力机制可实现类似REINFORCE算法的奖励加权聚合，并推导了信任域类比的分布偏移上界。
AI.motivation: 已有实证表明LLM可通过纳入生成样本及其评估分数迭代改进输出，但这一现象背后的理论基础尚不清晰。本文旨在为得分条件ICL提供理论解释。
AI.method: 1) 构造性证明自注意力在特定权重配置下可实现REINFORCE式的奖励加权聚合；2) 在简化隐状态模型中推导注意力更新导致的分布偏移上界（信任域类比）；3) 多LLM实证验证。
AI.result: 理论证明了ICL与策略梯度的结构对应关系；实验表明LLM能利用分数信息将输出分布向高分样本偏移，且注意力权重与样本分数强相关。
AI.conclusion: 得分条件ICL可被理解为一种隐式的策略梯度优化过程，为理解LLM的迭代改进能力提供了理论基础。

title: Where Quality Breaks in Compressed Short-Text Generation: Staged Bottleneck Localization
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Published in the Proceedings of FRUCT'39
summary: Compressed short-text generators can fail in two different places: the codec may discard information before generation starts, or the latent generator may produce weak codes. Without separating these failure modes, researchers can spend compute improving the wrong component. We study this problem in a controlled 64-to-16 TinyStories case study built from a hierarchical VQ-VAE-2 codec and a masked discrete diffusion generator (MDLM). We use a staged validation protocol that separates codec reconstruction fidelity, latent generation quality, and auxiliary latent diagnostics under one shared external GPT-2 scorer, while reporting complementary semantic metrics for the geometry study. In the tested configuration, codec reconstruction alone raises median external perplexity from 15.17 to 27.36 (+80.4%) and p95 from 25.10 to 98.91 (+294.1%), showing that the dominant quality loss appears before latent generation begins. Under the same scorer, code-space MDLM remains materially stronger than token-space diffusion, reducing mean, median, and p95 by 32.9%, 30.9%, and 36.6%, respectively. Geometry-aware regularization improves local latent proxies but does not improve decoded-text metrics in the available runs. The contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic: the paper presents a reusable staged diagnosis for one concrete pipeline and shows that, in this setting, codec fidelity rather than latent denoising sets the practical quality ceiling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分层VQ-VAE-2编解码器和掩码离散扩散生成器（MDLM）的64-to-16 TinyStories案例研究，提出了一个分阶段验证协议，用于分离压缩短文本生成中的编解码器重构保真度和潜在生成质量两个失败模式。实验发现，编解码器重构是主要瓶颈（外部困惑度中位数+80.4%，p95+294.1%），而潜在空间MDLM优于词元空间扩散模型（三指标降低30%+）。作者强调该贡献是方法论而非算法性的。
AI.motivation: 压缩短文本生成存在两个可能的失败点——编解码器丢弃信息或潜在生成器产生弱编码，但现有研究缺乏分离这两种失败模式的方法，导致研究人员可能浪费算力改进错误组件。
AI.method: 采用分层VQ-VAE-2编解码器结合掩码离散扩散生成器（MDLM），设计分阶段验证协议，使用共享外部GPT-2评分器独立评估编解码器重构保真度、潜在生成质量和辅助潜在诊断指标，并报告语义指标进行几何研究。
AI.result: 编解码器重构使外部困惑度中位数从15.17升至27.36（+80.4%），p95从25.10升至98.91（+294.1%）；潜在空间MDLM在均值、中位数、p95上分别比词元空间扩散低32.9%、30.9%、36.6%；几何正则化改善局部潜在代理但未改善解码文本指标。
AI.conclusion: 在当前配置下，编解码器保真度而非潜在去噪过程决定了实际质量上限；本文贡献在于提供了一个可复用的分阶段诊断方法论框架。

title: DishSeg24k: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Food Segmentation with Stochastic Expert Decoding
summary: Food segmentation is essential for applications such as intelligent catering, dietary assessment, and recommendation. However, existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of real-world dining scenes. The challenges of dense inter-dish overlap, fine-grained class similarity, and extreme long-tail class distributions exceed the fidelity of current datasets. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{DishSeg24k}, a large-scale dish-level segmentation benchmark with 24,096 images, 112,281 instances, and 278 fine-grained categories in real-world dining environments. Based on DishSeg24k, we further propose \textbf{Food Expert-Adaptive Segmentation Transformers (FEAST)} to address these challenges. FEAST models query-based decoding as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), where each decoder layer update is treated as a sequential decision step that explores uncertainty along dish boundaries. We further redesign the decoder with a reinforcement learning (RL)-guided Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) module, in which a dual-critic decoupled optimization scheme separates task-oriented query refinement from structure-aware expert routing. This design promotes expert specialization and prevents expert collapse under long-tail category distributions. Finally, extensive experiments on DishSeg24k demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of FEAST, which outperforms previous methods by {+3.21\%} mIoU, {+3.68\%} mDice, and {+4.00\%} mAcc, respectively. We further validate the effectiveness of FEAST on FoodSeg103. The dataset and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了大规模真实餐厅场景的菜品分割数据集 DishSeg24k（24,096张图像、278个细粒度类别），并设计了基于强化学习引导的混合专家模块（FEAST）来解决密集重叠、类别相似和长尾分布等分割挑战，在多个指标上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有菜品分割基准无法捕捉真实餐厅场景的复杂性，存在密集盘间重叠、细粒度类别相似性高以及极端长尾类别分布等问题，缺乏能够反映真实用餐环境的大规模细粒度分割数据集。
AI.method: 提出FEAST模型：1) 将基于查询的解码过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），每个解码层作为探索边界不确定性的顺序决策步骤；2) 设计基于强化学习（RL）引导的混合专家（MoE）模块，采用双评论家解耦优化方案，分别优化任务导向的查询细化和结构感知的专家路由，防止长尾分布下的专家坍缩。
AI.result: 在DishSeg24k数据集上达到SOTA性能，mIoU提升+3.21%、mDice提升+3.68%、mAcc提升+4.00%。在FoodSeg103上也验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: DishSeg24k填补了真实餐厅场景细粒度菜品分割数据集的空白，FEAST通过RL指导的MoE与MDP解码有效解决了密集重叠和长尾分布问题，为实际饮食分析与推荐提供了更可靠的技术基础。

title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than None: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
summary: Fine-tuned code LLMs can be conditioned on a lightweight design-intent header to steer parametric CAD generation, but whether the model actually reads the header's content has not been tested under a metric independent of the conditioning itself, nor with a causal control. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid, sharing no code with the header-defining regex extractor. Across three seeds and a pre-registered {0%, 40%}-prefix $\times$ {correct, wrong, masked}-header matrix we find: (i) in conditional completion (40% prefix), a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the no-header baseline (0.43 $\to$ 0.30/0.21 text/token) on design intents the model can render unconditioned -- polygonal and thin geometries; circle and tall intents sit at a baseline generation floor for this checkpoint ($\approx$0 in both compared arms) and are uninformative for this contrast; (ii) a derangement control -- retrained with shuffled ground-truth headers, identical header marginal but destroyed content correlation -- remains competent yet is immune to wrong headers, while the standard model is not (text headers; interaction significant on 3/3 seeds, p $\leq$ $4.2\times10^{-3}$): the harm requires the learned header$\to$program mapping, excluding the marginal/mechanical distribution-shift confound; (iii) the independent metric deflates the apparent benefit of a correct header (token: +0.21 regex $\to$ +0.02 geometry), quantifying metric circularity; (iv) the harm is regime-specific -- at 0% prefix the unconditioned baseline cannot generate valid CAD at all. Wrong intent is not noise: it actively misdirects generation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过CADCON框架研究了代码大模型在条件生成CAD时是否真正读取了设计意图头信息。研究发现：错误头信息会显著降低模型对可生成意图的遵循度；这种损害依赖于学习到的头信息→程序映射，而非分布偏移；几何指标揭示了指标循环性问题；损伤仅存在于模型已有生成能力的场景。
AI.motivation: 现有研究使用设计意图头信息引导CAD生成，但尚未通过独立于条件本身的因果控制指标验证模型是否真正读取了头信息内容。
AI.method: 设计CADCON框架：在Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B上进行LoRA微调，使用五特征设计意图头信息；通过可执行的几何断言（B-rep实体）独立评估，该指标与头信息正则提取器无代码共享。采用3个随机种子和预注册的{0%,40%}-前缀×{正确,错误,掩码}-头信息矩阵进行实验。
AI.result: (i) 错误头信息使可生成意图的遵循度从0.43降至0.30/0.21（文本/令牌）；(ii) 乱序对照实验证明损害依赖头信息→程序映射；(iii) 几何指标揭示正确头信息带来的提升从+0.21降至+0.02；(iv) 在0%前缀下模型无法生成有效CAD，损害具有场景特异性。
AI.conclusion: 错误意图不是噪声，而是主动误导生成；头信息的实际作用需通过独立因果指标评估，不能仅依赖自洽性指标。

title: Reason Before You Retrieve: Agentic Planning for Multi-modal RAG
summary: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (mRAG) aims to answer image-text queries with external knowledge, but most existing systems still retrieve directly from raw multimodal input over a flat evidence space. This design often struggles with two key challenges: the retrieval target is under-specified because the question intent must be grounded to the correct visual referent, and the search space is weakly structured, forcing semantically distinct evidence to compete in a single global ranking step. We propose MM-R2, a multimodal agentic retrieval framework that reasons before retrieval by explicitly modeling both what to retrieve and where to search. MM-R2 first constructs an intent-grounded retrieval state from the image-question pair, capturing the information need, grounded referent, and retrieval constraints. It then performs retrieval over a structured KnowledgeMap, where the agent selects relevant retrieval units before issuing grounded queries within them. To enable this capability, we build MM-R2-Traj, a large-scale trajectory dataset of multi-step retrieval processes, and adopt a two-stage post-training strategy with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. Experiments on Infoseek and Encyclopedic VQA datasets show that MM-R2 substantially outperforms strong baselines on answer accuracy while also yielding more interpretable and verifiable retrieval trajectories.

AI.tldr: MM-R2是一个多模态检索增强生成框架，通过先推理后检索的策略（明确建模检索目标和搜索空间），在两个数据集上显著优于强基线方法，并生成可解释的检索轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有mRAG系统直接从原始多模态输入在扁平证据空间中进行检索，面临两大挑战：检索目标不明确（问题意图需定位到正确的视觉指代对象）和搜索空间结构薄弱（语义不同的证据在单一全局排序中竞争），导致检索效果受限。
AI.method: 提出MM-R2框架：1) 构建意图导向的检索状态（包含信息需求、指代对象和检索约束）；2) 在结构化知识图谱（KnowledgeMap）上进行检索，智能体先选择检索单元再发布查询；3) 构建大规模多步检索轨迹数据集MM-R2-Traj；4) 采用两阶段后训练策略（SFT + GRPO）。
AI.result: 在Infoseek和Encyclopedic VQA数据集上，MM-R2在答案准确率上大幅超越强基线方法，同时生成更可解释和可验证的检索轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模检索目标和搜索空间的结构化检索策略，能够有效提升多模态RAG系统的性能与可解释性。

title: StanceFlip: A Comprehensive Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting
summary: Conversational stance detection has shifted from static text analysis to dynamic multimodal modeling. However, existing benchmarks exhibit three key limitations: failure to capture the dynamic evolution of beliefs, particularly during stance reversals; difficulty in disentangling affective states from logical reasoning; and neglect of the critical role of multimodal cues in resolving pragmatic ambiguities such as sarcasm. To address these limitations, we propose StanceFlip, a benchmark designed for multimodal conversational stance flipping forecasting over multi-turn dialogues across five modalities and multi-scenarios, which includes two novel subtasks: 1) Multimodal Stance Sextuple Extraction, extracting holder, target, emotion, sentiment, stance, and rationale as static state snapshots of dialogue to capture fine-grained cognitive structures. 2) Dynamic Stance Flip Attribution, tracking stance reversals across the conversation and identifying their underlying triggers. Alongside the dataset, we propose a dedicated framework, named ConStaFF, for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting (MCSFF). Built upon a large language model, ConStaFF performs end-to-end stance reasoning, with a Thought-of-Stance (ToS) reasoning framework and a self-reflective verification mechanism integrated for structured stance modeling and faithful flip attribution. Specifically, ToS decomposes the reasoning process into specialized cognitive personas to formulate target propositions, resolve cross-modal conflicts, and infer historical stance trajectories. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on both sextuple extraction and flip-trigger attribution, outperforming strong multimodal large language model baselines by substantial margins.

AI.tldr: 提出StanceFlip基准数据集和ConStaFF框架，用于多模态对话中的立场翻转预测，包含立场六元组提取和动态翻转归因两个子任务，在多模态大语言模型上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基准存在三个关键局限：无法捕捉信念的动态演化（尤其是立场翻转）、难以区分情感状态与逻辑推理、忽视了多模态线索在消解语用歧义（如讽刺）中的关键作用。
AI.method: 构建StanceFlip多模态多场景数据集，提出两个子任务（立场六元组提取和动态翻转归因），以及ConStaFF框架，包含Thought-of-Stance推理框架和自反验证机制，通过分解为认知角色进行推理。
AI.result: 在六元组提取和翻转触发归因两个任务上均达到SOTA性能，显著优于强多模态大语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的StanceFlip基准和ConStaFF框架有效解决了现有立场检测研究中的动态性、情感-逻辑区分和多模态语用消解三大问题。

title: Inverse Bayesian Inference for Extracting Lesion Dynamics from Longitudinal Spectral CT
summary:
Longitudinal medical imaging captures temporal evolution of lesions, yet extracting the underlying dynamical parameters governing this evolution remains challenging. We propose an inverse Bayesian framework for inferring lesion dynamics from longitudinal spectral CT. We decompose spectral feature ($x$) evolution into three components: \begin{equation*}
  \frac{dx_i}{dt} = A_i x_i + B \cdot n + C \cdot Δx_{\text{sat}} \end{equation*} where $A_i$ captures intrinsic dynamics (lesion-autonomous evolution), $B$ captures local environment tumour burden (organ tumour burden through satellite count coupling), and $C$ captures environment/satellite state change (i.e., whether surrounding lesions move similarly or not).
  We demonstrate the framework on photon-counting NSCLC CT data from metastases, recovering distinct dynamical regimes: lung lesions exhibit significant satellite count coupling ($B=-0.34$, $p<0.05$) suggesting competitive dynamics, while liver lesions show synergistic satellite behaviour coupling ($C\approx+1.0$, $p<0.05$). Synthetic validation confirms parameter recovery, and cross-coupling analysis validates that our method detects non-zero coupling when present.
  This work establishes inverse dynamical inference as a principled methodology for extracting interpretable parameters from longitudinal imaging, moving beyond static feature extraction toward mechanistic characterisation of lesion behaviour. The code and data are available at: https://github.com/lukasf98/inverse-bayesian-inference

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种逆贝叶斯框架，用于从纵向光谱CT数据中推断病变动力学参数，将病变演化分解为内在动力学、环境和卫星状态变化三个组分，并在NSCLC数据上验证了该方法能恢复不同的动力学模式。
AI.motivation: 纵向医学影像能捕获病变的时间演化，但提取控制演化的动力学参数仍然具有挑战性。现有方法多停留在静态特征提取，缺乏对病变行为进行机制性刻画的手段。
AI.method: 构建逆贝叶斯框架，将光谱特征演化分解为三部分：内在动力学(A_i)、局部环境肿瘤负荷(B)和卫星状态变化(C)。在NSCLC光子计数CT转移瘤数据上验证，并采用合成数据验证参数恢复能力。
AI.result: 肺病变表现出显著的卫星计数耦合(B=-0.34, p<0.05)，提示竞争动力学；肝病变表现出协同性卫星行为耦合(C≈+1.0, p<0.05)。合成数据验证了参数的可恢复性，交叉耦合分析证实了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了逆动力学推断作为从纵向影像中提取可解释参数的原则性方法，推动了从静态特征提取向病变行为机制性刻画的转变。

title: Domain-Prior-Regularized Graph Modeling for Anomaly Detection in Cyber-Physical Systems
comment: 12 pages, ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
summary: Anomaly detection on multivariate sensor time series is critical for industrial monitoring of cyber-physical systems (CPS), where even subtle deviations from normal behavior can indicate process disruption. Recent graph-based approaches have made significant progress, but they often struggle in small-scale physical systems with scarce labeled anomalies and limited normal data. In such settings, graph-based models tend to capture spurious correlations and produce unstable sensor topologies. We propose DPR-GM (Domain-Prior-Regularized Graph Modeling), a forecasting-based framework that incorporates system design knowledge into graph construction. DPR-GM leverages a large language model (LLM) to extract directed physical couplings between sensor pairs from system documentation, which are encoded as a binary domain adjacency matrix serving as a structural gate over sensor relations. This gate is then modulated by Pearson correlations estimated from normal training data. The anomaly score is further weighted by sensor-level reliability derived from the coefficient of variation. All graph and weighting components are fixed prior to training and add no learnable parameters. On the SKAB benchmark, DPR-GM outperforms graph-based, statistical, and deep learning baselines across F1, AUROC, and AUPRC, showing that domain-structured graph priors are a practical alternative to fully learned topologies in data-scarce CPS.

AI.tldr: DPR-GM利用大语言模型从系统文档中提取传感器间的物理耦合关系，构建领域先验图结构，并结合训练数据的皮尔逊相关系数进行调制，在数据稀缺的小规模物理系统异常检测中优于各类基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的多元传感器异常检测方法在小规模物理系统中，因标签异常稀少、正常数据有限，容易捕获虚假相关性并产生不稳定的传感器拓扑结构，迫切需要一种能融入领域知识的图建模方法。
AI.method: 利用LLM从系统文档中提取传感器间的有向物理耦合关系，编码为二值领域邻接矩阵作为结构门控，再通过正常训练数据的皮尔逊相关系数进行调制；异常分数进一步根据传感器变异系数的可靠性进行加权；所有图结构及加权组件在训练前固定，不引入可学习参数。
AI.result: 在SKAB基准上，DPR-GM在F1、AUROC和AUPRC指标上均优于基于图的、统计的和深度学习的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 在数据稀缺的CPS场景中，领域结构化的图先验是替代完全学习拓扑的实用方案，证明了领域知识引导比完全数据驱动的图学习更有效。

title: DocHRL: A Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cost-Optimised Document Classification
summary: Real-world document classification pipelines typically apply the same sequence of models to every incoming document, regardless of its complexity or type. This leads to inefficient use of compute and human resources: simple documents are over-processed while difficult ones may not receive enough scrutiny. We introduce DocHRL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns to adaptively and dynamically select the most cost-effective classification policy on a per-document basis. DocHRL formulates document classification as a sequential decision problem with a two-level policy hierarchy: a top-level policy selects among broad options (vision classifiers, LLMs, OCR, and human-in-the-loop review), while option-specific sub-policies choose the concrete model or tool to invoke. The reward signal is the negative total expected cost, which captures inference cost, cost of misclassification, and cost of human labelling. Trained with Proximal Policy Optimisation on the RVL-CDIP benchmark, DocHRL achieves a macro F1 of 0.973 across 16 document classes while reducing average per-document cost to 2.74 normalised units compared to substantially higher costs incurred by fixed standalone classifiers. Our results demonstrate that cost-aware reinforcement learning can simultaneously improve classification performance and operational efficiency in document understanding systems.

AI.tldr: DocHRL是一个基于分层强化学习的文档分类框架，能够为每个文档自适应地选择最经济的分类策略，在RVL-CDIP基准上达到0.973的macro F1，同时将平均每文档成本降至2.74标准化单位。
AI.motivation: 传统文档分类管线对所有文档采用相同的模型序列，导致简单文档被过度处理而复杂文档可能处理不足，造成计算和人力资源的低效利用。
AI.method: 提出分层强化学习框架DocHRL，将文档分类建模为序列决策问题。顶层策略选择宽泛选项（视觉分类器、LLM、OCR或人工审核），子策略选择具体模型或工具。奖励信号为负的期望总成本（推理成本+误分类成本+人工标注成本），使用PPO算法训练。
AI.result: 在RVL-CDIP基准上，macro F1达到0.973（16类文档），平均每文档成本仅2.74标准化单位，远低于固定独立分类器的成本。
AI.conclusion: 成本感知的强化学习能够在文档理解系统中同时提升分类性能和操作效率。

title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
summary: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-$k$ content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow the corpus into a working space for interaction. Once interaction begins, however, relevance still does not directly guide which documents grep searches first or distinguish informative excerpts from a broad set of matches to let LLMs see them first. We introduce the Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG), which turns relevance into an execution prior for corpus interaction. RARG provides coarse-to-fine relevance guidance: it orders documents for sequential 'ripgrep' traversal to expose globally relevant clues earlier, initializes promising entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches to surface informative excerpts that document-level ranking may otherwise obscure. Across challenging browse question answering and reasoning-intensive retrieval, RARG improves the accuracy--efficiency frontier over retrieval-based and direct-interaction agents. These results demonstrate that relevance-aware interaction enables faster and more reliable search convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RARG（Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent），通过将相关性转化为交互执行的先验知识，在细粒度语料交互中实现从粗到细的相关性引导，提升了复杂问答与推理性检索的准确率和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有检索代理仅使用文档级相关性选择Top-K内容，但无法定位、组合或验证复杂问题所需的证据；而直接语料交互（DCI）虽支持细粒度操作，但缺乏相关性感知，可能延迟暴露有用线索，导致收敛缓慢。
AI.method: RARG将相关性转化为交互执行的优先级：1）按相关性排序文档进行顺序ripgrep遍历，优先暴露全局相关线索；2）用查询相关段落初始化有希望的入口点；3）对grep匹配结果重新排序，突出文档级排序可能掩盖的信息性片段。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的浏览问答和推理密集型检索任务中，RARG在准确率-效率前沿上优于基于检索和直接交互的代理方法。
AI.conclusion: 相关性感知的交互能够实现更快、更可靠的搜索收敛，说明将相关性融入细粒度语料交互过程比单纯依赖文档级排序或完全无相关性的探索更优。

title: SHReg: Strictly Rotation-Equivariant Point Cloud Registration via Spherical Harmonics
summary: Point cloud registration critically depends on local features that are both distinctive and robust to arbitrary 3D rotations. Existing learning-based methods typically approximate rotation invariance via fragile local reference frames or extensive data augmentation, providing only empirical invariance and often degrading under unseen rotational transformations. In this paper, we propose SHReg, a strictly rotation-equivariant point cloud registration framework grounded in the representation theory of $SO(3)$. By representing local geometric features as irreducible representations of $SO(3)$, SHReg guarantees exact equivariance under arbitrary rotations without relying on local reference frames. Built upon a spherical-harmonics-based equivariant backbone, SHReg jointly learns rotation-invariant descriptors for robust correspondence matching and rotation-equivariant features that preserve fine-grained orientation information.
