AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于LLM的游戏代理在复杂任务中表现不佳的问题，发现空间推理能力受限是失败原因之一。通过因果提示增强和多步规划，在Qwen3模型上实验发现：大模型配合思考模式能更准确定位，因果上下文可提升胜率，多步规划在提升表现的同时还能降低响应延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM游戏代理在复杂任务中表现不佳，作者推测这与空间推理能力受限有关，因此希望探究这一关联，并寻找既能提升胜率又能控制响应延迟的可行方法。
AI.method: 使用开源Qwen3模型家族，在不同模型规模、推理模式和规划视野下进行实验。设计了包含三个自定义游戏和五个难度级别的GVGAI基准测试，采用定位实验和游戏成功率两种评估范式，并引入因果提示增强和多步规划策略。
AI.result: 大模型配合思考模式能更准确地定位坐标，但小模型整体坐标匹配能力有限。胜率随游戏难度和布局复杂度增加而下降。因果上下文提示可提升成功率（尤其对大模型），多步规划在提升性能的同时还降低了每步平均响应时间。
AI.conclusion: 因果提示增强和多步规划是提升LLM游戏代理空间推理与任务完成能力的有效手段，在推理深度与执行速度之间可实现实用权衡。

title: Weakly Supervised Instance-Level Gleason Pattern Estimation Using Primary and Secondary Labels
summary: In prostate cancer histopathology, the Gleason Score is determined by the most frequent (Primary) and second most frequent (Secondary) Gleason patterns within a whole-slide image. Although these slide-level labels are routinely available in clinical practice, instance-level Gleason annotations are rarely provided, making patch-level learning challenging. We propose a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that estimates instance-level Gleason patterns from slide-level Primary and Secondary labels. The proposed method formulates instance-level learning according to the clinical definition of the Gleason Score by aggregating instance predictions into class counts and explicitly modeling the Primary pattern, Secondary pattern, and their dominance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed formulation enables effective instance-level learning and outperforms existing MIL approaches on the SICAP-MIL dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多示例学习的框架，利用临床中常见的全切片级别（Primary和Secondary）Gleason评分标签，实现无需实例级标注的前列腺癌组织病理图像补丁级Gleason模式分类，并在SICAP-MIL数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 临床实践中仅有切片级别的Gleason评分（Primary和Secondary模式），缺乏实例级（补丁级）Gleason模式标注，而补丁级学习对于病理诊断至关重要。现有方法无法有效利用这种弱监督标签进行细粒度学习。
AI.method: 提出多示例学习（MIL）框架，将实例级预测聚合成类别计数，并根据Gleason评分的临床定义，显式建模Primary模式、Secondary模式及其主导关系，实现从切片级标签到补丁级标签的学习。
AI.result: 在SICAP-MIL数据集上的实验结果表明，该公式化方法能够实现有效的实例级学习，并且性能优于现有的MIL方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将临床定义直接嵌入MIL框架，可以在仅有切片级弱监督标签的情况下有效学习实例级Gleason模式。

title: Impute On-Demand: Adaptive Correlated Time Series Imputation for Changing Environments
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering (IEEE TKDE)
summary: Internet of Things (IoT) applications generate vast amounts of Correlated Time Series (CTS) data that often contain missing values and require imputation. Existing methods emphasize accuracy but often lack adaptability to changing IoT environments: they are vulnerable to sensor failures, cannot selectively impute only incomplete sensors, and use static architectures that do not adapt to resource availability. To address these limitations, we propose AdaCTSi, an adaptive CTS imputer for changing environments. AdaCTSi combines a One-shot Temporal Convolutional Network with a Learned Time-Sensor Index Table to extract and decouple complex spatio-temporal features into sensor-wise embeddings, enabling adaptation to varying sensor subsets. Sparse Spatial Attention efficiently extracts dynamic spatial correlations, while Correlation-Weighted Sensor Selection selects informative sensors to provide sufficient spatial context. Experiments with twelve baseline methods, three adaptability scenarios, and five benchmark datasets covering traffic, air quality, and trajectory data show that AdaCTSi reduces MAE by an average of 33.1% relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. A single trained model supports sensor-subset and resource-adaptive inference, and its modest memory footprint enables deployment on commodity computing devices, including MCUs.

AI.tldr: AdaCTSi是一种自适应相关时间序列插补方法，结合一次性时间卷积网络、学习型时间-传感器索引表和稀疏空间注意力，在变化环境中实现高效、灵活的多传感器缺失值填充，相比最强基线平均降低33.1%的MAE，且支持传感器子集自适应推理和资源受限设备部署。
AI.motivation: 现有CTS插补方法精度高但适应性差，具体表现为：对传感器故障脆弱、无法选择性插补不完整传感器、使用无法适应资源可用性的静态架构。亟需一种能够适应变化IoT环境的自适应插补方法。
AI.method: AdaCTSi包含三个核心组件：1) One-shot TCN + Learned Time-Sensor Index Table，提取时空特征并解耦为传感器级嵌入，适应变动的传感器子集；2) Sparse Spatial Attention，高效提取动态空间相关性；3) Correlation-Weighted Sensor Selection，选择信息量大的传感器提供充分空间上下文。
AI.result: 在12种基线方法、3种适应性场景和5个基准数据集（涵盖交通、空气质量和轨迹数据）上，AdaCTSi相比各数据集最强基线平均降低MAE 33.1%。单个训练模型支持传感器子集和资源自适应推理，内存占用小，可部署在包括MCU在内的商用计算设备上。
AI.conclusion: AdaCTSi有效解决了现有方法在变化IoT环境中适应性不足的问题，在插补精度、灵活性和部署可行性上均表现出显著优势，为资源受限的IoT场景提供了一种实用的自适应CTS插补方案。

title: Commitment To Cooperation With Self-Negotiated Contracts
summary: As AI agents operate with increasing autonomy in a multi-agent world, they will need to learn to cooperate with other agents and with humans to generate mutual benefits. However, cooperation is a challenge because the costs of cooperation are often incurred early on, but the benefits are only realized later, creating an incentive to defect. How can AI agents cooperate with commitment? Here, we draw on inspiration from legal institutions and contracting that human societies have used to solve principal-agent problems of this kind. Contracts provide observable representations of agreements that enable credible commitments through the enforcement of terms. We study the role of contract-based cooperation using LLM-based agents in \CT, a spatial-temporal game that combines bargaining with navigation towards a goal. We study a suite of contract representations that range from formal contracts that compile to code to natural contracts that require reinterpretation. We evaluate agents with a range of LLM backbones using different sizes and providers. We find that self-negotiated contracts can improve cooperative outcomes beyond what is possible with regular trading.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了AI智能体如何通过借鉴人类社会的合同制度来实现可信承诺与合作。在《契约时代》游戏中，LLM驱动的智能体通过自我协商合同（从形式化代码合同到自然语言合同），显著提升了合作效果，超越了常规交易模式。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在多智能体环境中需要学会合作以产生互惠利益，但合作面临"早期成本、晚期收益"的困境，导致背叛动机。现有方法缺乏有效的承诺机制来约束智能体行为。
AI.method: 从人类社会的合同与法律制度获得启发，设计了从形式化合同（可编译为代码）到自然语言合同（需重新解释）的一系列合同表示方法。在结合谈判与导航的时空游戏《契约时代》中，使用不同规模和提供商的LLM骨干模型进行实验评估。
AI.result: 自我协商的合同能够显著改善合作结果，超越传统交易模式所能达到的合作水平。
AI.conclusion: 合同机制为AI智能体提供了一种有效的可信承诺框架，能够解决合作中的时间不一致性问题，为构建更可靠的多智能体协作系统提供了新思路。

title: ConFusion: Continuous Fusion Space Learning for Fine-Grained Controllable Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
summary: Controllable infrared-visible image fusion aims to integrate complementary thermal and structural information with flexible region-aware modulation, producing fused images that adapt to diverse user requirements and downstream tasks. However, existing methods typically rely on predefined discrete control conditions, leading to a sparse space that fails to support fine-grained modulation demands. To address this, we propose ConFusion, a novel framework that learns the continuous fusion space via Gaussian-conditioned spatial-aware modulation, enabling instance-level fine-grained controllable infrared and visible image fusion. ConFusion employs a dual-branch architecture to disentangle modality-invariant and modality-specific representations under joint reconstruction and text-guided semantic alignment. Gaussian-conditioned instance modulation variables coupled with Grounded SAM-based instance masks guide instance-level fine-grained modulation through the Mask-Guided Specific Feature Modulator, while the Text-Driven Invariant Feature Enhancer improves semantic consistency and enhances fusion. During inference, the multimodal large language model parses user intents into instance-level modulation variables to guide image fusion. Extensive experiments show that ConFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics in both fusion quality and downstream tasks, while supporting fine-grained controllable image fusion. Our code is available at https://github.com/HeyufeiAnto/Confusion

AI.tldr: ConFusion提出了一种基于高斯条件空间感知调制的连续融合空间框架，通过实例级细粒度控制实现红外-可见光图像融合，在融合质量和下游任务中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有可控红外-可见光图像融合方法依赖预定义的离散控制条件，导致控制空间稀疏，无法支持细粒度的调制需求。
AI.method: 提出ConFusion框架，采用双分支架构解耦模态不变与模态特定表示；引入高斯条件实例调制变量与Grounded SAM实例掩码，通过掩码引导的特定特征调制器进行实例级细粒度调制；文本驱动的不变特征增强器提升语义一致性；推理时利用多模态大模型解析用户意图生成调制变量。
AI.result: 在多个融合质量和下游任务指标上取得SOTA性能，支持细粒度可控图像融合。
AI.conclusion: ConFusion通过连续融合空间学习与实例级细粒度调制，有效解决了离散控制条件带来的稀疏空间问题，为可控图像融合提供了更灵活、更精准的解决方案。

title: Topological Data Analysis and Graph-Theoretic Approaches for Tennis Match Prediction
summary: We present two approaches for predicting tennis match outcomes using topological data analysis and graph theory on ATP singles matches from 2000-2025. The first method applies lower-star filtration to player competitive networks, extracting topological features through persistent homology using four summary methods (VAB, HNAV, HWNAV, OW-HNPV) combined with Modified Band Depth analysis. Algorithmic optimizations including ego graph approximations and triangle elimination enable analysis of about 66k matches. Our Random Forest model achieves 66.2% accuracy (AUC = 0.719) using topological, graph-theoretic, and ranking features. Feature importance analysis reveals that rankings contribute 36.3%, centralities 25.5%, and TDA features 24.0%, with topological features providing complementary signal. When rankings are unavailable, the topology-only model maintains 63.56% accuracy, demonstrating that network-derived features alone capture meaningful competitive structure. The second method uses a modified Katz similarity index with temporal edge weighting, achieving 62.48% accuracy on held-out test data. This work represents the first application of lower-star filtration to tennis prediction, provides systematic comparison of four topological summary methods in sports analytics, and demonstrates that TDA can achieve above-chance prediction using network topology alone while providing additional value when combined with traditional features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于拓扑数据分析(TDA)和图论的网球比赛结果预测方法，使用2000-2025年ATP单打数据。第一种方法利用下星滤波对球员竞争网络进行持续同调分析，结合随机森林模型达到66.2%准确率；第二种方法采用改进的Katz相似度指数实现62.48%准确率。这是首次将下星滤波应用于网球预测。
AI.motivation: 传统网球预测方法多依赖排名和基本统计数据，缺乏对球员间竞争网络拓扑结构的深入挖掘。作者希望利用TDA捕捉网络中的高阶结构信息，验证拓扑特征能否提供传统特征之外的互补预测信号。
AI.method: 方法一：构建球员竞争网络，应用下星滤波提取持续同调特征，采用四种摘要方法(VAB、HNAV、HWNAV、OW-HNPV)结合改进Band深度分析，通过ego图近似和三角形消除优化处理约6.6万场比赛，最后用随机森林建模。方法二：提出改进的时态边加权Katz相似度指标进行预测。
AI.result: 随机森林模型准确率66.2%，AUC=0.719。特征重要性：排名36.3%、中心性25.5%、TDA特征24.0%。无排名时纯拓扑模型准确率63.56%。Katz方法准确率62.48%。TDA特征提供了互补预测信号。
AI.conclusion: 首次将下星滤波应用于网球预测，系统比较了四种拓扑摘要方法在体育分析中的效果。证明了TDA可以仅利用网络拓扑实现高于随机水平的预测，且与传统特征结合时能提供额外价值。该框架可推广到其他竞技体育的胜负预测。

title: Disentangling Multi-View Scanning in Mamba for Network Traffic Anomaly Detection
summary: Network Traffic Anomaly Detection (NTAD) is a critical task in cybersecurity, yet timely and accurate anomaly detection remains challenging. Mamba has emerged as a particularly promising backbone for NTAD due to its linear-time complexity for long-sequence modeling. It further incorporates a dedicated multi-view scanning mechanism to enhance detection precision through complementary contextual cues. However, we identify a previously overlooked structural deficiency in multi-view Mamba scanning for NTAD: redundancy accumulation. Specifically, distinct scanning branches capture substantial view-invariant information, which is repeatedly amplified during multi-view fusion; conversely, view-specific information is diluted or even suppressed, leading to representation homogenization and multi-view degradation. To address this problem, we propose DisenMamba, a novel disentangled multi-view Mamba framework. DisenMamba reformulates multi-view scanning as a two-stage disentangle-then-fuse process that explicitly separates view-invariant and view-specific components prior to fusion. This design prevents the invariant information accumulation while preserving complementary multi-view cues, yielding more discriminative representations for subtle traffic anomalies. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DisenMamba, establishing a new disentangled multi-view Mamba paradigm. Code is available at https://github.com/ikun0124/DisenMamba.

AI.tldr: 针对多视角Mamba在流量异常检测中存在的冗余累积问题（不同视角分支捕获大量视角不变信息，融合时被重复放大，而视角特有信息被稀释），提出DisenMamba框架，通过先解耦再融合的两阶段流程，显式分离视角不变和视角特有成分，生成更具判别性的表示，实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有Mamba多视角扫描机制在NTAD任务中存在结构缺陷：冗余累积。不同扫描分支捕获了大量视角不变信息，在多视角融合时被反复放大，而视角特有信息被稀释甚至抑制，导致表示同质化，多视角效果退化。
AI.method: 提出DisenMamba框架，将多视角扫描重构为"先解耦再融合"的两阶段过程，在融合前显式分离视角不变成分和视角特有成分，避免不变信息累积，同时保留互补的多视角线索。
AI.result: 广泛实验证明DisenMamba的有效性，建立了新的解耦多视角Mamba范式。
AI.conclusion: DisenMamba通过解耦设计解决了多视角Mamba在NTAD中的冗余累积问题，为流量异常检测提供了更精准的表示能力。

title: Markerless Motion Capture in Routine Clinical Upper Limb Assessments: Validity and Insights Beyond Ordinal Scoring
summary: The Action Research Arm Test (ARAT) is a widely-used upper limb outcome measure in neurorehabilitation, but its ordinal scoring is subjective and suffers from limited sensitivity and specificity. We evaluated whether artificial-intelligence (AI)-based markerless motion capture (MMC), embedded into ARAT assessments during clinical routine, accurately reconstructs upper limb movement and yields valid, objective kinematic metrics carrying clinically meaningful information beyond the ordinal score. Across 47 sessions from 20 mixed-neurological patients (1,174 ARAT tasks), biomechanical reconstruction was accurate and robust across impairment levels, and kinematic metrics showed the discrimination pattern expected of a construct-valid measure. In longitudinal case studies, the metrics added the specificity and sensitivity the ordinal score lacks: a domain decomposition exposed patient-specific recovery profiles underlying equal ARAT gains (specificity), and kinematic improvement continued to be detected after the ARAT had saturated (sensitivity). MMC in clinical routine can thus provide valid, objective, sensitive, and specific kinematic measurement complementing ordinal scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了基于AI的无标记运动捕捉技术（MMC）在临床常规ARAT评估中可准确重建上肢运动，并生成有效、客观的动力学指标，弥补了传统序数评分在敏感性和特异性上的不足。
AI.motivation: ARAT量表虽然广泛用于神经康复的上肢功能评估，但其序数评分主观性强，且敏感性和特异性有限，需要更客观、灵敏的评估方法。
AI.method: 将AI驱动的无标记运动捕捉（MMC）嵌入临床常规ARAT评估流程，对47次评估（20名神经系统患者，共1,174个ARAT任务）进行生物力学重建和动力学指标提取。
AI.result: MMC在不同功能障碍水平下均实现准确鲁棒的重建；动力学指标表现出构念效度应有的区分模式；纵向案例中，领域分解揭示了等ARAT增益下的患者特异性恢复曲线（特异性），且在ARAT评分饱和后仍能检测到动力学改善（敏感性）。
AI.conclusion: 临床常规中部署的MMC能够提供有效、客观、敏感且特异的动力学测量，可作为序数评分的有效补充。

title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
summary: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination. However, existing approaches are predominantly implemented under a single-target, single-state assumption, limiting their ability to model multi-target or multi-state interactions required for advanced function-oriented protein design. Here, we introduce Chamaileon, which unifies multi-target and multi-state binder design by formulating the problem as cross-context binding landscape modeling. The framework is underpinned by a training paradigm termed In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD) for context-aware sequence-structure co-modeling. During inference, we employ Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS), a scalable strategy that optimizes a single sequence across contexts while alleviating the scarcity of high-quality multi-conformational paired data. Extensive evaluation on our newly constructed benchmark, CROSS, demonstrates that Chamaileon effectively generates sequences adaptable to diverse conformational landscapes and multi-target requirements. The code is available on https://github.com/caohengyuan/Chamaileon.

AI.tldr: 提出Chamaileon框架，通过跨情境结合景观建模统一多靶点和多状态结合子设计，采用上下文内复合共设计（I3CD）训练范式和混合路径采样（MoPS）推理策略，在新建CROSS基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型在蛋白质结合子设计中大多基于单靶点、单状态假设，无法建模多靶点或多状态交互，限制了面向高级功能的蛋白质设计能力。
AI.method: 提出Chamaileon框架，核心包括：(1) 将多靶点多状态结合子设计形式化为跨情境结合景观建模；(2) 提出In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD) 训练范式实现情境感知的序列-结构共建模；(3) 提出Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS) 推理策略优化跨情境的单一序列。
AI.result: 在新建的CROSS基准数据集上，Chamaileon能够有效生成适应不同构象景观和多靶点需求的序列。
AI.conclusion: Chamaileon通过统一多靶点多状态结合子设计，突破了现有方法的单目标限制，为复杂功能导向的蛋白质设计提供了新范式。

title: Coordinated Networking for On-Device Agent-Augmented Real-Time Communication
summary: AI agents are enabling a new paradigm of agent-augmented real-time communication (RTC), where humans focus on high-level collaboration, while agents autonomously retrieve, analyze, and generate information in real time to support their interactions. These apps enable new experiences across various domains: for example, when corporate employees co-author a legal document, their agents can discuss and draft on their behalf, sparing them the burden of manually reviewing each other's work. As existing cloud-based agents suffer from privacy risks and unscalable server costs, on-device agent-augmented RTC offers a promising alternative. However, this on-device paradigm introduces a new networking challenge: contention between concurrent traffic flows generated by humans (for live video streaming) and agents (for sending context files for analysis). We design HFS, a framework to ensure both high live video quality and low agent response latency in agent-augmented RTC apps. We achieve the goal through an app-guided multi-flow transport approach, where a unified app-layer orchestrator jointly controls the sending rates of live video and agent context flows based on their heterogeneous app requirements. Our prototype built atop WebRTC and llama.cpp demonstrates that HAFS outperforms baselines, achieving 1.5x higher video quality while reducing agent response time by 31%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HFS框架，通过应用层统一调度器协调视频流和Agent上下文流的发送速率，在设备端Agent增强实时通信中实现高视频质量和低Agent响应延迟，相比基线方法视频质量提升1.5倍，响应时间降低31%。
AI.motivation: 现有云端Agent方案存在隐私风险和服务器成本不可扩展的问题，而设备端Agent增强RTC虽能解决这些问题，但面临人类视频流与Agent上下文流之间的网络竞争挑战，需要同时保证视频质量和Agent低延迟响应。
AI.method: 提出HFS框架，采用应用层引导的多流传输方法，通过统一的应用层协调器（orchestrator）基于异构应用需求联合控制实时视频流和Agent上下文流的发送速率。
AI.result: 基于WebRTC和llama.cpp的原型系统显示，HFS相比基线方法视频质量提升1.5倍，Agent响应时间降低31%。
AI.conclusion: 通过应用层的统一调度可以有效解决设备端Agent增强RTC中多流竞争问题，实现视频质量与Agent响应延迟的双重优化。

title: PathSelect: Sequential Token Selection for Whole Slide Pathology
summary: Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) present a fundamental computational bottleneck for vision-language models (VLMs) due to extreme sequence lengths. Existing approaches predominantly rely on spatial sampling or training-free pruning, which risk diluting weak but informative signals, leading to the loss of critical diagnostic evidence due to the spatially diffuse nature of pathological cues. We reformulate WSI token pruning as a sequential selection process, enabling the model to autonomously learn an optimal routing strategy rather than relying on static heuristics. We herein propose a decoupled routing framework integrated as an active plugin into the fully pre-trained SlideChat base model, leaving both the slide encoder and large language model frozen. To provide continuous gradients for the non-differentiable pruning operation during training, we introduce PathSelect. PathSelect employs a variance-preserving noise gate to modulate each patch's information flow via a differentiable Soft Top-K operator, paired with a diagonal-attention Denoiser that recovers the perturbed representations without semantic leakage. At inference, the PathSelect module is entirely detached. Relying solely on the trained Scorer, a deterministic Hard Top-K operator executes adaptive, data-dependent trajectory termination, significantly accelerating downstream generative processing with exceptionally low sequential token selection latency. Driven by an empirical average of only 44.86 tokens under a maximum constraint of K = 128, our framework achieves 74.00% overall accuracy on SlideBench (TCGA), representing an approximate 36.6x spatial token reduction relative to the uncompressed baseline average while consistently outperforming sampling-based counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathSelect框架，通过可微的Soft Top-K操作和去噪器实现WSI图像的自适应token剪枝，仅用平均44.86个token即在SlideBench上达到74.00%准确率，实现约36.6倍的压缩比。
AI.motivation: 全切片病理图像因极大序列长度给视觉语言模型带来计算瓶颈，现有空间采样或剪枝方法会稀释微弱但关键的病理信号，导致诊断证据丢失。本文旨在让模型自主学到最优路由策略而非依赖静态启发式规则。
AI.method: 提出解耦路由框架PathSelect，作为可插拔模块集成到预训练SlideChat中。训练时采用方差保持噪声门控+可微Soft Top-K提供连续梯度，配合对角注意力去噪器恢复扰动表征；推理时移除去噪器，仅用训练好的Scorer执行确定性Hard Top-K自适应剪枝。
AI.result: 在K=128约束下，平均仅用44.86个token，SlideBench准确率74.00%，相比未压缩基线实现约36.6倍空间token缩减，且一致优于基于采样的方法。
AI.conclusion: 将WSI token剪枝重构为序列选择过程，通过可微训练+推理解耦的设计，在极端压缩率下仍能保留关键诊断信息，验证了自适应路由策略的有效性。

title: Neonatal Hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy Classification from the EEG and HRV Signals Using a Conformer based Masked Autoencoder
comment: Paper submits to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: In this paper, we propose the MAEConformer, a novel self-supervised learning framework that combines the Conformer architecture with the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) paradigm for large-scale representation learning from unlabelled electroencephalography (EEG) and heart rate variability (HRV) signals. By integrating convolutional operations with Transformer-based self-attention, MAEConformer effectively captures both local temporal patterns and long-range contextual dependencies in physiological time series. To enhance reconstruction fidelity and representation quality, a multi-resolution short-time Fourier transform (MR-STFT) loss is incorporated alongside the reconstruction objective, enabling the model to jointly learn temporal and spectral characteristics across multiple scales. Modality-specific EEG and HRV MAEConformer models were pretrained on 6,030h and 4,868h of unlabelled recordings, respectively, and subsequently transferred to expert-annotated downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned representations provide strong transferability and data efficiency. In EEG-based hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) severity classification, the pretrained MAE-EEG model achieved test AUCs of 97.19% and 96.56% for binary and four-class classification tasks, respectively, outperforming a range of state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised baselines. On the HRV-based HIE severity classification task, MAE-HRV achieved a test AUC of 82.42%, surpassing both self-supervised Transformer-based and supervised convolutional baselines. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of MAEConformer for learning robust and transferable representations across multiple physiological modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出MAEConformer框架，结合Conformer架构与掩码自编码器范式，在EEG和HRV信号上进行大规模自监督学习，通过多分辨率STFT损失提升重建质量，在下游HIE严重性分类任务中取得了卓越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在生理信号表示学习中难以同时捕捉局部时间模式与长程上下文依赖，且缺乏大规模无标签数据的有效预训练手段。
AI.method: 将Conformer架构（卷积+Transformer自注意力）与MAE范式结合，引入多分辨率短时傅里叶变换（MR-STFT）损失函数，使模型能够联合学习多尺度时频特征。分别在6030h EEG和4868h HRV无标签数据上预训练。
AI.result: 在HIE严重性分类任务中，MAE-EEG在二分类和四分类上分别达到97.19%和96.56%的AUC；MAE-HRV达到82.42%的AUC，均超越多种监督与自监督基线。
AI.conclusion: MAEConformer能够有效学习鲁棒且可迁移的多模态生理信号表征，在数据效率和转移性能上具有显著优势。

title: What Can Be Enforced? A Theory of Certified Runtime Safety for Tool-Using Agents
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Extended version with complete proofs and additional experiments
summary: Runtime guardrails act before irreversible tool calls, but their guarantees depend on what policy state is representable, what a judge observes, and whether intervention changes future behavior. We separate three questions. First, relative to fixed oracle predicates, a deterministic gate enforces exactly the nonempty safety policies whose good prefixes its register model recognizes; policy nontriviality is undecidable with two decrementable counters but in PSPACE for a separable monotone fragment. Second, under a fixed exogenous law, Neyman-Pearson gives the exact false-block/miss frontier and conformal calibration gives a finite-sample marginal certificate, possibly via block-all. Third, once blocking changes future proposals, static scores and ungated trajectories need not identify the closed-loop frontier; a specified finite controlled model instead yields an occupancy program. Bounded representation attacks add a robustness margin, so benign calibration alone does not transfer. Experiments target these distinctions through static diagnostics, controlled-model enumeration, representation rewrites, and paired closed-loop reruns.

AI.tldr: 本文系统探讨了运行时护栏强制执行安全策略的三个核心问题：策略表示能力、静态检测极限和闭环动态影响，并通过实验区分了这些维度。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时护栏在实际部署中的保证往往不明确，特别是当策略状态表示受限、检测器判断有限、以及干预行为会改变未来提议分布时，亟需建立形式化的理论框架。
AI.method: 分离三个子问题分别分析：(1) 确定性门控的寄存器模型与安全策略的可表示性及计算复杂性；(2) Neyman-Pearson引理给出假阻塞/漏检边界，共形校准提供有限样本边际保证；(3) 闭环场景下静态分数失效，提出有限受控模型的占用程序。
AI.result: (1) 非平凡策略在双计数器下不可判定，在可分单调片段中属于PSPACE；(2) 静态校准可达最优边界但可能退化为全阻塞；(3) 闭环下静态方法无法识别真实前沿，需建模范式；边界表示攻击揭示了鲁棒性差距，纯良性校准不能迁移。
AI.conclusion: 运行时护栏的保证与表示、观察、干预三个因素密不可分，理论分析需区分这三个维度，实验验证了这些理论区别的实际意义。

title: WGDnet: Wishart-guided Geometric-aware Deep Network for PolSAR Image Classification
summary: Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar (PolSAR) classification underpins all-weather Earth observation. Conventional Wishart methods depend on rigid handcrafted operators with limited adaptability, while mainstream deep networks ignore PolSAR native Wishart scattering statistics. Additionally, fixed convolution windows fail to capture multi-scale, multi-directional terrain patterns, harming boundary detection and small-object characterization. To mitigate these drawbacks, we propose WGDNet, a Wishart-guided geometric-aware deep network. It integrates three core designs: (1) learnable Wishart convolutions with directional kernels for multi-scale statistical edge feature extraction; (2) an orientation-prior aggregation module that estimates dominant local directions and confidences to refine directional Wishart outputs adaptively; (3) GAnet, a scale-direction adaptive geometric-aware convolution that dynamically reshapes sampling grids to model anisotropic terrain and retain fine details. Our contributions lie in learnable Wishart statistical modeling, orientation-prior feature aggregation, and geometry-adaptive convolution. Evaluations across four real PolSAR datasets verify WGDNet surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches in classification accuracy and boundary fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出WGDNet，融合可学习Wishart统计建模、方向先验聚合和几何自适应卷积，在四个真实PolSAR数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统Wishart方法依赖固定手工算子适应能力有限，主流深度网络忽视PolSAR的Wishart散射统计特性，且固定卷积窗口无法捕捉多尺度多方向地形模式，损害边界检测和小目标表征。
AI.method: 提出WGDNet，包含三个核心设计：(1)可学习Wishart卷积与方向核，提取多尺度统计边缘特征；(2)方向先验聚合模块，估计局部主导方向和置信度，自适应优化方向Wishart输出；(3)GAnet，尺度方向自适应几何感知卷积，动态重塑采样网格以建模各向异性地形并保留细节。
AI.result: 在四个真实PolSAR数据集上，WGDNet在分类精度和边界保真度方面均超越现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: WGDNet通过将Wishart统计先验与几何自适应深度学习有机结合，有效提升了PolSAR分类性能。

title: Random Forest-Based Prediction of Bone Volume Fraction and Fracture Position from S-Parameters
comment: 5 pages,6 figures,This is a summary report prepared by undergraduate students I supervised, formatted as a letter
summary: In this paper, we propose a method for predicting bone volume fraction (BVF) and fracture position by constructing a random forest model based on multichannel S-parameters. A nine-antenna microwave scanning system is designed and fabricated to acquire the multichannel S-parameter data. Bone-mimicking phantoms are developed, and corresponding experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Both synthetic and experimental results demonstrate the validity of the method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多通道S参数的随机森林模型，用于预测骨体积分数（BVF）和骨折位置，通过九天线微波扫描系统和仿体实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统骨密度和骨折检测方法存在局限性，需要一种更有效的预测骨体积分数和骨折位置的技术手段。
AI.method: 设计并制造了九天线微波扫描系统采集多通道S参数数据，构建随机森林模型进行预测，并通过骨仿体实验进行验证。
AI.result: 合成数据与实验结果均证明了该方法在预测骨体积分数和骨折位置方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于多通道S参数和随机森林模型的微波扫描方法能够有效预测BVF和骨折位置，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Physical AI Governance: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
summary: With the emergence of Physical AI, artificial intelligence is extending beyond screen-based applications to embodied systems that perceive, interact with, and act in the physical world. Unlike traditional AI, Physical AI operates under real-time safety constraints, continuously interacts with dynamic environments, and coexists with humans, introducing governance challenges that existing AI governance frameworks do not explicitly address. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of Physical AI governance from both scientific and operational perspectives. We synthesize existing governance principles and organize them into a unified governance framework tailored to physical AI systems. Building on this foundation, we propose a five-stage Physical AI lifecycle comprising research, design, data, model development, and deployment, and demonstrate how governance can be operationalized across each stage through concrete implementation practices. By connecting governance principles with engineering workflows, this survey provides a structured reference for researchers, developers, and policymakers to build Physical AI systems that are safe, trustworthy, and aligned with societal values.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了Physical AI的治理问题，提出了一个针对物理AI系统的统一治理框架，并构建了包含研究、设计、数据、模型开发和部署五个阶段的治理生命周期，将治理原则与工程流程相结合。
AI.motivation: Physical AI（实体人工智能）正在从屏幕应用扩展到与物理世界交互的具身系统，面临实时安全约束、动态环境交互和人机共存等独特挑战，而现有AI治理框架尚未明确涵盖这些方面。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，综合现有治理原则，将其整合为针对Physical AI的统一治理框架，并提出五阶段Physical AI生命周期（研究、设计、数据、模型开发、部署），展示如何在各阶段实施具体治理实践。
AI.result: 构建了一个从科学和操作双重视角出发的Physical AI治理框架，明确了五阶段生命周期中各阶段的治理实施路径。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为研究人员、开发者和政策制定者提供了结构化参考，有助于构建安全、可信赖且与社会价值观一致的Physical AI系统。

title: GRAPE: Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation
summary: Articulated portrait mesh estimation is fundamental to 3D understanding, avatar generation, and immersive interaction. Existing approaches primarily rely on 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs). However, face-centric models suffer from the "floating head" assumption, conflating head pose with global rotation due to the lack of neck kinematics. Conversely, body-centric models lack high-fidelity facial expression capabilities. Furthermore, current methods struggle to disentangle jaw articulation from expression blendshapes, often over-relying on expressions for mouth opening. These limitations make monocular portrait recovery difficult across representation, supervision, and anatomical parameter estimation. To address these limitations, we introduce GRAPE(Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation). We build a Portrait Parametric Model (PPM) with an explicit torso-to-head kinematic chain and a canonical injection step to merge FLAME and the SMPL-X torso. We propose a Progressive Anatomical Alignment (PAA) network, which is composed of a pretrained portrait encoder, a Graduated-Mask Router, and coarse-to-fine experts that follow the portrait anatomical prior. We then train this network with multi-source supervision that combines sparse anatomical keypoints, feature distillation, foreground mask constraints, and relative geometry constraints. Experiments show that GRAPE improves portrait mesh recovery quality, pose alignment, and jaw--expression disentanglement over prior methods. We also demonstrate that our method can benefit the downstream tasks of audio-driven talking-head generation and 3D portrait generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAPE方法，通过建立包含躯干-头部运动链的人像参数化模型（PPM）和渐进式解剖对齐网络（PAA），解决了现有方法在头部浮动、颈部运动缺失、面部表情与下颌关节解耦困难等问题，实现了更优的单目人像网格重建、姿态对齐和下颌-表情解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人像重建方法存在三大局限：1）面部模型忽略颈部运动，导致"浮动头部"问题；2）身体模型缺乏高保真面部表情能力；3）难以将下颌关节运动与表情混合变形解耦，过度依赖表情来实现张嘴。这些问题阻碍了单目人像重建在表示、监督和参数估计方面的发展。
AI.method: 1) 构建人像参数化模型（PPM），融合FLAME和SMPL-X躯干，引入明确的躯干-头部运动链和规范化注入步骤；2) 设计渐进式解剖对齐网络（PAA），包含预训练人像编码器、渐进掩码路由器和遵循解剖先验的由粗到细专家组；3) 采用多源监督训练，结合稀疏解剖关键点、特征蒸馏、前景掩码约束和相对几何约束。
AI.result: GRAPE在人像网格重建质量、姿态对齐和下颌-表情解耦方面优于现有方法，并在音频驱动说话头部生成和3D人像生成等下游任务中展现出良好效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入解剖先验的渐进式路由网络和统一的躯干-头部参数化模型，GRAPE有效解决了单目人像重建中的关键瓶颈，为后续的人像生成和交互任务提供了更可靠的几何基础。

title: MS-GPT: Rethinking MS/MS De Novo Structure Elucidation as Spectrum-Induced Posterior Querying of a Molecule-Language Model
comment: 18 pages, 14 figures, and 9 tables, including appendices. Source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT
summary: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) is a central inverse problem in analytical chemistry. Most existing approaches to MS/MS identification remain tied to reference libraries or predefined candidate sets, whereas de novo methods aim to generate structures directly from spectra. A common de novo route predicts a molecular fingerprint from the spectrum and then decodes structures from it, enabling decoder pretraining on large molecule-only corpora. However, this paradigm creates a training-inference mismatch: the decoder is trained on oracle fingerprints computed from molecules, but at inference it is queried with a noisy spectrum-induced fingerprint posterior that is typically collapsed to a single thresholded fingerprint. We introduce MS-GPT, which recasts fingerprint-mediated de novo elucidation as spectrum-induced posterior querying of a conditional molecule-language model. MS-GPT conditions a molecule-language model on fingerprints and formulas, then converts the spectrum-induced posterior into a band of fingerprint queries near the oracle-fingerprint manifold through active-bit density calibration. Candidates sampled across this band are pooled and ranked by generation-frequency consensus. A lightweight LoRA adapter further mitigates domain-specific posterior bias while preserving the pretrained molecular prior. On NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym, MS-GPT sets a new state of the art, reaching Top-1/Top-10 exact-match accuracy of 29.8\%/41.1\% and 23.9\%/28.7\%, respectively. Candidate-pool scaling shows that efficient autoregressive molecular generation continues to improve recall with a little additional inference cost. The source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MS-GPT，通过将指纹介导的从头解析重新定义为谱图诱导后验查询条件分子语言模型，解决了训练-推理不匹配问题，在NPLIB1和MassSpecGym上取得了新的SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于指纹的从头质谱解析方法存在训练-推理不匹配问题：解码器在oracle指纹上训练，但推理时输入的是噪声谱图诱导的、被阈值化截断的指纹后验，导致性能受损。
AI.method: 1) 将分子语言模型条件化于指纹和分子式；2) 通过active-bit密度校准将谱图诱导后验转换为oracle指纹流形附近的指纹查询带；3) 在该带上采样候选结构，通过生成频率共识进行排序；4) 使用轻量级LoRA适配器缓解后验域偏移。
AI.result: 在NPLIB1上Top-1/Top-10准确率达29.8%/41.1%，在MassSpecGym上达23.9%/28.7%，均超越现有方法。候选池扩展实验表明自回归分子生成能以较低推理成本持续提升召回率。
AI.conclusion: MS-GPT通过后验查询机制有效弥合了训练-推理差距，为质谱从头解析提供了新范式，且代码和模型已开源。

title: XMatchAD: A Cross-Modal Matching Perspective on Reconstruction-based Anomaly Detection
comment: accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: The remarkable success of reconstruction-based methods in Unsupervised Anomaly Detection (UAD) lies in their ability to identify and localize anomalies by modeling discrepancies between input images and their reconstructed counterparts. However, these approaches often struggle to capture subtle anomalies and tend to produce blurred anomaly boundaries, which significantly limits their effectiveness, particularly in complex multi-class scenarios. To address these issues, we present XMatchAD, a novel UAD framework that reinterprets the task from a pseudo cross-modal matching perspective. Specifically, the input and reconstructed images are treated as two complementary modalities and their matching relationships are precisely exploited for anomaly detection. First, a pre-trained feature extractor is employed to encode discriminative representations. Second, an attention-guided cross-modal matching mechanism is introduced to match local inter-modal anomaly-related patterns while mutually refining the features. This enhances the sensitivity to anomalies with diverse shapes and subtle deviations and significantly improves the precision of anomaly detection and localization. Third, we design an adaptive frequency-aware fusion module that further delineates sharp anomaly boundaries through the coupling of high-frequency components from cross-modal multi-scale representations. Comprehensive evaluations on MVTec-AD, VisA, and MPDD benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in multi-class anomaly detection and localization. The code will be released at https://github.com/Mingxiu-Cai/XMatchAD.

AI.tldr: XMatchAD是一种新颖的无监督异常检测框架，通过将输入图像与重建图像视为伪跨模态匹配关系，利用注意力引导的跨模态匹配机制和自适应频率感知融合模块，有效提升了多类场景下细微异常和模糊边界的检测精度，在多个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于重建的无监督异常检测方法虽能通过输入与重建图像的差异识别异常，但在捕捉细微异常和处理模糊异常边界方面表现不佳，尤其在复杂多类场景下局限性明显。本文旨在解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出XMatchAD框架，核心包含三个模块：(1) 预训练特征提取器编码判别性表示；(2) 注意力引导的跨模态匹配机制，将输入与重建图像视为两种互补模态，匹配局部跨模态异常相关模式并相互精炼特征；(3) 自适应频率感知融合模块，通过耦合跨模态多尺度表示的高频成分，描绘清晰的异常边界。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD、VisA和MPDD三个基准数据集上的全面评估表明，该方法在多类异常检测和定位任务中持续取得优异性能，超越了现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将UAD重新诠释为伪跨模态匹配任务，XMatchAD有效提升了异常检测的精度和边界清晰度，为多类场景下的无监督异常检测提供了新的有效范式。

title: Restoration Flow Matching-Based Channel Refinement and Equalization Correction for MIMO Semantic Communications
summary: In multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) semantic communication, imperfect channel state information (CSI) and equalization mismatch can seriously degrade semantic reconstruction quality. To address this issue, we propose a unified restoration flow matching (RFM)-based framework for channel refinement and equalization correction. Specifically, the channel RFM (CRFM) module is developed to refine the coarse channel, thereby improving channel estimation accuracy. Based on the refined channel, the developed semantic RFM (SRFM) module is employed to correct the residual distortions in the post-equalization latent space. The key idea is to formulate the two cascaded inverse problems of channel estimation and equalization as the unified conditional restoration task, in which the learned conditional velocity field guides the perturbed distribution towards the target distribution. To enhance the robustness of these two modules under various distortion conditions, we develop a dual-anchor perturbation training strategy that jointly learns near-manifold refinement and large-error correction, and implement inference through a few-step deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver. Extensive experiments on MIMO channels and visual semantic transmission tasks demonstrate that the proposed scheme improves key metrics for channel estimation and semantic reconstruction quality. Moreover, compared with representative diffusion-based generative baselines, the proposed method requires fewer sampling steps.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于恢复流匹配（RFM）的统一框架，用于MIMO语义通信中的信道细化和均衡校正，通过双锚点扰动训练策略和少量ODE求解步骤，显著提升信道估计精度和语义重建质量。
AI.motivation: 在MIMO语义通信中，不完美的信道状态信息（CSI）和均衡失配会严重降低语义重建质量，现有方法对此问题缺乏有效的统一解决方案。
AI.method: 提出统一RFM框架，包含CRFM模块（细化粗信道）和SRFM模块（校正后均衡潜在空间的残余失真）；将信道估计和均衡的两个级联逆问题统一为条件恢复任务；开发双锚点扰动训练策略以增强鲁棒性；通过少量步数的确定性ODE求解器进行推理。
AI.result: 在MIMO信道和视觉语义传输任务上，所提方案在信道估计和语义重建质量的关键指标上均优于现有方法，且相比扩散生成基线需要更少的采样步数。
AI.conclusion: RFM框架有效解决了CSI不完美和均衡失配导致的语义重建退化问题，具有高效、鲁棒的优势。

title: Agent Team Work Zone: An Automated, Persistent Workspace for Long-Lived Coding Agent Teams
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have significantly improved coding and programming workflows. Claude Code, in particular, is one of the most powerful LLM coding agents and is capable of conducting complex coding tasks. However, several drawbacks can undermine long-term agentic workflows. (1) Irrecoverable agent teams: The Agent Teams feature is powerful, but the working state accumulated by each teammate is lost and cannot be resumed once the process stops, for example, when a terminal is closed. (2) Compaction erodes working detail: Compaction condenses the conversation into a summary, causing an agent's working details to become vague. (3) Agentic "technical debt": Over time, a user's decisions and the agents' operations become trapped in compacted old chats, making the project increasingly difficult to maintain and review. (4) Heavy prompt writing: Assigning or handing off tasks requires users to repeatedly write long prompts to achieve the expected agentic performance. We propose ATWZ (Agent Team Work Zone), a filesystem-based operations layer built around Claude Code's native Agent Teams that addresses these problems. Its central design principle is to treat each agent and teammate as a human employee and preserve their important working state in files stored in a dedicated directory called a "workstation," together with the skills, hooks, and scripts that use and maintain these files. With ATWZ, an agent team can periodically back up its working state, allowing an agent's knowledge to be recovered after compaction. After a process ends, the team can be restored with a single command. These features also substantially mitigate the agentic "technical debt" described above. Moreover, within ATWZ, agent "employees" can send documents to one another, greatly reducing the effort required to write prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATWZ（Agent Team Work Zone），一种基于文件系统的操作层，用于解决Claude Code等LLM编码智能体在长期工作流中面临的会话状态丢失、细节模糊、技术债务累积和提示编写负担重等问题，通过将智能体视为“员工”并持久化其工作状态到文件系统中，实现团队恢复、状态备份与文档传递。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM编码智能体（如Claude Code）在长期工作流中存在四个关键问题：(1) 智能体团队的工作状态在进程终止后无法恢复；(2) 会话压缩导致工作细节丢失；(3) 用户决策和操作被锁在压缩的旧对话中，形成“技术债务”；(4) 任务分配和交接需要用户反复编写长提示词，效率低下。
AI.method: ATWZ的设计核心是将每个智能体及其队友视为“人类员工”，在专用目录（称为“工作站”）中将重要工作状态持久化为文件，并配套技能（skills）、钩子（hooks）和脚本（scripts）来维护这些文件。具体包括：周期性备份工作状态以便压缩后恢复知识；通过单命令恢复终止后的团队状态；实现智能体之间文档互传以减少提示词编写负担。
AI.result: ATWZ能够使智能体团队在进程结束后通过单命令恢复；压缩后仍可通过文件恢复知识；文档互传大幅降低了提示词编写量；有效缓解因信息丢失导致的“技术债务”问题。
AI.conclusion: ATWZ通过文件系统级的持久化机制，将智能体工作状态从短暂的会话中解放出来，显著提升了LLM编码智能体在长期、复杂编程任务中的可持续性和可维护性，为智能体团队协作提供了一种实用的基础设施方案。

title: RRTrack: Robust and Recoverable Object 6D Pose Tracking for Dynamic Scenes
comment: 6D Pose Tracking, 10 pages, real-world experiments, training-free
summary: Robust object 6D pose tracking is critical for robotic systems operating in dynamic and occluded scenes. Per-frame estimators are accurate but computationally expensive, while current trackers struggle with fast motion and complete occlusion due to their reliance on continuous visibility. To address these challenges, we present RRTrack, an efficient, recoverable object 6D pose tracker that enables robust tracking through fast motion and target disappearance--reappearance. RRTrack introduces a 2D--6D closed-loop tracking strategy that integrates memory-based video object segmentation (VOS) with 6D pose refinement. The 2D branch maintains target localization, and the 6D branch verifies geometric consistency before memory updates. In addition, a DINOv2-based dual-bank template matching module is developed to recover lost targets by jointly exploiting offline synthetic templates and online observation anchors while maintaining real-time efficiency. We also introduce a synthetic RGB-D benchmark comprising three robotic scenarios with fast motion and full occlusion. Experimental results on the synthetic benchmark demonstrate that RRTrack improves equal-subset mean ADD-S AR by 66.3\% and ADD-S AUC by 65.7\% over FoundationPose while achieving 55.2 FPS. Real-world experiments further validate the robustness of RRTrack under noisy sensing conditions. Project page: https://github.com/7kevin24/RRTrack

AI.tldr: RRTrack是一个高效、可恢复的6D物体姿态追踪器，结合2D-6D闭环策略与DINOv2双库模板匹配，在快速运动和完全遮挡场景下显著优于FoundationPose（ADD-S AR提升66.3%，AUC提升65.7%），并达到了55.2 FPS的实时性能。
AI.motivation: 现有每帧估计算法精度高但计算成本大，而当前追踪器依赖连续可见性，在快速运动和完全遮挡时表现不佳，亟需一种既高效又能在目标消失后恢复追踪的鲁棒方案。
AI.method: 提出2D-6D闭环追踪策略：2D分支利用基于记忆的视频目标分割（VOS）维持目标定位，6D分支验证几何一致性后再更新记忆；开发基于DINOv2的双库模板匹配模块，联合利用离线合成模板和在线观测锚点实现丢失目标恢复；同时构建了包含快速运动和完全遮挡的合成RGB-D基准。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，相比FoundationPose，等子集平均ADD-S AR提升66.3%，ADD-S AUC提升65.7%，速度达55.2 FPS；真实实验验证了在噪声传感条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RRTrack通过2D-6D闭环设计与可恢复机制，有效解决了快速运动和完全遮挡下的6D姿态追踪难题，兼顾了精度、鲁棒性与实时性。

title: Optimal Reward Shaping: Autonomous Car Parking Case Study
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Includes supplementary video demonstration and open-source code link
summary: Designing effective reward functions for model-free reinforcement learning under non-holonomic constraints remains a persistent challenge, often resulting in severe local minima such as policy paralysis or over-conservative hazard avoidance. In this work, we present a parameterized reward shaping framework featuring coverage-gated alignment feedback, drive-direction switch regularization, and an aligned episode termination mechanism evaluated on an autonomous parallel parking task. Crucially, we show that environmental reward parameters and algorithmic hyperparameters are deeply co-dependent, requiring joint meta-optimization to achieve stable convergence. By employing surrogate-based Bayesian optimization, our co-optimized Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent resolves characteristic control failure modes, significantly outperforming uncalibrated baselines across both success rate and trajectory smoothness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非完整约束下模型无关强化学习的奖励函数设计难题，提出了一种参数化的奖励塑形框架（含覆盖门控对齐反馈、驱动方向切换正则化、对齐回合终止机制），并利用基于代理的贝叶斯优化对环境奖励参数与算法超参数进行联合元优化，在自动平行泊车任务中显著优于未校准基线。
AI.motivation: 非完整约束下模型无关强化学习的奖励函数设计常导致策略瘫痪或过度保守的避障等局部极小值问题，现有方法缺乏对奖励参数与算法超参数协同依赖关系的关注。
AI.method: 提出参数化奖励塑形框架（覆盖门控对齐反馈、驱动方向开关正则化、对齐回合终止机制），并采用基于代理的贝叶斯优化对环境奖励参数与算法超参数进行联合元优化。
AI.result: 联合优化的DQN智能体在自动平行泊车任务中解决了特征性控制失败模式，在成功率和轨迹平滑度上显著优于未校准基线。
AI.conclusion: 环境奖励参数与算法超参数存在深度相互依赖关系，需要联合元优化才能实现稳定收敛，所提框架有效缓解了非完整约束下的控制失败问题。

title: SAGE: Safety-First Defense-in-Depth Guardrails for Verified Lifecycle Control of High-Impact Generative AI
summary:
High-impact generative AI makes catastrophic misuse a lifecycle-control problem, not merely a prompt-filtering problem. SAGE is a safety-first, authorization-separated architecture in which credible catastrophic-enablement risk constrains admissibility before utility, latency, or commercial objectives are considered. It combines signed release manifests, diverse detectors, robust risk envelopes, least-risk defaults, output checking, three-valued monitoring, protected audit chains, containment, and rollback. Formal results establish safety priority, conservative detector bounds, monotone release gating, tamper-evident records, and an authorization cut; two PRISM abstractions verify authorization separation and lifecycle invariants under explicit assumptions.
  A frozen, vendor-symmetric study sent 84 cases to each of four GPT, four Claude, and two Gemini snapshots: 840 calls yielded 794 target responses, 46 provider errors, and 449 successful judgments covering 375 responses. Eight snapshots had complete judged domain coverage. Harmful-compliance estimates were low; variation arose mainly from benign utility and safe redirection. Seven multiplicity-adjusted contrasts involving Claude, Gemini, or GPT-5 snapshots and the GPT-5 mini and GPT-5 nano snapshots were supported, while no tested contrast between the Claude or Gemini snapshots and GPT-5 or GPT-5.5 survived correction.
  The observed harmful-compliance range is a conservative, protocol-bound view from one generation per prompt with no tools, retrieval, history, or human adjudication; it is not an upper bound on operational assistance. A preregistered extension specifies how to test a wider best-worst gap using a locked split, repeated sampling, multi-turn and sandboxed-tool conditions, and domain-expert scoring.

AI.tldr: SAGE提出了一种安全优先、授权分离的生成式AI架构，将灾难性滥用作为全生命周期控制问题处理，通过形式化验证和实验评估表明该方法在保证安全性的同时维持低有害合规率。
AI.motivation: 高影响力生成式AI的灾难性滥用不能仅靠提示过滤解决，需要从全生命周期进行控制。现有方法在安全与效用之间缺乏结构化的优先级保障。
AI.method: 提出SAGE架构，包含签名发布清单、多样化检测器、鲁棒风险包络、最小风险默认、输出检查、三值监控、审计链、隔离和回滚机制。使用PRISM抽象进行形式化验证，并通过840次调用跨GPT、Claude、Gemini模型进行实验评估。
AI.result: 840次调用获得794个目标响应，449个成功判定覆盖375个响应。有害合规率估计较低，变异主要来自良性效用和安全重定向。Claude、Gemini与GPT-5系列之间的对比未通过多重性校正。
AI.conclusion: SAGE架构在形式化层面建立了安全优先级、保守检测边界等关键性质。实验表明该方法可行，但观测到的有害合规率是保守的协议绑定视图，需通过扩展实验探索更广泛的性能差距。

title: Contrastive Parameter Disentanglement for Multi-modal Remote Sensing Image Generation
summary: Existing remote sensing image generation methods are largely confined to single-modality synthesis and therefore fail to exploit the complementary information inherent in multimodal imagery. To address this limitation, we propose a contrastive parameter disentanglement framework for multimodal remote sensing image generation, which generates semantically consistent and structurally aligned images across multiple modalities, including optical, infrared, and synthetic aperture radar (SAR), from a single text prompt. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive parameter disentanglement module that disentangles shared semantics from modality-specific attributes at the parameter level within an orthogonal core subspace. Based on this module, we develop a disentangled optimization strategy that first constrains the parameter matrix A of the LoRA adapter to capture modality-invariant semantics through a multimodal contrastive objective and then guides multiple parameter matrices B to learn modality-specific attributes under text conditioning. This strategy enables the simultaneous generation of multimodal images with consistent semantic content and distinct modality characteristics. Furthermore, to ensure structural alignment across the generated images, we devise a query-key structure transfer mechanism that jointly models multimodal sampling trajectories during inference by transferring structural correlation priors from an anchor modality to the remaining modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art remote sensing image generation approaches in terms of generation quality, semantic consistency, and structural alignment, while also achieving superior performance in the downstream object classification task.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种对比参数解耦框架，用于从单一文本提示同时生成光学、红外和SAR等多模态遥感图像，解决了现有方法仅支持单模态合成的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感图像生成方法局限于单模态合成，无法利用多模态图像中固有的互补信息。
AI.method: 提出对比参数解耦模块（在正交核心子空间中将共享语义与模态特有属性在参数级别解耦） + 解耦优化策略（先约束LoRA适配器参数矩阵A通过多模态对比目标捕获模态不变语义，再引导参数矩阵B学习模态特有属性） + 查询-键结构迁移机制（在推理阶段通过从锚定模态向其他模态迁移结构相关性先验，联合建模多模态采样轨迹）。
AI.result: 在生成质量、语义一致性和结构对齐方面优于现有遥感图像生成方法，并在下游目标分类任务中取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 对比参数解耦框架能够有效实现多模态遥感图像的同步生成，兼顾语义一致性、结构对齐与模态特异性。

title: Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA):TailoredAttentionMattersfor Science
summary: Attention enables context modeling via query-key scoring with softmax normalization. Driven by industrial long-context demands, mainstream research has converged toward sparsity and efficiency--yet softmax's independence assumption persists. For scientific tasks unburdened by long-token constraints, however, richer structured coupling may often be essential, making tailored attention both viable and more appropriate. To this end, we propose Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA), which augments softmax normalization with an interacting Ising model; attention patterns emerge from learnable pairwise couplings via variational mean-field inference, redefining attention from a ranking over isolated items to a collective state over interacting entities. We instantiate VIA on retrosynthesis reaction center prediction, a task inherently governed by cooperative bond-breaking constraints. Comprehensive experiments across model variants, coupled with mechanistic analyses, demonstrate that VIA consistently and substantially outperforms standard softmax attention. More broadly, our findings suggest that for scientific problems, the optimal solution is not general-purpose efficiency, but appropriately tailored attention aligned with intrinsic domain structure. This work provides a theoretically grounded and empirically validated instantiation of this paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变分伊辛注意力（VIA），用伊辛模型增强softmax归一化，通过变分平均场推断学习成对耦合，使注意力从独立项排序转变为交互实体的集体状态。在逆合成反应中心预测任务上，VIA显著优于标准softmax注意力，表明科学问题需要与领域内在结构对齐的定制化注意力机制。
AI.motivation: 现有主流注意力研究偏向稀疏化和高效性以应对长上下文需求，但softmax的独立性假设在科学任务中可能不适用。科学任务常需要更丰富的结构化耦合，因此有必要设计针对性的注意力机制。
AI.method: 提出Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA)，将softmax归一化与伊辛模型结合。注意力模式通过学习成对耦合参数，经变分平均场推断得出，将注意力从独立项的排序重新定义为交互实体的集体状态。
AI.result: 在逆合成反应中心预测任务上，VIA在多种模型变体下均一致且显著优于标准softmax注意力。通过机理分析进一步验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 科学问题的最优解不是通用高效的方法，而是与领域内在结构对齐的定制化注意力机制。VIA从理论和实验两方面证明了这一范式。

title: Design Theater: A Benchmark for Generative UI
summary: Generative UI tools promise to democratize UI design by turning natural language descriptions into complete interfaces. Alongside the interface, these tools generate user-facing design rationales that explain their layout, accessibility, and design choices. However, it remains unclear whether these stated rationales are actually reflected in the interfaces they produce. We call this disconnect ``Design Theater'': plausible and confident design rationales that have little relationship to the actual implementation. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a benchmark and three metrics for measuring Design Theater. The benchmark includes 24 UI generation tasks spanning structural, styling, and functional design requirements. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 120 interfaces created by five generative UI tools. On average, over 25\% of user-facing design rationales are not implemented in the generated interface, and the implementation failure increases to 34\% for functional requirements. Tools recognize roughly half of the UX principles embedded in prompts (mean = 0.54), with four of five tools implementing 6\% or fewer functional principles. We also measure interface similarity across tools and find convergence in visual appearance and layout organization, with greater variation in color choices. Overall, we contribute: 1) the concept of Design Theater; 2) a benchmark with metrics for assessing whether the stated reasoning of generative UI tools is reflected in their implementations; 3) and findings from a systematic evaluation of these tools. We discuss what these findings mean for the design and evaluation of generative UI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"设计剧场"（Design Theater）概念，指生成式UI工具宣称的设计理由与实际实现之间存在脱节。通过构建包含24个任务的基准测试和三项评估指标，对5种工具生成的120个界面进行评估，发现平均超过25%的设计理由未在界面中实现，功能性需求的实现失败率高达34%。
AI.motivation: 生成式UI工具在生成界面的同时会输出用户可见的设计理由（如布局、可访问性、设计选择等），但这些理由是否真正反映在实际生成的界面中尚不明确。作者希望揭示并量化这种"说一套做一套"的现象。
AI.method: 1) 提出"Design Theater"概念；2) 构建包含24个UI生成任务的基准测试（覆盖结构、样式、功能三类需求）；3) 设计三项评估指标；4) 对5种生成式UI工具生成的120个界面进行系统评估。
AI.result: 平均超过25%的设计理由未在界面中实现；功能性需求实现失败率达34%；工具平均只能识别prompt中约54%的UX原则；五种工具中有四种实现的功能性原则不超过6%；不同工具在视觉外观和布局组织上趋同，颜色选择差异较大。
AI.conclusion: 生成式UI工具存在严重的"设计剧场"问题——宣称的设计理由与实际实现脱节。作者为此提供了评估方法和实证发现，并对未来生成式UI工具的设计与评估提出了建议。

title: Perturbation-Aware Diffusion-Guided Hybrid Segmentation for Robust and Annotation-Efficient Plant Stress Phenotyping
summary: Semantic segmentation in agricultural imagery is often evaluated under in-domain protocols, yet practical deployment requires robustness to appearance perturbations, limited annotations, and cross domain shift. This paper presents a diffusion-guided hybrid segmentation framework in which U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer backbones generate coarse masks that are refined by Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM), latent diffusion, or semantic-guided diffusion. The framework is evaluated through a 3x3 architectural screening study on PlantSegV3, followed by boundary-constrained optimization, perturbation-guided retraining, low-data evaluation, constrained hyperparameter screening, and controlled cross-domain adaptation. On PlantSegV3, the best selected hybrid model achieves 71.83% refined mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) and 26.10% refined Boundary-F1, and the selected models remain stable under substantially reduced supervision, demonstrating strong annotation efficiency. Perturbation analysis identifies grayscale conversion, fog, coarse dropout, and shadow as the most disruptive appearance shifts, and the resulting augmentation policy substantially improves robustness during retraining. The adapted models further show effective transfer to external agricultural datasets under limited target supervision, indicating that diffusion refinement and boundary-aware optimization provide transferable structural priors. Overall, the results show that carefully matched backbone-refiner pairings, combined with perturbation-aware retraining, can improve structural delineation and robustness under realistic resource and distribution constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩散引导的混合分割框架，通过U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SegFormer骨干网络生成粗掩码，再由DDPM、潜在扩散或语义引导扩散进行细化。在PlantSegV3上最佳模型达到71.83%细化mIoU和26.10%细化Boundary-F1，在低数据、扰动鲁棒性和跨域迁移方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 农业图像语义分割在实际部署中面临外观扰动、标注不足和跨域偏移等挑战，现有方法多局限于域内评估，缺乏对鲁棒性和资源约束的综合考量。
AI.method: 提出扩散引导混合分割框架：U-Net/DeepLabV3+/SegFormer生成粗掩码，经DDPM/潜在扩散/语义引导扩散细化。通过3×3结构筛选、边界约束优化、扰动引导重训练、低数据评估、超参数筛选和跨域适应进行系统评估。
AI.result: PlantSegV3上最佳模型达到71.83%细化mIoU和26.10%细化Boundary-F1；灰度转换、雾、粗丢弃和阴影是最具破坏性的扰动；重训练显著提升鲁棒性；模型在低标注和跨域场景下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 精心匹配的骨干-细化器组合结合扰动感知重训练，可在现实资源和分布约束下改善结构描绘和鲁棒性，扩散细化与边界感知优化提供了可迁移的结构先验。

title: CALMRec: Causally Aligned Language Memory for Long-Horizon Recommendation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can summarize heterogeneous user evidence in natural language, but current LLM recommenders often collapse enduring preferences, transient intent, and exposure-induced behavior into one profile. This makes recommendation vulnerable to feedback loops: repeated exposure is mistaken for preference, immediate clicks dominate delayed satisfaction, and fluent explanations need not reflect the ranking decision. We propose our method, a model-agnostic framework for long-horizon recommendation. Our method uses a frozen multimodal language model to convert item content and feedback into evidence-grounded semantic atoms, then maintains separate short-term, long-term, and exposure memories. Propensity-weighted updates reduce policy-induced exposure bias, while a conservative offline critic reranks candidates for delayed satisfaction under a behavior-support constraint. Explanations use only influential evidence atoms and are checked by counterfactual deletion. We provide an identification result and evaluate the framework in e-commerce-like, news-like, and short-video-like environments. Across ten seeds, our method improves discounted long-term value over the strongest alternative by 6.1%, 7.6%, and 6.7%, respectively. Twenty-seed paired ablations show significant value drops after removing propensity correction (0.739 +/- 0.191) or conservative support regularization (0.523 +/- 0.234). A frozen instruction language model also more than doubles semantic-atom NDCG over TF-IDF on a held-out paraphrase benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模型无关的长期推荐框架，通过冻结多模态语言模型将证据转化为语义原子，分别维护短期、长期和曝光记忆，并用倾向性加权更新、保守离线评论家及反事实删除解释来缓解反馈循环问题，在多种环境中显著提升了长期折扣价值。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐系统将持久偏好、瞬时意图和曝光诱导行为混为一个画像，导致反馈循环：反复曝光被误认为偏好、即时点击主导延迟满足、流畅解释未必反映真实排序决策。
AI.method: 1）使用冻结多模态语言模型将物品内容和反馈转化为证据型语义原子；2）分别维护短期、长期和曝光记忆；3）倾向性加权更新减少策略诱导的曝光偏差；4）保守离线评论家在行为支持约束下重新排序候选物品以优化延迟满足；5）解释仅使用影响性证据原子并通过反事实删除校验。
AI.result: 在电商类、新闻类和短视频类环境中，方法相比最强基线分别提升6.1%、7.6%和6.7%的长期折扣价值。消融实验显示去除倾向性校正（0.739±0.191）或保守支持正则化（0.523±0.234）后价值显著下降。冻结指令语言模型在语义原子NDCG指标上比TF-IDF翻倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了推荐系统中的反馈循环问题，通过分离不同时间尺度的记忆、校正曝光偏差和保障延迟满足，显著提升了长期推荐价值，且解释具有可验证性。

title: Let AI Agents Translate Networks, Not Reason About Them
summary:
A formal model enables verifying reachability, localizing an outage, or anticipating the blast radius of a change. Yet, virtually no production network has one, since writing a model by hand demands rare expertise and is hard to keep current as the network changes frequently. At its core, network modeling is a typographical exercise: it translates network artifacts (e.g., configurations, topology, and routing state) into rules in formal logic. Translation of this kind is what large language models (LLMs) nowadays do well. Unlike free-form AI reasoning, such translation can be formally verified.
  Once modeling is no longer the bottleneck, trusting AI to reason over large, complex networks no longer makes sense. Our position therefore cuts against the prevailing race to put autonomous AI agents in charge end-to-end. We instead confine AI to translation and rely on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning, building a reusable formal model of general network behavior that can then be specialized to specific tasks, e.g., root-cause analysis (RCA). We build TypoNet that constructs and validates a symbolic model of an emulated production-scale WAN from the network's own artifacts. Our preliminary evaluation shows TypoNet helps in two ways. On its own, TypoNet answers operational questions (e.g., reachability verification and change-impact analysis) faster, more cheaply, and more reliably than an LLM. As a tool for an AI agent, TypoNet boosts fault localization at lower cost. The result makes the case for AI that builds verifiable network models and relies on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TypoNet，利用 LLM 将网络配置自动翻译为形式化模型，再通过求解器进行可靠推理，避免让 AI 端到端自主决策。初步实验表明，TypoNet 在可达性验证、变更影响分析和故障定位上比纯 LLM 更快速、更廉价、更可靠。
AI.motivation: 生产网络几乎没有一个拥有形式化模型，因为手工编写模型需要稀缺的专业知识，且难以及时跟上频繁的网络变更。虽然形式化模型能验证可达性、定位故障或预测变更影响半径，但建模成本过高成为瓶颈。
AI.method: TypoNet 将 LLM 限定在翻译任务（将网络配置、拓扑和路由状态转换为形式逻辑规则），然后依靠求解器进行可靠的长程推理。系统构建一个可复用的通用网络行为形式化模型，再针对具体任务（如根因分析）进行特化。
AI.result: 在仿真的大规模 WAN 上，TypoNet 独立回答运维问题（可达性验证、变更影响分析）比纯 LLM 更快、更便宜、更可靠；作为 AI 代理的工具时，能以更低成本提升故障定位效果。
AI.conclusion: 本文论证了应将 AI 限制在可验证的翻译环节，而非端到端自主控制；通过构建可验证的网络模型并依赖求解器进行可靠推理，是更务实、更可靠的网络管理路径。

title: GNM Head: A Generative aNthropometric Model of the human head
comment: The GNM is publicly available at: https://github.com/google/GNM
summary: Parametric models of the human head are essential tools traditionally used in computer vision and graphics for animation, rendering, and reconstruction. More recently, they serve as crucial conditioning signals within generative large vision models, allowing for tight spatial control of generated imagery. However, existing publicly available models are typically limited in anatomical scope, modeling only outer geometry while ignoring intra-oral and ocular structures, and frequently suffer from reduced geometric quality stemming from low-fidelity input datasets. In this report we introduce a new parametric model dubbed Generative aNthropometric Model (GNM), named as a homophone of the human genome. GNM encompasses the head, face, neck, eyeballs, teeth, and tongue, and it is built on an extensive database of high-resolution 3D scans combined with high-quality anatomy specific artist-made samples. This report details the data provenance, the model architecture including the specialized sub-models for the ocular and intra-oral structures, and shows its SotA performance on fitting target 3D face scans. To foster community innovation, the complete GNM framework is made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为生成性人体测量模型(GNM)的新型参数化头部模型，它涵盖头部、面部、颈部、眼球、牙齿和舌头等完整解剖结构，基于高分辨率3D扫描和艺术家制作的样本构建，在拟合目标3D面部扫描方面达到SOTA性能，并已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有公开的人头参数化模型存在两大局限：一是解剖范围有限，仅建模外部几何，忽略了口腔内部和眼部结构；二是由于输入数据集保真度低，几何质量较差。同时，这些模型在生成式大视觉模型中作为条件信号时，需要更精确的空间控制能力。
AI.method: 基于大规模高分辨率3D扫描数据库，结合高质量解剖学专用的艺术家制作样本，构建了包含头部、面部、颈部、眼球、牙齿、舌头的完整参数化模型，并为眼部和口腔内部结构设计了专门的子模型。
AI.result: 在拟合目标3D面部扫描任务上达到了SOTA（最先进）性能，且完整框架已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: GNM模型通过扩展解剖范围和提升几何质量，为计算机视觉和图形学提供了更全面的头部参数化工具，同时作为生成式模型的 conditioning 信号，有望推动相关领域社区创新。

title: DP-IVON-Gradsq: Differentially Private Squared-Gradient Improved Variational Online Newton
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Machine Unlearning and Privacy Preservation (WIPE-OUT 2), held in conjunction with ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Differential privacy provides formal privacy guarantees for training neural networks on sensitive data, while Bayesian deep learning offers a principled framework for uncertainty-aware prediction. Combining these two objectives remains challenging, as privacy noise can interact with the stochasticity introduced by Bayesian posterior sampling. In this work, we investigate differentially private variational Bayesian learning through the Improved Variational Online Newton (IVON) optimizer. We introduce DP-IVON-Gradsq, a private variant of IVON. The proposed method constructs its curvature estimate from the privatized gradient using a noise-corrected squared-gradient estimator, reducing the direct interaction between posterior-sampling noise and privacy noise while preserving the Adam-like computational efficiency of IVON. We evaluate DP-IVON-Gradsq on CIFAR-10 against the standard private optimizers DP-SGD and DP-Adam over a range of privacy budgets. The results show that DP-IVON-Gradsq is competitive under weak-to-moderate privacy constraints, i.e., large-to-moderate values of $\varepsilon$, while degrading under strong privacy. Code is available at https://github.com/NourJamoussi/DP-IVON-Gradsq.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DP-IVON-Gradsq，一种结合差分隐私与贝叶斯深度学习的变分在线牛顿优化器变体，通过在私有化梯度上构建噪声校正的平方梯度估计器，减少后验采样噪声与隐私噪声的交互，在弱到中等隐私约束下表现出竞争力。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私保障神经网络训练隐私安全，贝叶斯深度学习提供不确定性量化框架，但两者结合时隐私噪声会与贝叶斯后验采样的随机性发生交互，带来挑战。
AI.method: 基于 IVON 优化器提出 DP-IVON-Gradsq，使用噪声校正的平方梯度估计器从私有化梯度中构建曲率估计，减少后验采样噪声与隐私噪声的直接交互，同时保持 Adam 类计算效率。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 上与 DP-SGD、DP-Adam 对比，DP-IVON-Gradsq 在弱到中等隐私约束（大到中等 ε 值）下表现有竞争力，在强隐私约束下性能下降。
AI.conclusion: DP-IVON-Gradsq 在较弱隐私保护场景下是可行的差分隐私贝叶斯学习方法，但强隐私场景仍需改进。

title: Share No More Than the Request Requires: Federated Disclosure for Perspective-Aware AI
summary: Modern AI systems bring societal risks such as mass surveillance, extreme concentrations of power, and loss of user autonomy---calling into question a model where third-parties collect and control massive amounts of user data. Users require a sovereign system to securely own, govern, and disclose their context while remaining compliant across regulated domains with strict provenance, interpretability, and policy adherence. Perspective-aware AI approaches this by transforming a user's aggregated personal data into a structured identity model called a \emph{Chronicle}: a temporal knowledge graph that represents and grows with the user. Chronicles support the secure disclosure of context across federated networks. A Chronicle holder may expose a queryable, authorized view that a third-party agent may consult without centralizing anyone's data. This paper explores the problem of minimum-necessary disclosure across domain boundaries: when a requester's agent queries a Chronicle, how can the system constrain its response to release only what the requester's relationship, stated purpose, and specific task require? We propose \textbf{Provenance Preserving Chronicles} (PPC), a federated protocol that compiles each holder's Chronicle into a compact \emph{authorized evidence subgraph} governed by one rule: \emph{share no more than the request requires}. Holders keep local sovereignty; an access controller projects relationship-aware views over domain-expert ontologies; and a two-phase flow returns provenance-linked text first, releasing raw artifacts only after explicit holder approval. We frame the problem, map gaps in blockchain, P2P, and holder-sovereign designs, define the core constructs, and sketch the protocol with an explicit threat model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Provenance Preserving Chronicles (PPC)协议，通过将用户个人数据转化为结构化的时间知识图谱Chronicle，并基于最小必要披露原则，实现跨域联邦网络中用户主权的安全上下文披露。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统存在大规模监控、权力集中、用户自主权丧失等社会风险，用户需要一种自主系统来安全拥有、治理和披露其个人数据，同时满足严格的溯源、可解释性和策略合规要求。
AI.method: PPC是一个联邦协议：将用户的Chronicle编译为紧凑的"授权证据子图"，遵循"请求所需即所披露"的规则；通过访问控制器投射基于关系视角的领域专家本体视图；采用两阶段流程先返回溯源关联文本，经用户明确批准后再释放原始数据工件。
AI.result: 界定了最小必要跨域披露的问题框架，映射了区块链、P2P和持有者主权设计中的现有空白，定义了核心构建模块，并给出了带明确威胁模型的协议草图。
AI.conclusion: PPC为跨域数据披露提供了一个兼顾用户主权与合规性的联邦协议方案，在保护用户自主权的同时实现了最小必要披露。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of SAM3 for Prompt-Driven Surgical Concept Segmentation
comment: Accepted by The 2nd MICCAI Workshop on Efficient Medical AI
summary: Efficient surgical segmentation empowers clinical diagnosis, intraoperative monitoring, and downstream robotic pipelines for reconstruction and simulation. Although prompt-driven foundation models like Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) achieve strong segmentation performance on natural images, surgical data exhibits domain gaps against its pre-training data, resulting in degraded segmentation accuracy. Furthermore, existing medical SAM methods require full-parameter fine-tuning, incurring heavy computational consumption and low efficiency. To address these limitations, this work proposes a parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adaptation of SAM3 for surgical concept segmentation. We inject low-rank adapters into the prompt encoder, detector and tracker while fully freezing the vision backbone, which only optimizes 0.98% of the total model parameters and supports training on a single consumer GPU. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms zero-shot SAM3 and other mainstream baselines, and the generated segmentation results can be directly deployed to support downstream robotic surgical scene reconstruction and physical simulation pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LoRA的参数高效微调方法，将SAM3适配到手术场景分割任务，仅优化0.98%参数即可在单张消费级GPU上训练，显著优于零样本SAM3及其他基线方法，并可直接支撑下游机器人手术场景重建与物理仿真。
AI.motivation: SAM3在自然图像上表现优异，但手术数据存在域差异导致分割精度下降；现有医学SAM方法需要全参数微调，计算开销大、效率低。
AI.method: 对SAM3的提示编码器、检测器和跟踪器注入低秩适配器（LoRA），同时完全冻结视觉骨干网络，仅优化0.98%的总模型参数。
AI.result: 该方法在手术概念分割上 consistently 优于零样本SAM3及其他主流基线，且分割结果可直接用于下游机器人手术场景重建与物理仿真。
AI.conclusion: LoRA适配SAM3是一种高效且有效的手术分割方案，在极低参数量微调下即可实现强性能，并具备下游任务实用价值。

title: Breaking the Total Variance Barrier: Sharp Sample Complexity for Linear Heteroscedastic Bandits with Fixed Action Set
summary: Recent years have witnessed increasing interests in tackling heteroscedastic noise in bandits and reinforcement learning. In these works, the cumulative variance of the noise $Λ= \sum_{t=1}^T σ_t^2$, where $σ_t^2$ is the variance of the noise at round $t$, is used to characterize the statistical complexity of the problem, yielding \emph{simple regret} bounds of order $\tilde{\cal{O}}(d \sqrt{Λ/ T^2})$ for $d$-dimensional linear bandits with heteroscedastic noise. However, with a closer look, $Λ$ remains the same order even if the noise is close to zero at half of the rounds, which indicates that the $Λ$-dependence is not optimal. In this paper, we revisit the stochastic linear bandit problem with heteroscedastic noise, where the action set is prefixed throughout the learning process. We propose a novel variance-adaptive algorithm \texttt{VAEE} (Variance-Aware Exploration with Elimination) for large action set, which actively explores actions that maximizes the information gain among a candidate set of actions that are not eliminated. With the active-exploration strategy, we show that \texttt{VAEE} achieves a \emph{simple regret} with a nearly \emph{harmonic-mean} dependent rate. For finitely many actions, we propose a variance-aware variant of G-optimal design based exploration, which achieves a simple regret with sharper dependence on $d$. We also establish a nearly matching lower bound for the fixed action set setting indicating that \emph{harmonic-mean} dependent rate is unavoidable. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that breaks the $\sqrtΛ$ barrier for stochastic linear bandits with heteroscedastic noise.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异方差噪声下的随机线性赌博机问题，提出了一种方差感知的主动探索算法VAEE，实现了基于调和均值的简单遗憾界，首次突破了$\sqrtΛ$的界限。
AI.motivation: 现有异方差噪声研究中使用累积方差Λ刻画统计复杂度，但Λ在噪声一半接近零时仍保持不变，说明其依赖不是最优的。本文旨在突破这一界限，实现更紧的遗憾界。
AI.method: 提出方差感知消除探索算法(VAEE)，对大规模动作集主动探索能最大化信息增益的动作；对有限动作集提出基于方差感知的G-optimal设计探索方法。
AI.result: VAEE实现了基于调和均值的简单遗憾率，在有限动作集下获得了对维度d更紧的依赖，并给出了接近匹配的下界。
AI.conclusion: 首次在异方差线性赌博机中打破$\sqrtΛ$障碍，证明了调和均值依赖率的不可避免性。

title: ConsistencyGate: Preventing Memory Contamination in LLM Agents via Self-Consistency Admission Control
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables, 1 algorithm; includes appendices
summary: LLM agents that operate over many turns accumulate facts in an external memory store and reuse them as premises for downstream reasoning. A hallucinated fact written at one step therefore persists as a false premise for every subsequent step, a failure mode we call memory contamination. Existing memory management addresses retrieval and capacity but not write-time correctness; this admission problem cannot be solved by utility- or recency-based criteria, and uncontrolled contamination compounds across long trajectories. We propose ConsistencyGate, a write-time admission gate that, before committing a candidate fact m extracted from context c, queries the LLM K times for a soft support score and admits m only when the average exceeds a threshold. The mechanism is model-agnostic, requires no fine-tuning, and reduces to a single forward pass in a log-probability variant for latency-sensitive deployments. To measure the effect on natural data, we construct two real-conversation benchmarks (LoCoMo-Contam and MSC-Contam) by planting controlled single-detail corruptions in long-term conversations from LoCoMo and MSC, and complement them with a structured synthetic corpus (MemContam) that isolates a near-oracle upper bound. Across four LLM backbones, ConsistencyGate reduces contamination on every benchmark relative to a write-everything baseline, with the cost concentrated on facts that are stated only implicitly in the source context. We release all three benchmarks together with the gate implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConsistencyGate，一种在写入内存前通过多次LLM查询验证事实一致性的门控机制，有效减少长对话中LLM Agent的"记忆污染"问题。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent在长对话中会将幻觉事实写入外部记忆，这些错误事实会作为后续推理的错误前提持续存在（记忆污染），现有记忆管理只关注检索和容量，未解决写入时的正确性问题。
AI.method: 提出ConsistencyGate写入准入机制：在将候选事实写入记忆前，多次查询LLM获取软支持分数，仅当平均分超过阈值时才允许写入。支持对数概率变体以降低延迟，无需微调，模型无关。
AI.result: 在四个LLM骨干网络上，ConsistencyGate在所有基准测试中均降低了记忆污染。代价是那些仅在源上下文中隐含陈述的事实被拒绝写入。同时构建了LoCoMo-Contam、MSC-Contam和MemContam三个基准数据集。
AI.conclusion: ConsistencyGate是一种有效的记忆污染防御机制，通过写入前的多次一致性验证来筛选事实，可在不依赖微调的情况下提升长对话LLM Agent的可靠性。

title: DAP-Pose: Deep Temporal Alignment and Physics-aware Cross-modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Pose Estimation
summary: Robust and accurate pose estimation with multi-modal sensors is fundamental for autonomous vehicles and mobile robotic systems in complex environments. In this paper, we propose DAP-Pose, a unified end-to-end model for robust multi-modal pose estimation. DAP-Pose introduces a Bi-level Cross-modal Fusion (BCF) module that captures complementary semantic and geometric motion cues from visual, inertial, and GNSS measurements. To handle temporal offsets, we designed a Deep Temporal Alignment (DTA) module that explicitly aligns asynchronous streams in latent space, enabling coherent motion modeling without strict hardware synchronization. Furthermore, we incorporate physics-aware constraints via manifold geometry and GNSS-guided absolute metric scale, enforcing motion consistency and mitigating drift. Experiments upon the public KITTI benchmark dataset were conducted to evaluate the performance of DAP-Pose against existing methods. DAP-Pose achieved the state-of-the-art performance, with the lowest average translation error ($t_{rel}$) of 1.31% and rotation error ($r_{rel}$) of 0.46$^{\circ}$. Furthermore, it accurately estimates poses and maintains robust performance under severe artificially injected temporal misalignment.

AI.tldr: DAP-Pose是一个统一端到端多模态位姿估计模型，通过双层级跨模态融合、深度时间对齐和物理感知约束，在KITTI数据集上实现了最先进的位姿估计精度（平移误差1.31%，旋转误差0.46°），并在时间未对齐条件下保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态位姿估计方法在多传感器融合时面临两大挑战：一是视觉、惯性、GNSS等异构传感器存在时间偏移，硬件同步成本高；二是缺乏对语义与几何互补信息的有效利用，导致运动漂移累积。因此需要一种无需严格硬件同步、能融合多模态互补信息且具有物理一致性的统一位姿估计模型。
AI.method: 提出DAP-Pose统一端到端框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 双层级跨模态融合模块，捕捉视觉、惯性、GNSS的互补语义与几何运动线索；(2) 深度时间对齐模块，在隐空间中显式对齐异步多模态流；(3) 引入流形几何约束和GNSS导引的绝对度量尺度，实现物理感知的运动一致性约束，减少漂移。
AI.result: 在KITTI数据集上达到最先进性能：平均平移误差1.31%、旋转误差0.46°；在人为注入严重时间未对齐条件下仍能保持准确的位姿估计和鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: DAP-Pose通过双层级跨模态融合、深度时间对齐与物理感知约束的统一框架，有效解决了多模态位姿估计中的时间异步和漂移问题，验证了其在复杂环境下兼顾精度与鲁棒性的有效性。

title: Extreme Volatility Warning under Label Scarcity via Multi-Source Anomaly Fusion
summary: Early warning of extreme market volatility is central to financial risk management, but actionable events are rare, nonstationary, and often triggered by exogenous information shocks. In our CSI~300 setting, only $\sim$80 positive samples are observed across 791 training days, making heavily supervised multi-source models unstable. We first analyze a 100K-parameter hierarchical text-signal fusion model (HTSF) and find that added parameterization hurts in this low-label regime. Motivated by this failure, we propose \textbf{AAMSF} (Anomaly-Augmented Multi-Signal Fusion), a semisupervised framework that combines Isolation Forest anomaly scores over market indicators, GDELT events, Chinese financial news, and English media with lightweight Ridge score fusion. We further introduce \textbf{T-AAMSF}, a temporal extension for multi-day anomaly accumulation. On CSI~300 (2018--2023), AAMSF achieves test AUC-ROC \textbf{0.680}, outperforming the strongest unsupervised baseline (0.630) and neural baseline (0.588), while T-AAMSF improves PR-AUC to 0.291. Ablations reveal strong source asymmetry: GDELT and domestic financial news provide complementary risk signals, whereas English media consistently reduces performance, and learned weighting is unreliable under validation noise. These results suggest an empirical design principle for label-scarce financial risk warning: robust anomaly geometry and source reliability can matter more than supervised representation capacity.

AI.tldr: 针对金融极端波动预警中标签稀缺（CSI 300仅80个正样本）的问题，本文提出半监督框架AAMSF，用Isolation Forest异常分数融合市场指标、GDELT事件、中外新闻等多源信号，在ROC-AUC（0.680）上显著超越全监督基线（0.588）和无监督基线（0.630），并揭示源不对称性等设计原则。
AI.motivation: 极端市场波动预警对风险管理至关重要，但正样本极其稀缺（CSI 300中791个训练日仅约80个正样本）、非平稳且常由外生信息冲击触发，导致全监督多源融合模型在此低标签场景下不稳定、参数化反而有害。
AI.method: 先分析10万参数的层次化文本信号融合模型（HTSF），发现低标签下增加参数化反而损害性能。进而提出AAMSF：用Isolation Forest对市场指标、GDELT事件、中国金融新闻、英文媒体分别计算异常分数，再通过轻量级Ridge回归融合分数；并扩展为T-AAMSF实现多日异常累积。
AI.result: 在CSI 300（2018-2023）上，AAMSF的测试AUC-ROC达0.680，优于最强无监督基线（0.630）和神经基线（0.588）；T-AAMSF将PR-AUC提升至0.291。消融实验显示GDELT和国内新闻互补，英文媒体持续降低性能，学习权重在验证噪声下不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 对于标签稀缺的金融风险预警，鲁棒的异常几何结构和源可靠性比监督表示能力更重要，提出了一个经验性设计原则。

title: Reason Popper-ly: Patching In-Context Reasoning with Inductive Logic Programming
comment: Accepted at the 20th Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting enables large language models (LLMs) to tackle multi-step reasoning tasks, yet the generated intermediate steps are not guaranteed to be logically sound. We present Reason Popper-ly, a neurosymbolic framework that uses inductive logic programming (ILP) to learn relation composition rules from reasoning traces and deploys them as an online verifier for step-level correction. Given an LLM-generated trace, the method checks each inferred step against the learned rule table, diagnoses the violation type, rewrites incorrect steps with symbolically derived repairs, and regenerates the remaining suffix so that the model can produce its final answer conditioned on a verified trace. We evaluate on CLUTRR, a multi-hop kinship reasoning benchmark, using five language models over reasoning chains of 2 to 10 hops. Across all models, Reason Popper-ly consistently improves terminal accuracy over standard CoT, with gains of up to 48 percentage points for small models and 15 points for frontier models on the longest chains. Compared with a fully exogenous symbolic pipeline, our method performs better on harder instances by preserving the model's successful grounding while correcting only verifiable reasoning failures. In addition, step-level ILP verification yields a fine-grained error taxonomy that provides diagnostic insight beyond final-answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了Reason Popper-ly，一个结合归纳逻辑编程（ILP）的神经符号框架，用于验证和修正大语言模型在链式推理中生成的中间步骤，在CLUTRR任务上显著提升了推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 标准CoT提示生成的中间推理步骤不能保证逻辑正确性，导致最终答案可能出错。需要一种机制来检测并修正这些逻辑错误，而不完全依赖模型自身的自我修正能力。
AI.method: 使用归纳逻辑编程（ILP）从推理轨迹中学习关系组合规则，构建在线验证器。对LLM生成的每一步推理进行检查，诊断违规类型，用符号推导的修复重写错误步骤，然后重新生成后续部分，使模型基于验证过的推理链生成最终答案。
AI.result: 在CLUTRR多跳亲属关系推理基准上，使用5种语言模型在2到10跳推理链上测试。所有模型上均优于标准CoT，小模型最长链上准确率提升高达48个百分点，前沿模型提升15个百分点。在困难实例上优于纯外源符号管线。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法可以有效弥补纯LLM推理的逻辑漏洞，步级ILP验证不仅提升准确率，还能提供细粒度错误分类，为诊断提供超越最终答案准确率的洞察。

title: RoadVGGT: Road-Structure-Aware Feed-Forward Road Surface Reconstruction
summary: Large-scale road surface reconstruction supports high-definition mapping, autonomous-driving perception, annotation, and simulation. Existing road-specialized optimization methods can produce high-quality road representations, but they typically require per-scene training and scene-dependent coverage design around the driving trajectory, limiting scalable reconstruction over newly collected roads.
